jobs.title: Manager, Controls and Governance
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

This role focuses on strengthening OKX US' first line of defense while serving as the primary operational engine and bridge between the US business and control functions. Operating in a highly fluid environment, this position bridges the gap between hands-on internal controls and strategic US market execution.

You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with control functions across every aspect of the US business, from managing KYC/KYB onboarding pipelines and marketing content reviews to leading US executive reporting and customer support alignment. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, moves comfortably between granular risk management and growth strategy, and elevates organizational maturity to sustain OKX’s growth, integrity, and regulatory excellence.

What You’ll Be Doing

Controls Partnership & Operational Strategy

• KYC / KYB Pipeline & Remediation: Support Compliance-managed KYC and KYB onboarding pipelines, identifying friction points, accelerating throughput between business units and Compliance, and resolving operational friction.

• Risk Governance and Coordination: Serve as the key liaison to the US Risk organization, providing assistance in the monitoring of KRIs and the implementation of the risk framework.

• Customer-Facing Content Governance: Lead the cross-functional workflow for Compliance and Legal reviews of growth assets, including marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional materials, and client communications.

• Client Support & Compliance Alignment: Partner closely with Client Support and Compliance to streamline escalated customer workflows, ensure client support operations reflect regulatory requirements, and resolve customer-impacting compliance bottlenecks.

• Controls Product Management: Work with Legal, Compliance, and Risk to understand key risks associated with new product launches, and utilize relationships with Product to promote innovation and product delivery.

Local Market Governance

• Executive Reporting: Lead and coordinate reporting for executive meeting cadences, including soliciting updates and insight from business and control leads to present a cohesive view of US market performance and opportunities.

• Policy & Procedures: Support the drafting and upkeep of operational policies and procedures. Prepare regular risk, control, and operational performance reporting for senior leadership.

• First-Line Defense Leadership: Represent business operations in first-line risk management activities, supporting RCSAs, maintaining risk registers, and ensuring control effectiveness.

What We Look For In You

• Experience: 3+ years of progressive experience in Strategic Operations, Program Management, Compliance Operations, Governance, or Risk Management within fintech, crypto/web3, or heavily regulated financial services.

• Fluidity & Growth Mindset: A "builder" mindset with high comfort in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments. Ability to pivot smoothly from tactical execution (tracking pipeline bottlenecks) to strategic alignment (launching new market initiatives).

• Incident & Process Acumen: Proven track record leading cross-departmental incident response, mapping workflows, and executing post-incident remediation.

• Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Superior written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships across control and first line teams.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs for employees' growth and development

• Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Government Affairs Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.




ABOUT THE SUMMER INTERNSHIP PROGRAM

Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater.

Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else.

We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer.

 

We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules:

Cohort #1

Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13

Cohort #2

Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10

 

All internship roles are based at one of our offices (Torrance/Idaho Falls/Washington D.C.) and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements.

Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package if eligible.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Antares Nuclear is seeking a highly motivated and resourceful Government Affairs Intern to support the company's government affairs, communications, international business development, and commercial business development efforts from our Washington, D.C. office.

This position offers a unique opportunity to work on emerging national security and energy policy issues while helping advance the commercialization and international deployment of next-generation nuclear technology. The intern will support research, stakeholder engagement, strategic planning, and business development initiatives, working closely with Antares leadership and cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is an excellent writer and researcher, has a strong interest in national security, energy, public policy, or emerging technologies, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where initiative and attention to detail are essential.




ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Monitor congressional activity, federal legislation, appropriations, defense authorization, and executive branch initiatives relevant to advanced nuclear energy and microreactor deployment.

 - Research and analyze policy developments across the Pentagon, Department of Energy, Department of State, Department of Commerce, NASA, and other relevant federal agencies.

 - Assist in preparing briefing materials, talking points, policy memoranda, presentations, and other materials for meetings with government officials and congressional offices.

 - Track engagement with congressional offices, federal agencies, military services, and other key stakeholders.

 - Identify opportunities to advance policies, programs, and funding initiatives that support microreactor deployment for national security and commercial applications.

 - Support the development of strategic communications materials that articulate Antares’ mission, technology, and value proposition to government, commercial, and international audiences.

 - Draft and edit executive talking points, briefing materials, presentation content, website copy, and other communications products.

 - Monitor media coverage, industry developments, and public discourse related to advanced nuclear energy, national security, and microreactor deployment.

 - Help translate complex technical and policy issues into clear, accessible messages tailored to different audiences, including policymakers, prospective customers, strategic partners, and the general public.

 - Assist in developing communications strategies for key company milestones, government announcements, industry events, and strategic partnerships.

 - Identify opportunities to raise awareness of Antares’ work through relevant publications, industry forums, conferences, and other external channels.

 - Research international markets and identify countries, government agencies, utilities, defense organizations, and other prospective customers for Antares microreactors.

 - Assess country-level opportunities based on energy demand, national security priorities, regulatory frameworks, financing mechanisms, and government support for nuclear energy.

 - Support engagement with U.S. embassies, the State Department, the Foreign Commercial Service, international partners, and prospective overseas customers.

 - Research foreign government procurement processes, export requirements, financing options, and other factors affecting international reactor deployment.

 - Prepare country profiles, market assessments, customer briefings, and presentations to support Antares' international growth strategy.

 - Identify prospective commercial customers and strategic partners across sectors such as data centers, critical infrastructure, industrial facilities, remote power systems, and other energy-intensive applications.

 - Research customer power requirements, market dynamics, competing energy technologies, and potential use cases for microreactors.

 - Assist with developing customer presentations, market analyses, business cases, and strategic partnership proposals.

 - Maintain and update business development pipelines, stakeholder databases, and opportunity trackers.

 - Support preparation for customer meetings, industry conferences, and strategic partner engagements.




BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in public policy, international relations, political science, economics, business, engineering, energy policy, or a related field.

 - Strong research, analytical, and written communication skills.

 - Demonstrated interest in national security, energy, emerging technologies, international affairs, or commercial strategy.

 - Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise briefings and recommendations.

 - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.

 - A proactive, intellectually curious approach and willingness to take ownership of assignments.




PREFERRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

 - Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to manage sensitive matters and competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience with congressional offices, federal agencies, think tanks, political campaigns, consulting, or business development.

 - Familiarity with U.S. national security policy, federal appropriations, international trade, or the energy sector.

 - Experience conducting market research, developing presentations, or preparing policy and business memoranda.

 - Foreign language proficiency or international experience.




ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

 - Ability to travel as needed for government, regulator, supplier, customer, and international partner engagements.

 - Ability to support time-sensitive milestones or incidents outside standard business hours when necessary.




LOCATION

 - We are located in downtown Washington, DC in a space designed for team collaboration and easy access to Capitol Hill, federal government offices, foreign embassies, and DC-based think tanks.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Mid-Market - EMEA
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN SALES AT ASHBY

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love https://www.ashbyhq.com/customers during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby, including OpenAI, Doctolib, Bolt, Mistral and Monday.com http://Monday.com, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/series-d, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

Nearly 1 in 3 of Ashby’s globally distributed team call Europe home! We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~24% of our global revenue base, spread across UKI, DACH, France & the rest of the region. Clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader https://www.ashbyhq.com/ai in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/how-we-think-about-sales-quotas-and-incentives-at-ashby, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say https://www.repvue.com/companies/Ashby about working here.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/4ea5f68e-c33e-4ac9-831a-e732bee4a303/8f9d2fd6-1fd4-49d9-81a2-b66850fd33fd/image.png]
 


ABOUT ASHBY

We’re building the next generation of enterprise software and we’re starting with a suite of products that empower talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers to be a driving force for revenue & efficiency via a holistic, data-centric talent strategy. Some of our recent highlights include:

 - Raised series D last year & growing ARR >100% YoY, both Globally and in EMEA.

 - Over 5,000 amazing global customers including some of the fastest growing EMEA Mid Market logos like Synthesia (UK), Camunda (Germany) & Alan.com http://Alan.com (FR).

 - Rapidly moving up-market with no signs of slowing down.

 - Implemented AI https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/recruiting/ai-assisted-application-review-in-practice throughout the platform - Known for our pace of innovation and advanced analytics

 - We have a clear buyer persona and large target market. Plus, we already have multiple products to sell. Revenue is growing >100% Y/Y and we've only taken the first steps towards a much larger opportunity. In short, it's the perfect time to join! 🚀


ABOUT THIS ROLE

We are seeking an experienced SaaS Sales Manager in EMEA to lead our Mid-Market Sales Team; which serves the 101-1,000 FTE market. There are three primary responsibilities that this sales leader will take on:

 1. Be accountable for the revenue results of the segment. Understand the primary revenue drivers for the segment, focus your team's energy on high-impact activities, and partner with Marketing on pipeline generating initiatives.

 2. Provide consistent coaching to enable all Account Executives to achieve their full potential. Identify themes for improvement with individuals and at the team level. Help reps grow in their sales career.

 3. Make high quality hires in lock step with market demand. In general we believe that smaller, high caliber teams can achieve remarkable results.

In this role, you’ll report to our Head of Sales, EMEA (Jack Hanratty https://www.linkedin.com/in/hanrattyjack/) and have a significant impact in defining our go-to-market strategy. The best part about Mid-Market is the combination of high velocity and high value deals and we're already very good at winning both. If we are even moderately successful relative to our ambition, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years.




YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - 💰 You’ve managed a team of Account Executives delivering multi-million ARR/yr at a growth-stage SaaS company.

 - 🥇 You have a proven track record of hiring and onboarding new Account Executives who quickly become top performers. You challenge and support them to continue to grow their careers.

 - 🌎 You have experience managing sales teams in the DACH, French and/or across EMEA markets.

 - 👩‍🏫 You’re a teacher and a coach who loves helping reps hone their craft. You can quickly identify skill or knowledge gaps and deliver coaching that is empathetic and drives tangible improvement.

 - 📊 You have a strong mental model for what sales excellence looks like. At the same time, you're a lifelong learner and are open to new ideas and experimentation.

 - 🤝 You are comfortable jumping into deals to establish executive relationships with customers. You do so without ‘boxing out’ your team.

 - ⚙️ You have an operational mindset and have identified bottlenecks and implemented solutions to accelerate deal flow. You love working with Revenue Ops to continually refine processes and tools.

 - 🤓 You become a product and industry expert. You connect the dots quickly. Customers and your team trust you to provide practical advice and relevant stories.


BONUS

 - You were a high performing Enterprise AE and have upmarket deal strategy experience

 - You have sold complex platform applications to Talent and/or People leaders

 - You are fluent in German and/or French


YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF:

 - You're a dashboard-and-forecast manager who doesn't like to get into the deals and daily operations

 - You're not keen on learning about our substantial product. "That's for SEs" isn't how we approach things here.

 - Your sole experience is in the UKI market.


OUR PHILOSOPHY

Here are a few key points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

 - We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals

 - We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the TA space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience

 - We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best product makes winning new customers easier

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over decades of experience, and thoughtful & clear communication both internally and with customers.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those in a practical exercise. We'll provide you with some Ashby-specific data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our business and solutions engineering involvement. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

 1. Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Recruiting to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution

 2. Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Jack (Head of Sales, EMEA) through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the leader you are today

 3. Presentation (1 hr) - We’ll give you some Ashby data, and have you present a perspective on our business and your approach to sales leadership.

 4. Final Round (2 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with cross-functional interviewers




BENEFITS

 - A product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about https://www.ashbyhq.com/customers

 - Competitive salary, commission and equity.

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission is to catalyze innovations that solve global problems and improve the lives of the world’s poorest people. We do this by incubating products, advocating for important causes, engaging with global organizations, and managing venture investments.

Gates Ventures is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Health & Life Sciences (HLS) team operates three practice areas – a. advisory role and learning agenda b. US Healthcare, and C. Alzheimer’s disease-focused investments. Within the scope of Alzheimer’s disease-focused investments, Gates Ventures focuses on five pillars: 1. Upstream research, 2. Biomarkers/diagnostics, 3. Therapeutics pipeline, 4. Clinical trial bottlenecks and 5. Enabling data sharing and use.

Our Alzheimer’s Data pillar goal is to fundamentally transform Alzheimer’s disease research, accelerating progress toward new treatments and cures for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) by leveraging data and platform interoperability to create a global user community.

Our data pillar’s product suite is designed to remove barriers of siloed, non-interoperable data, establish an environment to enable digital innovation at scale for ADRD research, and deliver on the organization’s program objectives more effectively and collaboratively. Examples include the Alzheimer’s Data Initiative’s AD Workbench (ADWB), our secure cloud-based data platform, and the Federated and Distributed Data Sharing Appliance (FDSA), which enables access to previously unreachable datasets. The latest additions to our product suite include the Global Research and Imaging Platform (GRIP), an open-access, white-label, end-to-end solution for data owners/contributors as well as the users.

Additionally, we established the Global Neurodegeneration Proteomics Consortium (GNPC) in 2023, a neurodegenerative disease biomarker discovery effort uniting and expanding the available molecular “fingerprinting” data for thousands of patient samples across dozens of different dementia and population cohorts, including healthy aging, Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), and frontotemporal dementia (FTD).

POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for a Senior Manager to design, build and support the AI Applications Platform & Interoperability — from discovery through architecture through delivery, working closely with other members of the Product & Engineering org.

This is a hybrid role for someone equally comfortable in front of a research partner translating an ambiguous need into a feature specification, and in front of an architecture review defending a design decision on cost, security, or performance standpoint. You'll sit at the intersection of product strategy and technical execution for a platform that serves research partners, data scientists, and AI-powered applications — with accountability and authority that comes from assisting with the product roadmap and delivering the features.

The person must be comfortable operating in a startup environment, with a strong focus on customer and partner requirements and meticulous attention to detail to ensure products are built in a cost-sustainable manner. Experience leading remote teams, managing engineering sprints and outcomes, and guiding product managers in developing clear specifications is required. Clear, concise written and verbal communication with both executive and engineering stakeholders is critical to success. A growth mindset, strong accountability, and the ability to learn quickly while consistently delivering results are essential

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead and grow a remote team of engineers to deliver on the AI features

• Run engineering sprints and delivery rhythms, own outcomes across the path from spec to build to release and hold the team accountable for quality and timelines.

• Coach product managers to write clear, testable specifications.

• Build a culture of accountability, fast learning, attention to detail and continuous improvement suited to a startup pace.

• Own the roadmap for the AI Applications Platform and interoperability layer, working with the CPTO and product leaders to set priorities that match organizational goals and partner needs.

• Lead discovery with research partners, data scientists and internal teams, and turn unclear needs into clear problem statements, requirements and feature specifications.

• Set and track success metrics for adoption, reliability, cost and partner satisfaction, and use them to guide iteration.

• Influence the platform architecture for Azure keeping design patterns to extend AWS/GCP /on premises when needed, containerized services (Kubernetes/AKS), API and service design, and interoperability standards.

• Influence and deliver the architecture for AI/LLM integration, including model selection, inference patterns, agent and workflow orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.

• Present and defend design decisions in architecture reviews, weighing cost, security, performance and scalability.

• With Cost stewardship governance, keep infrastructure and inference costs sustainable by modeling the unit economics of key architecture choices.

• Track cloud and AI spend, find ways to optimize it, and build cost awareness into specs and design reviews.

REQUIRED SKILLS

• Demonstrated engineering/technical leadership and co-leading product management, with at least 3+ years managing engineers or technical teams directly in a fast-paced environment shipping features.

• Demonstrated experience in building a product roadmap end-to-end — from partner/customer discovery through spec, build, and iteration

• Hands-on architectural fluency: comfortable making and defending decisions on cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerized services (Kubernetes/AKS), authentication and multi-tenant isolation patterns, and API/service design

• Direct experience with AI/LLM-powered applications — model integration patterns, inference cost drivers, agent or workflow architectures — and a point of view on where AI adds real product value versus novelty

• A track record of cost-conscious infrastructure decisions — you can talk fluently about the relationship between architecture choices and unit economics

• Strong stakeholder management skills; experience being in a CPTO org, working with program managers, or equivalent cross-functional leadership Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a spec, defend an architecture decision, and brief an executive in the same week

• Bonus: experience in a regulated, research, healthcare, or scientific-data domain, where privacy, data governance, and partner trust are first-order product constraints

QUALIFICATIONS OR RELATED EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Bioinformatics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is a plus.

• Experience building or running research data platforms, such as secure data environments, trusted research environments (TREs), data commons, or federated analysis systems.

• Hands-on exposure to the modern AI stack, such as Azure OpenAI or other model providers, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector stores, LLM evaluation and observability tooling, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

• Experience managing distributed or vendor/partner engineering teams across time zones.

• Experience with Agile delivery and engineering tooling, such as Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Bicep).

Bonus:

• Experience working in mission-driven organizations or with high-profile stakeholders.

• Experience in life sciences, ideally neuroscience or Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD).

COMPENSATION/TERMS

This is a contracted tole. The salary range for this position is $225,000 to $235,000 per year. Offers will vary depending on several factors, including education, experience, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Alzheimer’s Disease Data Initiative is a coalition of leading academic, advocacy, government, industry, and philanthropy organizations that recognizes the need for dementia researchers to find easier ways to share unpublished data, analytical tools, and scientific findings. These partners are working together to accelerate progress towards new diagnostics, treatments, and cures in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD).

In 2020, the AD Data Initiative publicly launched a non-profit organization to implement the mission of the AD Data Initiative coalition and lead us to a future where open data and global collaboration power the end of ADRD.

The AD Data Initiative removes silos by unlocking important ADRD datasets, enabling seamless access to interoperable data sharing platforms, empowering researchers and fostering collaboration to accelerate new breakthroughs.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Alzheimer's Disease Workbench (AD Workbench), our secure, cloud-based data platform for ADRD research. You'll be accountable for AD Workbench end to end setting the roadmap, staying close to the researchers and partners who use it, keeping the platform healthy and cost-sustainable, and working closely with the Product & Engineering org to deliver what users need next.

This role sits at the intersection of user’s satisfaction, operations, and product. You'll know AD Workbench users deeply, bring clarity to fuzzy requirements, and carry the voice of the user into every product decision. You'll serve as the day-to-day owner of the AD Workbench partner relationship and oversee platform support delivered by our application management services (AMS) team. You won't work tickets yourself; instead, you'll bring the context behind each request and the judgment to confirm the team is focused on what matters most to users.

The right person is comfortable operating in a startup environment, pairs a strong customer focus with meticulous attention to detail, and treats cost as a product requirement. Clear, concise written and verbal communication with both executive and engineering stakeholders is critical to success, as is the habit of tracking and following up without being asked. A growth mindset, strong accountability, and the ability to learn quickly while consistently delivering results are essential.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

What you'll own

• Own the AD Workbench product roadmap end to end, leading quarterly and monthly goal setting and sign-off, and balancing near-term user needs against long-term platform scalability and clinical validity.

• Translate researcher and partner needs into a prioritized backlog, and make the call on trade-offs when engineering capacity, data governance requirements, and customer timelines pull in different directions.

• Drive high Net Satisfaction among existing and new users and partners and track it alongside adoption and platform health to guide iteration.

Users & partners

• Know AD Workbench users deeply: surface their pain points, bring clarity to fuzzy requirements, and act to close the gap between what the platform does today and what users need it to do.

• Field user questions and issues promptly, resolve what you can, and escalate early and clearly when you can't.

• Bring the voice of the user into product decisions, from backlog prioritization to roadmap reviews.

• Serve as the day-to-day owner of the AD Workbench partner relationship.

Platform support & costs

• Own the day-to-day health of AD Workbench support: review the incoming queue daily, understand what is breaking and why, and make sure nothing sits unattended.

• Partner with the AMS team that handles day-to-day support, bringing the context behind each request and confirming the team is prioritizing what matters most to users.

• Understand what AD Workbench costs to run and what drives those costs; keep spending within budget, monitor for unexpected spikes, and raise them promptly rather than letting them compound.

Internal coordination

• Keep leadership current on platform health, risks, and upcoming decisions, clearly and concisely, without needing to be asked.

• Act as the primary point of contact for internal communications on AD Workbench, tracking open items and following up through to resolution.

• Work closely with engineering to keep AD Workbench stable as the product evolves, providing additional detail and context on requirements when needed.

REQUIRED SKILLS

• 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a data, cloud, or SaaS platform used by technical or research audiences.

• Demonstrated experience owning a product roadmap end to end, from user and partner discovery through prioritization, delivery, and iteration, and making clear trade-off decisions under competing constraints.

• Strong customer and partner orientation: able to turn ambiguous feedback into clear problem statements and requirements, and to manage partner relationships day to day.

• Experience overseeing production support or operations, ideally through a managed service (AMS) or vendor team: triaging issues, setting priorities, and holding teams to service levels.

• Cloud cost fluency: understanding what drives platform spend, monitoring it against budget, and acting quickly on anomalies.

• Sufficient technical fluency to work credibly with engineering on cloud platforms (Azure preferred), data access and security controls, and API/service design.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to brief executives clearly and concisely and to give engineering the detail and context it needs.

• Strong organizational discipline: tracking commitments, following up, and closing loops across multiple stakeholders.

• Bonus: experience in a regulated, research, healthcare, or scientific-data domain, where privacy, data governance, and partner trust are first-order product constraints.

QUALIFICATIONS OR RELATED EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, bioinformatics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is a plus.

• Experience managing or supporting research data platforms, such as secure data environments, trusted research environments (TREs), data commons, or federated analysis systems.

• Experience working with managed service providers or vendor engineering teams, including SLA-based support models and ticketing tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk).

• Experience with cloud cost management and FinOps practices, such as Azure Cost Management, budgeting, and spend alerting.

• Experience measuring user satisfaction (e.g., Net Satisfaction, NPS, CSAT) and using it to drive product decisions.

• Experience with Agile delivery and product tooling, such as Azure DevOps, Jira, and product analytics or user-feedback tools.

Bonus:

• Experience working in mission-driven organizations or with high-profile stakeholders.

• Experience in life sciences, ideally neuroscience or Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD).

COMPENSATION/TERMS

This is a contracted role. The salary range for this position is $200,000 to $210,000 per year. Offers will vary depending on several factors, including education, experience, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Mission Engineer II - Grand Rapids
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable. As a Mission Engineer II, you'll work directly alongside public safety agencies to turn real operational challenges into working technical solutions.

You'll spend time with the people doing the work, understand how the agency operates, identify problems worth solving, and use Axon tools, AI, automation, data, and the broader Axon ecosystem to build against them.

Building is the core of the role, but customer needs come first. Because you're embedded with the agency, you'll also become a go-to technical resource who understands their Axon environment and helps them navigate critical needs when they arise. You may help quarterback an upcoming deployment, coordinate a complex technical issue, or connect the right Axon teams around an agency priority.

You won't replace Support, Deployment, Product, or other teams. You'll bring technical continuity, help connect the dots, and use what you learn to identify the next opportunity to build something better. Mission Engineers don't measure success by activity. They measure it by what gets built, what gets used, and what changes because of it.

What You’ll Do

Location: On Site with travel
Reports To: Manager or Senior Manager of Mission Engineering

Discover the Mission

• Embed with assigned agencies to understand their mission, people, workflows, systems, and priorities.

• Develop broad knowledge of the Axon ecosystem and deeper expertise in the products deployed at your agency.

• Work with frontline users, technical teams, and agency leadership to uncover operational friction.

• Translate customer problems into clear technical requirements and measurable success criteria.

• Identify opportunities for AI, automation, data, and Axon capabilities to improve how the agency operates.

• Understand what the customer needs—not simply what they initially ask for.

Build With the Platform

• Build applications, dashboards, workflows, automations, and using Axon products and other approved Axon tools.

• Apply foundational software engineering concepts including APIs, data structures, scripting, testing, debugging, and version control.

• Use AI and AI-assisted development tools responsibly within Axon's approved development and security environment.

• Configure and extend capabilities across Axon's technology ecosystem.

• Understand when you can solve the problem yourself and when deeper Product or Engineering partnership is required.

• Build with Axon—not around it.

Transform Builds Into Outcomes

• Move solutions from discovery into real customer use.

• Test and iterate alongside the people who will actually use what you build.

• Drive adoption and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Continue improving solutions until they create sustained operational value.

• Document successful solutions so they can be maintained, improved, and reused.

Be the Agency's Go-To Technical Resource

• Maintain a consistent onsite presence and deep understanding of the agency's Axon environment.

• Lean into critical customer needs when your technical context or involvement can materially improve the outcome.

• Help quarterback technical alignment around important deployments without replacing the teams responsible for deployment execution.

• Serve as a liaison when complex technical issues require coordination beyond standard Support.

• Help customers navigate capabilities across products such as Records, Fusus, AI Era, and the broader Axon ecosystem.

• Connect the right resources across Product, Engineering, Support, Deployment, Training, Mission Operations, Mission Success, and Sales.

• Continuously ask: What are we learning, what could work better, and what could we build so this is easier next time?

• Return to the highest-value build opportunities once immediate customer needs are addressed.

Learn in the Field. Improve Axon.

• Capture recurring customer needs, workflow patterns, and technical friction.

• Share successful builds and lessons across Mission Engineering.

• Bring platform limitations and customer insights back to Product and Engineering.

• Identify solutions that could be reused by other MEs and agencies.

What You Bring

Required

• Typically 3–5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, software engineering, systems, technical consulting, implementation engineering, or another hands-on technical role.

• Foundational software engineering capability and demonstrated experience building technical solutions.

• Working knowledge of APIs, scripting/ programming, data, testing, debugging, and modern development practices.

• Understanding of AI concepts and practical applications.

• Strong technical curiosity and ability to rapidly learn emerging platforms and tools.

• Ability to solve ambiguous problems rather than simply execute predefined tasks.

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

• Customer-facing mindset and curiosity about how organizations actually operate.

• Ability to obtain and maintain CJIS compliance and satisfy applicable agency background requirements.

• Ability to maintain the onsite presence required by the engagement.

Preferred

• Experience with Python, JavaScript, SQL, REST APIs, cloud platforms, or modern frameworks.

• Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code development, or data.

• Experience in public safety, defense, military, intelligence, government, or other mission-critical environments.

What Success Looks Like

You can take a meaningful customer problem through:

Discover → Build → Transform

Given Axon's approved toolkit, and a problem worth solving, you can turn it into a working solution and demonstrate whether it created value. And when the agency needs you elsewhere, you lean in without losing the engineering mindset—help solve the immediate need, identify what can be improved, and return to building.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to win and grow Enterprise customers by becoming the trusted partner of technical teams and their leaders.

As an Enterprise Account Executive covering US Central (Texas and Colorado), you will own a territory of larger organisations and drive complex deals from first conversation to signature:


GENERATE NEW-LOGO PIPELINE

 - Build and execute account plans for named Enterprise accounts with 1,001 to 5,000 employees.

 - Run outbound campaigns that open doors with CTOs, engineering leaders and platform teams.

 - Turn community adoption and inbound signals into structured enterprise opportunities.


LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-STAKEHOLDER DEALS

 - Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build a business case with your champions.

 - Map decision makers across engineering, IT, security and procurement and keep every thread alive.

 - Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical evaluations and proofs of concept.


CLOSE AND EXPAND

 - Own the sales cycle through security, legal and procurement reviews, typically over two to four months.

 - Negotiate with confidence and keep clear commercial control of next steps.

 - Hand over to Customer Success and plan expansion across teams and use cases.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🚀 Startup or open-source exposure: You have worked at an open-source, product-led or Series A to C company.

Why join us?

Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the world’s most ambitious companies.

jobs.title: Technical Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABBY CARE: POWERING THE FUTURE OF CARE AT HOME FOR ALL OF AMERICA.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.



The Opportunity:



At Abby Care we are building an organization that is at the intersection of technology and healthcare delivery. Our goal is to build AI native platforms that drastically improve how caregivers deliver care, more efficiently and safely, and with better outcomes. We are excited to hire a Technology Talent Acquisition Partner to focus on sourcing, engaging and closing the best tech talent here in the SF Bay Area. Reporting to the Director of Talent Acquisition, you will partner with our leadership team across Engineering, Product, Analytics and Design to understand the profiles and personas who are attracted to mission driven work, while articulating our particular value proposition in an intensely competitive market.



A high performing individual contributor, you have a strong bias for action and a clearly defined owner mentality. You take pride in managing clear, structured processes end-to-end, and understand that the best tech candidates are the ones we source. Human-centered, understanding candidate motivations and connecting them to a mission is second nature, and you take pride in building teams that have real, tangible impact. You’re naturally data-driven, and are comfortable using data to tell the Talent story, and aren’t afraid to come to the table with a POV and subject matter expertise in Tech hiring. If you are excited about the opportunity to build a team with a high bar, and even higher goals, we’d love to hear from you.



This is a full-time role based in our San Francisco Headquarters with an expectation of 3-4 days a week in office. 



What you’ll work on:



 - Scale Abby Care’s technical teams across Engineering, Product and Data while delivering an expedient, elevated and transparent candidate experience.

 - Build and execute a multi-channel sourcing engine tailored to capture top-tier technical candidates in a competitive market.

 - Design rigorous technical assessments and evaluation frameworks that keep the hiring bar consistently high.

 - Serve as a strategic advisor to leadership on headcount prioritization, equity dynamics, and closing tactics.

 - Champion the Abby Care story through high-converting outbound campaigns, technical content, and community engagement.

 - Lead end-to-end offer strategies in partnership with TA and executive leadership to close critical hires.
   
   

What success looks like:



 - Accelerate early pipeline velocity by securing initial priority technical hires and cultivating a consistent engine of highly-vetted passive talent.

 - Establish seamless loop calibration with EPD leadership through standardized evaluation frameworks, optimized pass-through rates, and rapid interview throughput.

 - Serve as a high-impact strategic advisor on market equity and compensation while articulating our complex engineering roadmap through compelling outbound storytelling.



What you’ll have:


 - 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience (engineering, product, data).

 - Proven ability to source and close senior technical talent, including Lead, Manager and Director level roles in fast-paced or high-growth environments - specifically within the SF Bay Area. Focus on Applied AI roles strongly preferred.

 - Strong understanding of engineering concepts, stacks, architectures, and product development cycles.

 - Experience running 4-6+ active technical requisitions simultaneously.

 - Excellent communication skills, critical thinking skills, strong attention to detail, and ability to manage complex processes.

 - Metrics-driven with a focus on throughput, quality, and continuous improvement.

 - High ownership mindset, low ego, and ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

 - Comfort and familiarity with our recruiting stack: Ashby, Juicebox, LinkedIn Recruiter, Notion, Google Workspace, Slack




BENEFITS:



 - Competitive compensation packages that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work.

 - Comprehensive health coverage that works for you. Choose from high-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company-funded HSA, alongside employer-paid life and disability insurance.

 - Generous paid time off. We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays.

 - Financial savings benefits to support your future. We support your financial well-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered).

 - Paid parental leave to support your growing family. We provide up to 10 weeks of paid parental leave based on tenure, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows.






OUR VALUES

 1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

 2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

 3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

 4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

 5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.



Equal Opportunity Employer

Abby Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, contact talent@abbycare.org.



Abby Care considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment and conducts background checks consistent with applicable law, including the California, Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Philadelphia, and New York City Fair Chance laws. We are an E-Verify participating company.



Automated Decision Tools

Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact talent@abbycare.org.

jobs.title: Industrialization Engineer
jobs.location: Mountain View, CA, USA; Novi, MI, USA
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

You will:

• Supplier Assembly Line Deployment: Lead the industrialization of "build to print" automotive autonomous sensors & ECUs (cameras, radars, lidars, compute) at external supplier partner facilities. Oversee the design, installation, and validation of automated and semi-automated assembly lines. Track production line readiness (PCBA and FATP) for all NPI builds and early production builds. Drive the resolution of open technical questions from external suppliers.

• Process Engineering & Quality: Ensure supplier manufacturing processes strictly adhere to engineering drawings, tolerances, and automotive quality standards. Drive the completion of DFxs, PFMEAs, Control Plans, MSA and capability studies (Cp/Cpk). Enforce structured equipment/station development with FMEA approach. Support ILQC audits and drive implementation of Preventative & Detective controls at external suppliers.

• Program Management: Act as the primary technical project manager for supplier launches. Establish realistic timelines, track milestones, manage equipment buy-offs (FAT/SAT), and ensure flawless execution through PPAP and Start of Production (SOP). Coordinate material supply to ensure the manufacturing development schedule stays on track. Ensure CMs have the latest BOMs and corresponding component specifications. Drive the mitigation of all process development / qualification risks that pose a threat to meeting the product performance and quality requirements.

• Contract & Commercial Management: Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to develop Statements of Work (SOW), technical specifications, and equipment contracts. Negotiate technical terms, manage change orders, and hold suppliers accountable to contractual obligations. Track suppliers Capex spend.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the technical liaison between Internal R&D, Quality, Purchasing, and External manufacturing partners. Coordinate with Waymo cross-functional technical teams for support in debugging & resolving issues that impact manufacturing line qualification. Ensure compliance to defined requirements and manage any changes proposed by Waymo or external suppliers. Provide clear updates to Waymo management on the manufacturing process & test development & qualification status.

• Continuous Improvement: Identify manufacturing bottlenecks, yield issues, and cycle time constraints on supplier lines. Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to optimize production efficiency and product quality. Identify key learnings from past projects and ensure target action items are fully executed. Ensure all proposed product or component changes are properly evaluated and appropriately implemented while mitigating associated risks for the production / equipment processes.

You have:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience: 10+ years of experience in process or manufacturing engineering within the automotive industry, with direct experience handling automotive sensors, ECUs or complex electronic assemblies.

• Technical Skills: Deep understanding of "build to print" manufacturing models, automated assembly processes, testing/calibration of sensors, and automotive core tools (APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA).

• Supplier Management: Proven ability to drive Tier 1/Tier 2 suppliers and equipment integrators to meet strict launch deadlines and quality metrics.

• Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience reviewing, negotiating, and executing technical contracts, SOWs, and capital equipment agreements.

• Program Management: Strong project management skills. PMP certification is a strong plus.

We prefer:

• Advanced Manufacturing Experience: Hands-on experience with automation, active alignment (AA) of optical lenses, precision automated adhesive/TIM dispensing, UV curing, wire bonding, or cleanroom manufacturing (ISO Class 5-7).

• Specialized Testing Knowledge: Familiarity with end-of-line (EOL) functional testing for ECUs, optical target rooms for cameras/LiDAR, or RF testing in anechoic chambers for radar.

• Certifications: Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.

• Software Proficiency: Experience using statistical analysis software (e.g., Minitab, JMP) to analyze supplier yield data, and basic proficiency in CAD (e.g., CATIA, SolidWorks) to review engineering prints and supplier DFM feedback.

• Industry Standards: Deep working knowledge of TS16949, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) and ASPICE, specifically how they dictate manufacturing traceability, serialization, and line-side controls.

Travel requirements:

• 30% to travel domestically and internationally to supplier manufacturing sites as required during critical launch phases.

jobs.description:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale, and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We are seeking a Solutions Engineer to architect and scale technical integrations for mortgage lending partners. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering and is responsible for designing integration solutions, accelerating onboarding, and ensuring partners fully leverage our API, webhook, and identity infrastructure.

You will work with enterprise and institutional partners from technical discovery through integration and early scale as a trusted technical advisor. You will work directly with partners to ensure implementations are robust and scalable. Your core responsibilities will include:

• Designing and documenting integration architectures, workflows, and data exchanges.

• Guiding partners through implementation using clear technical best practices.

• Proactively mitigating integration risks to accelerate onboarding and troubleshoot complex issues during implementation and early production.

Over time, you will help build more scalable onboarding infrastructure - including documentation, integration templates, and reusable patterns - to enable efficient, repeatable partner launches.

What You'll Do

Technical Discovery & Solution Architecture

• Lead technical discovery sessions with prospective and signed partners.

• Understand partner systems (CRM, LOS, servicing platforms, identity providers).

• Design scalable API and webhook integration architectures.

• Recommend preferred implementation patterns and identify edge cases and platform constraints early.

• Document solution designs for internal and external stakeholders.

Integration Enablement & Acceleration

• Serve as the primary technical advisor during API onboarding.

• Guide partners through REST API, webhook, authentication, and SSO flows.

• Support sandbox testing and production readiness.

• Reduce integration time by standardizing implementation patterns.

• Bridge partner engineering teams with internal Product and Engineering.

Post-Launch Optimization & Expansion

• Identify opportunities to expand API and real-time data usage.

• Improve partner workflows to increase throughput and ROI.

• Surface product gaps with structured technical feedback.

• Contribute to improved documentation and integration playbooks.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role. Fintech and Lending experience is a big plus.

• Strong fluency with APIs and integration patterns (REST, JSON, webhooks), including the ability to design and debug end-to-end integrations.

• Deep understanding of authentication and identity standards (OAuth 2.0, SAML, SCIM) and secure system design principles.

• Proven experience partnering with enterprise engineering teams to implement scalable, production-grade integrations.

• Ability to architect full system workflows and data exchanges — not just explain endpoints — with clear tradeoff analysis.

• Experience translating ambiguous partner requirements into structured technical implementation plans and strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues across distributed systems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an affinity for technical documentation.

• Comfortable influencing cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Compliance, Partnerships) and providing actionable product feedback.

• Experience in fintech (or regulated financial services environments) and familiarity integrating with CRMs, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and other financial platforms is a plus.

• Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.

• Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.

• Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

• Base Compensation Range: $131,398 - $197,097/yr

• 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly

• Company equity in the form of RSUs

jobs.title: Workplace Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the team/role

Our Workplace Operations and Talent Coordinator, reporting into Workplace, will be essential to the Workplace team's function and will hugely impact our company culture and workplace experience. We are looking for someone with great operational prowess, an upbeat and approachable attitude, impeccable customer service skills, and a willingness to cultivate the best employee experience for Checkrs!

What you'll do

• Support daily facilities operations in our Nashville office in coordination with the Checkr Workplace Operations Team. This includes assisting with janitorial services, HVAC maintenance, food services, badge and security management, and resolving general maintenance issues promptly and effectively.

• Partner with the Talent team to support onsite interviews: greeting candidates, managing breaks between interviews and additional talent and recruiting responsibilities. Assist with scheduling on occasion.

• Build strong working relationships with HR business partners (HRBPs), internal Checkr Resource Groups (CRGs), local management, and other stakeholders within Checkr to help implement employee experience strategies that enhance workplace satisfaction and productivity.

• Staff the front desk during absences and break periods, and provide coverage for Workplace team members during absences.

• Help implement the hybrid work strategy developed by the Workplace Operations leadership team to ensure effective operational continuity across different work arrangements.

• Support and help enhance employee experiences across the lifecycle from onboarding to off-boarding, including assisting with offboarding processes and presenting at new hire orientations.

• Coordinate and help execute engaging intra-office events for local Nashville Checkrs that reflect company culture and foster team cohesion, including site setup, item and food sourcing, and cleanup.

• In coordination with the Nashville Workplace team, help oversee daily lunch service and the snack and beverage program, organizing food needs for group meetings, internal employee meetings, and offsites.

• Support various project and program implementations to create smooth, transparent experiences for all employees, including coordinating with teams and tracking timelines.

• Assist in managing relationships with property management, coordinating necessary building operations and maintenance.

• Help manage shared audio-visual spaces within the Nashville office, resolving basic technical issues and ensuring these resources are used effectively.

What you bring

• Comfort working within a fast-paced office environment, and capability to work efficiently in the physical Nashville office daily.

• Willingness to work overtime periodically. Sometimes early days, sometimes late weekdays, and very rarely weekends for office moves or large capital project executions.

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.
