jobs.title: Senior TA Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The role

You will be the hands-on operator behind our Workday work and a key resolver for our core recruiting systems. In the near term you will help test and implement Workday for Talent Acquisition, then support it and improve its processes after go-live. Alongside that, you will resolve issues across Greenhouse and ChartHop for the core processes that recruiters and coordinators depend on, such as backfills and conversions. You will spot patterns in what breaks and fix the process, not just the ticket.

What you will do

Workday testing and implementation

• Partner with the Workday project team and TA stakeholders to document requirements, write and run test scenarios, and track and retest defects.

• Coordinate user acceptance testing with recruiters, coordinators, and business partners, and make sure issues are resolved before go-live.

• Validate data and process flows between Workday and our other TA systems, and help prepare cutover, training materials, and communications.

Workday support and improvement after go-live

• Be a first point of escalation for Workday questions and issues from TA, resolving what you can and routing the rest with clear context.

• Iterate on processes after launch: gather feedback, find friction, and propose and test improvements.

• Keep process documentation and job aids current as configuration and workflows change.

Core systems resolution (Greenhouse and ChartHop)

• Resolve system issues that affect core processes, including backfills, conversions, and requisition and headcount alignment between systems.

• Investigate data and sync discrepancies, fix the root cause where you can, and escalate with a clear summary where you cannot.

• Handle support tickets and requests with consistent quality and response times.

Continuous improvement

• Track recurring issues and questions, identify root causes, and recommend changes to configuration, process, or training.

• Partner with the enablement team so recurring questions become better training and guidance.

• Help define process around outcomes and actual tool usage, so the tools get used correctly and consistently.

How the role evolves

Early on, your time is split between Workday testing and implementation and core systems resolution. After go-live, the balance shifts toward Workday support and process improvement, while core systems resolution continues. As the Workday footprint grows, this role is a natural path toward leading larger systems projects, initiatives, and process improvement for TA to meet increasingly complex and scaling business needs.

US Salary Range

$101,000—$135,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

POSITION TITLE: EVENT OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

On board experiential marketing

OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly-but-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Event Operations Coordinator is an integral part of the team responsible for successful management and production of our programs. Reporting to a senior Event Operations team member, this person performs various duties in the planning, development, activation and wrap up stages of both client programs and internal initiatives, both in office and onsite. The Event Operations Coordinator helps ensure the highest quality of service in the performance of the approved client statement of work so that all deliverables are executed with the utmost in professionalism, accountability, skill, and timeliness, thus successfully meeting program objectives at the highest level of client and agency satisfaction.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Prepare materials, documents, meeting agendas, and communications to client and internal teams.

• Support in tracking deliverables across Event Operations and cross functional teams (Production, Creative, Strategy, Tech), update key documents.

• Participate in weekly status meetings both internal and external as required, capturing detailed and accurate notes and action items.

• Ensure assigned areas of program responsibilities are successfully completed, delivered, and implemented during pre-production planning phase.

• Successfully manage areas of program execution onsite

• Participate in program tear down meetings, internal & client recap decks, and client KPI measurement reporting.

• Join or lead internal agency initiatives & task forces, offsite planning for department and agency needs.

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Education / Experience

• BA/BS in marketing, business administration, communications, or related field.

• 1 - 3 years’ experience in marketing, promotions, and/or events, including on-site event experience. Experiential marketing agency experience preferred.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Strong interpersonal communication skills

• Ability to interact, internally, and with clients, at various organizational levels.

• Ability to connect with others authentically while equally honoring and respecting diverse perspectives.

• Ability to build trust and respect through communication and listening.

• Think creatively, with willingness to extend beyond the unexpected and consistently strive for innovation.

• Experience with brand management, ensuring brand integrity and quality is consistently maintained.

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and excellent organizational skills.

• Ability to navigate competing priorities and deadlines with ease.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and within teams.

• Pulse on social media trends and an understanding of how to utilize online methods to promote engagement.

• Must be able to work in a collaborative manner both internally and with clients.

• Ability to learn and navigate various office management platforms (inclusive of but not limited to Office 365, Keynote, Google Drive, Smartsheet, Slack, Zoom, etc)

Other Qualities and Skills

• Natural curiosity—the drive to always be learning and growing, professionally and personally.

• High energy and flexibility in working non-traditional hours as needed (some nights and weekends as deadlines dictate).

• Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stay on your feet for extended periods of time.

• Has hands-on payroll administration experience

• Has administered benefits: enrollments, qualifying life events, COBRA, and open enrollment

• Has a track record in employee relations and manager coaching, including performance documentation and terminations

• Has handled sensitive employee situations and exits with discretion and good judgment

• You bring a customer service mindset: you acknowledge fast, focus on solutions, and can't rest until every loop is closed

• You treat every interaction as if it could land on the front page of the NY Times

• You build real relationships and stay culture-aligned while making decisions in the best interest of Grüns

• You have extreme ownership and self-motivation, so micromanagement isn't needed because you're always 10 steps ahead

• You use AI to protect your focus for thoughtful people partnership

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $100,000 - $130,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Staff Materials & Process Engineer
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:
Awerx is a team within Relativity Space building agentic design tools for aerospace. The team focuses on agentic mechanical engineering and advanced manufacturing: systems that reason about geometry, materials, and process alongside the engineers who use them. The goal is design tools that produce parts that are not just analyzable, but buildable, qualifiable, and right the first time. You’ll work where software meets hardware, turning hard-won shop-floor knowledge into tools that change how aerospace hardware gets designed and built.

This role requires on-site presence at least three days per week, with flexibility to work remotely when the work allows. Much of the work is hands-on and best done alongside the engineers and hardware it supports.

About the Role:
As a Staff Materials and Process Engineer, you’ll bring deep metallurgical and manufacturing-process expertise into the Awerx design-for-manufacturing (DFM) systems. You’ll turn what you know about how metals solidify, deform, crack, and machine into the rules, models, and constraints our agents use to design and plan aerospace hardware. The focus is hybrid manufacturing. That means multi-additive routes that combine processes such as sintered metal powder and wire arc additive manufacturing (WAAM), and additive-plus-subtractive workflows that pair deposition with CNC finishing. Few tools reason well about these process chains today. You’ll help define how ours should, then build coupons and parts to prove it.

• Encode metallurgy and process knowledge into Awerx DFM systems as design rules, process windows, material models, and manufacturability checks, including how agents reason about multi-additive builds, process interfaces, and deposition-to-machining handoffs

• Develop process guidance for directed energy deposition (WAAM and other DED), CNC machining, and their combination, covering near-net-shape allowances, fixturing, distortion, and inspection access

• Characterize how process route drives microstructure, residual stress, defects, and properties in nickel superalloys, copper alloys, aluminum, and titanium, and build the materials and process datasets the agents depend on, with clear provenance and uncertainty

• Plan and run validation programs hands-on in lab and shop environments, including coupons, test articles, heat treatment, NDE, metallography, and mechanical testing, to confirm or correct what the tools predict

• Lead materials and process qualification of hybrid-manufactured hardware, including qualification plans, process controls, and statistically based design allowables in line with NAVSEA requirements and MMPDS methodology

• Collaborate with software engineers, designers, Relativity’s production, materials, and quality teams, and outside suppliers to specify and review tool features, evaluate agent-generated designs and process plans, and turn tacit shop knowledge and recurring failure modes into clear, explicit constraints

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

• 10+ years of materials and process engineering experience on aerospace or other high-reliability metal hardware

• Expertise in physical metallurgy across nickel superalloys, copper alloys, aluminum, and titanium, including solidification, phase transformations, heat treatment, and defect formation

• Hands-on experience developing or qualifying directed energy deposition processes (WAAM, laser DED, or electron-beam DED) and integrating them with CNC machining

• Experience designing and running test programs (coupons, metallography, NDE, mechanical testing) and generating statistically based design allowables (A- and B-basis) to NAVSEA, MMPDS, or comparable requirements

• Proficiency in Python or a similar language for data analysis and scripting

Nice to haves but not required:

• PhD in Materials Science, Metallurgy, or a related field

• Experience with sintered-powder routes (binder jet, metal injection molding, press-and-sinter) or laser powder bed fusion, including multi-material or bimetallic interfaces such as copper-to-superalloy transitions

• Experience with ICME, CALPHAD, or thermo-mechanical process simulation for additive manufacturing, or with CAM and deposition path planning

• Experience qualifying additive parts for flight under NASA-STD-6030 or comparable standards, or applying machine learning to materials or process data

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Hardware Development Engineer I to join our Power Electronics team. In this role, you will be a contributor helping to solve difficult hardware engineering problems related to high-power electronics systems. You will design, develop, and validate power electronics boards from concept through production, working on high-voltage DC systems that push the boundaries of performance, reliability, and efficiency.

This position requires an engineer who demonstrates strong technical skills in power electronics design, schematics, power electronics PCBA layout, hardware bring-up testing and troubleshooting.

Key job responsibilities
• Assist in the Design, develop, and test multi-layer power electronics board for high-voltage DC systems, from initial concept through volume production release.
• Support schematics development, PCBA layout, prototyping, DFM, board bring-up testing, drawings, bill of materials, and supporting design documentation
• Support development of test plans that validate designs against DO-160 and DO-274 standards, ensuring electromagnetic compatibility, environmental resilience, and functional safety.
• Create and maintain high-quality design documentation including schematics, specifications, analysis reports, and test results.
• Conduct design reviews with teammates and cross-functional teams.
• Apply system-level thinking to understand how power electronics subsystems integrate with and influence the broader product architecture.

A day in the life
You support the design and delivery of power electronics hardware, making sound trade-offs between performance, cost, manufacturability, and schedule. Your test plans thoroughly validate designs and efficiently address system integration challenges. You think in terms of the system, not just individual components, and proactively work to improve the overall product architecture. Your work is consistently high quality, meeting safety, regulatory, and reliability standards.

About the team
The Electric Propulsion Subsystem (EPS) organization conducts technology research, design and development of the power system for Prime Air’s drones. We are responsible to deliver an EPS and hardware components that safely supports 15-minute drone delivery and is certifiable by the FAA and EASA regulators.
Our work spans the full product lifecycle, from early-stage research and concept development through detailed design, prototyping, testing, and certification support. The EPS is a critical system enabling Prime Air’s autonomous delivery operations, providing the electrical power generation, storage, distribution, and propulsion capabilities required for safe and reliable flight.

jobs.description:
HSE Specialist - FPI prevention Program

Are you passionate about Safety? Would you like to play a key role in preventing events with the potential to result in Fatalities and Permanent Impairments across our global operations?

Join our Team!

Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward! Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

We create ways to collaborate with our colleagues, customers and communities. Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) are built into everything we do - product designing, planning and executing for our customers. Our expectation is to make every day a Perfect HSE Day with no injuries, accidents or harm to the environment.

Preventing conditions that could lead to Fatalities and Permanent Impairments (FPI) is one of our highest priorities.

Partner with the best

As a Technical Safety Specialist, you will play a key role in coordinating and supporting the Business Unit's Technical Safety and Fatalities & Permanent Impairment (FPI) Prevention Program. Working closely with site HSE teams, engineering functions, project teams, and business leadership, you will help ensure that major risks are systematically identified, assessed, and controlled throughout the lifecycle of facilities, projects, and operations.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities, reporting directly to the Business Unit HSE Lead. Success in this position will be achieved through technical expertise, strong cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to influence safety outcomes across multiple sites and business functions.

As HSE Specialist - FPI prevention Program, you will be responsible to:

• Coordinatin and support the deployment and continuous improvement of the Business Unit's Fatalities and Permanent Impairments (FPI) Prevention Program, ensuring alignment across sites and functions.
• Monitoring program progress against established milestones and objectives, identifying potential delays, gaps, or barriers and escalating critical issues to Business Unit HSE&S leadership.
• Developing, maintaining, analyzing, and reporting leading and lagging Technical Safety and FPI-related performance indicators to drive continuous improvement.
• Supporting the Business Unit HSE&S team in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the HSE Management System, helping drive the achievement of strategic HSE objectives, including: Eliminating conditions that could lead to Fatalities and Permanent Impairments (FPI); Ensuring Occupational Health, Process Safety, and Environmental compliance; Supporting the decarbonization of operations.
• Reviewing Technical Safety deliverables for operating facilities, capital projects, and Management of Change (MOC) activities to ensure consistency, quality, and compliance with Business Unit requirements and recognized industry practices.
• Supporting site HSE teams in planning, facilitating, and following up on hazard identification and risk assessment workshops, including Bow-Tie Analysis,
• Supporting the evaluation, prioritization, and implementation of risk reduction measures based on the ALARP principle, including cost-benefit assessments and risk-informed decision-making.
• Facilitating and support incident investigations, root cause analyses, corrective action development, and lessons learned activities, with particular focus on actual or potential FPI events.
• Promoting the sharing of best practices, lessons learned, and risk management methodologies across the Business Unit to drive standardization and continuous improvement.
• Analyzing HSE leading and lagging data, and support periodical HSE performance reviews.
• Supporting the development of Technical Safety capabilities across the Business Unit through risk assessment activities, technical studies, contractor and supplier reviews, regulatory compliance support, training, and the implementation of risk reduction measures.
• Visiting Company Plants/Sites to verify HSE system implementation and learn from that

To be successful in this role you will:

• Have a Bachelor's degree in Engineering
• Have 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in
• Have knowledge of risk assessment methodologies such as Bow-Tie Analysis, Barrier Management, and ALARP principles.
• Have experience supporting incident investigations and applying root cause analysis methodologies.
• Have familiarity with Management of Change (MOC) and risk-based decision-making processes.
• Have working knowledge of HSE Management Systems, applicable local HSE regulations, and internationally recognized standards and industry best practices.
• Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical information and translate it into practical risk reduction actions.
• Have strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions and geographical locations.
• Have good communication and interpersonal skills.
• Have good teamwork, mediation, relationship-building and influencing skills.
• Display innovative and analytical thinking.
• Have intellectual rigor, strong drive, and desire to lead change.
• Show initiative, drive and self-motivation skills.
• Be available to travel as required.
• Be fluent in verbal and written communication in English and Italian Languages.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

• Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI Governance
jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Senior Security Engineer on Zoom's Enterprise Security team, you will own the AI Governance program end to end, defining the technical standards and risk posture that determine how Zoom adopts AI safely and at scale. On any given day, you will be assessing emerging AI use cases, building security frameworks for GenAI and agentic systems, and serving as the trusted technical voice on AI security for engineering and enterprise stakeholders across four critical domains. This is a hands-on, highly autonomous role that calls for real depth in both AI/ML systems and security engineering; candidates without working familiarity with how modern AI introduces security risk will not be set up for success here. You will work as part of a globally distributed, multi-domain security engineering team, collaborating closely with colleagues across time zones and contributing across adjacent security domains beyond AI.

About the Team

Zoom's Enterprise Security team is the engineering foundation behind how the company identifies, contains, and gets ahead of risk across its most critical systems. Working across AI, data, network, endpoint, and cloud security, the team builds the controls, standards, and architectures that let Zoom move quickly without creating unacceptable exposure. As Zoom deepens its investment in AI across Zoom Workplace and its broader platform, this team's work is increasingly central to how the company grows responsibly.

Responsibilities

• Own the AI governance risk register and end-to-end assessment methodology across four domains (GenAI, Agentic AI, Shadow AI/Local AI, and AI Gateway/MCP); conduct and review risk evaluations using Likelihood x Impact scoring and drive remediation with owning engineering teams.
• Identify and prioritize security gaps in GenAI deployments including prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and insecure output handling; define monitoring and guardrail requirements for agentic systems operating with significant autonomy and tool access.
• Lead the Shadow AI governance strategy end to end, from quantifying risk exposure to recommending and operationalizing detection and enforcement controls across the enterprise.
• Set the security bar for AI gateway and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations, including secure configuration, access control frameworks, and governance coverage.
• Architect reference security patterns for AI adoption (AI gateways, MCP servers, agent frameworks, LLM integrations) and serve as design authority in AI-related architecture reviews; translate the AI Governance Risk Charter into a concrete roadmap of technical requirements and measurable outcomes.
• Drive evaluations of AI security tooling (AI gateways, CASB/SWG, agentic monitoring, MCP governance solutions), including POC design, cost-benefit analysis, and leadership recommendations; author and maintain security standards and policy for AI adoption.
• Lead security architecture reviews and risk assessments across adjacent domains including Network, Endpoint, Cloud, and Data Security; contribute to incident response, detection engineering, and purple team exercises as shared team functions.
• Serve as the primary technical partner to AI/ML, engineering, and enterprise teams; lead cross-functional working groups, mentor engineers on risk analysis and documentation quality, and deliver clear reporting on AI risk posture and forecasted challenges to leadership.

What We're Looking For

• 8+ years of security engineering or cybersecurity experience, including end-to-end ownership of a security domain or program, with a track record of driving risk assessment, prioritization, and remediation across cross-functional teams.
• Solid working knowledge of modern AI/ML systems and the security risks they introduce (LLMs, generative AI, agentic systems); direct experience securing GenAI or LLM-based applications in an enterprise environment is a strong differentiator.
• Understanding of AI gateways, Model Context Protocol (MCP), CASB/SWG, or DLP tooling, and a working understanding of shadow AI detection and governance strategies.
• Working knowledge across core security domains (network, endpoint, cloud, and data security) sufficient to independently lead architecture reviews and risk assessments outside of AI.

jobs.title: Regional Manager
jobs.description:
Redstone Residential is a national student and multi-family housing operator, managing more than 38,000 beds across 20 states. We are one of the largest third-party student housing management companies in the U.S. - and we're just getting started.

Our rapidly growing conventional housing portfolio reflects our ambitious, forward-thinking approach to real estate management. Headquartered in Provo, Utah, we combine industry-leading systems with a high-energy culture to deliver exceptional property performance and resident experiences.

Redstone's purpose is "to empower our people and elevate communities." We achieve our purpose by embodying our core values:

• We Are Believers

• We Communicate Authentically with Care

• We Stay The Course

• We Drive Performance

Redstone – Empowering People. Elevating Communities.

Do you light up when a struggling property turns the corner? Can you read a P&L as comfortably as you read a room? Are you the leader Community Managers call first — and the one clients trust to tell it to them straight?

If that sounds like you, this might be your next move.

Why Redstone?

At Redstone, we’re not just a property management company.
We’re a culture company that happens to manage properties.

Our purpose:
To empower our people & elevate communities.

Our vision:
To create a high-performing, people-first culture that attracts, develops, and empowers team members to thrive.

Our vibe:
Energetic. Fun. Creative. Growth-minded. People-first. Performance-driven.
(Yes — you genuinely get both heart and hustle here.)

As a company that serves student & multi-family communities, our culture naturally leans to vibrant, curious, and innovative. We believe in staying playful while driving meaningful results. We experiment. We learn. We grow. We celebrate wins (big and small). And we build experiences that make people proud to work here.

The Opportunity:

We're hiring a Regional Property Manager to lead a portfolio of student and multifamily communities — and the Community Managers who run them.

In this role, you'll be the bridge between our on-site teams and the clients and investors who trust us with their assets. You'll coach Community Managers to hit their goals, partner with clients on performance and strategy, and spot the opportunities that grow asset value and resident satisfaction.

As part of Redstone's corporate leadership, you'll set the tone for your region — modeling our core values and bringing consistency, accountability, and energy to every property you touch.

This role is perfect for someone who:

• Loves developing leaders and watching their teams win

• Is as comfortable in a client meeting as on a property walk

• Gets energized by KPIs, leasing velocity, and a well-built budget

• Can juggle multiple properties and priorities without dropping the ball

• Brings a “client-ready” presence and communicates with candor and care

• Sees a challenge at a property and builds the plan to fix it

• Wants a seat at the leadership table of a growing, ambitious company

What You'll Own:

As our Regional Property Manager, you will:

• Drive financial performance — review P&Ls, balance sheets, and budgets with clients and Community Managers; deliver timely, accurate monthly client reporting; and build professional annual business plans

• Guide budgeting — help Community Managers prepare and maintain their annual budgets, and oversee the right actions on delinquencies and evictions

• Own leasing results — hold your region accountable to weekly and annual leasing goals by tracking velocity, conversion ratios, traffic, and local market data

• Keep leasing sharp — audit leases for accuracy, make sure every community uses all available leasing tools, and approve the right campaigns and commission structures

• Lead and develop Community Managers — meet weekly to review KPIs and staffing needs, run quarterly reviews, and make hiring and termination decisions

• Build lasting client partnerships — meet regularly with clients to review KPIs and financials, respond to their questions and concerns, and earn their long-term trust

• Champion the resident experience — resolve escalated resident and parent concerns and run our annual customer service survey

• Protect and grow asset value — operate every asset in the client's best interest, ensure seasonal and life-cycle upkeep, and facilitate CapEx projects

• Show up on-site — visit each community at least quarterly for site audits and staff meetings, roll out policy and procedure changes, and keep offices organized, safe, and data-secure

This is the kind of role where your leadership shows up in the numbers — and in the people you develop along the way.

Who You Are:

You're a leader at your core: someone who drives performance and cares deeply about the people delivering it.

You bring:

• 6+ years of student housing or multifamily housing experience

• 4+ years of experience as a property manager

• Hands-on budget management and P&L ownership, with a working knowledge of financial reporting

• Previous client-facing experience and a polished, “client-ready” professional presence

• The ability to manage multiple projects and processes at once — and stay steady under pressure

• Experience with Entrata or similar property management software

• Quick to learn new technology — Google Apps, Microsoft Office, cloud-based management, and dashboarding tools

• A team-first leadership style that inspires high performance and delivers constructive feedback

• A detail-oriented work ethic

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience in both student housing and conventional multifamily

• Experience managing third-party assets for multiple ownership groups

• Experience overseeing CapEx or renovation projects

Compensation & Schedule:

Starting at $95,000 per year, plus the ability to earn an additional 20% of salary through performance bonuses. Full-time, salaried (exempt).

Location & Travel:

This is a full-time leadership role with regular travel, including quarterly visits to each community in your region. Air travel is required for client meetings and company events, including our annual leadership Summit, so you must be able and willing to fly when needed.

Why You'll Love Working at Redstone

• Health, vision, and dental insurance

• 401(k) with up to 6% company match

• Flex PTO and 10 paid holidays

• Discounted phone plan

• 3 paid service days per year

• Paid parental leave

• Short-term disability insurance

• Professional development program

• Employee assistance program

• Performance bonuses that reward the results you drive

• A seat on our corporate leadership team

• A people-first culture that walks the talk

• Leadership that values your judgment and your time

• A team that cares deeply and communicates honestly

• Work that matters — every property you lead is home to real residents

• A workplace where fun and performance go hand-in-hand

At Redstone, you'll have the opportunity to shape operations across a growing portfolio, develop the next generation of Community Managers, and do meaningful work that elevates communities.

Ready to Join Us?

If you thrive on turning numbers into wins and managers into leaders — we'd love to meet you.

Apply today and help shape the future of Redstone.

At Redstone Residential, we’re committed to creating a workplace where people thrive. We believe in elevating communities, starting with our own team. Whether you’re just beginning your career or looking to grow in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Field Marketer
jobs.description:
ABOUT HYPERBOUND

Sales runs on conversations. Hyperbound helps sales teams turn those conversations into better performance, stronger decisions, and action that moves deals forward.

We’re building the Revenue Activation Platform, connecting sales practice, coaching, and execution. Since coming out of YC S23, we’ve expanded from AI sales roleplay into technology that understands sales conversations, coaches reps in real time, and helps teams act on what they learn.

Companies including LinkedIn, Amazon, Intel, Notion, and Vanta trust Hyperbound. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, and we’re building the team to take our next big swings.


THE TEAM YOU'LL BUILD WITH

We’re a team of builders and operators who take ownership and work closely together. We value people who bring ideas, ask good questions, and care enough about the outcome to get into the details.

You’ll work alongside our Field Marketing Manager and partner with Marketing, Sales, and leadership to shape how Hyperbound shows up in person. You’ll have room to develop concepts and own execution, with teammates who share context, give direct feedback, and jump in when it’s time to make something happen.

We move quickly, learn from what happens, and adjust. When something goes wrong, we take responsibility and solve it together.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Field Marketer to help create and execute Hyperbound’s events calendar, from conferences and trade shows to dinners, partner events, and hosted activations.

One week, you might be bringing a booth activation to life at a conference with 1,000+ attendees. The next, you’re producing a dinner for 10 sales leaders or figuring out how to build a pop-up café at Dreamforce.

You’ll help shape the ideas and own the work that makes them real: venues, vendors, partners, budgets, timelines, and logistics. Working alongside our Field Marketing Manager, you’ll create experiences that break through the noise, build relationships, and contribute to pipeline.

This role calls for creative judgment, strong project management, and a willingness to move between the big picture and the smallest details.


WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

 - Events experience: You’ve delivered events, experiential marketing programs, or community experiences. You can walk us through what you owned, how you made it happen, and what you learned.

 - Strong project management: You can manage multiple events at once, keep budgets and timelines on track, and coordinate venues, vendors, partners, and internal teams. You anticipate dependencies and surface problems early.

 - Creative judgment: You bring original ideas and know how to make them work for the audience, budget, and setting. You care about creating something people want to participate in and remember.

 - Commercial mindset: You understand how events build brand awareness, strengthen relationships, and support pipeline. You work with Sales on the right audiences, target accounts, outreach, meeting goals, and follow-up.

 - High agency: You find gaps, bring recommendations, and move work forward. You’re resourceful when the answer isn’t obvious and comfortable turning an open-ended idea into a clear plan.

 - Hands-on execution: You’re willing to negotiate with a venue, coordinate shipments, check registration, brief the team, and help set up on-site. You take responsibility for delivering the experience.

 - An instinct for improvement: You use attendee feedback, sales conversations, event costs, and pipeline results to understand what’s working. You recommend what to repeat, improve, or stop.


HIGHLY PREFERRED

 - B2B experience: Experience creating events for business audiences, particularly sales leaders, revenue teams, or enterprise buyers.

 - Range across formats: You’ve worked on both larger conferences or activations and smaller, curated gatherings where the guest list and personal details matter.

 - Startup experience: You’re comfortable with changing priorities, limited resources, and building processes as you go.

 - Partner and vendor relationships: You’ve developed productive relationships with venues, agencies, vendors, or event partners and know how to get great work from them.


WHAT YOUR REGULAR THURSDAY LOOKS LIKE:

 - Review the upcoming events calendar with our Field Marketing Manager. Work through priorities, budgets, and deadlines, and bring a recommendation for a new activation or dinner series.

 - Develop a conference booth concept, compare production quotes, and work with a vendor to make the experience fit the space and budget.

 - Walk through a dinner guest list with Sales, check invitation progress, and confirm the venue, menu, seating, and plan for follow-up.

 - Build the production timeline for a Dreamforce pop-up café, coordinating the venue, partners, signage, staffing, and the details that make it feel like Hyperbound.

 - Review results from a recent event. Gather feedback from attendees and Sales, look at meetings and opportunities, and identify what to change for the next one.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - A strategy-only position. You’ll help develop the concept and do the practical work to bring it to life.

 - A role where every task comes with instructions. You’ll have support and context, and we’ll expect you to bring ideas, make recommendations, and take initiative.

 - A role measured only by attendance. We care about who’s in the room, the experience they have, the relationships we build, and what happens afterward.


INTERVIEW PLAN

 - Intro call with our recruiting team (30 minutes)

 - Conversation with our Field Marketing Manager (45 minutes)

 - Take-home exercise: develop an event concept and execution plan (1–2 hours)

 - Exercise review with the Marketing team (45 minutes)

 - Final conversation with founders and leadership (60 minutes)

We’ll share the process and timeline up front and keep you informed at each stage.


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - $100,000-$130,000 base salary

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - Commuter benefits

 - Lunch and dinner in the office

 - 401(k) and HSA options

 - [Expected travel frequency and event-related evening or weekend commitments]


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Hyperbound is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes candidates from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elastic is growing fast and we're looking for a highly motivated, committed, and passionate recruiter to join our global talent team. You will act as a Talent Advisor to our G&A (Finance, IT, HR, Legal) and Marketing teams. You will be responsible for driving the entire recruitment process for a variety of roles and levels. Are you a creative, high energy Recruiter ready for an exciting new challenge? We would love to have you join us for the ride.

What You Will Be Doing

• Engage talent — Identify the right people, get them engaged, and manage the full hiring process

• Build solid relationships with your hiring teams and serve as an advisor and partner to build healthy pipelines of stellar candidates and fill current openings. This means the type of roles can vary: Product Marketing Managers, Accountants, Attorneys, Salesforce Developers, Facilities Coordinators etc...

• Craft and improve a consistent and extraordinary candidate experience

• Manage and champion our hiring process to provide a consistent experience with the Elastic recruiting team

• Participate with the global recruiting team to develop, implement, and complete recruiting strategies

• Be a passionate Elastic brand ambassador before, during, and after recruitment. You will help us build our talent brand in addition to our talent pipeline

What You Bring

• 5+ years of recruiting experience across corporate G&A and marketing functions, ideally from both an agency and corporate environment.

• A passion for understanding at least the basics of what your hiring teams are working on.

• Demonstrable experience recruiting for a fast-paced company. Maybe it's a software company, start-up, and/or, better yet, even a company where talent isn't knocking down your door

• High attention-to-detail and ability to balance multiple reqs

• Sharp eye for business with the ability to listen, ask relevant questions, and think three steps ahead

• Ability to effectively articulate the Elastic value proposition and story to candidates

• Ability to establish relationships by phone, email, and social media channels

• Experience collaborating with and influencing hiring managers and executives throughout the recruiting cycle

• Solid understanding of ATS tools (Greenhouse a bonus!) and recruiting technologies

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

• Generous number of vacation days each year

• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. jobs.title: Account Manager, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting  capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What we are building

Domino Data Lab is looking for an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with some of our most strategic enterprise customers.

You will own a focused portfolio of large, complex customers, with responsibility for the long-term health, retention, and growth of each account. That means understanding how customers are using Domino today, where we can deliver additional value, and how to expand our presence across business units, use cases, and executive stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who thinks like an owner of the customer's business. You should be comfortable building executive relationships, engaging directly with technical practitioners, developing multi-year account strategies, and working across Domino to ensure we deliver on our commitments.

This role requires a balance of technical curiosity, strategic thinking, commercial execution, and customer advocacy. We expect our Account Managers to bring their own judgment and experience while maintaining the discipline required to consistently grow and retain our most important customers.

What your impact will be

• Own the commercial performance, retention, and expansion of a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise customers.

• Develop multi-year account plans that connect customer priorities, adoption, renewal strategies, and opportunities for growth.

• Build strong relationships across technical, business, and executive leadership, establishing multiple champions and sponsors within each account.

• Engage directly with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and technical practitioners to understand their workflows, challenges, and opportunities where Domino can deliver additional value.

• Understand how customers are using Domino, where they are realizing value, and what is required to expand adoption across the enterprise.

• Proactively identify and develop expansion opportunities across new business units, use cases, and stakeholders.

• Own renewal strategy and commercial negotiations, balancing customer outcomes with long-term account growth.

• Lead complex expansion opportunities from discovery and qualification through negotiation and close.

• Partner closely with Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, Product, Partnerships, Legal, and Deal Desk to coordinate customer engagement and execution.

• Maintain clear account plans, qualified pipeline, accurate forecasts, and visibility into risks and opportunities across your portfolio.

• Serve as the commercial point of accountability for your customers, ensuring Domino operates as a coordinated, strategic partner.

What we look for in this role

• 5+ years of experience selling complex enterprise technology solutions, including ownership and growth of existing customer relationships.

• Demonstrated success retaining and expanding large enterprise customers, including closing seven-figure software transactions.

• A track record of building multi-year account strategies and creating expansion opportunities rather than relying on existing demand.

• Experience navigating complex organizations, developing executive relationships, and expanding across multiple business units.

• Technical fluency and curiosity, with the ability to engage credibly with data scientists, engineers, and technical stakeholders, ask informed questions, and understand how technology fits into their workflows. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable going beyond a high-level product conversation.

• Strong commercial judgment and experience leading enterprise renewals, negotiations, and expansion opportunities.

• The ability to understand customer adoption, business priorities, and outcomes and translate them into opportunities for growth.

• A disciplined approach to account planning, opportunity qualification, pipeline management, and forecasting.

• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver customer outcomes and execute account strategies.

• Strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating with both autonomy and accountability.

• Experience with data, analytics, AI, infrastructure, cloud, or other technically complex enterprise platforms is valuable.

• Experience selling into highly regulated industries, including Life Sciences and Financial Services, is a plus.

Why Domino

Domino partners with some of the world's most sophisticated enterprises as they build, scale, and govern AI and data science.

The opportunity in this role is bigger than managing existing customers. You will own relationships that are central to Domino's long-term success, help customers realize greater value from their investment, and expand our presence across some of the world's most complex organizations.

We are looking for someone who wants that level of ownership.

What we value

• We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply

• We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success

• We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work

• We value all of you that believe improving is always possible. At Domino, everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything

• We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company

Visa Sponsorship: Visa sponsorship (including H-1B and other employment-based visa categories) may be available for this position depending on business considerations and the role's requirements. Sponsorship eligibility is assessed on an individual basis and is not guaranteed for any role or candidate. All applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of current or future immigration status.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Operations Support (Embedded)
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Title: Field Marketing Operations Support (Embedded)

On board experiential marketing

On Board Experiential (OBE) is an award-winning, full-service, experience-led agency that creates meaningful brand experiences worldwide. Recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events, our clients include Nike, Meta, JPMorgan Chase, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse, to name a few. We work out of our homes and physical offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, NYC, and London, or wherever our adventures take us! OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative and make magic happen on the regular. But behind each majestic activation is a human deserving of a healthy work-life balance. That's why we believe in recovery days, happy hours, friendly but competitive fitness challenges, and OBE offsites.

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences and unique perspectives. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

SUMMARY OF POSITION

OBE is seeking a Field Marketing Operations Support professional to join our team and be embedded within a client's Enterprise Field Marketing organization, supporting field programs across the Americas region. This role turns approved field marketing plans into coordinated execution — owning program management and marketing operations across the full event lifecycle — while working directly inside the client's systems, meetings, and planning rhythms as a trusted extension of their team.

While the role is operationally focused, the ideal candidate brings enough command of enterprise sales cycles, account-based marketing, and field marketing strategy to be more than an executor: someone who understands the business behind the events, sits close to sales, and proactively flags risks and recommends changes rather than simply reporting status.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Program Coordination & Project Management

• Build and maintain workback plans, trackers, approvals, and handoffs across the event lifecycle.

• Provide status updates and proactively escalate risks to the client's field marketing leadership.

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to keep programs on track from planning through execution.

Registration & Attendee Operations

• Own registration setup, RSVP management, and attendee communications for events.

• Track attendee data and ensure accuracy across systems throughout the event lifecycle.

Seller Enablement

• Build and maintain seller toolkits, outreach cadences, and audience segmentation for sales teams.

• Coordinate send-on-behalf communications and manage review and approval cycles with sellers.

Executive Readiness

• Coordinate briefing documents, executive profiles, and content inputs for executive participation in events.

• Manage review cycles and final deployment of executive-facing materials.

Campaign & Lead Operations

• Set up SFDC campaigns, manage lead uploads, and coordinate with Marketing Operations on data quality.

• Perform quality checks to ensure accurate campaign and lead tracking.

Reporting & Follow-Up

• Build and maintain post-event dashboards and reporting.

• Track follow-up actions and maintain visibility into outstanding items for the client's team.

Strategic Fluency & Account Support

• Understand the client's product, sales, and GTM motions well enough to align field programs to broader marketing and revenue goals.

• Sit in on sales calls and leadership meetings as needed to understand full account context, not just the events being supported.

• Bring a working knowledge of account-based marketing (ABM) principles to support the build-out and execution of long-term, account-specific marketing plans, typically spanning 12 to 18 month enterprise sales cycles.

• Analyze what is and isn't working from an event and program perspective, and proactively recommend adjustments.

summary of position

Education / Experience

• 3 to 6 years of experience in field marketing, marketing operations, event marketing, or program management, ideally supporting B2B or Enterprise organizations.

• Experience working within enterprise marketing and sales tech stacks (e.g., Salesforce/SFDC, marketing automation platforms, event registration tools).

• Exposure to enterprise sales cycles and account-based marketing (ABM) strongly preferred.

• BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Strong program and project management skills; able to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and approvals simultaneously.

• Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) campaign setup, lead management, and marketing operations workflows.

• Working understanding of account-based marketing (ABM) strategy and execution.

• Comfort operating inside a client's systems, tools, and meeting cadences as an embedded team member.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust with sales, marketing, and executive stakeholders.

• Analytical mindset; able to synthesize event and program performance data into clear, actionable recommendations.

• High attention to detail and follow-through, particularly around registration, data accuracy, and reporting.

Other Qualities and Skills

• Comfortable embedding within a client's team and adapting to their systems, culture, and cadence.

• Proactive and solutions-oriented; anticipates risks and brings recommendations, not just status updates.

• High energy and flexibility to support event timelines, which may include non-traditional hours.

• Natural curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, both professionally and personally.

• Willingness to travel as needed to support in-person events (approximately 25% to 30% of the time).

• Comfortable working in ambiguity within a fast-paced enterprise sales and marketing environment.

Compensation Range: $90,000 - $115,000 annually. This is the pay range OBE believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the level of experience, relevant skills, professional certifications, market pay, and demand for the role. OBE reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, Benefits include medical/dental/vision insurance, employer-paid basic life and personal accident insurance. Also included: Annual Profit Sharing/Bonus Plan based on the company’s performance and your individual performance, 401(k), Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, PTO, STD/LTD insurance benefits.

On Board Experiential is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other federally protected class.
