THE ROLE AT BLACKSMITH

We are looking for a Systems Security Engineer to build and operate security controls at Blacksmith. Your primary focus will be our bare-metal fleet, with responsibility extending to our AWS control plane, application services and the broader organization.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work alongside our systems engineers to harden production systems, strengthen workload isolation, and investigate and remediate security issues. You'll partner with our Security Lead to translate security priorities into engineering work.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Identify, prioritize and remediate security risks across our bare-metal fleet, AWS control plane, application services and the broader organization.

 - Strengthen tenant isolation, host hardening, network boundaries and access controls across our platform.

 - Build and operate automated security controls for secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, intrusion detection and response, validating their effectiveness without compromising production reliability or performance.

 - Investigate and respond to security incidents, driving remediation through to completion.

 - Partner with engineering and IT to establish secure defaults and practical security standards across systems and workflows, balancing security, reliability and usability.


YOU’RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Strong Linux systems experience, with the ability to debug production issues across the kernel, networking and storage stack.

 - A practical understanding of security fundamentals, including least privilege, defense in depth and threat modeling, and the ability to translate risks into technical solutions.

 - Experience with virtualization and Linux isolation primitives, such as Firecracker, KVM, namespaces and cgroups, and an understanding of their security boundaries and tradeoffs.

 - An understanding of storage access controls, tenant isolation and secure data deletion.

 - An understanding of how to use eBPF for runtime security monitoring, including observing process, file and network activity to detect suspicious behavior.

 - Experience securing production AWS environments, particularly IAM, networking and audit logging.

 - The ability to write and debug production code in Go, Rust, C, C++ or similar, and automate security changes through configuration management and infrastructure as code.

 - Strong comfort with agent-driven development and debugging, including directing coding agents, reviewing their changes and validating correctness and security.

 - A track record of turning ambiguous problems into practical engineering solutions, owning implementation through production rollout, and explaining technical tradeoffs to engineers, leadership and non-technical partners.

We welcome candidates from security engineering, systems engineering and SRE backgrounds. You should bring strong systems fundamentals and a demonstrated interest in securing the infrastructure you operate.


BONUS

 - You've found or reported CVEs, done container or VM escape research, or competed in CTFs.

 - You've secured multi-tenant infrastructure running untrusted workloads, such as CI runners, cloud compute or agent sandboxes.

 - You've built or extended eBPF-based detection tooling, turning runtime telemetry into actionable alerts and investigations.

 - You've secured software delivery pipelines, including build isolation, artifact signing, image provenance or secrets handling.

 - You've operated or secured distributed storage systems such as Ceph or MinIO in production.

 - You've secured macOS infrastructure running untrusted workloads.


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - 401K match.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options.

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US).

jobs.title: Event Ops Manager
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

POSITION TITLE: EVENT OPERATIONS MANAGER

On board experiential marketing

On Board Experiential (OBE) is an award-winning, full-service, experience-led agency that creates meaningful brand experiences worldwide. Recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events, our clients include Nike, Meta, JPMorgan Chase, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse, to name a few. We work out of our homes and physical offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, NYC, and London, or wherever our adventures take us! OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative and make magic happen on the regular. But behind each majestic activation is a human deserving of a healthy work-life balance. That's why we believe in recovery days, happy hours, friendly but competitive fitness challenges, and OBE offsites.

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences and unique perspectives. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Event Operations Manager is an integral part of the Account Team, delivering an exceptional level of service and execution of programs on behalf of our clients. Responsible for cultivating and growing our client accounts and relationships, which requires a comprehensive understanding of our clients’ business needs and industry.  They provide end-to-end project management on assigned programs and share accountability for their financial and operational performance, including budget tracking and resource coordination. Bringing consistent excellence and support, the Event Operations Manager ensures that programs and marketing strategies successfully promote client brands, products and services in accordance with client objectives and initiatives.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Partner with client / brand teams to understand and identify business opportunities and develop solutions and plans that deliver measurable results against program KPIs.

• Guide and coordinate the development of experiential tactical plans for IRL and / or virtual execution, in partnership with appropriate departments including Strategy / Creative, Production, Tech, Digital and Social.

• Manage the day-to-day activities for each project and event, ensuring programs are planned, staffed, and executed on time and on budget across internal and external teams.

• Lead weekly internal and external status meetings and deep dives, and manage the distribution of all communications between the client and account team throughout the engagement.

• Support the development of program SOWs and track resources, budgets, timelines, and deliverables against contract terms and client commitments.

• Provide ongoing monitoring of expenses and actual costs for approved program budgets. Update client and obtain client approvals as needed. Reconcile all project/event expenses in partnership with program Production lead.

• Track creative deliverables through client review and approval in partnership with other departments.

• Maintain organized internal and client-facing program documentation, including folder structures, shared resources, and key files, so that materials stay current and accessible to the account team, cross-functional partners, and external vendors.

• Remain current with industry trends and technologies.

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Education / Experience

• 3+ years of experience in project management, marketing, promotions, and events within an advertising, media, marketing or experiential agency.

• Minimum 2 years of experience as a day-to-day client contact or Account Lead to hospitality or enterprise clients.

• Strong project management capabilities, organization skills, attention to detail and ability to juggle multiple projects in a demanding but highly collaborative environment.

• Experience working with tech clients is strongly desired

• Experience managing IRL experiential activations is required.

• BA/BS in marketing, business administration, communications, or related field.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Strong communication skills with ability to connect with others authentically while equally honoring and respecting diverse perspectives.

• Ability to build trust and respect through coaching, communication, and listening.

• Think creatively, with willingness to extend beyond the unexpected and consistently strive for innovation.

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and excellent organizational skills.

• Ability to effectively present and sell ideas, bring ideas to life through storytelling.

• Excellent ability to proactively identify issues/obstacles and create timely and effective solutions.

• Ability to manage multiple clients with potentially differing priorities, commitments, and deadlines.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and in teams.

• Must be able to work in a collaborative manner both internally and with clients.

• Experience managing program financials and reporting.

• Ability to learn and navigate various office management platforms (inclusive of but not limited to Office 365, Keynote, Google Drive, Smartsheet, Slack, Zoom, etc)

Other Qualities and Skills

• Natural curiosity—the drive to always be learning and growing, professionally and personally.

• Team-oriented, driven, focused, passionate, and able to stay level-headed under pressure.

• Pro-active and Self-starter who takes the initiative on tasks and is solutions oriented.

• Comfortable with public speaking to both internal and external partners

• High energy and flexibility in working non-traditional hours as needed (some nights and weekends as deadlines dictate).

• Experience working with international teams and multiple time zones.

• Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stay on your feet for extended periods of time.

• Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time (nationally and internationally).

Compensation Range: $80,000 - $95,000 annually. This is the pay range OBE believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the level of experience, relevant skills, professional certifications, market pay, and demand for the role. OBE reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, Benefits include medical/dental/vision insurance, employer-paid basic life and personal accident insurance. Also included: Annual Profit Sharing/Bonus Plan based on the company’s performance and your individual performance, 401(k), Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, PTO, STD/LTD insurance benefits.

jobs.title: Chief People Officer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ORGANIZATION

The North Los Angeles County Regional Center (NLACRC) is a nonprofit organization funded by the California Department of Developmental Services that supports individuals with developmental disabilities and their families in the San Fernando, Santa Clarita, and Antelope Valleys. NLACRC helps individuals access and coordinate services such as assessments, early intervention, individualized planning, family support, advocacy, community resources, and other programs designed to promote independence, inclusion, and quality of life.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Reporting directly to the Executive Director, the Chief People Officer (CPO) serves as a key member of North Los Angeles County Regional Center’s (NLACRC) executive leadership team, providing strategic direction and oversight of all human resources functions. A collaborative and experienced leader, the CPO will bring a strong commitment to NLACRC’s mission of serving individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities while fostering a positive, inclusive, and high-performing workplace culture. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker who can navigate complex organizational needs, build strong relationships, and align HR initiatives with NLACRC’s long-term goals.

Overseeing a13-member Human Resources Department, the CPO is responsible for leading recruitment, employee engagement, labor relations, performance management, compensation and benefits, and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience leading HR operations within a large, complex organization, with expertise in employment law, union negotiations, workforce planning, and organizational development. This role requires a seasoned professional who can advise executive leadership and strengthen HR practices to support NLACRC’s continued growth and mission impact.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Organizational Leadership and Strategy

• Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the Human Resources Department, ensuring alignment with NLACRC’s mission, values, and organizational priorities.

• Develop and implement short- and long-term HR strategies, policies, and initiatives that support organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and workforce development.

• Lead, mentor, and manage 13 staff, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing department with clear expectations and accountability.

• Develop and implement pathways for professional development and clear avenues for growth within the HR Department.

• Partner with the Executive Director and senior leadership to advise on organizational planning, workforce challenges, and strategic HR decisions.

• Serve as a representative of executive leadership at monthly Board of Trustees meetings and provide support to designated Board committees.

Talent Management and Employee Relations

• Develop and oversee comprehensive recruitment, selection, retention, and succession planning strategies to attract and retain qualified professionals.

• Lead employee engagement, performance management, and professional development initiatives to strengthen workplace culture and organizational effectiveness.

• Provide guidance to executive leadership on complex employee relations matters, including disciplinary actions, terminations, conflict resolution, and performance concerns.

• Oversee labor relations, including union negotiations, collective bargaining agreements, grievance procedures, and labor-management meetings.

Compliance, Risk Management, and Labor Relations

• Ensure organizational compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, regulations, and reporting requirements.

• Oversee employee complaints, whistleblower investigations, and conflict-of-interest reporting and resolution.

• Collaborate with legal counsel and executive leadership on sensitive employment matters, labor disputes, and regulatory compliance issues.

• Develop, review, and implement HR policies and procedures that promote organizational accountability, mitigate risk, and support best practices.

Communication and Relationship Management

• Build collaborative relationships across all levels of the organization, fostering trust, open communication, and a positive workplace culture.

• Communicate confidently in individual meetings, group discussions, and presentations, adapting messaging to diverse audiences.

• Apply active listening, cultural sensitivity, and conflict resolution skills to navigate complex employee relations matters.

• Analyze HR data, identify trends, and develop informed recommendations and strategies to support organizational effectiveness.

Human Resources Operations and Financial Oversight

• Oversee the administration and continuous improvement of HR operations, systems, procedures, and departmental workflows.

• Partner with Accounting and Finance to develop and manage competitive compensation and benefits programs that meet regulatory requirements and organizational needs.

• Develop and monitor HR key performance indicators (KPIs), analyze workforce trends, and prepare reports and forecasts for executive leadership and applicable state agencies.

• Develop and manage the Human Resources Department budget, ensuring effective resource allocation and alignment with organizational priorities.

• Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen service delivery across the organization.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field from an accredited college or university required; MBA or master's degree in Human Resources or a related field preferred.

• At least five (5) years of experience in a Human Resources leadership or management role, including supervising HR staff and advising senior leadership on personnel matters.

• Experience in union labor relations, including collective bargaining, grievance hearings, labor-management meetings, and contract negotiations and fostering collaborative labor-management partnerships.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, effective at engaging employees, executive leadership, Board members, and external stakeholders.

• Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws, regulatory compliance, employee relations, and HR best practices.

• Previous HR management experience within a government, nonprofit agency, or regional center is beneficial but not required.

• Professional HR certification, such as SPHR, PHR, SHRM-SCP, or SHRM-CP, preferred.

• Valid California Driver’s License required, with the ability to travel regularly between NLACRC office locations in the San Fernando Valley, Santa Clarita Valley, and Antelope Valley.

• Demonstrated commitment to service, with prior experience in a service-focused organization or role supporting the well-being of individuals and communities.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary range of $165,000- $190,000.

• Health Insurance: NLACRC pays the full cost of employee-only coverage for select medical plans. Generous contributions are also provided toward additional medical plans for employees and eligible dependents.

• Dental Insurance: NLACRC pays the full cost of the Dental DMO Plan for employees and eligible dependents. A Dental PPO Plan is also available with a low monthly employee contribution.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA): Pre-tax flexible spending accounts are available for eligible healthcare and dependent care expenses.

• Life & Disability Insurance: No-cost Life Insurance, Accidental Death & Disability Insurance, and Long-Term Disability Insurance for employees.

• Vision Insurance: No-cost vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

• Retirement Plan: NLACRC participates in CalPERS, a defined benefit retirement plan that provides eligible employees with a monthly retirement allowance.

• Deferred Compensation Plans: NLACRC offers two deferred compensation plans: 457 and 403(b).

• Public Service Loan Forgiveness: Opportunity to participate in the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Program.

• Paid Time Off (PTO): Eligible employees accrue three weeks of vacation during their first year and eight hours of sick leave per month. Additional education, wellness, and sabbatical leave may be available based on eligibility.

• Paid Holidays: 12 paid holidays annually.

• Hybrid Work Options: Hybrid or remote work flexibility following an initial 90-day in-office introductory period.

Envision Consulting was retained by North Los Angeles County Regional Center to search for their Chief People Officer (CPO).

North Los Angeles County Regional Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing employment opportunities without regard to an individual’s age, color, disability, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or veteran status.

Applicants needing accommodation for any part of the application process may contact Envision Consulting at 626.714.7577 to request and arrange for assistance.

jobs.title: Sensors Engineer
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is looking for a Sensor Engineer to own our sensor products across the full development lifecycle, from clean-sheet concept to qualified, production-ready hardware. This role sits at the intersection of design, analysis, test, and production, acting as the technical authority that carries a sensor from architecture through qualification and into the field. You'll own how our sensors perform in the real world, driving trade studies that balance performance, cost, and risk, leading verification and qualification campaigns, and closing the loop through failure investigations that sharpen every future design.



Responsibilities:

System ownership

 - Own sensor products through the full development lifecycle, including conceptualization, architecture, design, analysis, prototyping, qualification, and production

 - Support production as the hardware Responsible Engineering Authority (REA), providing technical solutions, guidance, and documentation when issues arise

 - Manage project budget, schedule, and tasking within a multidisciplinary team of engineers

Test Engineering

 - Own verification and validation activities for sensor subsystem requirements

 - Develop and execute qualification and test campaigns, including creation of test plans, procedures, and reports. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and maintain test stations and ground support equipment (GSE/STE)

 - Perform failure investigations and root cause analyses, incorporating lessons learned into future designs and test approaches

Technical Development

 - Perform system- and component-level trade studies to evaluate architectures and designs to optimize performance, cost, schedule, and technical risk

 - Collaborate with teams across structures, thermal, optics, avionics, software, GNC, manufacturing, mission assurance, and supply chain to develop integrated sensor solutions

 - Present technical work at design reviews and create clear, thorough engineering documentation

Required Qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related discipline

 - Hands-on experience developing, prototyping, integrating, and/or testing multidisciplinary systems

 - Demonstrated hardware, project, or product ownership experience

 - Strong understanding of test engineering fundamentals and methodologies

 - Demonstrated leadership, time management, and organizational skills

 - Comfortable researching and creating clean-sheet subsystem architectures and designs within an open design space

 - Self-motivated and eager to learn in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment

Preferred Qualifications:

 - 1-2 years of experience in aerospace, automotive, or other technical product development/test

 - Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related discipline

 - Experience developing, designing, implementing, and/or testing sensor systems

 - Familiarity with Design for Manufacturing (DFM/DFMA) principles

 - Familiarity with satellite systems and space environments

 - Familiarity with all stages of the hardware product lifecycle

 - Familiarity with project management tools and techniques



#LI-HC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup: All the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. You can learn more about ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Apex Technology, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Staff Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.




APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Render is looking for a Staff Developer Relations Engineer to grow usage and word of mouth for Render among developers building full-stack and AI applications. You'll be Render's technical face on stage, in workshops, at meetups, and in the developer and AI ecosystems where our users build.

DX at Render has two halves. DX Engineering builds and maintains Render's tutorials, sample apps, templates, and video library. DevRel takes Render to developers in person and through the communities and partners they trust, then brings what it hears back into the product. You'll set the technical bar and direction for DevRel, and you'll be the person developers and partners go to for a deep, candid answer about running AI workloads on Render.

You'll build the demos and workshop material behind your own talks. When something you build deserves a long life, DX Engineering turns it into a maintained example or template.

This is a remote role within the US, with the option to work out of our headquarters in San Francisco. Expect regular travel for conferences and events.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Represent Render at conferences, meetups, hackathons, podcasts, and livestreams, with talks and live demos on building and running AI agents and full-stack apps.

 - Design and run hands-on workshops and hackathons, from the curriculum to the technical setup behind them.

 - Set DevRel's technical direction: pick the communities, ecosystems, and events worth investing in, and define what good looks like for talks, workshops, and demos.

 - Be the technical counterpart for ecosystem partners such as AI frameworks, agent tooling, and open source projects: joint workshops, co-hosted events, and the integrations worth building together.

 - Go deep in technical communities on GitHub, X, Discord, Reddit, and Hacker News. Answer hard questions, debug real deployments, and show up where Render has a credible voice.

 - Run the developer feedback loop. Turn what you hear in the field into clear, prioritized input for Product and Engineering, and follow it through until it ships.

 - Help Render's highest-potential developers and startups go further on the platform through technical deep dives and architecture reviews, and turn them into champions who talk about Render in their own communities.

 - Raise the bar for the DevRel team through talk reviews, demo reviews, and your own work.

 - Track impact through activation from events and workshops, community engagement, partner-driven adoption, and the product changes you drove.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in developer relations, solutions engineering, or software engineering, including at least 3 years in a developer-facing role at a developer tools, cloud, or infrastructure company.

 - Hands-on fluency with AI agents: tool calling, MCP servers, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks. You can build a working agent app live and explain what it needs to run in production, such as long-running tasks, sandboxed code execution, and retries. NICE-TO-HAVES

 - A hackathon co-hosted with an AI framework partner, including the starter kit and the technical support on the day.

 - The talk track for an upcoming launch, delivered by you and the rest of DevRel.

 - A recurring field report for Product on where developers get stuck running agents on Render.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.




BENEFITS

 - 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company.  Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service.  With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

• Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.

• Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.

Job Summary:

At SmithRx, we recognize that exceptional customer support is essential for both member satisfaction and product success. In healthcare, this is especially crucial, as it directly impacts patient access to care. We're seeking dedicated individuals to join our call center team, providing top-tier service to our members.

Ideal candidates possess strong communication, follow-through, and data entry skills, thriving in a fast-paced environment. A genuine, compassionate approach to member interactions is key.

$21—$21 USD

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's go-to-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows.

This is an engineering role that goes beyond pipelines. You'll treat GTM data as a product and a platform: built once, kept current, and available wherever people work. Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team.

Key responsibilities

• Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first-party product and revenue data alongside third-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape

• Build and maintain identity and entity resolution, so every source attaches to one trusted record for each company and the relationships between companies are clear

• Help build the canonical layer where key attributes are defined once and mean the same thing everywhere, with clear sourcing logic, provenance, and freshness

• Turn data into intelligence: scores, signals, and AI-generated attributes that help GTM teams prioritize and act, held to the same quality bar as any other source

• Deliver that intelligence to the surfaces where teams work, including the CRM, and bring production discipline to how data moves through those systems

• Operate what you build as a living system, with observability, data quality, cost, security, and access controls designed in, so problems surface before the field sees them

• Partner with the owners of GTM processes such as planning, segmentation, and routing to settle definitions, make clear commitments, and communicate tradeoffs

• Make the platform easy for other teams to build on, so work is contributed once and not rebuilt in silos

Minimum qualifications

• Experience as a data engineer or analytics engineer building and operating production pipelines and data models

• Strong SQL and Python, and experience with modern transformation and orchestration tooling on a cloud data warehouse

• Experience making messy data from many sources usable, including record matching, deduplication, and reconciling conflicting values

• Familiarity with go-to-market data and the CRM systems it flows through

• Judgment beyond the pipeline: weighing data sources, shaping definitions with business partners, and making calls on data quality

• Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical partners

• Regular hands-on use of AI tools in your engineering work

Preferred qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or GTM data roles

• Experience building a shared data product or platform that several teams depend on and contribute to

• Experience with company data such as firmographics, corporate hierarchies, or master data management

• Experience using LLMs inside data pipelines and evaluating their output

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including working at large data volumes

• Experience supporting GTM planning processes such as territory design, segmentation, or scoring

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Apera is an innovative, Vancouver-based company at the forefront of robotics, AI, and machine vision — recognized with the 2025 Frost & Sullivan Technology Innovation Leadership Award and the 2024 BC Tech "Company of the Year, Growth" award. We're on a mission to redefine AI-driven robotic vision.

Apera AI helps manufacturers make their factories more flexible and productive. Robots enhanced with Apera's software have 4D Vision — the ability to see and grasp objects with human-like capability. Challenging applications such as bin picking, sorting, packaging, and assembly are now open to fast, precise, and reliable automation. We work with the world's leading automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.

Our portfolio spans Vue (our 4D Vision software), Forge (a no-code simulation and AI training studio where customers build, validate, and de-risk robotic cells before any hardware is bought), and VuePod, our new turnkey, productized bin-picking cell.

Let's End Robot Blindness

Robots can do remarkable things, if they can see. We're Apera AI. Our 4D Vision platform turns blind robots into intelligent, adaptable workers. But that transformation doesn't happen without the right people, especially those who open new doors and help manufacturers see what's possible.

We're hiring a Business Development Manager for our Michigan and Ohio territory. If you've spent years building relationships with Tier 1 automotive suppliers, plant engineers, and OEM operations teams and you know how to navigate a complex, multi-stakeholder sales environment, this is the role you've been building toward.

What You'll Actually Do

• Hunt and close. Identify, qualify, and close six-figure deals with automotive manufacturers, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, and industrial OEMs across Michigan and Ohio.

• Build a territory from the ground up using AI-powered lead intelligence, account-based outreach, and a rigorous qualification process.

• Lead technical-commercial conversations with plant engineers, quality directors, and automation leaders to uncover real problems and propose real solutions.

• Develop ROI models and customized proposals that translate Apera's 4D Vision capabilities into operational value for each customer.

• Collaborate with Solutions Engineering on POC scopes, demos, and deployment planning.

• Grow strategic accounts, one plant win becomes a multi-site program.

Why This Is a Career Move, Not Just a Job

• You will own a territory at the center of North American automotive manufacturing, Detroit, Toledo, Cleveland, Columbus, and everything in between.

• You'll sell technology recognized by Frost & Sullivan, AAM, and BC Tech for transforming automation globally.

• Equity from day one and a growth path at a Series A company hiring deliberately and moving quickly.

• Every deal means faster production lines, safer factory floors, and smarter robots doing real work for real manufacturers.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of B2B business development or technical sales in industrial automation, machine vision, robotics, or manufacturing technology.

• Proven track record of building pipeline from scratch and closing long-cycle, solution-based deals with Tier 1 manufacturers or OEMs.

• Comfortable on plant floors and in executive conversations - you can engage process engineers and VP-level buyers in the same day.

• Experience collaborating with engineering teams on proposals, POC designs, and system demonstrations.

• Deep familiarity with the Michigan and Ohio manufacturing landscape.

• Willingness to travel 50-70%.

Bonus Points

• Direct experience selling to Tier 1 automotive suppliers (Magna, Lear, Aptiv, BorgWarner, Martinrea, Dana, and similar).

• Background in machine vision, 3D vision, or robotics automation software.

• Experience using AI tools for lead generation, pipeline management, or deal forecasting.

Why Apera?

• Every employee is an owner - equity for all from day one.

• Well-funded Series A to fuel ambitious product roadmaps and US market expansion.

• A team that moves fast, shares openly, and gives you the tools to win.

• Trusted by automotive Tier 1 suppliers and leading industrial manufacturers globally.

Annual Compensation: $90,000–$110,000 base salary  |  $175,000–$210,000 OTE

If you're ready to bring Apera's 4D Vision and show the automotive industry what robots can truly see - let's talk

jobs.title: Shop Manager – Bloomingdale’s Century City
jobs.description:
Jenni Kayne is a California-based lifestyle brand that aims to empower an elevated approach to everyday living. Whether it’s our edited style ethos or coveted interiors sensibility, we work hard to create a world that's inviting and intentional. From our stores across the country to our operations and corporate teams, we believe in the power of a workplace that’s built on diversity and inclusion—where the varied voices and viewpoints of our community pave the way.

As a Jenni Kayne Concession Shop Manager, your primary responsibilities include the following:

As the Bloomingdale's Shop Manager at Jenni Kayne, you will lead the day-to-day operations, sales performance, and client experience of our concession within Bloomingdale's. You will be responsible for driving revenue, developing a high-performing team, maintaining brand standards, and building strong partnerships with Bloomingdale's leadership and associates. This role requires a hands-on leader who embodies the Jenni Kayne brand, delivers an elevated client experience, and drives business results within a department store environment.

Role & Responsibilities

As the Bloomingdale's Shop Manager, your primary responsibilities include the following:

Sales & Client Experience

• Drive concession sales performance by achieving or exceeding sales goals, KPIs, and business objectives.

• Deliver an exceptional, personalized client experience that reflects the Jenni Kayne brand and service standards.

• Lead by example on the sales floor, demonstrating strong selling, styling, and relationship-building skills.

• Build and maintain an active client book through personalized outreach, follow-up, and clienteling initiatives.

• Partner with Bloomingdale's associates and department leadership to increase brand awareness, client engagement, and sales opportunities.

• Leverage Bloomingdale's clienteling tools, including B-Connected, to strengthen client relationships and drive repeat business.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, coach, and develop concession team members to achieve individual and collective sales goals.

• Foster a positive, collaborative, and results-driven team environment aligned with Jenni Kayne's values.

• Provide ongoing performance feedback, product education, and selling support to strengthen team capabilities.

• Partner with Retail Sales leadership and Bloomingdale's management on staffing, scheduling, and business coverage needs.

• Ensure team members consistently demonstrate brand knowledge, professionalism, and elevated service standards.

• Lead by example in maximizing productivity during downtime through client outreach, merchandising, and operational support.

Store Operations & Inventory Management

• Oversee daily concession operations, ensuring compliance with Jenni Kayne and Bloomingdale's policies, procedures, and operational standards.

• Maintain organized stockrooms, accurate inventory records, and efficient shipment, replenishment, and transfer processes.

• Oversee stock associate responsibilities, ensuring operational tasks are completed accurately and on time.

• Conduct weekly cycle counts, monitor inventory discrepancies, and report shrink or loss in accordance with company procedures.

• Partner with Buying, Planning, and Allocation teams to communicate product needs, inventory opportunities, and assortment feedback.

• Ensure accurate execution of point-of-sale transactions, returns, exchanges, and other customer service processes using Bloomingdale's systems.

Visual Merchandising & Brand Presentation

• Maintain the concession's visual presentation in alignment with Jenni Kayne's merchandising standards and brand aesthetic.

• Execute seasonal floor sets, product launches, and merchandising updates in partnership with Jenni Kayne and Bloomingdale's visual teams.

• Identify opportunities for enhanced brand visibility, including mannequin placement, product features, and promotional presentations.

• Provide regular visual updates, including photographs and feedback, to Retail Sales leadership.

• Ensure the sales floor and stock areas remain clean, organized, and consistently maintained.

Business Performance & Reporting

• Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance, identifying opportunities to improve revenue, conversion, and overall business results.

• Develop and execute action plans to achieve sales goals and improve concession performance.

• Provide weekly business recaps, product feedback, and performance updates to Retail Sales leadership.

• Participate in weekly business meetings and leadership touchpoints to review results, priorities, and opportunities.

• Prepare for and participate in quarterly business reviews and site visits, providing insights on sales, product performance, competitive brands, and operational needs.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to support business growth, inventory productivity, and overall concession success.

Bloomingdale's Partnership & Brand Representation

• Serve as the primary Jenni Kayne brand ambassador within Bloomingdale's, building strong relationships with department managers, associates, and leadership.

• Partner with Bloomingdale's management to identify opportunities to increase brand visibility, customer engagement, and sales.

• Coordinate product knowledge sessions, morning meetings, and quarterly training opportunities with Bloomingdale's associates.

• Collaborate with Jenni Kayne's Education & Training team to ensure consistent product knowledge and brand storytelling.

• Maintain strong communication and partnerships with nearby Jenni Kayne retail locations to support client referrals and cross-channel opportunities.

• Ensure the concession consistently represents Jenni Kayne's brand identity, service philosophy, and commitment to an elevated customer experience.

Qualifications & Experience

• 3–5 years of retail management or leadership experience, preferably within luxury, contemporary fashion, lifestyle, or department store retail.

• Proven ability to drive sales, achieve KPIs, and lead a high-performing retail team.

• Strong selling, styling, clienteling, and relationship-building skills.

• Experience working within a department store or concession environment preferred.

• Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Strong understanding of retail operations, inventory management, visual merchandising, and retail math.

• Ability to analyze sales performance and translate business insights into actionable strategies.

• Proficiency with POS systems, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office; Bloomingdale's systems experience preferred.

• Ability to manage competing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

• Flexibility to work a retail schedule, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays based on business needs.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout scheduled shifts.

• Ability to lift, carry, push, or move merchandise and supplies weighing 30 pounds or more, with assistance or equipment when appropriate.

• Ability to bend, kneel, reach, grasp, and climb ladders safely as required.

• Ability to perform essential job responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodation.

Additional Notes

This job description is not all inclusive. In addition, Kayne LLC dba Jenni Kayne reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Kayne LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

The annual base salary for this position is $80,000–$85,000. The base salary is determined by experience, education, skills, and location.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner, Claude Corps
jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

Role Type: Full-time
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Reports To: Head of People
Comp: $110,000 - $150,000

About Claude Corps

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Cohorts now run in the hundreds, and new fellows onboard while earlier cohorts are still placed. We need an HR partner who can support fellows and their managers year-round and run onboarding at that scale.

About the role

You are the HR partner to Claude Corps program leaders and the AI Practice Leads who manage fellows day to day. You will own onboarding quality and deadlines for each cohort while Sr People Operations Coordinator, reporting to you, runs the day-to-day execution.

Your focus shifts throughout the year. As a cohort prepares to start, you spend more time running onboarding and completing the work alongside the Sr. People Operations Coordinator. Once fellows are placed, you spend more time advising managers, addressing employee concerns, and supporting performance. New cohorts will onboard while earlier cohorts are still working, so you will need to balance both responsibilities.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You bring sound judgment to employee situations, help managers address issues early, and build clear processes as the program grows. You work closely with the Head of People, the recruiting team, program leaders, Finance, and our HR service providers.

As onboarding volume grows, you identify when additional support is needed, define that work, and train and oversee the people helping deliver it. You remain accountable for onboarding quality and deadlines.

What you’ll do

Partner with program leaders and managers

• Advise program leaders and AI Practice Leads on performance, employee concerns, role expectations, and team needs, and help managers set clear expectations and address problems early

• Clarify who owns what between fellow managers, host organizations, and the program team when employee questions arise

• Identify recurring issues and recommend changes to manager guidance, policies, or how the program operates

Manage employee relations and performance issues

• Handle employee concerns with care and consistency: gather the facts, document clearly, and bring significant issues and recommended actions to the Head of People

• Guide managers through performance conversations, improvement plans, and conduct issues

• Manage leave and accommodation requests with the appropriate providers and advisors

Own fellow onboarding

• Run onboarding for each cohort, from signed offer through the employment steps needed to start: background checks, I-9 and work authorization, employee records, payroll setup, and benefits enrollment

• Confirm work locations and coordinate state notices and employment documents

• Send clear instructions, track each fellow’s progress, and work with recruiting and program teams to resolve missing information, changes, and delays

• Complete onboarding tasks directly, check that records and setup are accurate, and keep employment onboarding aligned with orientation and cohort start dates

Plan and oversee onboarding support

• Manage the Senior People Operations Coordinator: set priorities by cohort, review their work, and keep sensitive questions and decisions with the right HR owner

• Plan onboarding workload against cohort size, deadlines, and support needed for current fellows, and flag when volume requires surge help

• Build checklists and repeatable processes so larger cohorts onboard with less manual work

Support fellows throughout the year

• Be an HR contact for questions about benefits, leave, workplace concerns, and employment policies

• Help managers and fellows resolve timekeeping issues and coordinate payroll corrections with Finance and our providers

• Maintain accurate employee records as work locations or employment details change

• Coordinate fellowship completion, early departures, and offboarding

• Track recurring questions and improve guidance so fellows and managers know what to do

Maintain policies and employment practices

• Keep the Fellow Handbook, manager guidance, and state supplements current with the Head of People and appropriate advisors

• Coordinate multistate employment requirements and help managers understand the rules for hourly, nonexempt employees

• Apply policies consistently and seek legal or specialized advice when a situation calls for it

Improve HR processes and reporting

• Track onboarding readiness, open tasks, and employee issues, and give the Head of People clear updates on risks, workload, and recommended actions

jobs.title: Content Product Marketer
jobs.description:
ABOUT WISPR

Wispr is an AI research and product company building the voice interface for computing. AI can now reason, code, and act. Yet, humans still do the work of the interface. We think that’s backwards. https://wisprflow.ai/post/the-master-plan

Our first products are Flow, which lets you speak naturally in any application, and Notetaker, which builds context across conversations. We’re building toward an interface that can perceive, understand, and take action with earned trust. That means solving hard problems across models, systems, and product - and caring about the final human experience as deeply as the technology underneath it.


We’re a talent-dense team that holds strong opinions, tests them quickly, and builds technology that sparks joy. Our goal is to build the first voice interface used every day by a billion people.




We're hiring a Content Marketer, Product to own how Wispr Flow's features show up on X and LinkedIn. Every time we ship something, you turn it into a video people actually stop for — and you keep that engine running week after week.



You'll sit between product and social. You'll know the roadmap before it ships, find the moment in each feature that makes someone go "wait, I need that," and cut it into creative that earns its reach organically.



What you will do

 - Own the evergreen product update motion on X and LinkedIn — from roadmap to finished post

 - Concept, script, shoot, and edit launch videos for every meaningful feature release

 - Keep shipped features alive with recurring formats: tips, workflows, before/after demos, power-user moments

 - Partner with product and design early, so creative is ready the day a feature ships

 - Adapt each piece natively per platform — what wins on X rarely wins on LinkedIn as-is

 - Use AI tools to move faster: rough cuts, b-roll, captions, voice, motion, variations

 - Track what outperforms, kill what doesn't, and turn the winners into repeatable templates

 - Work closely with brand, growth, and the social team while owning product storytelling end to end



What success looks like

 - Every feature release lands with a video that beats our account's organic baseline

 - A steady cadence of product content between launches, so features keep getting discovered

 - A library of proven formats the team can reuse and remix



Who you are

 - 3+ years making video content for software or consumer tech brands

 - A portfolio of feature launch videos that outperformed organically — bring the links and the numbers

 - Fluent in Premiere Pro, CapCut, and DaVinci Resolve

 - Strong instinct for hooks, pacing, and the first two seconds

 - Can take a dense feature and make it obvious, fast

 - Native to X and LinkedIn — you know how each platform rewards video

 - High-agency and quick: you ship, read the data, and iterate without waiting to be told



Bonus points

 - Comfortable behind a camera — lighting, audio, lenses, run-and-gun setups

 - Savvy with AI video and creative tools, and opinionated about where they help

 - Motion graphics or screen-recording polish (After Effects, Screen Studio, or similar)

 - A personal account or side channel where you've grown an audience with your own videos

 - You already use Flow




LOGISTICS

We sponsor H1B, O1, EB1, L1, STEM OPT, and more. We can't guarantee sponsorship for every role, but if we make you an offer we'll make every reasonable effort, with help from our immigration law firm.

We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. The strongest candidates we meet rarely do, so don't exclude yourself prematurely. We're rethinking how humans interact with AI, and doing that well demands diversity of perspective and experience.

We're committed to a fair and accessible interview process. If you need any accommodations or adjustments, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Trade Strategy, Distribution & Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

The Senior Director, Trade Strategy, Distribution & Strategic Accounts sets the strategy for all Trade Channel accounts, serves as the executive relationship lead for National Retail and other strategic trade partners, and is responsible for implementing and managing the day-to-day operations of ARS’ Trade and Distribution channels for our products. They will implement optimal network access for all new product launches across the entire Trade Channel to include 3PL, Wholesale, National Retail, Alternate Channel, Distribution, GPO, and Pharmacy partners. This role serves as the lead point of contact for all trade related activities, including distribution and trade contracting efforts for the entire product portfolio and developing business relationships with appropriate individuals within each assigned account. Beyond product availability, the role is accountable for identifying and growing trade partner opportunities that deliver measurable account growth and attractive channel economics.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Performs periodic business reviews and strategic planning meetings with Trade Channel partners, including National Retail accounts.

• Serves as the executive relationship lead for National Retail and other strategic trade partners and maintains strong business relationships with key decision makers across purchasing, pharmacy operations, distribution, and finance.

• Identifies and develops new growth opportunities with National Retail and other trade partners, translating them into joint business plans, negotiated initiatives, and measurable results.

• Direct and oversee all partner activities, including, product handling and storage, inventory management, performance measurement for services provided by channel, audit support, and resolution of field issues (i.e., problems reported from providers/pharmacies, distributors, related to service and product access); establishes service-level expectations and serves as the senior escalation point for partner performance

• Establishes and executes the multiyear U.S. trade and distribution strategy (channel architecture, partner mix, and service model) and any new product distribution strategy and launch preparedness, supported by business cases for channel expansion and strategic investments

• Owns an end-to-end understanding of how product moves through every component of the channel, from 3PL and wholesaler through retail and specialty pharmacy to the patient, and proactively identifies potential marketplace trends/barriers and opportunities to accelerate or leverage trade partners, and creates strategies that will optimize access and create reimbursement confidence with providers and patients; advises commercial leadership on partner consolidation and emerging distribution and retail models

• Owns trade activation and pull-through, ensuring contracted accounts can order, stock, and access product, resolving barriers such as item setup, eligibility, and ordering pathways, and distinguishing initial channel fill from sustained demand.

• Collaborates with cross functional teams specific to SOP’s and contractual obligations associated with distribution infrastructure, reimbursement, marketing, pharmacovigilance, supply chain, quality assurance, patient services, legal, regulatory, TechOps, and finance

• Negotiates and executes distribution and trade contracts including oversight and management of renewals, terms of sale, revenue recognition, payment/collections for product sales with all trade channel accounts, including National Retail, wholesalers, GPOs, buying groups, 3PLs, and specialty pharmacies; evaluates agreement economics and terms.

• Monitors and maintains compliance to Prescription Drug Marketing Act (PDMA), Good Manufacturing Practice, Safety Health and Environmental, Sarbanes-Oxley, business procedures, raising and addressing issues as they arise; partners with Government Pricing, Legal, and Compliance before trade commitments are finalized

• Aligns with Finance on managing accounting, pricing, GTN, inventory, forecasting and the trade operating budget

• Ensures data integrity and adequate data flows and compliance between the company and distribution vendors and trade partners; partners with business analytics to develop and disseminate distribution and account related key performance indicators/analysis covering channel inventory, downstream demand, account penetration, and contract performance, and ensures accurate sales/shipment reporting to senior management

• Proactively develops data-driven, defensible strategic recommendations for leveraging trade partners and presents them to the VP, Market Access, owning each recommendation from analysis through implementation.

• Perform quarterly accuracy and completeness audits for finance and external auditors.

• Builds and leads the trade function (including internal partners essential to trade/account work, supported by external partners as appropriate) directing vendors and cross functional workstreams against defined outcomes and budgets

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Strong understanding of various distribution and retail trade models, operation challenges and requirements to implement.

• Ability to build relationships and expand company's presence with National Retail and distribution partners, with executive presence among senior trade and purchasing leaders.

• Deep experience and strong understanding of Trade processes and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements, including government reporting and pricing considerations.

• Strong commercial judgment, financial acumen, analytical, communication and negotiation skills, and broad understanding of Pricing and Contracting SOPs, practices, methodology, and approaches.

• Strategic and rigorous analytical agility while using sound judgment to set objectives; naturally curious and proactive, approaching the role as a strategic owner

• Leadership, presentation, and cross-functional interaction skills with a proven track record of delivering results, and the ability to build a function while remaining hands-on.

• Strong diplomatic & interpersonal skills and able to inspire respect and trust from others, and ability to influence without authority.

• Must be able to travel up to 35%, consistent with national account responsibilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Sales, Business Administration or Pharmaceutical related field required; advanced degree (e.g., MBA and/or CPA) preferred.

• 12–15+ years relevant industry experience in the bio/pharmaceutical, and/or vaccines environment, including leadership responsibility in trade, distribution, or strategic accounts.

• 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry experience working with payer / reimbursement/ wholesale/ specialty distributors, national retail, GPOs, and specialty pharmacies; strong understanding of typical functions and procedures.

• Demonstrated success negotiating complex trade agreements, launching products, and delivering measurable account growth with national retail and other trade partners.

Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer- SDR Hardware
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Radio Hardware Engineer

As a Radio Hardware Engineer at Astranis you will be responsible for the design, qualification, and test of our custom software defined radios. We're looking for people who are comfortable designing state of the art high speed hardware. If you think of signals in volts, bits, and dB's, this is the role for you! You will work closely with the RTL, Comms, and RF designs to help design the best possible radio systems for our payload and TTC systems.

Role

• Design and test ultra high speed digital data systems

• Work with state of the art FPGAs and data converters

• Design and lay out PCBs to implement these systems

• Test and validate full radio signal chain

• Integrate these systems into the spacecraft by working closely with the rest of the team

• Assist in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring additional teammates to our rapidly-growing team.

Requirements

• B.S. or M.S. in electrical or computer engineering, or equivalent technical degree

• A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design and development

• Demonstrated ability to personally design, build, and test hardware from scratch

• Experience with Altium or similar EDA tools

• Experience with high-density PCB design

• Strong analog/mixed-signal circuit design skills

• Experience designing high speed clock trees

• Comfortable working with full RF signal chain

• Don't meet them all? Not a problem. Please apply even if you do not meet all these criteria.

Bonus

• Experience using state of the art wideband programmable data converters

• Familiarity with radio nonidealities (HD, IMD, IQ imbalance, gain ripple, group delay distortion)

• Familiarity with high speed SERDES protocols (double bonus: JESD204B)

• Experience with RF test + measurement equipment

• Experience with digital communications theory and measurement

• Experience with Python for measurement automation and data analysis

What we offer:

All our positions offer a compensation package that includes equity and robust benefits.

Base pay is just one component of Astranis’s total rewards package. Your compensation also includes a significant equity package via incentive stock options, high-quality company-subsidized healthcare, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement planning, flexible PTO, and free on-site catered meals.

Astranis pay ranges are informed and defined through professional-grade salary surveys and compensation data sources. Backed by some of the top VC’s such as: Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into Ironblood, the first AI Native streaming platform for action and adventure, is only the beginning of our journey to becoming the next-gen entertainment powerhouse.
The Role:
We’re building the best romance catalogue in the world, and we’re assembling a small team of creative people to do it. As an Associate Editor, you’ll take books that readers almost love and reimagine them: the characters, the stakes, the pacing, the plot, the emotional payoff. You’ll study how readers respond, work out what’s holding a story back, and rebuild it into something that hits far harder. Then you’ll put your version in front of real readers and see if you were right.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Grow With Us

We’re seeking a Senior Customer Implementation Consultant to join our growing Customer Success and Support team. This is a senior-level individual contributor role for someone who thrives in complex implementation environments, has strong product expertise, and is passionate about improving operational excellence.

You’ll be a strategic advisor during the onboarding journey for our most complex customers, owning the implementation lifecycle and working cross-functionally to ensure customer success. You’ll also be a thought partner to leadership and a mentor to peers—raising the bar as we scale our team and company.

This role reports to the Senior Manager of Implementation and is based in Lehi, UT, with a hybrid schedule requiring in-office presence on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

• Lead high-complexity implementations for large, multi-site customers with minimal oversight.
