• Own the end-to-end project lifecycle, including project planning, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and successful go-live.

• Collaborate deeply with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to influence roadmap priorities and share customer feedback.

• Build and continuously improve scalable implementation processes, documentation, and templates.

• Deliver executive-level presentations and client onboarding plans for key enterprise accounts.

• Contribute to internal enablement by mentoring team members, leading knowledge shares, and serving as a go-to implementation SME.

• Influence team culture by modeling operational excellence, curiosity, and customer empathy.

Who You Are

• You think like an operator—planning ahead, spotting inefficiencies, and continuously refining the customer journey.

• You’re a trusted voice in the room, both with customers and internal stakeholders.

• You’re naturally curious and autonomous—you don’t wait for a playbook; you help write it.

• You lift others—offering your expertise freely and proactively mentoring teammates.

• 5+ years of experience leading SaaS implementations for complex or enterprise-level clients, ideally in HRIS, Payroll, and/or B2B software

• 5+ years in a customer-facing consulting, implementation, or technical onboarding role

• Proven ability to manage multiple high-touch onboarding projects simultaneously

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills—especially with Product and Engineering

• Experience advising clients on process design, adoption strategy, and change management

• Deep project management skills—you can build Gantt charts in your sleep

Nice To Have

What We Offer

• An early employee opportunity at a Series B hyper-growth startup; work with the founding team and industry veterans to accelerate your career

• Competitive salary and equity

• Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision. We pay 95% of your premiums for our employees and 85% for dependents

In compliance with the California Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range for this role is $90,000 to $105,000 in Lehi, Utah, plus eligibility for a performance-based bonus and equity package. jobs.title: Senior Event Ops Manager
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

POSITION TITLE: SENIOR EVENT OPERATIONS MANAGER

On board experiential marketing

OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly-but-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Senior Event Operations Manager is an integral part of the Account Team, delivering an exceptional level of service and execution of programs on behalf of our clients. Responsible for generating and expanding our client accounts and relationships, which requires a comprehensive understanding of our clients’ business needs and a competitive landscape.  They lead end-to-end project management on large-scale, complex programs, creative and strategic solutions to deliver on program KPIs. This position is accountable for financial and operational performance, managing program budgets and resource utilization. The Senior Event Operations Manager ensures that programs and marketing strategies successfully promote client brands, products, and services in accordance with client initiatives.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Demonstrate thought-leadership with insightful analysis of client objectives to develop innovative solutions that successfully deliver clients’ message and enhance the brand presence.

• Drive all client activations and program activities and ensure that they are planned, developed, staffed, and executed with the utmost professionalism, accountability, and timeliness.

• Develop and manage program SOWs ensuring resources, budgets, timelines, and deliverables stay aligned with terms of contract and client commitments.

• Lead weekly internal and external status meetings and deep dives. Manage the proper distribution of all communications and client/account team interface throughout engagement.

• Provide ongoing monitoring of expenses and actual costs for approved program budgets. Update client and obtain client approvals as needed. Reconcile all program expenses in partnership with program Production lead.

• Provide ongoing monitoring and guidance of creative deliverables, ensuring client review and approvals as needed in partnership with Creative, Production and Digital teams.

• Continuously optimize program processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

• Oversee the organization of internal and external workstreams and program documentation, ensuring the account team keeps materials current and accessible to cross-functional teams and external partners.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously and supervise, mentor, and develop account personnel, including Event Operations Managers.

• Remain current with industry trends and technologies.

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Education / Experience

• 5+ years of experience in project management, marketing, promotions, and events within an advertising, media, marketing, or experiential agency.

• Minimum 3 years of experience as a day-to-day client contact or Account Lead.

• Experience supervising and developing junior account staff.

• Strong project management capabilities, organization skills, attention to detail, and ability to juggle multiple projects in a demanding but highly collaborative environment.

• Experience working with tech clients is strongly desired

• Experience managing IRL experiential activations is required.

• BA/BS in marketing, business administration, communications, or related field.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Strong communication skills with the ability to connect with others authentically while equally honoring and respecting diverse perspectives.

• Exceptional project management and critical thinking skills, with a drive to optimize processes.

• Ability to build trust and respect through coaching, communication, and listening.

• Think creatively, with a willingness to go beyond the expected and consistently strive for innovation.

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and excellent organizational skills.

• Ability to effectively present and sell ideas, bring ideas to life through storytelling.

• Excellent ability to proactively identify issues/obstacles and create timely and effective solutions.

• Ability to manage multiple clients with potentially differing priorities, commitments, and deadlines.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and in teams.

• Must be able to work in a collaborative manner both internally and with clients.

• Experience owning budgets and financial reporting across multiple concurrent programs.

• Ability to learn and navigate various office management platforms (inclusive of but not limited to Office 365, Keynote, Google Drive, Smartsheet, Slack, Zoom, etc)

Other Qualities and Skills

• Natural curiosity—the drive to always be learning and growing, professionally and personally.

• Team-oriented, driven, focused, passionate, and able to stay level-headed under pressure.

• Pro-active and Self-starter who takes the initiative on tasks and is solutions oriented.

• Comfortable with public speaking to both internal and external partners

• High energy and flexibility in working non-traditional hours as needed (some nights and weekends as deadlines dictate).

• Experience working with international teams and multiple time zones.

• Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stay on your feet for extended periods of time.

• Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time (nationally and internationally).

Compensation Range: $95,000 - $110,000 annually. This is the pay range OBE believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the level of experience, relevant skills, professional certifications, market pay, and demand for the role. OBE reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, Benefits include medical/dental/vision insurance, employer-paid basic life and personal accident insurance. Also included: Annual Profit Sharing/Bonus Plan based on the company’s performance and your individual performance, 401(k), Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, PTO, STD/LTD insurance benefits.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)

As a Sr. Software Engineer on the Starlink Enterprise Products team you will define, build, and deploy product features and capabilities that unlock new opportunities to advance global connectivity. Your software will have a meaningful and measurable impact in areas such as aviation, maritime, transportation, healthcare, remote communities, research operations, media broadcast, datacenters, and more.

To succeed in this role, you must be a technically excellent first-principles problem solver. You must be a self-starter and have a passion for making things work in high-impact situations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop highly reliable real-time software running on network switches, servers, ground antennas, and satellites to optimize network performance to support the most demanding applications and environments.

• Own the impact of the software you create over its complete lifecycle including architecture design, implementation, testing, and support. Incorporate learnings from real-world deployments to drive continual improvement.

• Develop tools where needed to support testing, performance monitoring and troubleshooting of the systems that depend on your software.

• Build prototypes and manage experiments to prove out key design concepts.

• Innovate next-generation networking technologies to direct data through an ever-changing network of satellites, ground stations, and users.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or science discipline.

• 5+ years of professional experience in software development.

• Experience with networking protocols (UDP, TCP/IP, etc.) and operating systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience writing software on embedded devices.

• Experience writing C or C++ in a production environment.

• Experience owning development, testing, and deployment of software for real-world applications.

• Experience developing software for network optimization, traffic shaping, or bandwidth management.

• Proven ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements.

• Experience with security issues associated with distributed systems and internet services.

• Deep understanding of service provider networks including but not limited to:

• Connectivity (Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6 and MPLS)

• Routing (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS)

• Internet services (subscriber provisioning, BRAS, DNS, DHCP, NTP)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 3: $165,000.00 - $270,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

jobs.title: Partner Sales Director, Federal & Public Sector
jobs.description:
Forward was founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, building the industry's first network digital twin: a mathematically accurate model of the production network. It's the foundation for autonomous networking, giving engineers and AI agents the ability to know the impact of every change before it touches production. We're accurate and evidence-driven, relentless about clarity, and we'd rather be certain than comfortable.

Global leaders like Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM and Dell trust Forward, alongside fast-growing enterprises and government agencies, realizing an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits, according to IDC. Some of the top Federal agencies are already buying and referenceable. Forward is backed by A. Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, Omega Venture Partners, Section 32 and Threshold Ventures, and is headquartered in Santa Clara.

The Role

We're looking for our first Partner Sales Director for Federal and Public Sector to build and scale Forward's Federal, State, Local and Education (SLED) Partner ecosystem. You'll recruit and grow the Federal resellers, distributors,and MSPs who can both sell and deliver Forward, and you'll own a Partner-sourced and Partner-influenced pipeline number and the closed revenue that follows. This is a 100% channel role.

You'll report to the VP, Strategic Partnerships & Channel Sales, with a dotted line to the VP of Sales, Federal & Public Sector. You'll work hand-in-hand with the Federal Regional Sales Directors (DoW,for example Air Force,Navy/Marines, Civilian and their SE teams, and you'll be the voice of the Federal and Public Sector Partner inside Forward.

This is a builder's seat. Forward's Federal channel is early. Real distributor and reseller activity is in flight, but deal registration, enablement and the Forward Pathfinder Partner Program (F3P) are in early roll-out stages. You'll help define what F3P looks like for Federal and Public Sector, then run it.

Responsibilities:

• Build the Federal and Public Sector Partner strategy. Work with the VP of Sales, Federal & Public Sector to align Partner coverage to agency and SLED account plans, and map whitespace across agencies, commands and SLED entities.

• Execute the Partner lifecycle: Recruit, Onboard, Enable, Grow.

• Recruit. Use existing Federal reseller, distributor and SI relationships to identify the most strategic Partners, including contract-vehicle holders (GSA MAS, SEWP, CIO-SP, ITES, state and cooperative contracts). Align Partner strengths to Forward's platform to create joint solutions that win agency attention.

• Onboard. Engage the right stakeholders on both sides to stand up a real go-to-market Partnership. Drive Partner agreements through to signature and make sure Forward is orderable in the Partner's systems.

• Enable. Map Partner and Forward sales stakeholders and build field relationships. Win Partner mind share with engaging sales and technical training, and roll out new products, pricing and Partner economics (margin, deal registration protection, incentives) to the Partner sales community.

• Grow. Own the number. Run metric-driven executive QBRs, build quarterly joint business plans with named targets and pipeline commitments, and heat-map Partner performance to fill gaps. Hold Partners to their commitments, and tier, grow or exit them based on results.

• Drive revenue with Federal sales. Partner with Federal RSDs and SEs on sell-to and sell-through opportunities, from Land & Expand deals to multi-Partner teaming on larger programs. Champion joint strategic opportunities inside Forward.

• Lead Partner marketing and demand generation. Work with Marketing on events, agency briefings, webinars and Federal-focused campaigns with priority Partners.

• Manage the business in Salesforce. Attach pipeline and deal registrations to the right Partners, and forecast Partner-sourced and Partner-influenced bookings weekly.

• Shape Forward Partner program for Federal. Help define and evolve rules of engagement, deal registration, channel conflict resolution and Partner tiers for a business running both direct and Partner motions.

• Be the voice of the Federal Partner. Feed Partner input to Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance and Operations.

• Travel up to 25%, mostly across the DC / MD / VA region, for Partner planning sessions and customer opportunities.

Requirements:

• 7-10 years selling into or supporting the Federal Government market, with 5+ years in channel or Partner sales, including hands-on selling, not just program management.

• Proven success recruiting and growing Federal resellers, distributors, aggregators with consistent performance against Partner revenue, pipeline and closed-won targets.

• A record of exceeding quota in an Enterprise software ARR model.

• An existing network of Federal Partners you can leverage immediately.

• Working knowledge of Federal procurement and contract vehicles (GSA MAS, SEWP, CIO-SP and similar) and how Partners use them to win.

• SLED channel experience, including state and cooperative purchasing contracts, a plus.

• Three Customer mentality: 1) the End User; 2) the Partner; and 3) the Forward Sales team you support.

• Excellent communication: credible with both a Partner's CEO and their reps in the field.

• Deep understanding of the networking and security market and Forward's buyers.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

The expected On-Target Cash Earnings for this role is between 240k and 300k per year. Within this range, individual pay is determined by several factors including but not limited to, job-related skills, work experience, and relevant education/training.

About the Team

The Uber Freight team is building a better future for shipping. We believe that when shippers and carriers have the freedom to move together, the entire industry moves ahead. Our teams design and build innovative applications, distributed systems, and real-time models to power our global logistics marketplace, spanning the Carrier experience, high-throughput Shipper enterprise portals, internal operations tooling, and core pricing, matching, and forecasting engines.

About the Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer at Uber Freight, you will be instrumental in designing and building the highly scalable systems that power our logistics platform, focusing on robust backend services, microservices, and APIs. You will work at the intersection of system reliability and complex business logic, partnering across product, operations, and fellow engineering teams to deliver seamless, high-performance solutions. Your technical depth and leadership will help define architecture and best practices for our backend infrastructure, while mentoring peers to raise the engineering bar across the organization.

What You Will Do

• Build Scalable Backend Services: Design, develop, and maintain high-throughput, low-latency microservices and distributed systems using languages like Go, Java, Python, or C++.

• Lead System Architecture: Drive architectural decisions, data models, and API contracts for resilient, fault-tolerant backend infrastructure.

• Champion Engineering Excellence: Advocate for best practices across automated backend testing, security, code maintainability, and deployment pipelines.

• Drive Scoping & Product Delivery: Partner closely with Product, Operations, and fellow engineering teams to define technical scope, manage trade-offs, and ship complex logistics features.

• Shape the Technical Roadmap: Proactively identify technical debt, bottlenecks, and architectural limits to guide the long-term scalability of the platform.

• Mentor & Foster Culture: Guide and mentor engineers across levels, conduct rigorous code and system design reviews, and promote operational ownership.

• Own Production Health & Reliability: Troubleshoot distributed system failures in production, monitor service health, and drive blameless post-mortems to improve availability.

Basic Qualifications

• BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

• Minimum 5 years of software engineering experience.

• Strong coding skills in one or more backend languages (Go, Java, Python, or C++).

• Experience building and scaling microservices and distributed systems integrated with APIs.

• Deep understanding of system performance, API design, and data modeling.

• Experience with backend testing practices (unit, integration, and end-to-end).

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of data structures and algorithms and the ability to use them practically when implementing solutions.

• Experience with one of the following databases: MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle.

• Proven track record of leading technical projects and mentoring engineers.

• Knowledge of the logistics and transportation industry.

Uber Freight helps companies move goods more reliably and efficiently. That helps customers spot issues early, avoid costly surprises, and deliver on time. Uber Freight works with 1 in 3 Fortune 500 shippers across North America and manages over $17B in freight. jobs.description:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

We're hiring a product minded, hands on, technically strong Tech Lead Manager to help establish and lead our Product Growth engineering function. This is an opportunity to shape a new growth engineering capability at a pivotal moment for Glean as we expand the reach and impact of our Work AI platform. You will work at the intersection of product engineering, data, experimentation, and applied AI to help more people discover, adopt, and continuously engage with Glean. This is a high impact, full stack leadership role for a software engineering leader who can guide architecture, partner deeply with product, design and data science, and grow a strategically important team.

The Product Growth team owns the end-to-end experiences that help users discover Glean, get to value quickly, build lasting habits, and expand their use of the product. This includes the journey from invitation and first sign-in through activation, onboarding, engagement, re-entry, and broader adoption across teams and functions. The team works across key entry points and touch points—including login and setup flows, the home page, navigation, desktop and browser experiences, in-product education, lifecycle communications, and product-led expansion—to make Glean easier to discover, understand, and use regularly.

You will:

• Define technical direction and lead execution for product growth initiatives across Glean’s user-facing experiences.

• Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Applied AI to identify and prioritize opportunities that increase product awareness, adoption, activation, and engagement.

• Lead a team of full-stack engineers in building thoughtful, measurable experiences that help users realize value from Glean more quickly and return to the product more frequently.

• Use product data, customer insights, behavioral analysis, and experimentation to understand growth opportunities and make informed technical and product decisions.

• Help establish a strong experimentation and measurement foundation, including clear hypotheses, success metrics, instrumentation, experiment design, analysis, and iteration.

• Own projects end to end, from identifying a user or customer problem through technical design, implementation, launch, measurement, and follow-through.

• Stay close to the code and architecture, contributing directly where needed, reviewing designs and code, debugging complex issues, and maintaining a high technical bar.

• Bring strong backend and systems leadership to the team while partnering effectively across the full stack and user-facing product experience.

• Collaborate with engineering teams across Glean to deliver cohesive experiences and build scalable foundations for growth.

• engage with users and customers when useful to understand their needs, identify friction, and ensure that growth initiatives solve meaningful problems

• As the team grows, hire, coach, and develop engineers; establish effective engineering practices; and create an environment of ownership, learning, and high-quality execution.

About you:

• 8+ years of software engineering experience building production distributed systems or cloud‑native applications.

• 1+ years of engineering management experience of a full stack team

• BS/BA in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• You are a product-forward software engineering leader with experience building and shipping user-facing products, preferably in B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or other high-engagement software.

• You have a strong track record of execution and can lead a group of engineers through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

• You have partnered effectively with Product Managers, Designers, and Data Scientists to define problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver measurable product improvements.

• You are highly analytical and comfortable using data to understand user behavior, evaluate opportunities, define success metrics, and assess experiment results.

• You have demonstrated experience with product growth, experimentation, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, or other data-driven product optimization work.

• You have a strong understanding of customer needs and enjoy building products that users discover, adopt, and use regularly.

About the Team

OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation.



About the Role

As a member of our AI Product Counsel team, you will help shape how frontier AI moves from research into products used around the world. Working cross-functionally across OpenAI, you will partner closely with product teams developing new models and experiences. Your work may span ChatGPT and Codex, including consumer and workplace offerings and integrated verticals in regulated areas. This is a unique opportunity to tackle novel legal questions and help shape the next generation of AI products.



This role is based in San Francisco or Washington, D.C., where we follow a hybrid schedule of three days in the office per week. Remote candidates will also be considered, and we offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In this role, you will:

 - Be the go-to counsel and partner for several teams focused on frontier AI models and products.

 - Identify and address product, regulatory, copyright, commerce, privacy, and other legal risks and mitigations, including for industry verticals and consumer ChatGPT experiences.

 - Develop strategies for handling legal issues in creative ways and build processes for scaling flexible solutions that address risk.

 - Serve as an expert in AI legal matters and help propose and advance AI legal policy positions.



You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 8+ years of experience with a mix of in-house or technology-focused law firm roles.

 - Understand the letter of the law and can approach problems in a practical, principled approach.

 - Build cross-functional relationships and communication styles that resonate with teams to balance risk-taking with responsible development.

 - Have a strong sense of ownership, are inquisitive and enthusiastic about technology, enjoy being continually challenged, and can demonstrate sound judgment in ambiguous situations.

 - Have a JD and license or qualification to practice in CA.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III (Fullstack)
jobs.description:
Schedule: Full Time

Job Type: Hybrid

Salary Type: Salary

Req #: 3591

No immigration sponsorship or transfer available for this role.

About the Team

The Uber Freight team is building a better future for shipping. We believe that when shippers and carriers have the freedom to move together, the entire industry moves ahead. Our teams design and build innovative applications, distributed systems, and real-time models to power our global logistics marketplace, spanning the Carrier experience, high-throughput Shipper enterprise portals, internal operations tooling, and core pricing, matching, and forecasting engines.

About the Role

As a  Fullstack Engineer at Uber Freight, you will be instrumental in designing and building end-to-end systems that power our logistics platform, from backend services and APIs to the React-based web interfaces used by our customers. You will work at the intersection of user experience and business logic, partnering across product, design, and fellow engineering teams to deliver seamless, scalable solutions.

What You Will Do

• Build End-to-End Applications: Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable fullstack services and interfaces using modern technologies like Go/Java and React.

• Lead System Architecture: Drive technical design and architectural decisions for systems spanning both frontend user interfaces and backend distributed services.

• Champion Engineering Excellence: Advocate for best practices across testing, security, code maintainability, and deployment pipelines to elevate the engineering bar.

• Drive Scoping & Product Delivery: Partner closely with Product, Design, and Data Science to define technical scope, navigate trade-offs, and deliver complex logistics features.

• Shape the Technical Roadmap: Proactively identify technical debt, scale bottlenecks, and architectural opportunities to influence the long-term technical direction of the platform.

• Own Production Health: Troubleshoot and resolve complex, cross-layer issues across both frontend and backend systems in production environments.

Basic Qualifications

• BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

• Minimum 3 years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years working across both backend and frontend systems.

• Strong coding skills in one or more backend languages (Go, Java, Python, or C++) and frontend technologies (React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS).

• Experience building scalable microservices and frontend applications integrated with APIs.

• Deep understanding of web performance, API design, and data modeling.

• Experience with testing practices across backend and frontend (unit, integration, and end-to-end).

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of data structures and algorithms and the ability to use them practically when implementing solutions.

• Experience with one of the following databases: MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle.

• Proven track record of leading technical projects and mentoring engineers.

• Familiarity with frontend component libraries and design systems.

• Strong product sense and attention to UX quality.

• Knowledge of the logistics and transportation industry.

Benefits & Compensation for U.S. Employees

Employees working more than 30 hours in the US at Uber Freight are eligible for benefits like a company sponsored health plan, dental and vision benefits, 401k match, financial and mental wellness benefits, parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage, life insurance and more.  US based employees may also be eligible for a performance or sales incentive bonus program, participation in Uber Freight equity awards, and other types of compensation depending upon the role.

About Uber Freight

Uber Freight helps companies move goods more reliably and efficiently. We bring together the technology, people, and transportation capacity they need, using real‑time data from millions of shipments to guide smarter decisions. That helps customers spot issues early, avoid costly surprises, and deliver on time. Uber Freight works with 1 in 3 Fortune 500 shippers across North America and manages over $17B in freight. Learn more at www.uberfreight.com.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Uber Freight is committed to protecting the privacy of our candidates. We collect and process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. For detailed information on how we handle candidate data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

EEOC

Uber Freight is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Physician (IM/FM)
jobs.description:
​​The Staff Physician provides high-quality, evidence-based primary care in a 100% outpatient setting, with a strong focus on prevention, obesity, diabetes, and related cardiometabolic conditions. This role cares for a diverse patient population with significant chronic disease burden and works closely with a multidisciplinary care team to improve individual and population health outcomes.

​Reporting to the CMO or CMD, the Staff Physician will provide comprehensive, longitudinal care while partnering with primary care providers, behavioral health, physical therapy, health coaching, and other clinical team members to deliver coordinated, patient-centered care.​

This is an onsite position based in Lost Hills and Delano, CA.

Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities:

• Provide compassionate, high-quality, evidence-based primary care, including preventive care, chronic disease management, and evaluation and treatment of acute conditions
• Diagnose, treat, and manage obesity and obesity-related conditions, including diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, and other cardiometabolic diseases
• Develop individualized treatment plans and partner with patients to support sustainable improvements in health, disease management, and overall well-being
• Manage an empaneled patient population and coordinate care across the multidisciplinary clinical team to improve clinical outcomes and continuity of care
• Collaborate closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, behavioral health providers, physical therapists, health coaches, medical assistants, and other members of the care team
• Provide clinical guidance to care team members as appropriate to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care
• Participate in clinical quality improvement and population health initiatives focused on prevention, chronic disease management, patient engagement, and access to care
• Review clinical and population health data to identify opportunities to improve patient outcomes and quality of care
• Coordinate appropriate referrals, follow-up care, and specialty services to promote continuity and timely access to care
• Support onsite, mobile, and community-based efforts designed to improve patient engagement, access, population health management, and clinical quality
• Maintain accurate and timely medical documentation and adhere to applicable clinical, regulatory, and organizational standards
• Provide care in a 100% outpatient practice, seeing an average of approximately 16 patients per day, with no evening or weekend call responsibilities
• Supervision of, in addition to collaborative practice with, non-physician providers is required

• MD or DO degree from an accredited medical school
• Board-certified in Family Medicine or Internal Medicine preferred
• Current or eligible for unrestricted California medical licensure
• Current DEA registration or eligibility to obtain registration
• Current BLS certification or ability to obtain prior to start date
• Experience providing outpatient primary care strongly preferred
• Experience managing patients with obesity, diabetes, and other cardiometabolic conditions preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Strong clinical knowledge of comprehensive adult primary care, preventive medicine, and chronic disease management
• Knowledge of evidence-based approaches to obesity, diabetes, and cardiometabolic disease prevention and management
• Demonstrated commitment to improving health outcomes for populations experiencing significant chronic disease burden and barriers to care
• Strong patient communication skills with the ability to engage patients in shared decision-making and long-term disease management
• Ability to work effectively within an integrated, multidisciplinary care model
• Written and verbal fluency in medical Spanish strongly preferred
• Proficiency with electronic medical records and standard workplace technology

Wonderful's dedication to you:

• Pay range: $250,000 - $315,000 annually. Final compensation will be dependent upon skills & experience
• Monthly Car Allowance
• Annual Performance Bonus eligible
• Student loan repayment assistance potential
• Malpractice and tail end coverage
• Continuing Medical Education allowance
• College scholarships for employees' children
• Competitive benefits packing including Medical, Vision, Dental, 401k, PTO, sick days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement program and 100% of CA accreditation fees paid
• Wonderful Giving (www.wonderfulgiving.com) -- allowing you to donate company money to a cause of your choice
• Access to many Wonderful Company perks, including the corporation's health clinic and fitness center

Quality of Life in the Central Valley:

Framed by the Sierra Nevada to the east and the Coast Ranges to the west, California's Central Valley is one of the world's most productive agricultural regions and the base of The Wonderful Company's agricultural operations. This vast area enjoys a moderate climate and offers residents a high quality of life, low cost of living, and a host of diverse cultural and recreational activities. From wine tasting and hiking to rafting, fishing, skiing, and surfing -- all within a two-hour drive -- the family-friendly Central Valley has much to offer.

jobs.title: Test Technician III - B Shift
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

TEST TECHNICIAN III - B SHIFT

Based out of Rocket Lab's Headquarters in Long Beach, CA the Test Technician III is responsible for the testing of our Rutherford rocket engine. The engine consists of a thrust chamber, pumps, valves, plumbing, TVC actuators, motor controllers, and other mechanical components. You will support the Propulsion Production Manager and Production organization, with deliverables required for internal leadership, board of directors, and investors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

• Perform high-pressure pneumatic operations (GN2/HE).

• Set up and operate Data Acquisition (DAQ) systems, including FlexLogger and LabView.

• Troubleshoot and repair valves, regulators, pressure relief valves, pressure transducers, and check valves.

• Work with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs).

• Conduct hydrostatic testing and handle LN2/cryogenic components during testing procedures.

• Generate Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) to document and address issues.

• Implement and improve 5S practices to maintain a clean and organized work area.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A TEST TECHNICIAN III:

• 5+ years of experience in high-pressure operations.

• Experience in Data Acquisition & Instrumentation systems such as FlexLogger and LabView.

• Hands-on experience with valves, regulators, pressure relief valves, pressure transducers, and check valves.

• Experience handling LN2/cryogenic components under test conditions.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• 8+ years of mechanical assembly and/or mechanical fitting experience

• Experience performing; torquing, safety and/or lock wire installation, assembly per work instructions, and environment tests (proof and leak).

• A&P, trade, or industry certified.

• Experience with in-space testing.

• Knowledgeable in manufacturing processes and continued product development.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Willing to work Monday - Thursday (3:15pm - 1:45am)

• Stand and walk for entire shift (8+ hours) on various work surfaces

• Climb ladders and work at elevated height small spaces, awkward positions, and tight areas as needed

• Perform repetitive motions including bending, twisting, reaching, grasping, pushing, pulling, and stooping

• Use hands with precision to handle, control, and operate tools, instruments, and equipment

• Lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment up to 25 lbs.

• Work in varied environments including production floors, equipment areas, and field locations with exposure to noise, temperature variations, and moving machinery

• Flexibility to work extended hours, weekends, and varied shifts as operational needs require.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

Hourly Pay Range (CA Only)

$30—$40 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

jobs.title: Senior UX/UI Designer
jobs.description:
NOTE: A link to an active portfolio is a requirement for applying to this role.

Location: Broomfield, Colorado

Work Environment:

Hybrid or In Office: Office presence is critical for this role. While we offer hybrid flexibility, this individual will be expected to work in the office in Broomfield, CO Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays at a minimum.

Bertram Labs is the technology consulting and transformation arm of Bertram Capital, a private equity firm targeting investments in lower middle market companies.  Bertram is not singularly focused on achieving its investment returns through financial engineering and the extraction of near-term cash flow. Instead, Bertram focuses on reinvestment and technology enablement to drive growth and value through digital marketing, e-commerce, big data and analytics, application development and internal and external platform optimization.

Visit www.bcap.com for more information.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a UX/UI designer to work internally as well as across our portfolio companies.

The ideal candidate is an adaptable, individual contributor who brings best practices and evolving technical and design knowledge to solve design-related problems. The candidate we are looking for is independent and able to devise solutions on their own, but also is a solid team member who enjoys collaborating with developers, growth experts, and stakeholders alike.

As a UX/UI Designer at Bertram Labs, you will use your skills to create amazing customer experiences with elegant and simple UI that deliver business results to a wide variety of clients. You have a passion for designing effective digital experiences that are informed by customer research, industry best practices and business needs. You use your keen sense of curiosity, strong storytelling skills, and polished user experience solutions to deliver customer-focused work in a fast-paced and complex environment. You are someone who dislikes monotony and enjoys working on new and unique projects. You are someone who enjoys having a close-knit community of coworkers who are very experienced and love what they do.

Responsibilities:

• Work alongside developers, business stakeholders and product managers throughout all stages of the product development cycle

• Work with the design team and software engineers to generate user flows, user stories, wireframes, prototypes, and detailed visual design as needed. Basic web development experience is a plus.

• Design within clients’ design systems and brand standards

• Own the design visuals and user experience across multiple platforms- web apps, mobile apps, marketing websites and E-commerce websites

• Translate challenges, needs, and requirements into wireframes, mockups, and communicate them clearly to software engineers

• Identify and account for edge cases in the experience of the product, the interaction design of a component, and on the user interface

• Work closely with software engineers to ensure technical restraints are understood to problem solve for the best user experience that increase the quality of our product

• Work enthusiastically, respectfully, and collaboratively within the department as well as across other departments within the company

• Maintain knowledge of UX/UI processes, tools and best practices to achieve higher quality, lower costs and shorter time to release

• Stay current with trends in UX/UI principles, visual design, mobile app and web design

• Actively embrace AI tools while maintaining an understanding of design mechanics

• Deliver and socialize your solutions

• Educate others disciplines about their value to both the organization and the user

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university

• 5-7 years of professional work experience designing user interfaces and user experience (UI/UX) for applications and websites

• Efficiency in Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design and prototype software.

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively

• Proven track record of presenting to and influencing stakeholders and senior management

• Strong visual design skills and a keen sense of effective UI

• Solid understanding of UX best practices and strong visual design skills

• Experience with WCAG or accessibility visual design

• Designing thinking and critical thinking mindset

• Obsessive attention to detail and organization

• The passion, motivation, and curiosity to be a contributor, self-starter, and problem-solver

• Ability to give and receive direction and constructive criticism in an open, positive, and collaborative communication style

• Strong understanding of website design, including mobile-first responsive design and E-commerce design

• Ability to handle multiple projects at the same time

• Willingness to jump in where needed on a variety of design-related tasks

• Fast-learner on a wide variety of product lines and markets

• Some experience with graphic design, iconography, print and logo design

• Familiar with agile methodology and sprint scheduling

• A proven portfolio showing the complete process from ideation to final visual designs

• Knowledge/experience in building web application front ends a plus

Compensation and Benefits

The expected salary range for this position is: $140,000- $160,000 total annual compensation. Offered salary may be based on a variety of factors including skills, experience, and qualifications for the role. Other compensation includes profit sharing.

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits are provided at no cost to the employee. We offer a generous 401K match as well as a “take what you need” PTO policy.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Bertram Capital we value and celebrate the many perspectives that arise from a variety of cultures, genders, religions, national origins, ages, abilities, socioeconomic status and sexual orientation. Our commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) ensures that Bertram is a place that attracts, grows, and promotes top talent from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.



From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.



Learn more at envoy.com http://envoy.com




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join the Product Marketing team and help shape Envoy's position in the security workplace and visitor management technology market. You will be a key driver of Go-to-Market (GTM) success, spanning both inbound work — pre-launch strategy, research, and positioning — and outbound work — go-to-market execution and sales-facing motions that drive pipeline. This role requires strong cross-functional collaboration and a high degree of ownership — and the ability to stay effective as priorities shift in a fast-moving environment.

YOU HAVE

jobs.title: Research Intern, Frontier
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage-agnostic. We invest in seed- to venture- to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, frontier, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Role

a16z Frontier research is a multidisciplinary lab that bridges the worlds of academic theory and industry practice. The lab has recently expanded its focus from crypto-focused research to include other emerging areas of technology, ranging from AI-enabled applications to new scientific developments in materials, energy, and hardware. In addition to fundamental research, we collaborate with portfolio companies to solve hard technical and conceptual problems. Research interns will have the opportunity to learn from and collaborate with the firm’s investment and engineering teams.

We are seeking students with a strong technical background and an interest in emerging technologies to join the group for the summer. Example research areas of interest include AI and machine learning, agentic commerce, cryptography, security, distributed computing, hardware design, economics (micro, macro, and empirical), energy, material science, biology, incentives, quantitative finance, market and mechanism design, foundations of computing, and pure mathematics. This list is not exhaustive and we encourage applicants with different backgrounds, who may have unique perspectives on the emerging technologies, to apply.

We anticipate selecting a wide range of applicants, including ambitious undergraduate students with a unique grasp of emerging technologies, graduate students looking to transition from academic work to building and entrepreneurship, and PhD students pursuing a more traditional academic career.

This role will be based in New York City, NY and requires in-office presence in our New York City, NY office.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

• Pursue fundamental research on topics relevant to the firm.

• Collaborate with a16z Frontier’s full-time researchers and other student interns.

• Collaborate with portfolio companies on technical research problems.

• Quickly develop expertise in emerging areas of science and technology.

• Take full advantage of the latest generation of AI tools.

• Contribute to blog posts, white papers, and other public expository content.

• Meet with visitors from academia and industry and attend research seminars.

Preferred Qualifications

• Pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in a relevant field such as computer science, economics, mathematics, operations research, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics, chemistry, biology, etc.

• Passionate, knowledgeable, and optimistic about science and technology.

• Experience with absorbing and producing fundamental research.

Internship Details

• A typical schedule will have an intern spending ⅔ of the time pursuing their own research (typically in collaboration with other lab members and visitors) and ⅓ of the time collaborating on portfolio-related problems.

• In-person residency required in New York, NY.

• Interns will have access to and will typically make heavy use of the latest AI tools.

• Duration of internship June 1, 2027 – August 20, 2027 (minimum residency 10 weeks, maximum 12 weeks).

• The anticipated weekly rate is dependent on the current degree program. Actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope:

• PhD: $4,500 per week, plus $500 per week housing stipend

• Masters: $4,000 per week, plus $500 per week housing stipend

• Undergrad: $3,500 per week, plus $500 per week housing stipend

Materials to Upload:

• Resume/CV

• List of publications/blog posts/any other public content (optional but recommended)

• Twitter/X, github, personal website, public crypto wallet (optional)

• Research statement (1-page max PDF, optional but recommended)

• Letters of recommendation (one letter is required, a second letter is optional but recommended): recommenders should email their letters of support to frontier-research-applications@a16z.com, with the name of the applicant in the subject line

• Please provide the name(s) of your recommendation letter writer(s) as part of your application

• For full consideration, please submit applications by 12 p.m. PT on November 20, 2026

Notice

Export Control: This position requires access to information and technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Your responses to the questions below will be used solely to determine your eligibility under U.S. law to receive information and materials subject to U.S. export controls.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including international applicants. Employment is subject to applicable work authorization requirements in the country where the position is based.

a16z culture

• We do only first class business and only in a first class way

• We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business

• We believe in the future and bet the firm that way

• We are all different, we recognize that, and we win

• We celebrate the good times

• We do it for the team

• We play to win

At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. We hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. These differences are what enables us to work towards the future we envision for ourselves, our portfolio companies, and the World.

• Progress each project every month to ensure all projects are monitored for project controls in line with the monthly reporting cycle, checking accuracy and consistency of data.

• Advanced skills with spreadsheets, report writing and presentations.

• High proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite of applications.

• Experience with cloud-based software.

• Hands on scheduling experience with P6 knowledge.

• Skilled in the use of industry accepted applications for cost, planning and progress measurement.

• Good organization skills, ability to multi-task, be a team player and integrate easily with others.

• Must have strong and professional English oral and written communication skills.

Education/Experience:

• Experience working in a cost focused construction project controls role.

• Experience working on large sized, complex construction projects.

• College degree; ideally in construction, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or related.

jobs.title: Freelance Graphic Designer - AI Training
jobs.description:
About HumanSignal

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

About the Opportunity
We're looking for graphic design professionals to rate the quality of design work, helping AI models learn what makes a design effective.

Key Details

• Type: Freelance, project-based opportunity

• Project length: 4 weeks, with new projects launching regularly

• Compensation: Paid per accepted task. On this project, you can earn the equivalent of up to $9 per hour, with pay rates varying by country of residence.

What You'll Do

• Rate design samples for typography, visual hierarchy, design execution, color, layout, and overall polish

• Follow detailed rubrics to keep your ratings consistent across high volumes of design samples

• Identify flaws in one slide within the overall design, from minor issues like font size to major ones that require a full reconstruction of the slide

• Edit the flawed slide using the other slides in the design as a reference, to build more cohesion across the entire design

Please note: you won’t create your own designs. You’ll rate and edit the samples we provide, following our guidelines.

What We're Looking For

Must have

• Education in design or arts (degree or certificate)

• 2+ years of experience as a graphic designer, illustrator, SMM specialist, or marketing professional

• English proficiency at B2 (Upper-Intermediate) level or higher

• Strong grasp of composition, color theory, typography, visual hierarchy, and overall design effectiveness

• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain focus during repetitive tasks

Nice to have

• Experience with Figma, Adobe Illustrator, or other modern design tools

• Prior data annotation or AI training experience

How It Works

• Apply with your portfolio

• Register on our platform

• Confirm your identity

• Validate your skills

• Start earning on projects

Why Join Us

• Work from anywhere: fully remote, with just a laptop and a stable internet connection.

• Set your own schedule: work whenever suits you, alongside your current job, studies, or other commitments.

• Get paid every week: weekly payouts for the work you deliver.

• Shape the future of AI: your expertise helps train the AI tools people use every day.

• More projects ahead: once you're validated, get access to new projects that match your skills.

We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Help the Samsara team both at our San Francisco headquarters and online to resolve their tech problems.

• Manage a ticket queue and seek opportunities to improve how we work.

• Drive core operations that keep the company secure and productive.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Obsess Over the Customer, Build for the Long Term, Growth Mindset) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Minimum of 2 years of help desk or technical support experience.

• Minimum of 1 year of experience working onsite supporting employees in an IT environment.

• Basic networking experience

An ideal candidate also has:

Total Rewards

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. Flexible Working

Belonging at Samsara
