jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer II, Mechanisms
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Mechanisms Manufacturing team at Relativity Space is currently in the design release and New Product Introduction phase for Terran R, our next generation, fully re-useable rocket. This team handles a broad range of responsibilities, collaborating closely with vehicle design, supply chain, test, production, and vehicle integration to develop electromechanical and pneumatic hardware that supports rocket reusability. This includes key components like landing legs mechanisms, grid fin actuators, pneumatic separation and release mechanisms, and linear and rotary electromechanical actuators. Additionally, the team is responsible for developing and designing intricate processes, tooling, training technicians, and optimizing factory floor layouts. Unique to Relativity, you will get to work across many teams to iterate and support development of the vehicle program. To be successful in this role, you need to be a self-starter that can thrive in ambiguity, identify problems and quickly resolve them, and provide definition to the previously undefined. You should have a commitment to quality, balance short-term and long-term solutions, and have the discipline required to achieve our objectives.

About the Role:

• Own major mechanized assemblies and their child components from design release through test and successful integration onto the Terran R launch vehicle—lay out the build and test flow to ensure an efficient, high-quality product flow capable of scaling with time.

• Drive the assembly’s build and test effort through design integration, part sourcing, assembly sequencing, mBOM development, build and test work order creation, and specification authoring.

• Support workcenter development by considering assembly and test operations, safety, tooling and capital equipment requirements, and company operational goals.

• Provide hands-on support to the shop floor and production personnel, promptly addressing any issues that arise and offering upstream feedback to drive design for manufacturability.

• Analyze and disposition recurring manufacturing discrepancies and lead multi-disciplinary teams on root cause analysis and corrective actions.

• Foster a culture of critical thinking and imaginative problem-solving, constantly challenging the established norms in engineering and manufacturing, and pushing the boundaries to achieve efficient production throughout the workcenter. Mentor other manufacturing engineers, providing guidance to support technical and professional development.

About You:

• BS degree in aerospace, mechanical, or manufacturing engineering with 2+ years of experience building and testing hardware in a manufacturing environment.

• Extensive experience developing processes, authoring work instructions and/or test procedures to build and test interdisciplinary mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic assemblies.

• Experience interfacing with design engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, planning, and production personnel.

• Extensive experience leading, executing and managing large process and/or quality improvements with large scope of ownership.

• Ability to work autonomously with little supervision in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

• Knowledge in at least 2 of the following: fastening and torquing operations, pneumatic and/or electromechanical assembly, electrical and/or pneumatic testing or functional checkouts, tooling design and fabrication, potting processes, grease plating processes, harness manufacturing, machining of complex products like gears.

Nice to haves but not required:

• New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into a manufacturing, test, and production system with proven success. Along with transitioning products from prototype to high volume production. Understand the importance of assessing a situation and leveraging both short-term and long-term solutions.

• Working knowledge of rocket subsystems including structures, mechanisms, high pressure gas systems and/or avionics.

• Expert understanding of GD&T and drafting principles.

• Experience in capacity analyses, DFMEA/PFMEA, value stream mapping.

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Hiring Range:

$104,000—$156,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@relativityspace.com.

Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.



From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.



Learn more at envoy.com http://envoy.com




ABOUT THE ROLE

Marketing at Envoy runs on a mix of product-led signups, inbound demand and outbound motions across several products. You'll be the person who tells us which of those actually create pipeline and revenue — and you'll build the data foundation that makes the answer trustworthy.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll write production SQL and dbt models, not just query tables someone else built. You'll sit with Marketing and RevOps leadership as their analytical partner, and with the Data team as a builder who ships to the warehouse.

This is an onsite position that requires at least 5 days a week (Monday - Friday) in our San Francisco HQ office.



YOU WILL

You'll work like a forward-deployed engineer embedded in Marketing: sit with the team, find the problem, and ship the data product that solves it — on AWS, in production, end to end.

 - Own the marketing data platform on AWS. Build and run marketing pipelines across Redshift, S3, Glue, Lambda and Iceberg tables, with infrastructure defined in Terraform and deployed through GitHub Actions.

 - Model the funnel in dbt. Ship tested staging, intermediate and mart models for lead → MQL → SQL → opportunity → closed-won, plus semantic models others self-serve from.

 - Build attribution as a product. Design multi-touch attribution across web, paid, events, email and outbound, run it as scheduled jobs in Airflow, and expose it through governed tables and APIs.

 - Ship internal apps, not just dashboards. Build lightweight tools Marketing uses daily — campaign ROI explorers, lead-routing consoles, self-serve query apps — on AWS Amplify, Lambda and API Gateway with Cognito/Okta auth.

 - Build serverless data APIs. Expose warehouse metrics to apps, Slack and AI agents through Lambda-backed endpoints and MCP servers, with least-privilege IAM.

 - Close the loop with reverse ETL. Sync scores, segments and product signals from the warehouse back into Salesforce, Marketo and Outreach so Sales and Marketing act on them.

 - Engineer the event lake. Join Segment product events in S3/Iceberg to CRM records to measure product-qualified leads and PLG conversion at scale.

 - Build lead scoring and intent models. Turn product usage, firmographic and job-change signals into scores in Python or Databricks, then deploy and monitor them in production.

 - Run experiments and measure spend. Design A/B and holdout tests, and report CAC, payback and channel ROI with Finance.

 - Use AI to move faster. Build with Claude Code and LLM tooling to prototype apps, generate models and automate analysis, with the rigor to verify the output.

 - Keep it reliable. Own source freshness, data tests, CI checks, cost and monitoring so a broken pipeline never reaches a board deck.




YOU HAVE  

 - 5+ years in analytics, with at least 2 focused on marketing, growth or go-to-market analytics at a B2B SaaS company.

 - Expert SQL: window functions, CTE-first style, query performance on a columnar warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake or BigQuery), and the judgment to spot a fan-out join before it reaches a dashboard.

 - Production dbt experience: you've built layered models, written tests, and shipped through code review and CI.

 - Fluency in Python for analysis and statistics (pandas, statsmodels or similar), including experiment design and causal inference basics.

 - Deep familiarity with marketing and sales data: Salesforce objects (leads, contacts, campaigns, opportunities), marketing automation (Marketo or HubSpot), web and product event tracking (Segment or similar).

 - Working knowledge of attribution approaches and their trade-offs, plus funnel and cohort analysis.

 - Comfort with Git, pull requests and the command line.

 - A track record of influencing decisions: you can explain a model's assumptions to a CMO in two sentences and defend them under questioning.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Airflow or another orchestrator, and with ingestion tools such as Fivetran or Estuary.

 - Semantic layer or metrics-layer experience (dbt Semantic Layer, Omni, Looker).

 - Data lake experience: Iceberg, Spectrum, Athena or Spark.

 - Lead scoring, propensity or marketing-mix modeling.

 - Exposure to sales engagement and revenue intelligence data (Outreach, Gong) or job-change signals.

 - Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up analytics work, with the rigor to check their output.
   
    

 

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have fully read and understand the job requirements and received the Envoy Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here https://envoy.com/privacypolicy/. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Envoy to process your application. Envoy is an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by local, state or federal law.

jobs.title: Business Development Lead, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

 

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

 


OUR ETHOS

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Rain is looking for a Business Development Lead to build and scale our presence in the rapidly emerging agentic commerce ecosystem.

You’ll drive new business by identifying high-value opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, and building a strong commercial pipeline. You’ll also help shape Rain’s commercial thesis at the intersection of stablecoins and AI, identifying where our infrastructure can unlock new use cases and where Rain has a right to win.

Working closely with Product and Engineering, you’ll translate market insights into commercial and product opportunities and position Rain as a critical infrastructure partner for the next generation of commerce.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role for someone who can see where the market is headed, move early, and turn emerging opportunities into meaningful growth for Rain.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build Rain’s agentic commerce pipeline: Identify, source, and develop high-value commercial opportunities across AI-native companies, agent platforms, agentic commerce infrastructure providers, and emerging payment ecosystems.

 - Develop our agentic commerce strategy: Define priority segments, use cases, target accounts, and partnership opportunities, with a particular focus on where stablecoin and payments infrastructure can unlock new capabilities for AI-powered commerce.

 - Drive commercial execution: Develop compelling value propositions, manage a high-quality pipeline, and work cross-functionally to convert opportunities into long-term partnerships.

 - Stay ahead of the market: Identify emerging trends, technologies, companies, and use cases across AI and payments early, and translate them into commercial opportunities and strategic priorities for Rain.

 - Own strategic partnerships: Lead opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through solutioning, negotiation, deal execution, and handoff.

 - Build the ecosystem: Establish relationships with founders, developers, and industry leaders shaping the future of AI-powered commerce and autonomous payments.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering: Bring market intelligence and prospective partner feedback into product discussions, helping inform Rain’s roadmap and identify opportunities for new capabilities.

 - Shape Rain’s market position: Develop our point of view on the role of stablecoins in agentic commerce and build Rain’s position as a leading infrastructure partner in the ecosystem.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or a related commercial role, ideally within AI, fintech, payments, or emerging technology.

 - Strong understanding of the AI ecosystem, particularly agentic commerce, AI agents, and the infrastructure enabling autonomous transactions.

 - Demonstrated ability to source, develop, negotiate, and close strategic commercial partnerships.

 - Entrepreneurial mindset with experience building new business opportunities end to end, entering emerging markets, or developing go-to-market strategies from the ground up.

 - Strong commercial judgment and the ability to identify high-potential opportunities in rapidly evolving markets.

 - Ability to form an independent point of view on emerging markets and translate it into commercial action.

 - Ability to engage credibly with both technical and business stakeholders, translating complex technologies into clear commercial value propositions.

 - Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

 - High degree of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and bias toward action.

 - Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and limited established playbooks.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Direct experience working at an AI-native company, agentic commerce platform, or AI infrastructure provider.

 - Existing relationships within the AI developer, agentic commerce, or emerging payments ecosystem.

 - Familiarity with AI agent frameworks, agent payment protocols, and emerging standards for autonomous transactions.

 - Experience with payments infrastructure, card issuing, stablecoins, wallets, or blockchain-based financial services.

 - Track record of building and scaling a new commercial vertical or ecosystem partnership strategy.


THINGS THAT ENABLE A FULFILLING, HEALTHY AND HAPPY EXPERIENCE AT RAIN:

Unlimited time off 🌴Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace, if you feel comfortable at home please work from home. If you’d like to work with others in an office feel free to come in. We want everyone to be able to work in the environment in which they are their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers will have a stipend to create a comfortable atmosphere at home.

Easy to access benefits 🧠For US Rainmakers, we offer comprehensive health, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents, as well as a 100% company subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 We offer every Rainmakers an equity option plan so we can all can benefit from our success.

Rain Cards 🌧️ We want Rainmakers to be knowledgeable about our core products and services. To support this mission, we issue a card for our team to utilize the card for testing.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers are welcome to use their card for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain! Time spent together helps us get to know each other, strengthen our relationships, and build a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites both domestically and internationally.

jobs.title: Mobile Growth Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Mobile Growth Manager to take full ownership of monetization and retention for our AI LLM chat mobile app on iOS and Android. You will be accountable for how much revenue each mobile user generates and for how long they stay.

This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end ownership. You own the funnel from store listing to first session, trial, paid conversion, renewal and win-back. You decide what to test, what to scale and what to cut, and you are accountable for the results. We need someone who has grown ARPU and retention on subscription apps, who can run experiments quickly and independently, and who knows how to work within Apple and Google subscription rules.

You will manage performance against real revenue data (ARPU, trial-to-paid conversion, ROI D7, retention and cohorts), not vanity metrics. We also work AI-first, and we expect you to use Claude and automation to move faster.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own mobile growth end to end: from store page to paid conversion and renewal, across strategy, experimentation, launch, reporting and documentation.

 - Deliver a quarterly ARPU target on mobile (set against a measured baseline), through conversion, retention and perceived product value.

 - Own the paywall and pricing: offerings, packaging, trial and intro-offer structure, price tests by geo, and placement. Run them through RevenueCat or an equivalent.

 - Own onboarding and activation: shorten the path to the first moment of value and fix drop-offs in the first session and first week.

 - Build retention and win-back loops: push, in-app messaging, cancellation-save flows and involuntary-churn recovery (billing retries, grace periods).

 - Own store conversion: ASO, listing and screenshot tests, ratings and review prompts on the App Store and Google Play.

 - Keep web and app aligned: manage the web-to-app handoff and make sure subscribers get a consistent experience and entitlement across both.

 - Manage signal quality: subscription and in-app events, attribution and MMP data, and measurement under iOS privacy rules (ATT / SKAdNetwork).

 - Run a structured experiment process: own the mobile backlog, with a clear hypothesis, target metric and kill/scale rule for every test. Run the A/B tests end to end.

 - Review sessions daily: find friction, drop-offs and behavioural patterns, and turn them into backlog items.

 - Build the reporting: Mixpanel dashboards and a weekly report on mobile ARPU, trial conversion, ROI D7 on matured cohorts, 1-hour cancellation and retention.

 - Own policy compliance: keep paywalls, subscription disclosure, refunds and store listings within Apple and Google rules, with prevention-first checks before launch.

 - Prototype with AI: use Claude and automation for prototypes, analysis, QA and reporting, and ship the ones that work.

 - Diagnose drops and spikes quickly and act on them.

 - Document tests, learnings and playbooks.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS


MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years in mobile growth, product growth or lifecycle roles on subscription apps.

 - Proven, measured ARPU, conversion or retention gains on a live subscription app, on both iOS and Android.

 - Strong understanding of subscription economics: trials, intro offers, renewals, LTV, payback windows and cohorts.

 - Hands-on paywall and pricing experimentation (RevenueCat, Superwall or similar).

 - Hands-on with Mixpanel or an equivalent: funnels, cohorts, custom boards.

 - Experience with StoreKit and Google Play Billing mechanics: grace periods, billing retries, refunds, cancellation flows.

 - Experience with MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular or similar) and with ATT / SKAdNetwork-era measurement.

 - Experience with push and in-app messaging tools and with building retention mechanics.

 - Working knowledge of ASO and store listing conversion.

 - Strong experiment discipline: hypotheses, sample sizing, readouts and clean decisions.

 - Daily use of Claude or other AI tools for prototyping, analysis and writing.

 - Ownership mentality: you run the funnel with minimal supervision and take responsibility for outcomes.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with AI or consumer-subscription products.

 - Experience with web-to-app subscription funnels.

 - Experience coordinating paid acquisition with product conversion, as a partner to a UA lead.

 - Experience working under strict platform policy (subscription disclosure, ROSCA-type rules).




LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

 - Company-provided MacBook: Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Read more about it here: Independent Contractor Agreement
   
   https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!




LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we're a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that a diversity of thought and backgrounds builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status. Join us and be part of a company that is crafting the future of technology across multiple industries.

jobs.title: Per Diem Medical Assistant
jobs.description:
Oula delivers maternity care built around our patients—offering comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.

Since launching in 2021, we’ve expanded our services to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. Today, we serve patients across six clinics in three states, with continued expansion planned for 2027 and beyond. Join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists who are passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

The Role

We're growing our clinical team and looking for a Per Diem Medical Assistant to support our NYC clinics. You'll work alongside our clinicians and clinic operations team to support patient rooming, phlebotomy, and day-to-day clinical operations while helping deliver an exceptional, patient-centered maternity care experience.

Location: NYC

Schedule: Per diem, with flexibility to work from clinic opening until the last patient departs. Specific hours and availability will be coordinated with the clinic team.

Employment type: Per diem, non-exempt.

What You'll Do

Clinical Support & Patient Care

• Room patients efficiently and assist with routine clinical procedures within the Medical Assistant scope of practice.

• Perform phlebotomy and support other clinical needs as appropriate.

• Maintain proficiency with clinical equipment and promptly report any issues.

• Follow universal precautions and safely handle and dispose of medical waste.

Clinic Operations & Patient Experience

• Support daily clinic operations to maintain an efficient, organized patient flow.

• Complete clinical documentation, paperwork, forms, and other administrative tasks accurately.

• Assist with patient follow-up and care coordination to support a seamless care experience.

• Communicate effectively with patients and colleagues, contributing to a welcoming and supportive environment.

• Anticipate clinic needs, take initiative, and provide cross-site coverage as required.

Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED.

• At least three years of relevant healthcare experience.

• Proficiency and comfort with phlebotomy.

• Solid knowledge of medical terminology.

• Strong computer skills and familiarity with electronic medical records (EMRs).

• Ability to work flexibly based on clinic hours and patient needs.

Preferred: Bachelor's degree, experience in pregnancy or maternity care, and Spanish language proficiency.

How We Work

Our values are Excellence, Candor, Humanity, Ownership, Evidence, and Service. In practice, that means we care about our patients and each other, have honest conversations with respect, make decisions based on evidence, and keep the patient at the center of everything we do.

Oula offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, and  comprehensive benefits. Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner (Contract)
jobs.description:
ABOUT HIYA

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Contract Talent Acquisition Partner who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and takes pride in delivering exceptional hiring experiences. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing hands-on recruiting with strategic partnership, driving both process excellence and high-quality outcomes. This is a 3 month initial contract, with a potential to extend. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting across technical, G&A, and GTM functions.

 - Leverage AI and automation tools to enhance sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and workflow efficiency.

 - Drive process and productivity improvements — identify opportunities to streamline recruiting operations, improve data visibility, and boost speed without compromising quality.

 - Partner with hiring managers, coaching them through talent strategy, calibration, interviewing, and decision-making to ensure exceptional outcomes.

 - Champion quality of hire, using structured assessments, data insights, and onboarding feedback loops to continuously refine hiring effectiveness.

 - Navigate ambiguity with confidence, bringing clarity and structure to complex hiring needs.

 - Source creatively and strategically, building deep talent networks across AI and emerging tech communities.

 - Support university and early-career programs, especially for technical and AI-focused roles.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor, translating hiring requirements into clear recruiting strategies that attract top performers.

 


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of progressive recruiting experience, including at least 4 years in full-cycle, in-house or embedded roles supporting technical, G&A, and GTM hiring.

 - Proven experience operating as a Talent Partner in a high-growth startup, owning full-cycle hiring while helping leaders build teams from early scale through rapid growth.

 - Technically fluent— Genuinely curious about how software, data, and AI systems are built, using hands-on technical understanding to define roles clearly, improve interview signal, and hire stronger technical talent. A trusted partner to engineering, product, and data leaders, able to assess technical roles at a systems level in a modern SaaS environment.

 - AI native mindset and a natural technology tinkerer —actively experiments with AI tools, automation, and emerging technologies, and intuitively applies them to improve recruiting judgment, workflows, and outcomes. Demonstrated ability to optimize recruiting processes through technology, data, and workflow improvements.

 - Skilled at coaching and influencing hiring managers with credibility and insight.

 - Passionate about data-driven recruiting and continuous improvement in quality, speed, and candidate experience.

 - Experience using modern TA Tech Stack (e.g., Ashby, Juicebox, Pin, Metaview) and integrating AI tools into daily workflows.




HOW WE WORK

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

 - Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

 - Own, share in success and open up to failures

 - Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

 - Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

 - Do, rather than observe


HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

Compensation & Ownership
Equity Compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growth

We offer an L&D budget to support your growth and real internal mobility so career pathing isn't just a talking point — because we're building this with people who own the outcome.

 


COME WORK WITH US!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!



Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineering Residency Program
jobs.description:
Bluestaq Cybersecurity Residency Program

Program Duration: January 11 through March 31, 2027 (11.5 weeks). Residents work 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM with a 30-minute lunch.

Position Type: Temporary, Non-Exempt, Hourly

Conversion to Full-Time: This is the heart of the program: residents who successfully complete the residency may be eligible to join Bluestaq full-time as an Associate Cybersecurity Engineer. Full-time offers are contingent on performance and business need.

Position Description
Ready to launch your cybersecurity career? The Bluestaq Cybersecurity Residency Program is an 11.5-week, paid, cohort-based program built around one goal: turning promising early-career cyber talent into full-time Bluestaq Associate Cybersecurity Engineers. This isn't a coffee-run internship. From week one you'll do real security work on the systems our U.S. Space Force customers rely on every day, guided by a dedicated engineer-mentor, and you'll close out the program by presenting your capstone work directly to Bluestaq engineering leadership.

Who We’re Looking For
We're offering the residency to early-career Cyber talent ready to commit to a full-time engineering role, including: final-year associate, undergraduate, or master's students (graduating by December 31, 2026), recent graduates in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Information Security, Data Science, or related fields. If you're excited about learning fast, collaborating, and shipping real-world solutions, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do
At Bluestaq, our residents aren't confined to one technology stack. You'll explore multiple technologies while contributing to impactful projects.

• System hardening: Secure systems using industry best practices and DISA STIGs.

• Vulnerability remediation and analysis: Identify, prioritize, and fix vulnerabilities across our environments.

• SIEM engineering and log analysis: Build and tune SIEM tooling and analyze logs to detect and investigate suspicious activity.

• Incident response: Support detection, triage, containment, and recovery when security events occur.

• ATO/RMF documentation and review: Help prepare and review authorization packages and security documentation under the Risk Management Framework.

• AWS security engineering and maintenance: Configure, secure, and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS.

• Patch testing and implementation: Test patches before rollout and help deploy them with minimal disruption.

• Access control and auditing: Implement and verify access controls and support audits that keep systems compliant.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Security fundamentals: You understand core concepts like the CIA triad, least privilege, authentication and authorization, and common vulnerabilities and attack techniques. Coursework, labs, CTFs, a cyber club, or personal projects all count.

• Operating systems: You’re comfortable working in Linux environments, including command-line use and basic administration.

• Networking basics: You know how TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, and common protocols work.

• Cloud familiarity: You have exposure to cloud platforms, ideally AWS, through coursework, certifications, or hands-on projects.

• Compliance awareness (a plus): You’ve seen frameworks like NIST SP 800-53, the Risk Management Framework (RMF), or DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs). Not required, because we’ll teach you.

• Log and SIEM exposure (a plus): You’ve worked with tools like Splunk or Elastic, or analyzed logs in a lab or class.

• You're capable of working in a team-centric environment.

• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• You're passionate about big data technologies and excited to work with cloud infrastructures.

• You have ability to obtain a security clearance.

• You’re available to work full-time on-site for the full program (January 11 – March 31, 2027).

Benefits: This position is not eligible for employment benefits such as 401k, Medical, Dental, or Vision Insurance. This position is eligible for sick pay as per the Colorado Healthy Families & Workplaces Act (HFWA).

Salary Range (US)

$40—$40 USD

Clearance Requirement: This position may require an active TS/SCI Clearance. Current clearance holders are strongly encouraged to apply. If you don't currently hold one, Bluestaq will sponsor eligible candidates through the clearance process based on program needs.

Relocation: Relocation assistance is available for full-time positions.

About Bluestaq
At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

We're engineers, problem-solvers, and builders who take the mission seriously, but not ourselves. We automate the repeatable, question the status quo, and design systems that are as reliable as they are scalable. Whether we're supporting space, defense systems, or healthcare advancements, we build with the same principles: cloud-native solutions, security by design, and relentless simplicity.

What We Offer:
For full-time positions

• 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision for you and your dependents

• Up to 6% match to 401(k) contributions with additional discretionary 4% profit share on day one. Roth options available; no vesting period.

• Every role is eligible for an annual performance bonus

• $200,000 employer-paid life insurance, plus short- and long-term disability coverage

• $5,000 annual professional development budget per employee

• 20 days PTO, plus 8 paid holidays

• Pet insurance, onsite gym, and flexible schedule

Bluestaq is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees on the basis age 40 and over, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by state or local law.

Bluestaq will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities and employees whose work requirements interfere with a religious belief unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to Bluestaq or a direct threat. Employees needing such accommodation are instructed to contact Human Resources immediately at contact.us@bluestaq.com.

Applications will be accepted for 60 days beyond the posting date, or until the position is filled, whichever comes first.

ABOUT PAYZEN

PayZen is on a mission to bring financial health to healthcare. Our products improve both access and affordability for patients and cash flow and administrative complexity for medical providers. You own a product surface within Care Finance's provider and partner platform — the systems that connect PayZen to health systems and partners — on a weeks-long horizon, in an environment governed by HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and SOC 2.

Deliver Reliable Craft on Your Surface

REQUIREMENTS

jobs.title: Sr. Demand Generation Associate, Life360 Ads
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360 Ads is our advertising business. We help advertisers reach relevant audiences across screens, informed by our direct, ongoing relationship with Life360 members. Ads Marketing makes that value clear. We are product marketers, creatives, content and brand people, and event builders, and we work side by side with sellers every day. We say what we think, we move fast, and we judge ourselves by whether our work brings advertisers into the conversation. If you like building from the ground up and seeing your work show up in real deals, you'll fit right in.

About the Job

Advertisers get pitched all day. The Sr. Demand Generation Associate builds the system that makes Life360 Ads easy to find, easy to trust, and easy to talk to. You own the path from a first search or click to a sales conversation: website and landing-page operations, search, lead capture and routing, and email and LinkedIn campaign delivery. You'll partner with the Content Manager, who owns the message and editorial calendar, and with sellers, who follow up with buyers and tell you what is working.

Here is the honest starting point. We have HubSpot, but today it mostly runs website forms. We don't yet have a consistent lead process or clear handoff to sellers. You will build this in stages with the Senior Director, Sales, and Sales Operations. First, make forms, seller handoff, event follow-up, essential website updates, and basic reporting reliable. Next, launch focused account campaigns, email follow-up, and selected paid campaigns. Add more advanced scoring, search improvements, and testing as the basics work and buyer activity supports them. You'll report to the Senior Director of Ads Marketing. The Senior Director and events team handle paid media relationships and negotiations with industry partners; you support campaign tracking and buyer follow-up.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $102k - 152k USD. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits[, as well as equity: confirm with HR].

What You'll Do

• Build our first lead process with Sales: agree on lead stages, buyer fit, a qualified opportunity, follow-up timing, and routing. Start with simple rules and clear next steps; introduce more advanced scoring when useful data is available.

• Own Marketing's use of HubSpot and the lead handoff into Salesforce. Partner with Sales Operations and system administrators on integration, permissions, account ownership, data quality, and reporting. Coordinate changes with the teams that control the systems.

• Own Life360 Ads website and landing-page operations. Build and improve pages within the available tools, partnering with life360.com owners, developers, and agencies for technical work. Content owns the words and Design owns the visual assets; you own forms, testing, tracking, and conversion.

• Lead search-engine optimization (SEO) for Life360 Ads. Prioritize keyword strategy, useful page structure, and on-page improvements, and brief developers on technical fixes and structured data. Sequence the work against buyer needs and available support.

• Improve visibility in AI search: work with Content on clear, accurate pages that answer advertiser questions, coordinate technical improvements, and track observable citations and referrals. Use what we learn to improve; placement in AI answers is not guaranteed.

• Plan, run, and improve selected paid search and LinkedIn lead-generation campaigns, with priorities and spending agreed with the Senior Director. Establish reliable tracking and Sales follow-up before expanding.

• Own email and LinkedIn campaign operations: audiences, lists, sends, forms, ad accounts, testing, and reporting. The Content Manager owns the message and editorial calendar. Agree on campaign goals and timing together.

• Build useful campaign pages and forms, using gated content where it serves a clear purpose. Make sure event and website inquiries reach the right seller and receive timely follow-up.

• Support account-based campaigns aimed at named brands and agencies.

• Set up tracking and practical dashboards with Sales Operations. Check lead capture and follow-up weekly; report monthly on lead quality, sales conversations, qualified opportunities, and campaign spending. Use cost per lead as one measure, not the main definition of success. Explain the results and recommend what to improve.

• Test pages, offers, and campaigns. Do more of what works and stop what doesn't.

• Meet with sellers regularly to hear what is working and fix what is not.

• Work with Content, Product Marketing, Design, Events, and PR on a shared campaign schedule. Partner with life360.com owners, developers, and Sales Operations on technical delivery. Make support needs and dependencies clear before committing to timelines.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years in B2B demand gen, marketing operations, or digital marketing, with a track record of measurable lead and pipeline growth.

• Builder's track record: you have set up lead scoring, routing, and nurture programs in HubSpot yourself, and you can show us.

• Hands-on HubSpot and Salesforce skills, including how data moves between them.

• Website ownership: you have managed a website and built landing pages, and you know how to brief and check the work of developers and agencies.

• SEO foundation: keyword strategy, on-page and technical SEO, site structure, and structured data, with results you can show.

• AI search know-how: you understand how AI tools find and cite content, and you have shaped content to improve visibility in them.

• Paid search and LinkedIn Campaign Manager experience, with results you can show.

• AI-native operator: you use AI tools in your daily work (research, analysis, reporting, building) and can guide them to produce work that fits the brand.

• Data-driven decision maker who can build dashboards, spot problems early, and explain what the numbers mean for the business.

• Proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and an SEO tool such as Ahrefs or Semrush (or equivalent).

• Strong cross-functional partner who works well with Sales, Content, Creative, Events, and PR, and can influence priorities without direct authority.

• Clear, confident communicator who explains technical things in plain words to sellers and non-technical teammates.

• Experience marketing to advertisers or in media, and account-based marketing experience, are strong pluses.

Our Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)

• Paid parental leave

• 401(k) plan with company matching program

• Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being

• Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns

• Learning & Development programs

• Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment

• Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference.

• Be a Good Person: We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.

• Be Direct With Respect: We communicate directly, even when it's hard.

• Members Before Metrics: We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.

• High Intensity, High Impact: We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.location: Remote - Austin; Remote - Seattle; San Francisco, CA, United States
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this role:

Samsara’s cloud-connected sensor platform collects observations about the world in near real-time. Samsara builds an extensive set of products, including battery-powered, wireless sensors, Linux-based IoT gateways, and Internet-connected dashcams. These devices are the building blocks Samsara uses to construct enterprise solutions for a wide range of verticals, including commercial fleet management and industrial monitoring. Through a unique integration of sensor data such as GPS, acceleration, temperature, video, and more, we enable our customers to gain greater insights into operations, identify and eliminate inefficiencies, and react to alerts all in near real-time.

As a Firmware Engineer at Samsara, you will develop software that runs on millions of devices, deployed by our industrial and enterprise customers. You’ll tackle challenges including evaluating and selecting hardware components, bringing up new hardware platforms and sensors, building systems to gather data and detect meaningful events, and structuring recorded data to allow efficient analysis across thousands of devices while providing deep insights into individual events.

We use C for our MCU-based platforms, Golang for embedded applications on Linux-based gateways and backend services, Google protocol buffers to structure data, and various AWS technologies to process and store data. Experience with these exact technologies is not required.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

Click here to learn more about Samsara's cultural philosophy.

In this role, you will:

• Shape the hardware, not just the code that runs on it. Sit in reviews with our electrical engineers and help choose the right SoC, amount of flash/RAM, and combination of sensors, then prove those choices out on prototypes that reach real customers in months, not years.

• Be the first person to make a new board do anything at all. Bring up new platforms and prototypes from virgin silicon: configure I/O, get SPI, I2C, UART, BLE talking, debug system init, validate the design, and turn unproven hardware into a product.

• Build the layers everything else depends on. Peripheral drivers, secure bootloaders, device firmware updates, as well as the core management layers like power and connectivity, that determine whether a device in the field quietly recovers on its own or becomes an RMA.

• Chase every microamp. Design protocols and hardware management for battery-powered sensors and gateways where the gap between good firmware and great firmware is measured in years of device life.

• Work with the people who ship the whole product. Partner with product, full-stack, mobile and quality engineers so the data your firmware produces arrives intact and useful as it lands in the hands of dispatchers, fleet managers, and technicians who depend on it every shift.

• Raise the bar for the engineers around you. Your designs, reviews, and instincts help raise the ceiling for the whole team. You will help shape how Samsara works, keep a high bar, be intellectually honest, work with urgency and deliver iteratively, as we scale globally and across new offices.

What you bring

• 2+ years building firmware for resource-constrained systems, on products that shipped to real customers and then had to survive in the field.

• Fluency in C. You know what the compiler is doing, and you can read a linker map, a stack trace, or a corrupted heap without guessing.

• Solid bare-metal and RTOS experience - Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or equivalent. You have made scheduling, memory and timing decisions. Mutexes and semaphores are everyday tools for you.

• You have helped bring up new boards. First power-on of unproven hardware, at the bench with the electrical engineer who drew it up, working out whether the bug is in your code, a library, the schematic, or the part itself.

• Fluency in the low-level interfaces - SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, ADC and the ability to debug the seam between hardware and software.

• Real bench instincts. The usage of an oscilloscope, network analyzer, or RF spectrum analyzer, is how you form a hypothesis, not what you reach for after the print statements run out.

• Cross-team scope. You have contributed to work spanning hardware, firmware, cloud and quality from concept to shipped product. You have worked effectively across teams to build consensus.

• Cross-layer judgment. You can trace how a decision at the driver level surfaces in a customer's experience three layers up, and you factor that into your design decisions.

• You write things down. Design docs, review comments and post-mortems that other engineers can actually act on.

• You ship fast without shipping poorly. Comfortable iterating on customer feedback at speed, backed by automated testing and code you would be content to inherit.

• You use AI smartly. It’s part of your every day work flow and multiplies your output without watering things down.

What will set you apart

• BLE at depth - You understand what’s going on down the PHY and can build orchestration for the system to use in a performant and power efficient way.

• Cellular IoT - LTE-M or NB-IoT modem integration, power state management, and the certification gauntlet (FCC, PTCRB, carrier approval).

• Securing embedded systems end to end - secure boot, firmware signing, cryptography, and key management that survives contact with manufacturing.

• OTA and device firmware update at fleet scale - A/B partitions, rollback, and the discipline of never bricking a device you cannot physically reach.

• Embedded Linux on the gateway side - Yocto or Buildroot, kernel drivers, device trees.

• CAN and J1939 work on commercial vehicles, including reverse-engineering data bus parameters across makes and models.

• Python and Bash for tooling, and hardware-in-the-loop test automation.

• You’ve been on the factory floor - You have an understanding of the processes behind the mass production and quality assurance of electronics. You have a track record of fixing production show stoppers.

jobs.title: Head of Fulfillment Operations & Support
jobs.description:
Today, we live in a world where everything has become convenient. Now you can get a ride anywhere, buy anything, answer any question with just a couple clicks on your phone. Convenience isn’t a luxury, it’s an expectation.

So why not renting? It’s still a chore to get utilities set up, buy renters insurance, get air filters changed, handle pest control, and more.

That’s why we’ve built the world’s first Resident Experience Platform that makes resident onboarding, resident services, and ancillary revenue effortless for property managers.

We’re passionate about turning friction into triple win experiences for residents, property managers, and investors. That way renting can be easy and rewarding for everyone.

And now you can join us. Apply today to join 300 passionate, creative people who strive to make a difference each day so residents, property managers, and investors all win; creating the ultimate Triple Win.





ROLE OVERVIEW

The Head of Fulfillment Operations and Support will own the enrollment and fulfillment functions for Second Nature’s resident benefit services, as well as the end-to-end resident and Property Management Company (PMC) support experience. The core mission: ensure accurate and timely resident enrollment and fulfillment, while continuously elevating service quality and driving down unit cost to serve.

This is a builder’s role, not a caretaker’s. The ideal leader is an operator at the core and deeply service-oriented. They recognize that high-quality service at scale isn't only delivered through hustle.  It's delivered through control: process discipline, vendor accountability, and systems that make flawless fulfillment and excellent service repeatable rather than heroic.

Note: Leveling (Director vs. VP) will be determined based on candidate qualifications, executive leadership track record, and scope of experience.



METRICS THIS ROLE IS ACCOUNTABLE FOR

This is an outcome-driven build role. You will directly own and be evaluated on the following core metrics:

 - Enrollment and Fulfillment Speed & Quality: High-accuracy thresholds for timely resident benefit enrollments, billing charges, benefit fulfillment, and partner data exchange management.

 - Speed of Resolution & First Contact Resolution (FCR): Mean time to resolve (MTTR) and % of issues closed on first contact across BPO and internal support channels.

 - Fulfillment Cost per New Enrollment & Support Cost per Active Enrollment: Unit cost to enroll residents and resolve support issues across all channels, driven downward without sacrificing customer quality, CSAT or SLA performance.

 - Resident & PMC CSAT: Resident-side satisfaction and likelihood-to-recommend, tracked distinctly from PMC-side satisfaction given the two-audience model.


SCOPE & RESPONSIBILITIES


ENROLLMENT MANAGEMENT

 - Own the processes and outcomes for accurate, timely resident enrollment, accurate PMC billing, and error-free benefit fulfillment. Run the data- and queue-intensive operation that turns variable-quality resident data from thousands of PMCs (API, flat file, and more) into clean enrollments.

 - Serve as the operational engine that moves enrollments to external benefit providers, so every resident receives their benefit on time and every PMC is billed correctly.

 - Collaborate in lock-step with dedicated internal product and engineering platform teams to identify and exploit opportunities to redesign and automate error-prone, high-latency, labor-intensive enrollment and fulfillment workflows..


SUPPORT OPERATIONS (B2B2C)

 - Own multi-channel support (phone, chat, email) for both client segments: PMC staff/admins (B2B) and residents (B2C), managing distinct SLAs, tones, and workflows for each.

 - Lead workforce planning, forecasting, and queue/channel architecture for internal and external support (BPO) resources.

 - Manage day-to-day operations and accountability for BPO partners: SLA compliance, quality assurance (QA) scoring, coaching, volume forecasting, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

 - Scope, design, and launch segment specific support models tailored for enterprise, mid-market, and small business accounts.  This is a new motion with no existing playbook to inherit.


ZERO-TOUCH & DIGITAL-FIRST SUPPORT

 - Formulate and execute a digital-first support strategy (self-service, AI/automation, chat deflection) to resolve routine contacts faster and at higher quality without human intervention.

 - Conduct contact-driver analysis to identify candidates for elimination, deflection, and automated resolution; build and manage the rollout roadmap over time.

 - Maintain strict quality and accuracy standards for automated and AI-driven workflows to protect CSAT and FCR.


COST OPTIMIZATION & PROCESS ENGINEERING

 - Identify and execute cost-curve reduction through process redesign, automation, and AI-enabled workflows, without degrading enrollment quality, support CSAT, or SLA performance.

 - Optimize unit economics across all support channels.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - 60 Days:
   
   - Full visibility into enrollment and fulfillment performance, including intake volume by channel, queue aging, error and exception rates, and billing accuracy; top data quality issues by PMC and source documented and ranked; zero degradation in enrollment timeliness or accuracy during onboarding.
   
   - Full visibility into current BPO performance with live scorecards; Enterprise Support model scoped and documented; zero CSAT/SLA degradation during onboarding.

 - 100 Days:
   
   - Live enrollment and fulfillment dashboards driving daily queue management and accountability; first data quality improvement shipped for the highest-volume exception driver (e.g., intake validation or PMC feedback loop); accuracy and turnaround targets defined and tracked with external benefit providers.  End to end roadmaps in place and active for highest leverage opportunities on the pareto.
   
   - Vendor scorecards actively driving operational accountability; first major cost-curve reduction initiative shipped; Segment specific support models piloted with key segmented accounts; digital-first deflection live for top contact driver.

 - 180 Days:
   
   - Measurable improvement in enrollment accuracy, time to enroll, and billing accuracy; a meaningful share of enrollments processed with no manual touch; exception volume trending down across API and flat file channels; partner data exchange operating to agreed accuracy and timeliness standards.
   
   - Measurable downward trend in cost per resolution while CSAT/SLA hold or improve; Enterprise Support fully operational; zero-touch channel handling a meaningful share of volume without FCR or accuracy loss.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years leading high-volume, transaction-driven operations such as claims processing, enrollment administration, or benefits and billing operations, where accuracy, queue management, and data quality across multiple intake channels determine the outcome.

 - 7+ years of progressive operational leadership in customer support, vendor management, or BPO operations within a fast-growing B2B2C, PropTech, Marketplace, or SaaS environment. Ability to command a broad span of control and work.

 - Proven track record managing multi-site or nearshore/offshore BPO partners and third-party fulfillment vendors with strict SLA enforcement.

 - Demonstrated experience implementing digital-first self-service, AI agent workflows, and CRM ticket routing tools (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Gorgias, or similar).

 - Advanced analytical capability (workforce planning, unit economics, contact volume forecasting, and vendor scorecards). Strong intellectual wherewithal and ability to delineate signal v. noise

 - A systemic, process-oriented operator who thrives in unstructured environments and prefers building scalable infrastructure over manual workarounds. High say:do ratio.
   


REMOTE WORK STATEMENT

This position is a remote-first, work-from-home position. Second Nature is committed to creating a culture and workplace where remote work fosters collaboration and connections and is a vital part of our company story and success. To be successful in a remote work role at Second Nature, you must:

 - Be available and engaged during core working hours aligned with the Eastern Time Zone to ensure effective collaboration and timely completion of responsibilities

 - Have a quiet, professional, distraction-free environment in which to complete your work

 - Have access to your own reliable high-speed internet connection

 - Attend our bi-annual in-person company meetings (Second Nature will reimburse the cost of your business travel per company guidelines)




💟 WHY SECOND NATURE?

🩺 Health First: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, & 401K Plan

📍Location: Work remotely from anywhere in the US

📆 Flexibility: Open PTO and sick days

🤩 The Product: Beyond the awards and 5-star reviews, our clients and customers love what they can do with a fully managed RBP

🤗 Diverse, Inclusive Culture: We embrace employees from all backgrounds with openness and respect

💻 Training: A supportive team to help you grow your career and unlock your full potential

🚀 Growth: The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a fast-growing startup that’s designing and developing an exciting category



We get it. Requirements can sometimes hold people back from applying to a job, but don’t let that be the case here. If you believe you have the skills it takes to elevate this role, team, and company, we encourage you to apply for this role.



Second Nature is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We take action to ensure equal employment opportunities for all candidates and employees and to provide employees with a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. Our hiring decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by federal and/or state law.

jobs.description:
The right team is more than an advantage; it’s a game changer! Come work with a team of professionals dedicated to excellence at Coffman Engineers’ San Diego Office.  We are seeking a Commissiong Technician to join our team.

This is an Entry-level or developing technical position intended to provide hands-on experience in building systems commissioning. Under the direction of an experienced Commissioning Specialist or Commissioning Manager, the Commissioning Technician I will assist with field observations, equipment verification, documentation review, pre-functional inspections, functional performance testing, deficiency tracking, and preparation of commissioning documentation.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Learn to operate commissioning and test and balance tools proficiently.
• Assist with field observations and verification of installed building systems and equipment.
• Assist with pre-functional inspections and functional performance testing.
• Review and organize equipment startup, testing, and related field documentation.
• Document observed deficiencies, incomplete work, testing results, and required follow-up actions.
• Communicate field progress, constraints, deficiencies, and testing results to the Commissioning Manager.
• Complete assigned tasks accurately, safely, and within established project schedules.
• Listen carefully to verbal and written instructions, follow supervisor instructions, and accurately carry out assigned commissioning activities.
• Ask appropriate questions when instructions, testing procedures, or expected results are unclear.
• Coordinate professionally and effectively in person with trade subcontractors, controls technicians, and other field personnel.
• Clearly communicate testing requirements, planned activities, observed deficiencies, and required follow-up actions.
• Maintain a professional and respectful approach when working through field issues.
• Follow established lines of communication and avoid directing subcontractors beyond the authority assigned by the Commissioning Manager or project team.
• Read and comprehend technically written material.
• Maintain company work gear, cellphones, computers, tools, equipment, supplies and vehicles in good working order.
• Attend meetings and provide input necessary to coordinate and complete assigned tasks.
• Adhere to schedules provided by Supervisor.
• Adapt work habits to accommodate a variety of office and field tasks.
• Perform other duties as may be assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

• Attentive listener who can understand and follow verbal and written instructions
• Possess organizational and clear written/verbal communication skills; computer skills with databases and Microsoft Windows Operating systems (i.e. Word and Excel).
• Willingness to learn building systems, commissioning processes, construction-site practices, construction project-management platforms, commissioning software, and other project-specific programs used to manage documents, observations, issues, and field activities.
• Possess team player attitude.

Expected Hourly rate is $28.00 per hour.

This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

Must maintain a valid passport and be willing and able to travel as project needs require, potentially including:

• overnight and extended travel assignments within and outside home state and internationally, lasting up to two consecutive weeks,

• Previous experience in the construction industry preferred.
• Familiarity with construction sites, building systems, trade coordination, construction drawings, or field documentation desirable.
• Experience preferences include construction, commissioning, TAB, and direct digital control systems.
• Experience with mechanical/electrical engineering, design and construction processes desirable.
• Experience with construction site work activity conditions and safety protocols desirable.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
