jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Affairs
jobs.description:
Spyre Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company committed to developing next-generation therapies that elevate the standard in immunology by delivering more complete disease control, greater durability, and a simpler treatment experience for patients. Spyre's pipeline includes investigational extended half-life antibodies targeting α4β7, TL1A, IL-23, and IL-17A/F as well as rational combination programs.

Role Summary:

• As the Director, Regulatory Affairs, you will play a key role in managing and overseeing regulatory affairs activities and execution within our organization, initially focused on Spyre’s IBD program. You will be responsible for planning and executing regulatory strategies that enable Spyre to initiate and manage clinical trials. You will also contribute to preclinical, CMC, and clinical development plans with the goal of ensuring Spyre performs the necessary studies to gain and maintain product approval(s) that are consistent with our target product profile(s).

• You will act as the overall lead of global regulatory applications for one or more drug candidates and will lead the submission of original investigational new drug and clinical trial applications. You will lead efforts to plan and prepare for meetings with global health authorities (Type C & EOP2 meetings with FDA, EMA scientific advice, etc.) and support live discussions. You will also support the team by contributing to the development of other assets for which you are not the overall lead, and by contributing to the development of processes for the Regulatory Department.

Key Responsibilities:

• Regulatory Strategy: Develop and implement regulatory strategies that enable the company’s clinical trials and marketing applications. Stay current with evolving regulatory requirements and industry trends and advise the company on regulatory expectations.

• Regulatory Submissions: Prepare, review, and submit regulatory applications and dossiers to health authorities, such as the FDA, EMA, PMDA, and other global regulatory agencies, ensuring timely and successful approvals.

• Health Authority Meetings: Plan meeting strategy, lead the development of briefing materials, capture action items, and support the team in implementation and strategy.

• Communication: Represent the company in regulatory interactions and maintain effective communication with regulatory agencies, responding to inquiries and requests in a professional and efficient manner. Communicate regulatory agency interactions and guidance to Regulatory Affairs leadership and cross-functional teams.

• Risk Management: Identify potential regulatory risks and proactively develop strategies to mitigate them. Monitor changes in regulatory landscapes and assess their impact on the company's products.

• Regulatory Intelligence: Keep abreast of new and evolving regulations, guidelines, and best practices in the pharmaceutical industry and adapt company strategies accordingly.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other departments, including Pre-clinical Research & Development, Clinical Development, Technical Operations, Legal, and Quality and Compliance to ensure regulatory considerations are integrated into the product development process.

• Budget Management: Contribute to development and management of the regulatory affairs budget for assigned projects, ensuring cost-effective use of resources while maintaining high-quality regulatory activities.

Ideal Candidate:

• Bachelor’s degree with 8-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical regulatory affairs and/or related disciplines, or an equivalent combination of relevant education, training, and experience.

• Proven track record of successfully managing complex regulatory submissions

• Proven experience managing clinical trial applications in the US and globally

• Strong knowledge of global pharmaceutical regulations and guidelines, including FDA, EMA, and ICH requirements

• Proficient in medical and/or technical writing, including the ability to author or contribute to documents such as Module 2 and 3 summaries, DSURs, safety reports, investigational brochures, clinical trial protocols, clinical trial reports, and/or IMPDs

• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills

• Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities

• Ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities

• Proficiency in regulatory affairs software and document management systems.

• Experience with CMC regulatory, device (e.g., pre-filled syringe and/or auto-injector) and/or diagnostic (e.g., companion diagnostics)

What We Offer:

• Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where you help shape the culture of our young company, contribute broadly to advance meaningful medicines, and learn quickly.

• Market competitive compensation and benefits package, including base salary, performance bonus, equity grant opportunities, health, welfare & retirement benefits.

• Unlimited PTO

• Two, one-week company-wide shutdowns each

• Commitment to provide professional development opportunities.

• Remote working environment with frequent in-person meetings to address complex problems and build relationships.

The expected salary range offer for this role is $220,000 to $245,000. Actual pay offered may vary depending on job related knowledge, experience, education, and geographic location.

As an equal opportunity employer, Spyre is committed to a diverse workforce. Employment decisions regarding recruitment and selection will be made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non-job-related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state and local laws. We also embrace differences in experience and background, and welcome diversity of opinions and thought with active recruitment designed to create a stronger and better Spyre that is focused on developing life-changing products for patients.

Spyre Therapeutics, along with other biotech companies, has become aware of a surge in email scams targeting prospective job candidates within our industry. Please be aware that official recruiters at Spyre Therapeutics only use email addresses with the domain “@spyre.com.” We want to also emphasize that we never request candidates to make any purchases or divulge sensitive personal information via email.

Please also be aware that all job postings will be listed on our website at spyre.com/careers/.

jobs.title: Director, Actuarial & Performance Guarantees
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

This role is a unique opportunity to own how Twin puts its outcomes on the line. Twin stands behind its results with performance guarantees, and you’ll be the credentialed actuarial owner of those commitments from first design through final settlement.

As Director, Actuarial & Performance Guarantees, you’ll help shape Twin’s deals from the start, validating the business case we present to clients. You’ll lead the development of Twin’s performance guarantees and serve as the actuarial voice in partner contracting. You’ll also oversee measurement and settlement of every guarantee in market. You’ll partner closely with Accounting and Finance to ensure the company forecasts guarantee outcomes accurately and recognizes revenue appropriately. This is a highly visible role reporting into Value, Access & Pricing leadership, working directly with senior leadership, sales, finance, clinical, and data teams. Your work will shape how health plans, employers, and health systems evaluate Twin.

Responsibilities

• Shape deals from the start by partnering with sales and pricing on deal structure, fees at risk, and guarantee terms, so that each opportunity is commercially attractive and actuarially sound before it reaches contracting, including structuring arrangements that fit Medicare Advantage plan economics, bid cycles, and quality programs.

• Validate client business cases by reviewing the savings projections, ROI models, and population assumptions Twin presents to prospective clients. You’ll make sure every claim is defensible and consistent with how Twin measures and guarantees results.

• Lead performance guarantee design, including savings and clinical guarantee structures, measurement windows, comparison populations, statistical credibility thresholds, and payout mechanics. You’ll balance what partners find compelling against the risk Twin can responsibly hold.

• Price guarantee risk by modeling expected payout distributions and fees at risk under a range of scenarios, and by linking guarantee terms to Twin’s pricing and deal structures.

• Serve as the actuarial lead in contracting, owning guarantee terms in negotiations, reviewing contract language, and defending Twin’s methodology with payer actuaries, benefits consultants, and partner analytics teams.

• Own guarantee execution from data inputs through measurement, reconciliation, settlement, and resolution of disputes with partners. You’ll make sure every result can be reproduced and defended.

• Partner with Accounting and Finance on forecasting by developing expected-payout estimates for variable consideration under ASC 606, supporting quarterly accruals and true-ups, and ensuring revenue forecasts reflect realistic guarantee performance.

• Govern actuarial methodology by documenting and validating savings and outcome methods, producing actuarial memos consistent with relevant Actuarial Standards of Practice, and maintaining a clear audit trail for every guarantee, ensuring consistency from proposal to contract to settlement.

• Collaborate across the business, working with sales, clinical, and data engineering teams to ensure guarantee definitions are operational, measurable, and supported by Twin’s claims data model.

• Build the actuarial function by establishing processes, mentoring analysts, and shaping how the team grows as Twin’s book of guaranteed business scales.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• Credentials: Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) and Member of the American Academy of Actuaries (MAAA) required.

• Background: 8+ years of health actuarial experience, including 3+ years designing, pricing, or reconciling performance guarantees, value-based contracts, or vendor ROI arrangements, whether at a payer, consulting firm, or health services company.

• Medicare Advantage Expertise: Direct Medicare Advantage actuarial experience is required. That includes a working knowledge of the MA bid process, CMS-HCC risk adjustment, Star Ratings, medical loss ratio requirements, and supplemental benefits, and of how a vendor program affects each from the plan’s perspective.

• Deal & Contracting Expertise: Proven experience shaping deal structures and negotiating actuarial terms directly with health plans, employers, or their consultants, and defending business cases and methodology under external review.

• Financial Acumen: Experience partnering with Accounting on revenue recognition, accruals, or reserving for at-risk or contingent arrangements. Familiarity with ASC 606 variable consideration is strongly preferred.

• Methodological Rigor: Strong grounding in claims-based savings measurement, risk adjustment, and comparison group methods, including difference-in-differences and matched cohort designs, with an understanding of their limitations.

• Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in SQL and a statistical programming language (R or Python), with comfort working directly in a modern data warehouse.

• Communication: Ability to translate complex actuarial findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership, sales teams, and external partners.

• Passion: Twin’s purpose to transform lives by empowering people to reverse, prevent and improve chronic metabolic diseases excites you.

• This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $205,000 - $215,000 annually. This position is bonus eligible.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

• A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies

• A remote and accomplished global team

• Opportunity for equity participation

• Unlimited vacation with manager approval

• 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents

• 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options

• 401k retirement savings plan

Salary range for US jobs

US Salary Range

$205,000—$215,000 USD

The analyst validates and reviews data for accuracy, and enters laboratory data into the LIMS that ultimately generates required reports to clients. Schedules sample workload according to due dates and sample hold times, and must be knowledgeable of the job-specific laboratory testing equipment, requiring the exercise of discretion and judgment in its operation.

Asbestos Analyst  responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Prepare and analyze aerobiological and environmental samples for asbestos.
• Accurately enters and reports analytical data using the LIMS
• Performs independent data reviews for other analysts’ work
• Performs analysis of reference materials, proficiency samples and other quality control samples as needed
• Maintains client service and provides technical support as needed
• Assists the QA manager in development, implementation and data collection of QA processes for the different analytical tests
• Performs confirmation of lab results as needed by client services personnel
• Performs and completes all analytical testing and Quality Assurance related tasks as needed
• Assists in pursuing, receiving and maintaining necessary laboratory accreditations
• Maintains and updates all necessary Training and QA documents onsite as necessary
• Coordinates and manages projects according to their rush status and due time for timely delivery
• Assists co-workers on analytical questions, as necessary
• Participates in Lean initiatives as needed
• Follows company policies and procedures and ensures that coworkers are doing the same
• Manages and maintains the inventory of re-sale supply items and laboratory consumables and takes necessary steps to re-order supplies as needed
• Manages and disposes analyzed samples as needed
• Provides training support for relevant analytical services (i.e. mycology, bacteriology, asbestos, ect) as needed
• Recommends and coordinates sample transfer as necessary
• Establishes and maintains laboratory stock culture and reference samples
• Performs root cause analysis and implements corrective actions for errors and issues as necessary
• Maintains all equipment properly and co-ordinates servicing of all equipment used in the laboratory, as needed
• Routinely communicates available capacity to Regional Manager
• Supports other departments within the lab (mycology, asbestos, bacteriology, and other) when appropriate and as needed
• Other responsibilities as deemed necessary by the Supervisor/Manager

Basic Minimum Qualifications:

• 0-1+ years of experience performing asbestos microscopy using Polarizing Light Microscope (PLM)

• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship

• 8 units of Geology courses preferred
• General regulatory requirements knowledge
• Knowledge of computers, spreadsheets, and databases
• Strong computer, scientific, and organizational skills

Compensation Range: $23-$27 per hour depending on level of experience and qualifications.

Position is full-time, with possible weekends and overtime as needed.  Candidates must be available to work Monday - Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm.

jobs.title: Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management
jobs.description:
Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!

Vaxcyte is a clinical-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance.

WHAT we do is every bit as important as HOW we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:

*RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.

*AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.

*LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.

*MODEL EXCELLENCE:  The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making.

Summary:

As we grow, we are seeking a strategic and collaborative Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management to ensure the integrity, accessibility, and effective use of data and knowledge assets across the organization. This role will execute component-level analysis, utilizing data and knowledge resources critical to our process development, regulatory, and operational activities. The Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management is instrumental in ensuring scientific data integrity, regulatory readiness, and the preservation of institutional knowledge in a dynamic, fast-paced clinical environment.

Essential Functions:

Engineering Analytics & Process Insights:

• Assess process trends and discrepancies using engineering knowledge, and evaluate the technical rationale and potential impact of proposed process improvements

• Apply chemical and biochemical engineering principles to evaluate relationships between process parameters, unit operation performance, and product quality attributes

• Partner with data science team to drive data visualization, reporting, and insights.

• Support the use of AI/ML and automation for improved data analysis and knowledge extraction.

Manufacturing Process Data Management & Governance:

• Acquire, integrate, and technically evaluate manufacturing process data from internal teams and contract manufacturing sites to support process monitoring, continuous improvement, and CMC regulatory submissions.

• Develop data management and verification workflows that preserve the accuracy, integrity, and traceability of manufacturing process data.

• Lead and own data verification for all commercial regulatory submissions.

Process Knowledge Management:

• Develop structured systems and workflows to capture and retain organizational knowledge, including protocols, study results, lessons learned, and decision rationales.

• Develop tools and processes that enable technical teams to access, share, and apply process knowledge to support manufacturing and process improvement.

• Champion a knowledge-sharing culture across technical, scientific and operational functions.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership:

• Partner with regulatory, quality, R&D, IT and contract manufacturing teams to understand technical needs and develop appropriate solutions.

Compliance & Risk Management:

• Ensure compliance with data protection and clinical trial regulations, including GDPR, HIPAA, and 21 CFR Part 11.

• Identify and mitigate risks related to data security, access, and retention.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is required. 8+ years of relevant experience in biopharmaceutical process engineering, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), process development, manufacturing technical support, or related engineering work, including at least 3 years in the life sciences or biotechnology industry. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered.

• Experience interpreting manufacturing process data and applying engineering and statistical methods to evaluate process performance.

• Proven experience leading enterprise data governance and knowledge sharing initiatives in a highly regulated environment.

• Strong technical communication, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, scientific, and manufacturing teams.

• Experience with tools like SharePoint, Veeva Vault, Confluence, Tableau, and SQL is highly desirable.

Preferred:

• Experience supporting clinical trials and regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, BLA).

• Background in immunology, vaccines, or infectious disease R&D.

• Experience in scaling systems and processes in a high-growth, early- to mid-stage.

Reports to: Senior Director, Process Validation, Global MSAT

Location: United States

Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy):

Remote

Compensation:

The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component.

Salary Range: $121,000 - $142,000

Relocation:

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Please be aware of fraud or scams from individuals, organizations and/or internet sites claiming to represent Vaxcyte in recruitment activities. Vaxcyte has an established recruitment process for all positions prior to issuing an offer for employment and we will never extend unsolicited employment offers or ask candidates to provide financial or sensitive personal information as part of the application process. All legitimate communication from Vaxcyte will come from an official @vaxcyte.com email address. Qualified and interested candidates should apply to current openings at vaxcyte.com/careers.

jobs.title: Talent Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE TALENT ACQUISITION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Deploy AI across the entire funnel. Use the latest models in every part of talent ops to find the best people in the world faster than any team has before. You won't bolt AI onto old processes; you'll rebuild recruiting around it.

 - Treat talent as the critical path. Every role we can't fill slows the whole company down. We need to figure out how to move faster than everyone else in market without ever dropping the bar; one wrong hire costs more than a slow one.

 - Build a brand the best want to join. Make Fluidstack a name top talent seeks out, not one we have to chase. You'll shape how the world's best engineers and operators hear about us, and why they say yes.
   
    


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own interview coordination end to end: schedule and manage complex, multi-stakeholder interviews across formats, time zones, and roles with zero dropped balls.

 - Deliver a white-glove candidate experience as the primary point of contact through the interview process, responsive and clear at every touchpoint.

 - Keep the machine running: anticipate and resolve scheduling conflicts, logistical issues, and process bottlenecks before they become problems.

 - Maintain data integrity: own accurate, up-to-date candidate records and workflow tracking in the ATS.

 - Support the TA team operationally, partnering with Partners and Sourcers on the tasks that keep pipelines healthy and hiring moving.

 - Spot friction in the process, flag it, and help build better workflows, leaving every system better than you found it.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've coordinated recruiting, or run administrative or operations work, in a fast-paced tech or startup environment.

 - You manage high volumes of moving parts across multiple roles at once without losing quality or urgency.

 - You sweat the details and run a tight process, and people can always count on you to follow through.

 - You communicate with precision, so candidates, hiring managers, and teammates always know where things stand.

 - You keep clean data and have a low tolerance for errors, because clean systems produce better outcomes.

 - Bonus: ATS and scheduling tools (Greenhouse, Ashby, or similar). High-volume technical recruiting coordination. Process and workflow building.

 

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125,000 per year, depending on experience, skills, qualifications, and location. This range represents our good faith estimate of the compensation for this role at the time of posting.

 



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

jobs.title: Real World Data Lead
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

This role is a unique opportunity to build the data foundation behind how Twin proves its value to every partner it serves. You won’t just maintain pipelines; you’ll design the claims data model that powers partner reporting, performance guarantee measurement, and a new partner-facing portal.As the Real World Data Lead, you’ll own Twin’s claims data architecture from end to end. You’ll take partner claims data from its ingested raw form, standardize it to deliver trusted, analytics-ready tables to internal teams and external partners. You’ll also consolidate our existing reporting marts onto this common foundation. This is a highly visible role at the center of how Twin demonstrates outcomes and savings. You’ll collaborate closely with data engineering, application engineering, health economics, and partner-facing teams.

Responsibilities

• Build Twin’s Tuva-based claims data model by designing and implementing the architecture in dbt and Snowflake, from the Tuva Input Layer through Tuva Core and the data marts our reporting depends on.

• Develop and maintain partner connectors that map each partner’s ingested claims and eligibility data to the Tuva Input Layer. You’ll partner with the ingestion team to define clear data contracts at the handoff between raw and modeled data.

• Own claims data quality by running structural and logical data quality checks, monitoring each partner data source, and reconciling modeled outputs against partner-reported totals.

• Consolidate existing reporting marts onto the common data model, retiring duplicated claims logic. You’ll run old and new versions in parallel so current reporting continues uninterrupted during migration.

• Build the partner portal serving layer with versioned, contract-enforced tables designed for application queries. This includes pre-aggregated models, performance tuning, and freshness commitments that partners can rely on.

• Enforce partner data isolation and PHI security in Snowflake using role-based access, row access policies, secure views, and masking, so that each partner sees only its own data.

• Maintain a single source of truth for metrics by ensuring that savings, PMPM, utilization, and outcome measures in the portal match the definitions used for contract measurement. You’ll work closely with health economics and actuarial partners on those definitions.

• Manage the model lifecycle, including Tuva version upgrades, regression testing, CI/CD, documentation, and change communication to downstream consumers.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. You bring 6+ years of experience in data or analytics engineering, including 3+ years working directly with healthcare claims data.

• Claims Expertise: Deep familiarity with medical and pharmacy claims and eligibility data, including adjudication, reversals, claim lag, and standard code sets (ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, NDC, NPI). Experience with payer data formats (837, 835, 834) is a plus.

• dbt Expertise: Extensive experience building and maintaining production dbt projects, including model contracts and versions, testing, and CI. Hands-on experience with the Tuva Project is strongly preferred.

• Snowflake Proficiency: Advanced SQL and Snowflake experience, including query performance tuning, RBAC, row access and masking policies, and warehouse cost management.

• Data Product Mindset: Proven experience delivering data to applications or external customers through stable, versioned interfaces, with a clear sense of what “production-grade” means when a partner is on the other end.

• Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with data engineering, application engineering, and analytical teams to define data contracts, metric definitions, and ownership boundaries.

• Innovation & AI Mindset: Demonstrated interest in using AI-assisted development and coding agents to accelerate connector development, testing, and documentation.

• Passion: Twin’s purpose to transform lives by empowering people to reverse, prevent and improve chronic metabolic diseases excites you.

• This hybrid opportunity based out of our New York office. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $185,000 - $195,000 annually. This position is bonus eligible.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

• A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies

• A remote and accomplished global team

• Opportunity for equity participation

• Unlimited vacation with manager approval

• 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents

• 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options

• 401k retirement savings plan

jobs.title: AI & Innovation Lead, G&A
jobs.description:

You bring the domain depth: you know how G&A teams actually work, where their processes and systems break, and which manual work eats their week. You’ll start with Finance, then quickly extend into People and the rest of G&A. You’ll prototype the fix yourself, vibe-coding agents, apps, and workflows on Sanity’s own platform and AI tools. Systems Engineering and the Data team back you on architecture, security, and production hardening, so your ideas become systems the business can rely on. ABOUT YOU:

NICE TO HAVE:

jobs.title: OT Network Engineer, Mission Systems
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

OT NETWORK ENGINEER, MISSION SYSTEMS

SpaceX is looking for an exceptional network engineer with experience in mission-critical and large-scale production environments to support high-cadence launch operations as well as high-reliability production networks. As a member of the Mission Systems / IT Launch engineering team, you will provide operational and design services for networks used by launch/production operations, automation & controls engineering, and facilities teams. The ideal candidate thrives in intense, high flux environments, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, communicates effectively, and demonstrates high levels of technical acumen.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design and implement highly available networks, carefully balancing various routing and redundancy technologies depending on unique requirements between production and launch.

• Design and maintain mission data center and site networks in accordance with company network standards. Collaborating with adjacent infrastructure and enterprise teams.

• Evaluate, procure, and deploy network hardware including switches, firewalls, multiplexing and SDWAN appliances.

• Contribute to ever-maturing network automation tooling; implementing configuration analysis, linting, and scalability into the deployment framework.

• Plan and coordinate network outage windows with stakeholders to perform software updates, hardware refreshes, and general network maintenance (sometimes on weekends and evenings).

• Troubleshoot and resolve network-related issues, publishing root cause analysis (RCA) documentation and hosting retrospective data reviews.

• Provide direct networking support during launch and test campaigns and be on-call or provide real-time support as networking responsible engineer during operations.

• Proactively tailors network monitoring to provide ever more valuable operational telemetry with emphasis on issue detection prior to operational impact.

• Continuously create and update network documentation, including architecture overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with network designs, especially in regards to systemic, cascading failure modes, and superficial redundancy.

• Perform job walks with customers, vendors, and contractors to gather network requirements and create implementation plans.

• Ensure networks are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g., ITAR, ISO, NIST), with particular attention to controls network segmentation and security.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or other STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional network engineering experience; OR 5+ years of professional network engineering experience in lieu of a degree.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Extensive hands-on experience designing, deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 networks in latency sensitive and/or industrial environments.

• Functional experience with multiple network vendors either in production or lab environments.

• Experience with GitOps and Infrastructure as Code frameworks, both as user and contributor.

• Strong understanding of the OSI model and network standards.

• Hands-on experience with Cisco, Arista, and Juniper data center class switches.

• Experience with Wave Division Multiplexing (WDM) and fiber optics infrastructure.

• Extensive knowledge of common enterprise and media protocols.

• Experience with switch port security features, network segmentation, QoS, multicast, and redundancy protocols.

• Familiarity with network monitoring tools and layer 1 testing tools.

• Proficiency in scripting (Bash/PowerShell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).

• Linux and Windows system administration experience professionally or from labs.

• Industry standard certifications such as CCNA or CCNP.

• Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, oil & gas, or similar high-reliability industries.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, and management in both formal and informal situations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to pass DoD background check for launch site access.

• Ability to work in tight quarters; physical dexterity is necessary to perform job functions.

• Availability for extended hours and/or weekends as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required.

• Ability to provide 24x7 on-call support in emergency situations and participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.

• Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.

• Ability to lift 30 lbs.

• Ability to work at heights.

• Ability to drive (active valid driver’s license).

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Senior Healthcare Consultant
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

This role is a unique opportunity to be the face of Twin’s value story. You won’t just build models; you’ll stand in front of employers, health plans, and health systems and show them exactly what Twin can do for their populations.

As a Senior Healthcare Consultant, you’ll build client-specific business cases, use Twin’s value modeling tools, and present results directly to client decision-makers. You’ll also create the sales materials that tell Twin’s value story and track how competitors price and position their offerings. You’ll bring a health economics and pricing perspective to all of it. This is a highly visible role, working closely with sales, actuarial, marketing, and clinical teams.

Responsibilities

• Build client business cases by developing population-specific savings and ROI projections for employers, Medicare Advantage plans, and health systems, using client claims, census, and benefits data. Your projections will stay consistent with Twin’s actuarial methodology.

• Run value modeling using Twin’s analytical tools to produce client scenarios, keeping assumptions and benchmarks current as Twin’s outcomes data and product offerings evolve.

• Present directly to clients, leading value conversations with benefits leaders, health plan executives, and benefits consultants. You’ll explain assumptions clearly and answer tough questions with confidence.

• Develop sales collateral, including value narratives, case studies, one-pagers, and segment-specific presentations grounded in Twin’s clinical and financial outcomes.

• Perform competitive intelligence by tracking competitors’ pricing models, ROI claims, and clinical evidence across diabetes, obesity, GLP-1 management, and cardiometabolic care. You’ll turn that research into battle cards and positioning guidance for the sales team.

• Bring a health economics and pricing lens to market analysis, including medication cost trends, benchmark comparisons, and how Twin’s value compares to alternatives available to each client segment.

• Collaborate across the business, partnering with actuarial on methodology, with sales on deal strategy, and with data teams on the inputs behind every business case.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• Background: Bachelor’s degree in Health Economics, Economics, Public Health, Statistics, or a related field (Master’s preferred). You bring 4–7 years of experience in healthcare consulting, payer or employer benefits analytics, health economics, or digital health.

• Health Economics & Pricing Expertise: Strong command of PMPM economics, claims-based savings and ROI methods, and pricing concepts. You understand how employers, Medicare Advantage plans, and health systems each evaluate value.

• Technical Proficiency: Advanced SQL and R skills are required, along with strong spreadsheet modeling ability.

• Client Presence: Proven experience presenting analytical findings directly to senior client stakeholders and handling challenging questions in real time.

• Storytelling: Ability to turn complex analyses into clear, compelling materials for non-technical audiences.

jobs.title: Functional Safety Manager
jobs.description:
Meet the Team:

This role is responsible for driving the execution framework that enables the safe, scalable deployment of autonomous capabilities across multiple platforms and operational domains. As autonomy systems increase in complexity, this position ensures that safety, systems engineering, validation, and operational readiness activities are planned, integrated, and executed with the rigor required for safety-critical systems.

Working across engineering, functional safety, systems engineering, autonomy, hardware, software, and operations, the Functional Safety Manager provides the structure, governance, and visibility needed to deliver safety-critical capabilities from concept through deployment. The role ensures requirements traceability, verification and validation readiness, risk management, and alignment of safety objectives with program milestones, supporting both product delivery and safety assurance objectives.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead planning and execution of safety-critical initiatives across the autonomous vehicle lifecycle, ensuring alignment between product roadmaps, safety goals, and deployment milestones.

• Establish and maintain traceability between hazards, safety requirements, system requirements, verification activities, validation evidence, and release decisions.

• Coordinate cross-functional safety activities including hazard analysis, safety assessments, safety case development, and operational readiness reviews.

• Drive integrated verification and validation planning across simulation, test environments, closed-course testing, and field operations to support evidence-based deployment decisions.

• Manage program risks, technical dependencies, and change impacts across systems, software, hardware, perception, localization, controls, and operational teams.

• Monitor safety and program metrics, proactively identifying issues that could impact system performance, safety objectives, regulatory compliance, or delivery commitments.

• Facilitate executive reviews and technical governance forums, providing clear visibility into program health, residual risk, and safety readiness.

What you need to succeed

• Experience leading programs involving autonomous systems, ADAS, robotics, aerospace, industrial automation, or other safety-critical platforms.

• Demonstrated experience applying ISO 26262 across the safety lifecycle, including hazard analysis and risk assessment (HARA), safety goals, functional and technical safety concepts, and ASIL decomposition. Working knowledge of ISO 21448 (SOTIF) and other related standards such as IEC 61508, UL 4600, or ISO/PAS 8800 is a plus.

• Familiarity with safety lifecycle artifacts including Item Definitions, HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, Safety Requirements, Safety Plans, Safety Cases, and Verification & Validation strategies.

• Demonstrated ability to align engineering execution with safety assurance objectives while maintaining program delivery commitments.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field plus demonstrated competencies and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 6+ years of experience OR; Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field plus demonstrated competencies and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 3+ years of experience OR; PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field plus demonstrated competencies and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 1+ years of experience. jobs.title: Manager, Business Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
About the role

Help shape what service should become next.

Service is changing quickly. Customer expectations are rising, technology is expanding what is possible, and many of the most valuable opportunities do not arrive as neatly defined projects. They begin as unresolved questions: Where can service create more value? Which ideas are worth testing? What should we scale, rethink, or stop?

As Manager, Business Strategy and Operations, you will sit at the center of those questions. You will turn customer needs, market shifts, and business realities into strategies and experiences worth building, then help move the strongest ideas from possibility to proof.

This is not a traditional project-management or analytics support role. You will form a point of view, bring structure to ambiguity, connect insight to action, and bring the right people together to turn strong ideas into evidence-backed decisions. Your work will influence how we evolve service for customers, partners, and the business, and your portfolio will evolve as new priorities and opportunities emerge.

What You Will Do

• Shape service strategy: Bring together customer, partner, market, competitive, operational, and financial evidence to develop a clear point of view on where and how our service strategy should evolve.
• Spot and shape new opportunities: Find promising ways to improve or reinvent service, turn them into clear opportunities, and determine which are worth pursuing.
• Turn ambiguity into action: Take broad or unresolved questions and create a practical path forward, including the learning agenda, analysis, stakeholders, decisions, and next steps required.
• Figure out what’s worth pursuing: Build the case for where we should invest, weighing customer and partner value, growth potential, economics, feasibility, and what it will actually take to make an idea work.
• Design tests that answer real questions: Translate promising opportunities into concepts, hypotheses, experiments, pilots, success measures, and decision criteria.
• Help make the best ideas real: Work across teams to move validated concepts toward launch, keeping the customer problem, intended value, and measures of success intact along the way.
• Shape important decisions: Give senior leaders a clear point of view on what we should do, why, what the evidence says, and what we're trading off.
• Build a repeatable innovation capability: Help us get better at finding, testing, and advancing good ideas so innovation becomes a repeatable discipline, not a series of one-off projects.

The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here

• You are energized by important questions that don’t yet have obvious answers.
• You can see the bigger opportunity without losing sight of what it will take to make it real.
• You connect customer insight, market context, financial thinking, and operational realities rather than treating them as separate exercises.
• You know the difference between an interesting idea, an opportunity worth testing, and one worth scaling.
• You form a point of view, challenge assumptions constructively, and are willing to recommend stopping when the evidence isn’t there.
• You can influence executives and working teams through judgment, clarity, and credibility, not formal authority.
• You can make complex work simple and make the decision or next step obvious.
• You enjoy creating new capabilities and ways of working, not just operating established processes.
• You want the opportunity to shape the work, not simply execute a strategy someone else has already defined.

What Success Looks Like

• We are making smarter choices about where service can create meaningful value for customers, partners, and the business.
• Promising ideas move from “interesting” to tested, evidence-backed opportunities.
• Ideas that don’t hold up get challenged, reshaped, or stopped before we invest heavily in them.
• Leaders have better evidence and a clearer point of view when making investment and roadmap decisions.
• Teams understand the problem they’re solving, why it matters, and what needs to be true for an idea to succeed.
• You’ve helped build a stronger muscle for finding, testing, and advancing new service ideas.
• As the business evolves, so does your portfolio, giving you room to take on new questions and opportunities.

How You Will Work

You’ll have a lot of autonomy, but you won’t work in a vacuum. You’ll partner across the business to bring the right perspectives into the work, challenge thinking when needed, and create momentum around promising opportunities.

You’ll move constantly between strategy and execution. One day that may mean framing a new opportunity or digging into customer research; another may mean pressure-testing a business case, working through a concept with Product and Technology, or helping leaders decide whether an idea is ready to move forward.

You won’t always be handed a clean problem statement. A big part of the job is figuring out what question we should be asking in the first place.

Role Scope

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad program and functional leadership responsibility. The role does not have direct reports or formal personnel-management authority. Leadership comes through ownership, judgment, cross-functional influence, and the ability to turn complex questions into decisions and action. The scope of the role will evolve as business priorities and the service portfolio change.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
• Typically 10+ years of related experience in strategy, service innovation, customer experience, consulting, incubation, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• A track record of owning complex work that crosses teams, functions, or business areas and turning it into tangible decisions and outcomes.
• Experience developing strategic recommendations, business cases, experiments or pilots, roadmaps, and plans for bringing ideas to life.
• Experience advising senior leaders and driving work forward when the answer, ownership, or path isn’t obvious.
• Strong strategic problem solving, synthesis, executive communication, facilitation, and stakeholder influence.
• Advanced analytical skills; comfort working with both qualitative and quantitative evidence and turning analysis into business decisions.

Experience That Could Set You Apart

• Experience in protection plans, insurance, repair, warranty, subscription services, or another complex service ecosystem.
• Experience with customer research, journey discovery, competitive benchmarking, opportunity sizing, or value-proposition development.
• Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to move ideas from discovery into experimentation, MVPs, or roadmap decisions.
• Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Python can be helpful, but aren’t required.

At SquareTrade you'll have access to:

• Medical, dental and vision coverage with network optionality and the ability to contribute to a savings account (HSA or FSA)
• Up to 4% company match into 401(k) and contributions into your company-sponsored pension

jobs.title: Manager, Healthcare Analytics
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

This role is a unique opportunity to lead the insights that show what Twin’s program delivers. You won’t just run models; you’ll own rigorous, high-stakes claims analyses and turn them into findings that executives, partners, and clinical stakeholders can act on.

As Manager, Healthcare Analytics, you’ll work at the intersection of causal inference, messy real-world claims data, and client-facing communication. You’ll own analyses from end to end, from raw claims extraction through methodology to a polished, decision-ready narrative. You’ll also lead and develop a team of analysts. Your focus is insights: program evaluation, cost and outcome trends, and evidence that informs partners and Twin’s own decisions. Performance guarantee design, measurement, and settlement are owned by Twin’s actuarial team, and you’ll partner closely with them so that insights and guarantee results tell a consistent story. This is a highly visible role, working closely with sales, client success, actuarial, and data teams.

Responsibilities

• Lead rigorous claims analyses of medical and pharmacy data to evaluate program impact, cost trends, and clinical outcomes, applying causal inference methods suited to observational data, including difference-in-differences, propensity score matching and weighting, instrumental variables, and regression discontinuity.

• Stress-test every finding with sensitivity and robustness checks, including placebo tests, pre-trend analysis, negative controls, and specification-curve analyses, so you know the defensible range of a result before it is shared externally.

• Tailor results to the audience, from board-level summaries for executives to detailed methodology appendices for sophisticated partners and plain-language explanations for non-technical stakeholders.

• Partner with client-facing teams to scope analyses, set clear expectations about what the data can and can’t support, and translate findings into practical implications for operations and program design.

• Defend insights and evaluation methodology under scrutiny from partner analytics teams, benefits consultants, and third-party auditors.

• Align internal stakeholders across sales, client success, and data teams, agreeing on what an analysis can support before it is promised externally and keeping methodology and data decisions consistent across teams.

• Contribute to the evidence base through peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations, bringing academic rigor to applied, commercial analyses.

• Build reusable analytical frameworks so that recurring analyses, such as total cost of care studies, adherence analyses, and outcomes evaluations, can be reproduced and audited.

• Make AI a core part of the workflow by using tools such as Claude and Claude Code to draft and review analysis code, accelerate data cleaning and QA, and speed up documentation and reporting. You’ll coach analysts to do the same and help set team norms for where AI speeds work up and where it needs a human check.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• Background: 5+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, health economics, biostatistics, or a related applied research role, including people management or project leadership.

• Causal Inference Expertise: Strong grounding in difference-in-differences, matching and weighting, instrumental variables, and regression discontinuity, with the judgment to know when each is and isn’t appropriate for observational claims data.

• Claims Data Expertise: Hands-on experience with medical and pharmacy claims, including coding systems (ICD-10, CPT, NDC), adjudication quirks, enrollment and eligibility logic, and the data-cleaning judgment calls that come with them.

• Methodological Rigor: A track record of peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or comparable evidence of work that has withstood external scrutiny.

• Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in SQL and R or Python. Experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake is a plus.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills, including presenting directly to clients and executives and defending methodology under pushback. You can tailor one analysis for different audiences without distorting the findings.

• AI Fluency: Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code to work faster, paired with the judgment to know when a task needs full human diligence, such as anything going to a client, a regulator, or a published methodology.

• Passion: Twin’s purpose to transform lives by empowering people to reverse, prevent and improve chronic metabolic diseases excites you.

Preferred

• Value-based care: Experience with value-based care, chronic disease management, or employer and payer program evaluation.

• Healthcare economics: Familiarity with total cost of care analyses, PMPM and PMPY metrics, and healthcare economics broadly.

• Reproducible pipelines: Experience building reproducible analytics workflows with dbt and version-controlled R or Python projects.

• Contract structures: Familiarity with value-based and outcomes-based contract structures, such as shared savings and risk-based arrangements, and how they shape the questions partners ask of their data.

• This hybrid opportunity based out of our New York office. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $140,000 - $155,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

• A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies

• A remote and accomplished global team

• Opportunity for equity participation

• 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents

• 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options

• 401k retirement savings plan

You will own the strategy, roadmap, and performance of the platform powering registration and titling, taxes and fees, financing, identity verification, fraud prevention, insurance verification, trade-ins, document generation, and secure document storage. Working closely with consumer product, engineering, operations, finance, legal, compliance, and customer experience teams, you will establish priorities, resolve complex cross-functional challenges, and deliver the technology and operational capabilities behind Scout’s direct-to-consumer transaction experience.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Lead the Vehicle Transaction Product Team

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of specialized technical product managers.

• Establish clear ownership, priorities, objectives, and measurable outcomes across the team.

• Empower product managers to lead their domains while holding the team accountable for end-to-end customer and business outcomes.

• Establish effective planning, prioritization, and decision-making practices.

• Assess organizational capacity and build the product capabilities needed as Scout grows.

Define Vehicle Transaction Strategy

• Own the vision, strategy, operating model, and roadmap for Scout’s Vehicle Transaction Platform.

• Translate business objectives into measurable customer, operational, and platform outcomes.

• Prioritize investments across transaction domains, balancing near-term business needs with long-term scalability.

• Guide the platform’s evolution as Scout expands its products, markets, and transaction capabilities.

• Communicate strategy, priorities, trade-offs, risks, and investment needs to senior leadership.

Own the End-to-End Transaction Platform

• Oversee product capabilities spanning registration and titling, taxes and fees, financing and credit, identity verification, fraud prevention, insurance verification, trade-ins, document management.

• Ensure these capabilities operate as a cohesive customer and operational journey.

• Partner with engineering leadership on platform architecture, system boundaries, integrations, data flows, and technical investments.

• Lead product strategy for third-party transaction partners and integrations, including APIs, data contracts, service expectations, and exception handling.

• Evaluate build, buy, and partner decisions based on customer value, operational impact, cost, risk, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is scalable, secure, compliant, resilient, observable, and auditable.

Drive Execution and Business Outcomes

• Partner across consumer product, engineering, operations, finance, legal, compliance, customer support, vehicle delivery, and customer experience.

• Align stakeholders on priorities, ownership, dependencies, and execution plans.

• Navigate complex cross-functional decisions and resolve competing business and technical priorities.

• Establish and monitor KPIs such as transaction completion, checkout conversion, financing approvals, registration completion, fraud detection effectiveness, operational efficiency, and exception resolution.

• Use customer insights, operational feedback, and platform data to continuously improve outcomes.

• Provide leadership with clear visibility into product performance, delivery progress, dependencies, capacity, and material risks.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role requires 3 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Subject to change.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

Product and People Leadership

• 10+ years of relevant experience, including demonstrated experience leading and developing product managers responsible for complex technical products or platforms.

• Experience setting team objectives, delegating ownership, managing performance, and developing product talent.

• Proven ability to establish direction and operating structure when problems or requirements are not clearly defined.

• Ability to balance people leadership, product strategy, portfolio management, and execution accountability.

Domain and Platform Experience

• Experience leading products across multiple transaction, commerce, or regulated domains, such as financing, identity and fraud, taxes and fees, registration and titling, trade-ins, or document management.

• Experience managing dependencies across customer experiences, enterprise systems, operational workflows, and external partners.

• Strong technical fluency across APIs, system architecture, workflow orchestration, event-driven systems, data models, and enterprise integrations.

• Ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders on technical trade-offs, architecture, sequencing, and platform investments.

Leadership Skills

Education

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Pay Transparency

organizing, and monitoring the receiving, storage, order fulfillment, and shipping functions to ensure a smooth and

consistent operation. The DC Supervisor provides support to employees and, at the discretion of DC leadership,

other departments as necessary.

What Will You Be Doing?

and job knowledge.
