jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________




ABOUT THE ROLE

Docker's Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team embeds senior engineers inside our most strategic customers to solve their hardest deployment, integration, and adoption problems. FDEs then bring what they learn back to Docker Product and Engineering so that every customer benefits.



As the Principal Technical Program Manager for FDE, you define what good looks like for the organization and run the business that delivers it. You define the standards for how FDE plans, commits, delivers, and measures quality. You own the operating rhythm, track commitments Docker has made to customers, the commitments Docker Engineering has made to FDE, and the timelines and resourcing behind them.



This is a senior role that works with stakeholders across the business to drive outcomes for Dockers most important customers. FDE is where Docker proves it can deliver for the customers that matter most while the technology around us changes quickly. You will set the standard for how a small team of senior engineers earns and keeps the trust of customers, and you will make what they learn useful to the whole company. The practices you establish will become the model for how Docker engages with its largest, most complex customers.



_______________________________________________________________________




RESPONSIBILITIES


DEFINE WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

 - Define the FDE delivery standards, engagement model, and quality bar, and write them down so engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and engineers.

 - Decide which metrics matter for FDE, set targets, and revise them as the team learns.

 - Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable practice and product improvements.


RUN THE FDE BUSINESS

 - Give executives a clear account of what is on track, what is at risk, what decision is needed, and from whom.

 - Own FDE capacity management and staffing plans with FDE leadership and recruiting: which engineers are aligned to which customers, where the gaps are, where and when to hire to stay ahead of demand.


OWN CUSTOMER AND ENGINEERING COMMITMENTS

 - Instrument every commitment Docker has made to FDE customers, and every commitment Docker Product and Engineering teams have made to FDE.

 - Track commitments, map dependencies across teams, and surface risks early enough to act on them.

 - Negotiate and confirm dates with teams that run on their own planning processes, and hold them to those dates.


INFLUENCE ACROSS DOCKER

 - Represent FDE with Product and Engineering leadership. Make sure customer needs are well defined using data, and that product decisions map to achievable FDEs action.

 - Improve the internal processes that slow collaboration between Field, Product, and Engineering, and bring those improvements to the wider company when they work.

 - Present FDE results and risks to Docker executives and customer stakeholders.


LEAD THE PROGRAM PRACTICE

 - Set priorities for junior TPMs, define the reporting FDE needs, and mentor them in program management practice.

 - Choose the tools and standards FDE uses to track work.

_______________________________________________________________________




QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - 10+ years of technical program management experience, including 4+ years at Staff level or above, supporting customer-facing engineering, professional services, or field engineering teams.

 - A track record of delivering commitments on schedule for enterprise customers, including contractual or executive-visible deadlines.

 - Experience defining standards, quality bars, and operating processes that other teams adopted.

 - Experience running dependencies across many engineering teams that you do not manage, and getting reliable dates from them through influence.

 - Strong technical background in cloud platforms, containers, and modern software delivery. You can read a design, challenge an estimate, and tell a real blocker from a vague one.

 - Experience choosing metrics and setting targets, including working with incomplete data and deciding what is good enough to act on.

 - Executive communication skills, with the ability to deliver difficult news early and clearly to customer stakeholders, Docker leaders, and engineers.

 - High agency and comfort working autonomously in a distributed, remote-first company where processes are still being defined.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Occasional travel to customer sites and to Docker team gatherings.


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience supporting a Forward Deployed Engineering, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, or Customer Engineering organization.

 - Familiarity with the agentic AI ecosystem, including coding agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and enterprise requirements for security and governance of AI workloads.

 - Experience with regulated or compliance-driven customers in financial services, healthcare, government, or similar sectors.

 - Experience at a developer tools, infrastructure software, or platform company.

 - Familiarity with Docker products, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development platforms.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - FDE has written delivery standards, a quality bar, and KPI targets that FDEs, Field, Product, and Engineering all know and use.

 - Every customer commitment and every Docker engineering commitment to FDE has an owner and a date, and strategic customer deadlines are met.

 - FDE operating reviews run weekly, produce decisions, and close their actions.

 - FDE capacity, hiring, and customer alignment are planned ahead of demand.



Visa sponsorship: Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

_______________________________________________________________________

 


COMPENSATION & EQUITY

All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

 

United States: $162,505 - $254,650 base

______________________________________________________________________




POSTING INFORMATION

 - Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

 - AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

 - Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________




PERKS & BENEFITS

jobs.title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer, Data Center Equipment
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI and its capital and technology partners are building a global network of data centers for demanding AI workloads. The Infrastructure Quality team sets and verifies quality, reliability, and performance requirements for equipment across that network.

We work with manufacturing partners, general contractors, engineers, and operations staff from supplier qualification through commissioning. Together, we verify that equipment arrives ready for installation, startup, and long-term service.

About the Role

As a Manufacturing Quality Engineer, you will oversee the quality of data center equipment at supplier factories. You will use production data, audits, and test results to identify systemic, recurring, or safety-related issues and work with suppliers to address them through Closed Loop Learning (CLL).

You will work with suppliers and internal teams to define inspections and factory tests for each type of equipment. You will coordinate issue resolution before shipment and manage deviations across multiple suppliers and project sites.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Monitoring and Supplier Improvement

 - Manufacturing monitoring: Work with Manufacturing Operations to monitor production progress, quality controls, inspection results, and test readiness. Flag emerging risks and coordinate a response with suppliers.

 - Product and process audits: Audit products and processes during and after production against engineering requirements, critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristics, approved procedures, and quality standards. Document findings and track corrective actions to closure.

 - Manufacturing coordination: Agree on production checkpoints and inspection and testing requirements with suppliers, engineering, sourcing, supply chain, commissioning, and quality teams. Escalate risks to equipment acceptance or delivery.

 - Manufacturing scorecards: Develop supplier and product scorecards with Manufacturing Operations. Review audit findings, test results, recurring defects, and open issues with suppliers to prioritize improvements.

 - Drive continuous improvement: Lead the CLL process with suppliers. Track root cause analyses and corrective and preventive actions in a shared register. Verify that each action addresses the underlying problem before closing it.

Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)

 - Standardize requirements and formats: Develop product-specific FAT requirements and standard test formats with equipment suppliers and OpenAI’s engineering, commissioning, quality, and Manufacturing Operations teams.

 - Define critical quality requirements: Document the CTQ characteristics each test must verify in an OpenAI-accepted format. Use CLL findings to revise FAT procedures so future tests check for known failure modes.

 - Ensure auditable supplier records: Require suppliers to retain test results and make them available for OpenAI audits.

 - Manage documentation and revision control: Review final FAT records and audit reports for each piece of equipment and maintain a controlled revision history.

 - Conduct periodic supplier audits: Check that suppliers follow approved test procedures and that their records accurately reflect the tests performed.

Factory Witness Testing (FWT)

 - Align checklists and stakeholders: Develop standard FWT checklists with OpenAI subject matter experts, installing contractors, and the construction management team. Agree on requirements before testing begins.

 - Manage documentation and reporting: Collect and review final witness test reports and supporting records from participants.

 - Before shipment, confirm that each witness-test issue is resolved or covered by a documented deviation. Log systemic, recurring, or safety-related findings in the CLL tracker and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions with the supplier.

Deviation Management

 - Assess short shipments and missing or failed tests in partnership with Manufacturing Operations.

 - Coordinate supplier support to resolve issues at the project site.

 - Document each deviation and track the agreed actions through closure.

Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, or industrial engineering.

 - At least 10 years of data center industry experience spanning quality engineering and project management.

 - Experience coordinating FAT and FWT with suppliers and resolving equipment quality issues.

 - Ability to develop test checklists, define CTQs, review test results, and maintain auditable quality records.

 - Experience monitoring supplier production, auditing products and processes during and after production, and using scorecards to improve supplier and product quality. Experience managing controlled documents and deviations.

 - Ability to coordinate supplier schedules and plan inspections and tests across multiple pieces of equipment.

 - Ability to communicate quality requirements and coordinate decisions across suppliers, engineering, commissioning, sourcing, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, quality, and construction teams.

 - Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60% of the time to supplier manufacturing facilities and data center project sites.

Preferred Skills

 - Technical knowledge of data center infrastructure, including mechanical, electrical, and controls systems.

 - Experience in supplier performance management for mission-critical facilities.

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Quality Manager, or Quality Auditor.

 - PMP or equivalent project management certification.

 - Experience in industrial or high-volume manufacturing environments.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Technical Consulting is Ramp's post-sales technical delivery team. When a finance org needs Ramp to work the way their business actually runs, this is the team that takes customers through that transformation, from complex accounting issues to integration errors to everything in between.

The Senior Manager, Technical Consulting, Strategic leads the team responsible for Ramp's largest and most strategic accounts. You'll own post-sales technical implementation for this segment end to end — from technical discovery and solution design through go-live, adoption, and expansion — working shoulder-to-shoulder with our Customer Activation team, with whom you'll co-own activation milestones and time-to-value.

Strategic customers arrive with multi-entity structures, legacy ERPs, in-flight finance transformations, procurement and treasury requirements, and executive sponsors who expect a named technical leader in the room. Your team is the last line of technical escalation for these accounts — there is no tier above you.

This role suits an experienced leader who can hold two things at once: the operating rigor to run a delivery function at scale, and the technical credibility to sit across from a Controller or VP of Finance and design the solution live.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and grow the Strategic Technical Consulting team — coach senior and principal-level consultants, own hiring, onboarding, performance, and career architecture, and build a bench deep enough to scale with the segment

 - Own post-sales technical implementation for Ramp's largest accounts — accountable for solution quality, delivery timelines, and technical outcomes across the portfolio

 - Co-own activation milestones with Customer Activation — build a joint operating model where TC drives technical design and Activation drives adoption and enablement, with shared accountability for time-to-value and a single, coherent customer experience

 - Serve as the terminal escalation point for complex technical and delivery challenges — ERP integration failures, custom API work, at-risk go-lives, and commitments made pre-sales that need to be re-scoped

 - Define the Strategic delivery model — scoping standards, solution design review, rules of engagement with CSM/Activation, staffing and capacity models, and quality bars that hold up under enterprise scrutiny

 - Run the function with operational rigor — forecast capacity, balance workload across accounts, instrument the team with KPIs (time-to-value, go-live on-time rate, escalation volume, adoption and expansion attach), and use the data in coaching and planning

 - Partner cross-functionally at the leadership level — Customer Activation, Strategic CSM and AM, Sales, Product, Engineering, and GTM Ops — to align on roadmap, feedback loops, and segment strategy

 - Turn field insight into product influence — synthesize what Strategic customers actually need, champion it with Product and Engineering, and close the loop back to the field

 - Set precedent where none exists — make sound calls in ambiguous, high-stakes situations, document the reasoning, and teach the team to do the same




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 5+ years in technical consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, or professional services — with substantial time on enterprise or strategic accounts

 - 2-3+ years managing individual contributors and owning team-level outcomes; experience managing senior or principal-level ICs strongly preferred

 - Proven track record owning post-sales implementation for large, complex customers — multi-entity, multi-system, executive-sponsored engagements

 - Deep fluency in ERP and financial systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Oracle, Workday Financials, Microsoft Dynamics), APIs, SSO/HRIS integrations, and core accounting workflows (chart of accounts, subsidiaries, approval hierarchies, month-end close)

 - Ability to assess and guide technical solution design at enterprise complexity — and to tell the difference between a configuration problem, a product gap, and a customer process problem

 - Experience building the operating model between two functions — e.g. delivery and onboarding, or services and customer success — and making shared accountability actually work

 - Executive-grade communication — able to hold the room with a CFO or Controller, advocate for your team internally, and translate technical trade-offs into business consequences

 - Demonstrated judgment in ambiguity and a bias toward ownership in a fast-changing, high-growth environment




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at an ERP or financial systems vendor (Workday, NetSuite/Oracle, Sage Intacct, Coupa) or in a Big 4 / systems integrator implementation practice

 - Background in fintech, spend management, or AP automation

 - Experience standing up or scaling a technical consulting / professional services function from an early stage

Cranial Technologies is the only company in the world completely dedicated to researching and treating plagiocephaly (commonly called flat head syndrome). With over 500,000 babies successfully treated, we are the plagiocephaly experts and the leader in pediatric cranial shaping orthoses.

Cranial Technologies also provides treatment with EarWell® to correct infant ear shapes without surgery. With over 600,000+ successful outcomes, EarWell® is a proven, non-invasive treatment option for families.

We are currently looking for a full-time Clinician to Western Pennsylvania. This position will be a split role between our Johnstown and Pittsburgh clinics.

This position is in a pediatric clinical outpatient setting, working exclusively with infants. If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to specialize in a non-traditional, niche area, Cranial Technologies may be the place for you. This is a unique opportunity to treat patients in a child-friendly, state-of-the-art clinic.

As a Clinician, you will treat infants to reshape head shapes with the DOC Band® and correct ear shapes with EarWell®. Pediatricians and parents alike look to our Clinicians as the experts in evaluation and in treatment of plagiocephaly as well as conditions involving misshapen ears. Our treating Clinicians develop great relationships with our families at every stage of their treatment process.

We hire from various backgrounds because each background is a great fit in its own way.

• PTs and OTs are an excellent fit with their background knowledge of symmetry and asymmetry, cervical anatomy, torticollis, and infant/toddler development.

• Registered Nurses are a great fit with their experience in hands-on patient care and compassion for families as well as their capability to treat the whole patient.

• Certified Prosthetist-Orthotists & Certified Orthotists are also a strong fit because of their hands-on experience with orthotics and direct patient care.

A background in pediatrics is preferred, but not necessary as we have a formal training program that includes mentoring.

What we have to offer:

• You will see visible, measurable changes in two to three weeks

• Traditional workweek schedule with no nights and minimal to no weekend work

• We value our employees and invest in their training and mentorship

• Direct patient care with minimal paperwork

• No productivity/patient quotas

• Cranial Technologies is a nationwide company with future opportunities available in training, mentoring, and travel

Qualifications:

• Licensed PT

• 500 hours of basic orthotic fitting experience with off-the-shelf orthotic devices (e.g. splints, braces, maternity belts) *If you are unsure if you meet this requirement, please apply and we can discuss this with you further*

Benefits Package for Cranial Technologies:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 401k Retirement Plan with matching

• 3.5 Weeks Paid Time Off plus 7 company-paid Holidays

• Life Insurance

• Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

• Clinician Continuing Education Benefit & Licensure Renewal Fees Reimbursed

• This position is also eligible for quarterly performance bonuses and annual raises.

• Many internal growth and promotional track opportunities available.

jobs.title: Brand & Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Piston

Piston (PistonPay) is a payments company, starting by changing how trucking fleets pay for fuel. We run a cardless, closed-loop payments network that connects fleets directly with fuel retailers. Fleets get a more secure alternative to legacy fuel cards plus access to fuel discounts, and fuel merchants get more predictable sales.

We were founded by logistics industry veterans and are a Series A company. In September 2026 we raised a $15M Series A led by FPV Ventures, with Spark Capital and Pear VC participating, the same firms that backed companies like Anthropic, Dropbox, DoorDash and Canva. Piston is accepted at more than 2,000 fuel stations across 48 states, and our point-of-sale integrations reach systems that cover more than 95% of U.S. merchant fuel sites.

We're building the financial backbone for the trucks and fleets that move the economy, and we're just getting started.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Brand & Product Designer to build and scale Piston's visual identity across every marketing channel, and to carry that brand into the product our customers use every day. This is a full-time, mid-level individual contributor role on our Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Marketing and based in our Cupertino, California office five days a week.

About 80% of your time will go to brand and marketing design: brand identity, campaign creative, the marketing website, design systems and performance-driven creative testing. About 20% will go to product UI/UX design, working with Product and Engineering on the screens and flows that fleet operators, drivers and fuel merchants use.

You will work directly with the Head of Marketing to develop a distinctive, scalable brand, create high-impact marketing assets, and keep improving creative performance through testing and experimentation. You will also partner with Product so that the brand, the website and the product feel like one experience.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Identity & Visual Design

• Drive the development and evolution of the brand's visual identity, working closely with the Head of Marketing.

• Design and refine logos, typography, color palettes, iconography, imagery and graphic elements.

• Translate brand strategy and creative direction into a cohesive visual language.

• Develop visual concepts that communicate trust, innovation and differentiation.

• Build a flexible identity that scales across audiences, channels, the product and future markets.

• Create and maintain comprehensive brand guidelines.

• Ensure visual consistency across all customer-facing materials, in marketing and in the product.

2. Creative Strategy & Execution

• Own creative design across paid media, organic social, email, landing pages, presentations, events and marketing campaigns.

• Develop compelling visual concepts and campaign creative.

• Translate messaging and value propositions into effective visual communication.

• Design creative variations for different audiences, channels and campaign objectives.

• Establish creative standards that balance quality, consistency and performance.

• Manage creative projects from initial concept through final production.

• Collaborate with Marketing on creative direction, campaign execution and optimization.

3. Creative Testing & Optimization

• Develop and run structured creative testing programs.

• Design A/B test variations across imagery, messaging presentation, layouts, calls to action and creative concepts.

• Partner with Marketing to analyze campaign performance and conversion data.

• Identify creative elements that improve engagement and conversion rates.

• Apply quantitative and qualitative insights to design decisions.

• Document experiment results and build learnings into future creative.

• Keep improving creative effectiveness while maintaining brand consistency.

4. Website Design & CRO

• Support the visual design and ongoing optimization of the marketing website.

• Design landing pages, page layouts, visual components and conversion-focused assets.

• Apply CRO principles to improve engagement and conversion.

• Create and test variations of page layouts, visual hierarchy, imagery and calls to action.

• Review heatmaps, session recordings and analytics to find design improvements.

• Work with web developers and external agencies to implement designs.

• Ensure responsive, accessible and consistent digital design.

5. Product UI/UX Design (about 20% of your time)

• Partner with Product and Engineering to design user flows, wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI for Piston's apps and web dashboards.

• Design onboarding, sign-up and activation flows that connect the marketing site to the product.

• Bring the brand into the product through visual design, UI components, icons, illustration and in-product moments.

• Contribute to a shared design system that serves both marketing and product, so the brand and the product look and feel like one company.

• Run lightweight usability testing with fleet operators, drivers and fuel merchants, and turn findings into design improvements.

• Hand off clean, well-documented designs and specs to engineers, and review what ships for quality and consistency.

6. Design Systems & Creative Operations

• Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable component libraries for brand, web and product.

• Develop templates for presentations, social media, campaigns, advertising and other materials.

• Establish organized asset libraries, naming conventions and design documentation.

• Create efficient workflows for creative production, iteration and approvals.

• Explore AI-powered creative tools to speed up ideation, production and testing.

• Ensure all creative follows established brand standards.

• Help establish the design function's processes and best practices as the team grows.

7. Research & Visual Exploration

• Research competitive brand identities, product experiences, visual trends and emerging creative approaches.

• Develop mood boards, creative territories and visual explorations.

• Take part in customer feedback sessions to evaluate design effectiveness.

• Test visual concepts and product flows with target audiences.

• Translate research and performance insights into stronger design.

• Proactively find ways to improve brand recognition, differentiation and design quality.

8. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner directly with the Head of Marketing on brand development and creative priorities.

• Collaborate with Marketing on campaign design, experimentation and optimization.

• Work with Product and Engineering on product UI/UX priorities, sharing ownership of the user experience with the product team.

• Work with website agencies and developers to maintain visual quality and consistency.

• Present creative concepts, design rationale and testing results to leadership.

• Manage multiple design initiatives independently and meet deadlines.

What We're Looking For

Experience

• Professional experience in brand, graphic, visual or creative design.

• Professional experience designing UI/UX for web or mobile products, shown in your portfolio alongside brand work.

• Experience contributing to the development or evolution of a brand identity.

• Strong portfolio showing visual identity systems, creative campaigns, digital marketing design and at least one shipped product experience.

• Experience building scalable brand guidelines and reusable design systems.

• Experience designing and optimizing digital marketing assets.

• Familiarity with creative experimentation, A/B testing and CRO.

• Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, payments, B2B SaaS or consumer brands preferred.

• Ability to independently manage design projects from concept to execution.

Design & Technical Skills

• Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout and prototyping, and in Adobe Creative Cloud, especially Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign.

• Solid grasp of UX fundamentals: information architecture, user flows, interaction design and usability.

• Strong understanding of typography, color theory, composition, layout and visual hierarchy.

• Solid skills in logo development, visual identity and brand systems.

• Strong understanding of responsive web design, mobile UI patterns and accessibility.

• Experience designing marketing websites, landing pages and digital advertising.

• Familiarity with Webflow and working alongside web and product engineers.

• Experience with motion graphics, animation or video editing is a plus.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted design and creative production tools.

Analytical & Creative Optimization Skills

• Understanding of A/B testing and creative experimentation methods.

• Ability to interpret campaign performance, engagement, conversion and product usage data.

• Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar or similar tools.

• Experience designing creative variations and evaluating their effectiveness.

• Ability to connect design decisions with measurable business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of visual communication and customer psychology.

Collaboration & Ownership

• Strong creative judgment and attention to detail.

• Ability to explain and defend design decisions.

• Comfortable building creative processes and systems from scratch.

• Self-directed, organized and able to manage multiple priorities across Marketing and Product.

• Open to feedback, experimentation and iterative improvement.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to balance creative ambition with speed and execution.

• Excited to work in person with the team, five days a week.

Why This Role Matters

This is a chance to build a brand from the ground up and own its visual evolution as Piston scales.

You will shape how Piston looks, feels and communicates across every marketing channel and in the product itself, while building the creative systems and experimentation practices that drive long-term growth.

We are looking for a designer who combines exceptional craft with analytical thinking, ownership and a desire to build something lasting.

What We Offer

• Base salary of $130,000 to $155,000, depending on experience

• Early-stage equity

• Medical insurance

• All the hardware and software you need to do your best work

jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Implementation Manager for Employer Customer Success, you’ll be the first touchpoint after the sale, reporting to the Director of Customer Success. You’ll help build a scalable onboarding function that delights our enterprise & strategic customers in their first 60-90 days with Handshake. Your focus is building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and aligning employers on their goals, so every partner launches with a clear plan and a path to success.

 - Launch enterprise & strategic employers through kick-off calls, product set-up, & implementation checklists that drive adoption in the first 60-90 days

 - Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders to translate business goals into clear success metrics & implementation plans

 - Train & coach employer partners on early talent best practices & workflows to accelerate time to value

 - Use data to refine implementation strategies & build SOPs that scale onboarding across the team

 


DESIRED CAPABILITIES 

 - 5+ years in a customer-facing role with project management experience (customer success, customer education, onboarding, or implementation)

 - Excellent executive-level communication skills, written & verbal, with customers & internal stakeholders

 - Proven track record of building relationships & trust quickly with senior stakeholders

 - Strong project & time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple implementations at once

 - Data-informed approach, with the ability to communicate outcomes in a compelling & tangible way

 - Flexible, creative problem solver who is scrappy, curious, & finds another way when one door closes

 - A good listener who works well across multiple teams & departments

 - Bias for action, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves regardless of title

 


EXTRA CREDIT

 - Prior implementation & project management experience

 - Experience creating & rolling out new processes

 


PERKS

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported—and thrive at work and in life.

The below benefits are for full-time US employees.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, wellness stipend

📚 Growth: Learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days

🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers http://joinhandshake.com/careers.

jobs.title: Marketing Product Coordinator
jobs.description:
About us: Stanley 1913 - Built for Life® since 1913.

The Stanley 1913 brand has fueled the human experience since the iconic Stanley vacuum bottle revolutionized the way people enjoyed food and beverage. Today, our colorful and thoughtfully designed products including the popular Quencher™ series go beyond function, elevating everyday moments with style and empowering active lifestyles. We’re a community of creators, builders, and inventors who believe in creating sustainable products for a better life and world that minimizes our impact on the planet. Learn more at www.stanley1913.com.

Position Overview

The Marketing Product Coordinator is responsible for managing the ordering, tracking, and organization of product samples to support cross-functional teams. This role focuses on coordinating sample requests with factories, overseeing shipment logistics, and maintaining an accurate, well-organized in-office inventory. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and enjoys working in a fast-paced, operational environment.

This role is based onsite at our Seattle office.

What You'll Do

• Manage end-to-end sample logistics, including placing orders with factories and warehouses, tracking shipments, and resolving delays or discrepancies

• Coordinate with shipping partners and internal teams to align on timelines, delivery expectations, and priorities

• Maintain an organized in-office inventory, including logging incoming samples and quantities

• Fulfill internal sample requests and partner with cross-functional teams to forecast needs

• Communicate risks, constraints, and timelines clearly to stakeholders

• Continuously improve processes for sample ordering, tracking, and inventory management to drive efficiency and visibility

Who You Are

• 1–3 years of experience in operations, logistics, or inventory management

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

• Experience with tracking systems or spreadsheets (e.g., Excel, Asana)

• Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

• Ability to work on-site and handle physical inventory (lifting, organizing, moving boxes as needed)

Stanley 1913 is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. Stanley 1913 is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please reach out to recruiting@stanley1913.com.

Stanley 1913 is a total rewards company, which includes rewards beyond base salary. At Stanley 1913, full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus, based on company and individual results. In addition, we offer a variety of employee benefits, personalized time off, 14-Paid holidays, dental, vision, 401(k), and much more.

The base pay range for this position is for a successful candidate within the state listed. The successful candidate’s actual pay will be based on multiple factors such as work location, job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Salary Range

$80,000—$90,000 USD

jobs.description:
About Hone

Hone is an online medical clinic at the forefront of transforming healthcare and enhancing longevity. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values:

• Fight for the Customer

• Execute Ruthlessly

• Communicate Candidly, Clearly, and Kindly

• Collaborate Selflessly

• Practice Calculated Risk-Taking

• Maximize Joy and Gratitude

Hone has been fully virtual from day one and will continue to be a remote-first employer.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives.

The Role

Hone is looking for a Pharmacy Operations Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will report to the VP of Pharmacy and Lab Operations and support our team by acting as a subject matter expert throughout the medication fulfillment process.

Primary Responsibilities

Key responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to) the following:

• Process new and refill prescription medications accurately and efficiently using e-Prescribing software and other internal tools

• Work closely with other internal and vendor partners to ensure proper and timely shipment of medication by reviewing and resolving any gating tasks

• Attentively complete data entry including prescription authoring, lab order generation, and other internal tracking tasks

• Investigate issues with prescriptions and lab orders to identify and resolve any errors or incomplete items

• Own the relationship with our pharmacy partners, from launch of new medications through ongoing quality review and demand forecasting, so patients get their prescriptions on time and without interruption.

Qualifications

In order to qualify for this role, candidates must meet the following criteria:

• 2-3 years experience in a healthcare operations role, preferably but not required to be in pharmacy or lab operations at a telemedicine startup; in lieu of experience, highly motivated college graduates with applicable majors (e.g. pharmacy, chemistry, biology, etc.) are also encouraged to apply

• Experience with pharmacy and/or lab software applications and prescribing/ordering workflows is a major plus

• Awareness and appreciation of regulatory and legal requirements that must be understood and maintained in the telemedicine environment

• Technically savvy and able to learn new software applications quickly

• Patient-centric — you understand our patients and their needs and always prioritize patient safety and wellbeing

• Ability to communicate professionally with other healthcare providers and vendors

• Highly organized with a strong attention to detail

• Enjoys structure and routine processes in daily work

• Sound judgment to make appropriate decisions or escalate items outside your scope

• Analytically minded problem solver

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of autonomy

Compensation Range

$60,000-$75,000

Benefits*

Hone wants our team to be in the best condition of their lives, so we offer a range of benefits including:

• A remote-first work environment

• Competitive compensation and equity options

• Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage

• Short-term disability and basic life coverage

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs)

jobs.title: Territory Account Executive, Saskatchewan / Manitoba
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Remote from Canada in either British Columbia, Ontario or Quebec

About the Department

The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.  Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences.

What you'll do

You'll drive new business by identifying and qualifying target Commercial accounts for Cloudflare’s Enterprise service plan. This is a great opportunity for a Sales Professional to help build the business at Cloudflare Canada. You will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.

Responsibilities

• Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan

• Increase sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets

• Create and articulate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services

• Manage contract negotiations

• Maintain a robust sales pipeline

• Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts

• Ensure customer satisfaction

• Develop and maintain partner relationships as it relates to customer base

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• Minimum 3 years of direct technical sales experience

• Experience selling solutions related to Cyber Security, Networking, Cloud Solutions, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS is a plus

• Mid to advanced understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”

• Aptitude for learning complex technical concepts/terms (technical background in engineering, computer science, or IT strongly desired)

• Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills

• Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit

• Comfortable working in a fast paced, dynamic environment

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

You will plan, budget, schedule, and oversee preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance, while developing the standards, training programs, and best practices that help our team operate safely and in compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements.

This is a highly visible role for an experienced technician who enjoys hands-on troubleshooting, mentoring others, and driving continuous improvement across laboratory, pilot plant, and utility systems in a fast-paced biotech environment.

*This is a full-time, fully onsite role based in Emeryville, CA.

Responsibilities

Maintenance & Technical Execution

• Perform hands-on preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance, fault diagnosis, troubleshooting, calibration, and repair of Facilities’ mechanical, electrical, and infrastructure systems independently or with a team, requiring minimal supervision.

• Maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, and repair flow, pressure, temperature, and analytical instruments, as well as mechanical components including bearings, gearboxes, pumps, valves, and seals.

• Recommend and implement preventative and proactive maintenance methods to improve system reliability, reduce downtime, and extend asset life.

• Coordinate proactive monitoring of facility systems to ensure maximum operational efficiency, uptime, and compliance in high‑reliability environments.

Utilities Systems

• Operate, maintain, calibrate, and repair utilities systems to the component and instrument level, including:

• HVAC&R and environmental control systems

• Boilers and clean steam systems

• Air compressors and compressed gas systems

• Reverse Osmosis (RO) and Deionized (DI) water systems

• Chilled water systems

• Pumps, agitators, mechanical seals, piping, drainage, and waste equipment

Process & Pilot Plant Systems

• Maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, and repair process equipment including:

• 1000L, 300L, and 20L reactors and associated piping and instrumentation

• Centrifuges, TFF skids, and CIP skids

• Establish maintenance practices supporting safe, reliable operation of pilot plant and process systems at optimized life‑cycle costs.

Laboratory Systems

• Maintain, troubleshoot, calibrate, and repair laboratory equipment in collaboration with equipment owners and users.

• Determine best repair approach including in‑house repair, vendor support, spare part procurement, or equipment replacement.

Leadership, Supervision & Training

• Provide technical leadership, tasking, training, oversight, and mentorship to Facilities and Machine Shop personnel to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operations.

• Develop, implement, and maintain basic and advanced machine shop and mechanical training programs for facilities personnel.

• Select, develop, and evaluate personnel to ensure effective staffing, skill development, and efficient operation of the function.

• Lead and coordinate daily maintenance operations, work prioritization, and resource allocation.

Planning, Budgeting & Continuous Improvement

• Plan, budget, and schedule repairs, maintenance activities, system upgrades, and modifications for critical facilities systems.

• Provide relevant maintenance and asset data to support budget development, forecasting, and cost control.

• Develop and implement maintenance standards, procedures, and best practices to improve operational efficiency and reliability.

• Establish and sustain maintenance practices aligned with company standards and regulatory requirements.

Compliance, Safety & Reliability

• Ensure maintenance programs comply with internal standards and all applicable regulatory, safety, and environmental requirements.

• Monitor execution of facility policies, practices, and procedures to ensure compliance with organizational and governmental standards.

• Inspect new installations, repairs, and modifications performed by contractors to ensure quality, code compliance, and operational readiness.

• Maintain safe, clean, and orderly work areas; promote safe work behaviors and hazard awareness at all times.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Emergency Response & Vendor Coordination

• Coordinate and lead response to emergency situations or unplanned events that may impact operations, including after-hours call-ins as required.

• Establish and manage effective partnerships with external vendors and service providers to support maintenance activities and share best practices.

Documentation & Asset Management

• Ensure timely completion of work orders with accurate documentation in accordance with applicable standards.

• Update, generate, and maintain maintenance documentation, procedures, engineering records, service manuals, and asset data.

• Identify, anticipate, and manage acquisition of spare parts, safety equipment, tools, and test equipment to support reliable operations.

Basic Qualifications

• Minimum of a completed trade apprenticeship or technical school program, plus relevant on-the-job training.

• Proficiency in standards and practices for industrial mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation systems.

• 7+ years of experience in facilities operations and maintenance in the biotech/laboratory industry or a similar environment.

• Understanding of and experience with general safety and Lock Out/Tag Out (LOTO) standards.

• Proficiency reading drawings, sketches, and O.E.M. instructions and specifications for troubleshooting and repair.

• Experience using Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).

• Strong mechanical aptitude.

• Strong team player who can change direction quickly in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and proficiency with Word and Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

• Extensive experience safely operating tools and testing equipment and executing field work in compliance with applicable safety procedures and requirements.

• Extensive machine shop experience with equipment such as mills, lathes, grinders, drill presses, table saws, and welders.

• Demonstrated welding proficiency (MIG, TIG, and/or SMAW/stick).

Physical Requirements

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, push and pull equipment, kneel and bend to install equipment, crawl through low spaces, and climb ladders.

• Must be able to lift at least 50 lbs.

The salary range for this role is: $122,000 to $158,000.

jobs.title: Hospitality Concierge/Butler
jobs.description:
Currently Hiring Part-time

Salary Range: $21 - $23

Reports To:

The Butler reports directly to the Life Enrichment Director.

FLSA Classification:

This position is classified as non-exempt and is an hourly position.

Job Overview:

The primary responsibility of this position is to ensure residents' comfort during the admission process and throughout their transition to the community by providing the highest degree of personal attention and exceptional customer service. The Butler serves as a liaison between residents and all departments, ensuring each resident feels welcomed, supported, and well cared for. The Butler is also an active member of the Life Enrichment team, assisting with programs, outings, special events, and resident engagement while providing support with dining services, room service, and other community needs. Guided by an "Anything, Anytime" service philosophy, this role offers flexible, hands-on support wherever needed to create an exceptional resident experience.

Responsibilities and Duties:

• Meets with managers on a daily basis to discuss any new admissions, concerns, changes, etc.

• Reviews resident’s room prior to admission to ensure room is clean and in acceptable move-in condition.

• Contacts appropriate departments as needed, i.e. housekeeping, laundry, maintenance to address any resident needs or concerns.

• Greets and escorts new residents to their apartment, orient/escort resident around community; introduce team members; and orient to the building.

• Reviews concerns and needs of all residents daily. Follow up to ensure residents’ needs/requests are met.

• Performs “Quality Checks” to ensure residents enjoy their meals.

• Perform light duty maintenance when needed, such as changing light bulbs, checking cable boxes, etc.  • Reviews and organizes resident requests and plans responsibilities for the following day

• Acts as a liaison between residents and departments to meet the overall needs of residents.

• Guides residents through their adjustment period ensuring their new home  is comfortable making the move an enjoyable experience by promoting utilization of programs and services.

• Addresses any issues and/or difficulties as they arise. Seeks the guidance of Manager for any assistance required.

• Maintains an open and ongoing dialogue/relationship with residents, families and other team members. Assures successful communication with team members for vital and rewarding guest experience.

• Ensures all follow up issues are addressed from the resident to the appropriate team member.

• Review menus and collect choices for all meals for the following day for Room Service program.

• Collect and deliver room service selections from culinary department to resident rooms as requested.  • Collects orders for Dining Room for lunch and dinner; picks up food orders from Culinary, serve in dining room and breaks down dining room post meal.

• Manage magazine subscriptions and/or distribute daily newspapers as needed. • Coordinates daily cocktail hour with culinary team and serves prior to dinner.

• Call residents daily to ensure all culinary needs are met.

• Assist with touring community during marketing tours. • Coordinate trips with Life Enrichment department and will be responsible for some driving duties .

• Distribute Life Enrichment Newsletter and Calendar of Events to rooms and review . • Review common areas for housekeeping needs and complete as needed.

• Ensure all pantries, common areas, hallways, living rooms, dining rooms are tidy, clean and organized at all times.

• Works with hostess and communicates daily regarding the memory care neighborhood operations and resident needs.

• Is knowledgeable of resident rights and ensures an atmosphere which allows for the privacy, dignity and well-being of all residents in a safe, secure environment.

• Completes requirements for in-service training, acceptable attendance, uniform and dress codes including personal hygiene, and other work duties as assigned.

• Other duties as directed by supervisor.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or GED equivalent required.

• Valid driver’s license is required.

• Minimum of two years’ experience in health care, hospitality, customer service, resident care, social work, recreation or human service field preferred.

•  Must have a genuine interest in working with older adults. Physical Abilities

• While performing the duties of this job, the associate is often required to stand, walk, sit, use fine and gross motor skills, reach with hands and arms, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, talk, hear, and smell.

• An individual in this position will be required to lift or carry weight up to 50 lbs. The associate must use proper body mechanics.

• Flexible Schedule
• On the job training
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
• Free Parking

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor, Manufacturing (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Ingram Content Group (ICG) is hiring an Operations Supervisor to support our Manufacturing team in Chambersburg, PA.  The Operations Supervisor oversees the day-to-day operation of assigned shift(s) and/or department(s) within a production, manufacturing, or distribution/warehouse environment, ensuring associates comply with company policies and procedures. Ensures TAT (turnaround time) targets, throughput, and quality standards are observed and met, while efficiently allocating resources, instructing associates, and monitoring shift and individual performance.

Want to join a key team that helps the world read?

At Ingram, the Operations team serves a key role within the organization.  We ensure that our distribution centers and manufacturing facilities function at maximum efficiency.   Safety is a core value in our operations environment.  We emphasize this through training, education, and accident prevention programs.  Process Improvement is another core value, and through innovations such as voice and Radio Frequency (RF) technologies, as well as feedback from our associates, we work toward constant improvement.

The world is reading, and it is our goal to connect as many people as possible to the content they want in the simplest ways.  If you want to be part of a customer-centric team that strives for excellence, collaboration, innovation, we can’t wait to meet you!

Schedule:

• D Shift: Wednesday - Friday 7pm-7am + every other Saturday 7pm-7am

What You’ll Need:

• HS Diploma or GED
• 1 year of experience in a formal leadership role with a minimum of one year of manufacturing, production, or distribution experience
• OR 4-year college degree with comparable leadership experience gained through role, leadership training/internships

Preferred Skills:

• Experience applying lean principles and continuous improvement to enhance operations.
• Ability to manage a diverse workforce and foster an inclusive environment.
• Flexible and adaptable to changing environments and able to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced setting
• Proven track record in driving safety culture improvements and Kaizen initiatives.

What You’ll Do:

• Supervises the associates assigned to specified departments, providing adequate resources to ensure maximum throughput and minimum waste while monitoring all quality standards in place.
• Identifies, organizes, plans, and allocates resources; acquires and analyzes relevant information about shift and department performance indicators.
• Identifies issues or processes that deviate from standards and takes necessary corrective action; audits individual productivity and quality to ensure associates are meeting expected and established standards.
• Provides daily supervision of associates, including accurate record keeping, time and attendance monitoring/approval, performance evaluations, and recommendations regarding associate advancement and/or disciplinary procedures, up to and including issuing progressive counseling or termination for performance below minimum expectations.
• Manages relevant distribution and/or production systems and processes (e.g., DMS, PKMS, WMS, KRONOS) to ensure timely and accurate movement of materials and orders, and to maintain accurate payroll records.
• Tracks department processing in accordance with established TAT schedules and production goals; analyzes staffing needs and delegates work based on volume requirements in assigned departments.
• Interviews and selects associates for hire and/or promotion; trains or oversees the training of newly hired associates, and conducts or oversees process-update training as changes are implemented.
• Ensures that all administrative duties are completed according to established timelines and maintains HR-related information and standardized status reporting.
• Compiles a thorough pass-down to inform the incoming shift of current operations and department status, through an interactive crossover with incoming management staff.
• Escalates problems or issues that cannot be solved at this level to the appropriate level; keeps Senior Management aware of all issues that may impact the shift's ability to provide and meet established service levels.
• Maintains consistent quality assurance standards through interaction with the Quality Services team to ensure that orders are processed completely and accurately.

Hiring Salary Range: $78,071k - $98,712k. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary for this position. It will be determined by factors including but not limited to:  the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, geographic location, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Perks/Benefits:

• A highly competitive compensation package with generous benefits beginning first day of employment for Medical/Prescription Drug plans, HSA, Vision, Dental and Health Care FSA.15 vacation days & 12 sick days accrued annually and 3 personal days401K match, Life and AD&D, Employee Assistant programs, Group Legal, & more
• Encouraged continued education with our tuition reimbursement program
• Financial and in-kind opportunities to engage with non-profits in your communityCompany match program for United Way donationsVolunteer opportunities and in-kind drives for non-profits throughout the year
• Casual Dress Code

The world is reading, and Ingram Content Group (“Ingram”) connects people with content in all forms. Providing comprehensive services for publishers, retailers, libraries and educators, Ingram makes these services seamless and accessible through technology, innovation and creativity. With an expansive global network of offices and facilities, Ingram’s services include digital and physical book distribution, print-on-demand, and digital learning. Ingram Content Group is a part of Ingram Industries Inc. and includes Ingram Book Group LLC, Ingram Publisher Services LLC, Lightning Source LLC, Ingram Library Services LLC, Tennessee Book Company LLC, Ingram Content Group UK Ltd. and Ingram Content Group Australia Pty Ltd.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Coordinator

About Us

At West Cancer Center, we are dedicated to providing compassionate, patient-centered care while advancing groundbreaking research. Our team fosters collaboration, innovation, and professional growth, ensuring that every role contributes to making a difference in patients’ lives. Join us in our mission to provide comprehensive support to those navigating the challenges of cancer treatment.

Position Overview

The Data Coordinator (DC) plays a key role in managing clinical trial data by working closely with Sponsors/CROs, investigators, research coordinators, and other internal departments. This position is responsible for accurate and timely completion of case report forms (CRFs), resolution of data queries, and collaboration during monitoring visits. This role requires a high level of professionalism, strong attention to detail, and adherence to confidentiality standards in all internal and external interactions.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage site data for all West Clinic study subjects

• Complete CRFs (electronic and paper) using scanned source documents or direct EMR access

• Generate and follow up on queries for missing information; contact sites every 7 days until resolved

• Schedule and oversee sponsor monitoring visits

• Review CRF entries for accuracy before monitoring visits

• Communicate with site personnel to resolve outstanding issues

• Meet with monitors during visits to complete CRF corrections

• Maintain subject screening/enrollment logs as directed

• Prepare for potential study audits

• Serve as liaison between coordinator, monitor, and regulatory affairs

• Attend investigator meetings and sponsor/CRO visits as needed

• Participate in internal and external meetings, including with project management and regulatory teams

• Develop timelines based on project priorities

• Promote professionalism and maintain confidentiality

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders

• Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree OR

• Three years of relevant experience in healthcare or clinical research OR

• Equivalent combination of education and experience

• Preferred: Medical terminology and health information management experience

Skills & Abilities

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel

• Ability to understand medical documentation (e.g., physician notes, pathology reports)

• Capacity to manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Strict adherence to confidentiality standards

• Positive customer service and teamwork orientation

• Self-motivated and detail-oriented

• Strong understanding of GCP/ICH guidelines and FDA regulations

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

• Comfortable with standard math operations and data interpretation

• Physically able to sit, stand, walk, and lift up to 25 lbs

• Willingness to travel as required

Why West Cancer Center is a Great Place to Work

• Meaningful Impact: Play a direct role in supporting patients through one of the most challenging times of their lives.

• Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of dedicated professionals committed to improving cancer care.

• Professional Development: Benefit from ongoing training, educational resources, and growth opportunities.

• Mission-Driven Environment: Be part of an organization guided by compassion, integrity, and innovation.

Comprehensive benefits package. No nights, weekends, or holidays.

Join Us

Take the next step in your career and become part of a team that is making a real difference. If you’re passionate about data quality, clinical research, and supporting life-changing cancer care, apply now to join West Cancer Center as a Data Coordinator.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Global Business Development Forecasting
jobs.description:
Business Development is a critical pillar of AbbVie’s future growth, and Global Business Development Forecasting helps determine which external opportunities can create the greatest long-term value. The team brings commercial insight, analytical rigor, and strategic clarity to high-stakes BD decisions by translating science, market dynamics, competitive context, and uncertainty into actionable forecasts.

The Associate Director plays a high-impact and highly visible role in this process, leading forecasts and commercial perspectives that shape executive understanding of opportunity value, risk, and strategic fit. Working across R&D, Commercial, Pipeline Commercial Strategy, CBSO, BD Finance, and other partners, this role sits at the intersection of scientific innovation and commercial strategy and directly supports decisions that influence AbbVie’s future portfolio.

Success requires strong forecasting and commercial analytics expertise, rigorous assumption development, clear executive communication, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. Candidates should be curious, collaborative, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to create structure in fast-moving situations. For the right candidate, the role offers meaningful growth through exposure to senior leaders, enterprise-wide relationships, and deeper understanding of both R&D and Commercial strategy.

This role reports to the Director, Global Business Development Forecasting.

Responsibilities

• Lead commercial forecasting, market assessments, scenario analyses, and commercial P&Ls for BD opportunities, balancing analytical rigor with timely decision support in a fast-paced environment.
• Develop patient-based forecast models, pressure-test assumptions, and apply primary research, secondary data, epidemiology, competitive intelligence, market access input, and expert perspectives to build a well-supported commercial view.
• Partner broadly across BD, PCS, finance, market access, epidemiology, marketing analytics, and senior leadership to align assumptions, clarify risks and opportunities, and ensure commercial perspectives are reflected in deal valuation and governance discussions.
• Translate complex analyses into clear recommendations, executive-ready narratives, and decision options for senior leaders and governance forums, facilitating productive discussion around uncertainty, trade-offs, and strategic implications.
• Advance BD forecasting capabilities by sharing best practices, improving tools and processes, and helping create faster, more consistent, and audit-ready ways of working.

• Education and experience: 7+ years of relevant forecasting, market analytics, finance, or life sciences consulting experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or related industries; MBA or other advanced degree preferred. Bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting or business required.
• Forecasting and analytics skills: Experience building forecast models in Excel and forecasting platforms such as IQVIA Forecast Horizon; ability to develop and/or utilize patient-flow modeling approaches, craft robust assumptions, and prepare evidence-based forecast inputs from epidemiology, secondary data, market research, treatment dynamics, competitive profiles, and expert input. Familiar with key data sources used to substantiate forecast recommendations and demonstrated ability to clearly document forecast assumption logic and rationale. Familiarity with using and crafting Target Product Profiles (TPPs), establishing and aligning analytical business rules and market definitions, and leveraging claims data analytics is also highly desirable.
• Business and therapeutic area knowledge: Experience supporting strategic decision making in specialized therapeutic areas such as Neuroscience, Immunology, Oncology, or other complex markets is preferred; ability to apply data, assumptions, and market context effectively is critical.
• Communication and influence: Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to tailor messages by audience, translate complex quantitative analyses into recommendations and decision options, and influence stakeholders across functions and cultures without direct authority.
• Project leadership: Strong project management skills in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, with the ability to prioritize multiple workstreams, communicate trade-offs, escalate risks appropriately, and deliver high-quality work under time pressure.
