jobs.title: Food & Beverage Manager
jobs.description:
At Fairmont Copley Plaza, exceptional service and memorable dining experiences are the hallmarks of our food and beverage operations. As Food & Beverage Manager, your leadership and commitment to service excellence will help drive strong operating results through engaging offerings, an empowered team, and consistent guest satisfaction. The Food & Beverage Manager supports the property’s dining, beverage, and event operations, helping deliver the high standards of service and guest experience associated with Fairmont.

Summary of Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Director of Food & Beverage, responsibilities and essential job functions include but are not limited to the following:

Oversees the day-to-day Food & Beverage operations of assigned outlets and functions in accordance with established property and brand standards.

Leads, coaches, and supports Food & Beverage colleagues to deliver efficient operations, strong revenue performance, and exceptional guest service.

Works closely with the Executive Chef and culinary team on menu execution, purchasing, staffing, food preparation, presentation, and service coordination, as applicable.

Ensures consistent food and beverage quality and service standards across outlets, events, and other assigned operations.

Works with the Food & Beverage team and colleagues across departments to improve guest and employee satisfaction while meeting operational and financial objectives.

Implements guest-service standards and identifies opportunities to improve products, service delivery, revenue, and profitability.

Executes departmental plans and initiatives and supports achievement of departmental and property goals while maintaining brand and organizational standards.

Understands guest expectations for food quality, presentation, and service delivery and ensures colleagues consistently meet those expectations to encourage guest loyalty.

Participates in recruiting, onboarding, training, development, and retention of colleagues; promotes a respectful, inclusive, and accountable work environment.

Coordinates with marketing and public relations teams, as applicable, to support promotions, menus, and concepts that strengthen the property's appeal to hotel and external guests.

Assists with management of the annual operating budget, including labor, productivity, supplies, and operating expenses; monitors results and supports forecasting and strategic planning.

Ensures compliance with standard operating procedures, food safety and sanitation requirements, workplace safety policies, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

Supports food and beverage portion control, inventory management, waste reduction, and other cost-control procedures.

Ensures uniforms, equipment, and operating supplies are ordered within budget and properly inventoried, maintained, and available for service.

Interacts professionally with guests, clients, vendors, company representatives, and community partners; addresses complaints and ensures appropriate follow-up and corrective action.

Trains and reinforces colleague understanding of safety, loss prevention, and accident-prevention procedures.

Provides direction, coaching, and performance feedback; supports performance reviews, conflict resolution, and fair and consistent treatment of colleagues.

Develops and maintains positive working relationships with third-party partners and service providers, as applicable.

Salary Range: 76-78k USD annually

Previous food and beverage experience, including supervisory or management responsibility, required.

Restaurant, hotel, or comparable hospitality operations experience required.

Ability to understand budgets, operating statements, payroll reports, and other financial information used to manage departmental performance.

Experience coordinating operations across multiple outlets, teams, or departments.

Strong interpersonal, communication, guest-relations, and problem-solving skills.

About The Company:

NineDot's name derives from the classic mathematical puzzle for sparking out-of-the-box solutions. As a leading community-scale, clean energy developer with a growing portfolio of projects across a range of technologies, NineDot Energy is creating innovative energy solutions that support a more resilient electric grid, deliver economic savings, address environmental justice and reduce carbon emissions. Our pipeline includes more than 1 GW of clean energy projects designed to strengthen local power grids and provide clean, reliable and resilient power to the communities we serve.

With the backing of Manulife Investment Management and The Carlyle Group - two of the world’s leading infrastructure investors - NineDot is continuing to expand its core battery energy storage pipeline, deliver enhanced products and services, explore new regions and consider potential acquisitions all to advance the decarbonization of New York’s grid. This is an exciting opportunity to build a platform from the ground-up with a world-class team of developers and innovators.

Job Summary

Working closely with the VP, Engineering, the Project Engineer will take on meaningful project responsibility while deepening their expertise in battery energy storage design and delivery. The ideal candidate will have a strong engineering background, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.

Roles and responsibilities

• Help bring battery energy storage projects from design through construction, translating project goals into clear engineering scopes, technical requirements, and deliverables.

• Coordinate with external engineering firms, equipment suppliers, and utility partners to keep designs aligned with project schedules, site conditions, and construction needs.

• Review engineering drawings, shop drawings, and equipment specifications for technical accuracy, constructability, and compliance with project requirements.

• Review system interfaces across battery equipment, inverters, electrical distribution, and SCADA and controls, coordinating with specialists to identify and resolve integration issues.

• Partner with Development, Permitting, Construction, and Operations to identify technical risks early and resolve issues before they affect project cost, schedule, or performance.

• Support utility interconnection and permitting activities by coordinating technical submissions, responding to comments, and incorporating requirements into project designs.

• Investigate engineering issues during design and construction, working with contractors, vendors, and consultants to recommend solutions and escalate complex decisions.

• Support contractor and equipment selection by developing technical scopes, evaluating proposals, and identifying differences in performance, quality, and cost.

• Track engineering milestones, review consultant deliverables, and flag delays or unresolved decisions that could affect project execution.

• Identify opportunities to simplify designs, improve constructability, and reduce costs while maintaining safety, reliability, and performance.

• Maintain clear project records, including design revisions, technical decisions, equipment documentation, and outstanding issues, to support construction and handoff to Operations.

• Contribute lessons learned and improvements to engineering standards, templates, and processes as NineDot’s battery storage portfolio grows.

• Other duties as assigned.

Competencies for Success

• Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

• Drives Results - Constantly achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

• Interpersonal Savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.

• Manages Ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.

• Nimble Learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both success and failures as learning fodder

• Plans and Aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

• Tech Savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.

Required education and experience

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering.

• 5+ years in engineering, preferably in the renewable energy, energy storage and / or the construction industry.

• Working knowledge of battery storage systems, electrical distribution systems, renewable energy technologies and SCADA and controls.

• Familiarity with the utility interconnection and construction process.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

• Familiarity with relevant industry standards and regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, FP&A – Global Marketing
jobs.description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Marketing is the engine of how SharkNinja operates and grows, and you will be the Finance leader who facilitates that in a fiscally responsible and effective way.

At SharkNinja, our mission is to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world. We bring that mission to life through bold innovation, creative, quality, and viral content, a relentless focus on consumers, and an Outrageously Extraordinary mindset that challenges conventional thinking.

As Senior Manager, FP&A – Global Marketing, your role sits at the forefront of the company's growth. You will help decide where the next dollar of marketing investment goes, understand which channels deliver more or less, and guide on which bets are worth taking. Senior leaders will come to you for a point of view, not just the numbers.

You will lead the finance team that manages the Global Marketing function: forecasting, actuals, scenario planning, and the recommendations that follow. You’ll dive deep into the full marketing funnel across brand media, affiliate marketing, performance marketing, and campaign specifics.  You’ll help shape and shift the strategy for evolving business priorities. You will balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, operate with agility and flexibility to help teams make real-time tradeoffs, navigate complex financial challenges, and deliver meaningful improvements across multiple workstreams.

You will embody our Relentless Drive for Edge by seeking better ways to analyze performance and challenge assumptions, and bring an Insatiable Impatience for Action, turning insight into timely recommendations while leading a collaborative team to Outrageously Extraordinary results.

What you'll do

Business partnership and thought partnership

• Advise senior leaders in Marketing, Commercial, and regional teams on where to invest, what returns to expect, and which trade-offs to make.

• Lead the finance conversation with senior leadership, bringing the team's analysis to the table with a clear point of view.

• Build and pressure-test investment scenarios and bring a clear recommendation with each one.

• Elevate how we review and view the marketing business: challenge the way things are done, build new P&L views and metrics, and find new ways to free up time and deliver value. Encourage your team and business partners to do the same.

Planning, reporting, and controls

• Own forecasting, budgeting, actuals, and variance analysis for global marketing investments.

• Own the monthly and quarterly narrative for leadership: what moved, why it moved, and the move we make next.

• Own data integrity and controllership: close partnership with Accounting to keep the financial statements accurate, keep documented controls current, and handle sensitive financial information with discretion.

• Arm leaders with self-service, readily available information so they can run discussions and make decisions quickly.

Team leadership

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of analysts with clear priorities, ongoing feedback, and clear development paths.

• Foster an environment where Winning Is a Team Sport, encouraging collaboration, constructive challenge, accountability, and shared ownership of results, and set the team's rhythm for planning cycles, reviews, and handoffs.

• Demonstrate Communicating for Impact by translating complex financial information into concise recommendations for executive and cross-functional audiences.

Building with AI and automation

• Use AI tools in daily work to speed up analysis, recurring deliverables, and pressure-test assumptions.

• Build what the team needs, from models and reporting automation to data pipelines, and show results early rather than waiting for a perfect build.

• Drive process improvement: continually move manual and repetitive work into automation.

What you bring

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field. MBA preferred.

• 7–10 years of progressive FP&A, corporate finance, or related experience.

• Experience leading, coaching, and developing a team of analysts.

• Mastery of planning and reporting rhythms, including budget, forecast, long-range plan, and monthly close.

• Experience analyzing marketing or commercial investments.

• Experience in consumer products is strongly preferred. Retail or e-commerce experience is a plus.

• Advanced Excel and financial modeling, with experience in visualization tools, ERP systems, and data management tools.

• Hands-on AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own workflow and can show what you built with them.

• A track record of influencing senior leaders with concise, decision-ready recommendations.

How you'll work

• Details make the difference: you check the numbers, then check the logic behind them.

• Progress over perfection: you ship a useful version this week and improve it next week.

• Conviction: you take a position, back it with data, and change it when the data says so.

• Drive: you bring the next idea, not only the next report, and you follow it through.

• Builder's mindset: you prototype quickly, get into the data yourself, and build tools instead of waiting for them.

Salary and Other Compensation: The annual salary range for this position is displayed below. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts (HSA) with company contribution, 401(k) retirement plan with matching, employee stock purchase program, life insurance, AD&D, short-term disability insurance, long-term disability insurance, generous paid time off, company holidays, parental leave, identity theft protection, pet insurance, pre-paid legal insurance, back-up child and eldercare days, product discounts, referral bonus program, and more.

Pay Range

$105,300—$203,300 USD

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

You have run Temporal in production — not just written workflows on top of it. You've operated a self-hosted cluster yourself, configured and maintained the datastores it depends on, and reasoned about retries, idempotency, and partial failure under real load. You've been the person other teams escalate to when something breaks. You think in terms of guarantees, and you can say concretely what teams building on a shared platform should be able to assume, and how you'd prove the platform is holding up its end.

You've also led a technical migration, infrastructure consolidation, or platform re-architecture across multiple stakeholder teams — sequencing risk, owning the decision record, and driving it to completion.

This is a senior individual contributor role on Shared Services, the team that owns and operates platform shared capabilities across Justworks engineering, so product teams can build on reliable, well-run foundations without owning that complexity themselves. You would be the team's de facto Temporal tech lead and its long-term technical authority on the platform.

The role spans both halves of platform engineering: operating and hardening a live system other teams depend on today, and building the scaffolding, conventions, and documentation that make it straightforward to build on tomorrow. You'll be hands-on with reliability and migration work, and you'll help shape what the platform becomes as more teams adopt it.

What You Will Work On

• Harden the shared Temporal cluster for multi-tenant readiness — capacity modeling, namespace isolation, and admission control

• Define the service promise: SLOs for Temporal-backed services, and alerting trustworthy enough that every page is worth waking someone for

• Build the golden paths and conventions that let other teams build workflows on the shared platform safely, with less hand-holding over time

• Enable multi-cluster availability, so tenant workloads keep running through a cluster or regional failure

• Own capacity and cost efficiency as the shared platform scales to more tenant teams and workflow volume

• Partner with tenant teams on workflow design, idempotency, and safe retry patterns as they onboard

• Rotate on the shared platform's on-call schedule — incident response, root-causing production issues, writing postmortems, and continuously tuning alerts and SLOs

How You Will Do Your Work

Good judgment — the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.

Resourcefulness — taking a can-do approach, even in the face of obstacles and constraints by assessing what's in front of you and effectively and efficiently optimizing what you have, whether it's working on something new or thinking about how to do something better.

Teamwork and communication — putting our collective best together through documentation, collaboration, relationship-building, listening, empathy, recruiting, and evangelism.

Influence and leadership — fostering a community of knowledge-sharing, collaboration, mentorship, and forward-thinking.

Skills and knowledge — the capacity to actively learn and apply specific domain knowledge, know-how, and best practices to continually enhance and improve.

COGIS Values

• Camaraderie — Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You're an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

• Openness — Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You're curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

• Grit — You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You're committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

• Integrity — Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You're honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

• Simplicity — Be like Einstein: "Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler."

Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

• 2+ years of hands-on, production experience operating self-hosted Temporal — running the cluster itself, not only writing workflows against one. This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have: experience with another workflow orchestrator does not substitute, and Temporal Cloud alone does not meet the self-host requirement

• Experience operating a distributed system in production at scale — retries, idempotency, partial failure, and the datastores and storage configuration it depends on

• Operational depth in Temporal internals and cluster administration — how the cluster is configured, maintained, and tuned, and how its constraints shape workflow design

• Experience securing and troubleshooting service-to-service communication between clients, workers, and the cluster

• Experience leading a technical migration or infrastructure consolidation across multiple stakeholder teams

• Experience defining SLOs and alerting for a platform-level service, including per-namespace / per-tenant observability and routing problems to the owning team

• Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production

• Strong Golang proficiency plus at least one additional language

Nice to Have

These are the parts of the profile we consider coachable — hands-on Temporal depth matters more than any of them:

• A specific language beyond Go

• A particular cloud or Kubernetes flavor

• A prior formal "migration lead" title — someone with deep Temporal chops can grow into leading the migration without that exact label on a resume

Technologies

• Orchestration: Temporal, self-hosted (primary focus)

• Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers

• Languages: Go (primary), plus at least one more — whatever fits the problem

• Service communication: gRPC, TLS/mTLS

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $188,000.00 - $242,000.00 per year.

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

The Tax Information Reporting and Withholding Advisory Manager will be an integral part of the Coinbase tax team. The role sits at the intersection of tax advisory, product development, and operational execution, helping Coinbase translate complex U.S. and global tax requirements into scalable processes and systems. This role focuses on strong advisory judgment and practical experience applying information reporting and withholding rules in fast-moving business environments.

The Coinbase tax team ensures full compliance with tax obligations across all jurisdictions in which Coinbase operates, including building world-class tax protocols for digital asset transactions. We are passionate about tax and crypto, and we are seeking a candidate with a similar passion and collaborative mindset to join our team.

What you'll do:

• Own end-to-end execution of key information reporting and withholding workstreams, including reporting readiness, withholding calculations, reconciliations, remittance support, and operational issue resolution.

• Translate tax laws, regulations, and internal policy positions into clear business requirements, logic, and data specifications for technical and operational teams.

• Review product and process changes to identify tax impacts, define data capture needs, and ensure compliance requirements are addressed early in the development lifecycle.

• Partner with Tax, Product, Engineering, Operations, CX, and Finance to implement scalable processes supporting U.S. and global compliance.

• Lead the design and execution of user acceptance testing for tax-related features, workflows, and reporting outputs.

• Support tax audits, notices, and regulatory inquiries through timely data gathering, reconciliation, and documentation.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 8+ years of experience in information reporting and withholding within a bank, broker-dealer, fintech, technology company, Big 4, or similar advisory environment.

• Deep working knowledge of U.S. information reporting and withholding regimes (Forms 1099, 1042-S, 1099-DA, backup withholding, NRA withholding) with familiarity with global regimes such as CRS and CARF.

• Proven ability to draft business requirements, translate tax rules into implementable logic, and partner with engineering teams to operationalize compliance.

• Advisory experience from a law firm, Big 4, accounting firm, or in-house tax function, with the ability to explain complex tax requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

$166,345—$195,700 USD

Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Sr. Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

Business Systems is shifting from a classic admin/ops setup to a more engineering-led team. We want people who write code, take release process seriously, and use AI to increase your efficiency 10x.

You'll help build and connect the systems behind Engine's go-to-market motion: CRM, engagement, enrichment, automation, and the glue between them. Some of that lives in Salesforce; a lot of it is integrations, internal tooling, and workflows that span multiple platforms. You'll ship through git and CI/CD, not one-off manual deploys, and help us get sharper at that as the team changes shape.

A big part of the job is automation — wiring AI into production workflows where it cuts manual work, and using coding tools like Cursor or Claude Code in your own day-to-day, with normal review and testing. You'll sit with RevOps, Sales, and Growth on the problems that actually matter, turn them into systems that stick, and leave the next person something they can maintain.

What We're Looking For

• 3–5 years as a business systems / GTM systems engineer (or similar) — building, integrating, and automating, not ticket-only admin work

• Comfortable writing code where it counts (scripting, APIs, light application work) and knowing when a no-code or low-code path is enough

• Hands-on with git and CI/CD for how changes get to production

• Some real AI work under your belt — shipped automations, agents, or heavy use of AI coding tools on production systems

• Experience across a modern GTM stack (CRM, sequencing/engagement, enrichment, iPaaS / integration layer) — Salesforce is a plus and part of our world, not the only thing that matters

• Can explain tradeoffs to non-engineers without drowning them in jargon

Nice to have: Salesforce Admin or Platform Developer certs, travel/marketplace background, Data Cloud / Agentforce, or you've helped a systems team make a similar move toward engineering practices.

Why this role

You're not joining a finished machine. You'll help decide how Business Systems builds and ships going forward, with plenty of exposure across GTM and Engineering at a company that's already at scale and cash-flow positive.

Applications for this role will be accepted until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

$101,200—$140,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

• Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.

• Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture

• Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

jobs.title: Critical Harms Investigations & Incident Management Specialist
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox’s Safety Operations team is dedicated to protecting our community from bad actors. The Critical Harms Investigations & Incident Management (CHIIMS) team applies subject-matter expertise to high-sensitivity matters involving child safety, violent extremism, and other critical harms. As part of our commitment to safety, we are looking for a Specialist with an investigator’s mindset, skills, and curiosity, and an incident manager’s coordination, communication, and rigor. You will work closely with cross-functional partners across the company to quickly and professionally respond to urgent escalations, while balancing multiple responsibilities and competing priorities. Among other strategic impacts, you will share findings and recommendations with internal partners to help mitigate safety risks to our platform.

Please Note: This role will require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies. This role will also require On-Call support during weekends and holidays.

You’ll report to the Director of Law Enforcement & Critical Harms Operations. This full-time, hybrid position is located at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA.

You Will:

• Lead rapid investigations into critical and complex incidents, including those related to child safety, violent extremism, and other high-severity harms.

• Operate within a 24/7 on-call rotation and act as the primary point of contact for safety incidents across the company, including with senior leadership.

• Utilize internal tools, data analysis, and open-source intelligence techniques to gather evidence, establish facts, and conduct root cause analyses.

• Draft and deliver real-time, high-stakes communications to senior leadership regarding incident status, impact assessment, and mitigation efforts.

• Apply sound judgment in triage, lane assignment, escalation, and case closure.

• Develop, test, and maintain robust incident response playbooks for critical harms scenarios.

• Improve our investigative methods, operating processes, templates, and quality standards.

• Build trust with cross-functional partners and mentor others to strengthen our investigative capabilities.

You Have:

• 5+ years leading investigations, incident management, and/or policy enforcement on a technology platform.

• Demonstrated ability thriving in high-pressure, sensitive, and complex investigations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical and sensitive issues to executive audiences and non-technical partners.

• Fluency with data analysis, dashboards, and a range of investigation tools; familiarity with online safety considerations.

• Strong project management skills, prioritization acumen, and enthusiasm to build processes from the ground up.

• Demonstrated mentorship, informal leadership, and subject-matter expertise that helps other investigators grow.

• Outstanding judgment, discretion, collegiality, and resilience.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

Annual Salary Range

$144,620—$174,100 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.description:
About Turing

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

Role: Research Partner - Frontier AI Sales
Location: San Francisco Bay Area
Experience Level: 7+ years of relevant sales or business development experience
Work Model: Onsite, five days per week in either the San Francisco or Palo Alto office.

Why Join Turing?

As a Research Partner, you will help drive revenue growth across Turing’s AI capabilities and talent solutions.

You will identify, develop, and expand client relationships, owning the full sales lifecycle from prospecting and opportunity qualification through solution development, negotiation, and closing.

This is a senior commercial role for someone who can independently originate and close complex business, build executive relationships, expand strategic accounts, and consistently deliver against revenue targets.

You will work closely with internal operations, talent, product, finance, and commercial teams to develop compelling proposals, deliver a strong client experience, and convert opportunities into long-term commercial partnerships.

As a Research Partner, You Will

Develop New Business

Identify, prospect, qualify, and close new business opportunities across targeted accounts and markets.

Develop outbound sales strategies, manage inbound opportunities, and build qualified pipelines that support new client acquisition.

Own the Full Sales Cycle

Lead discovery, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure.

Understand client requirements and align Turing’s capabilities with their business and technical needs.

Grow Strategic Accounts

Build strong relationships with existing clients and identify opportunities to expand engagements and increase account revenue.

Develop account strategies that support retention, cross-selling, and long-term commercial growth.

Lead Client Engagement

Build relationships with business, technical, and executive decision-makers. Understand organizational priorities, purchasing processes, and evolving requirements.

Communicate Turing’s capabilities and value proposition effectively to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Drive Commercial Results

Deliver against assigned sales quotas, bookings, and new business objectives.

Maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline and use data to monitor opportunity progression, account performance, and conversion.

Collaborate Across Turing

Partner with operations, talent, product, finance, and other commercial teams to develop proposals and support successful client engagements.

Coordinate internal resources to ensure client requirements, commercial commitments, and execution capabilities are aligned.

Strengthen Commercial Strategy

Share client feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights to strengthen Turing’s commercial strategy and sales effectiveness.

The Anti-Sell

Full-cycle sales ownership: This is not a role for someone focused only on account management, renewals, or relationship maintenance. You will be expected to originate, develop, and close new business.

Proactive business development: You will need to create opportunities through outbound prospecting, disciplined qualification, and relationship development.

Commercial accountability: You will be expected to manage a qualified pipeline and consistently deliver against assigned commercial targets.

Complex stakeholder environments: You will work across business, technical, and executive stakeholders and must be comfortable navigating complex purchasing processes.

Independent execution: This role requires strong organization, judgment, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.

Our Research Partners Typically Have

Senior commercial experience: Seven or more years in business development, strategic account management, consultative sales, or quota-carrying commercial roles.

New business ownership: A demonstrated record of independently originating, developing, and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

Executive-level relationship building: Experience building trusted relationships with business, technical, and executive decision-makers and navigating complex client organizations.

Strategic account expansion: A track record of expanding existing accounts through cross-selling, relationship development, and account strategy.

Full-cycle sales leadership: Experience leading discovery, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure.

Commercial performance: Consistent success delivering against quota, bookings, pipeline, and revenue objectives.

Technical and consultative fluency: The ability to understand complex client challenges, communicate technical solutions, and connect Turing’s capabilities to measurable business value.

Independent leadership: The judgment, organization, and execution discipline to operate independently while influencing internal teams and advancing complex opportunities.

Top-Tier Candidates Will Have

• Experience working directly with or selling to frontier AI labs.

• Experience at an AI data, annotation, expert-network, or technical talent company.

• Experience selling technical talent, AI capabilities, IT consulting, technology solutions, or related business-to-business offerings.

• Experience developing high-velocity outbound sales strategies in technology-focused markets.

• Familiarity with software engineering, technical talent requirements, or enterprise technology environments.

• Experience selling to technical stakeholders and adapting commercial approaches to different technology stacks and client requirements.

• Demonstrated success expanding existing accounts through cross-selling, relationship development, and strategic account planning.

• Experience using CRM platforms, pipeline analytics, and sales performance reporting to improve commercial outcomes.

Values

• We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.

• We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection

• We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

• Work at the frontier of AI, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.

• Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.

• Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.

• Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.

• Move at the pace of AI innovation, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace  and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Our Senior Account Executive-SMB will be essential in providing the highest level of service to our small business customers, to understand their financial needs and lender partners to manage a process towards funding. If you’re interested in the position, here are a few things you’ll get to do and the qualifications that will make you successful in this role.

 - Manage the entire sales process from handling initial outreach to closing the deal.

 - Dive right into training and quickly learn the NerdWallet Small Business sales process, including our entire product suite and basic qualifying material.

 - Jump on the phones and become a NerdWallet Small Business expert who can confidently speak about our products and help business owners find the best loan options for their business.

jobs.title: Clinic Manager - Mission-driven Primary Care
jobs.description:
Clinic Manager

Job Description

Employment type: Full-time, onsite   |   Level: Manager

Location: Minneapolis–Saint Paul, MN (clinic-based)   |   Reports to: VP, Clinical Operations

Who we are

Herself Health provides primary care designed for women 65 and older. Our model addresses the needs of women later in life, including post-menopausal care, bone health, weight management, and mental, social and emotional well-being. We bring personalized care and meaningful relationships to the communities we serve.

Our Mission: We deliver exceptional, compassionate, and high value advanced primary care for the unique needs of maturing women, empower HER to live a healthier, fuller life.

How you will work

We look for colleagues who put patients first, collaborate across teams and take ownership of their work. You bring curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn, using feedback and data to improve how we care for patients and support one another.

Our values guide how we work, make decisions and show up for our patients and one another. We bring them to life through our everyday actions:

Her, First — We center every decision on the women we serve.

Curious, Always Learning — We ask questions, seek feedback and keep improving.

Own it, Act — We take responsibility, follow through and solve problems.

Together, Unstoppable — We share knowledge and support each other to deliver better care.

About the role

The Clinic Manager leads daily clinic operations and people leadership across Herself Health’s Twin Cities clinics, bringing our clinical operating model and patient-first values to life. This hands-on leader builds and develops Medical Assistant, clinical and front-desk teams; uses performance data to improve quality, access and patient experience; and guides colleagues through evolving workflows and organizational change. Working closely with providers and cross-functional partners, the Clinic Manager ensures safe, effective and consistent clinic operations.

What you will do

• Lead clinic teams through changes to workflows, technology, staffing and care models; explain the rationale, coach through resistance and sustain adoption.

• Oversee daily clinic operations, complex shift schedules, time-off requests and coverage for call-outs while maintaining continuity of patient care.

• Use dashboards and performance reports to set clinic goals and improve Annual Wellness Visits, preventive screenings, chronic care gap closure and other quality measures.

• Build a high-performing, accountable team through clear expectations, huddles, recognition, regular feedback and fair performance management.

• Recruit, onboard and develop Medical Assistants, clinical and front-desk colleagues; complete orientation and required training, conduct regular one-on-ones and create development plans.

• Make sound decisions amid changing priorities and incomplete information; communicate short-term priorities and escalate risks appropriately.

• Partner with Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, Operations, quality, value-based care, revenue cycle and People teams to manage staffing, costs, processes and patient care standards.

• Communicate clearly with patients, families, colleagues and leaders; maintain a calm, appropriate response to urgent or emergency situations.

• Ensure clinic operations comply with applicable federal, state and local requirements and organizational policies.

What you bring

Required qualifications

• At least two years of experience overseeing day-to-day on-site operations, preferably in a clinical setting, including scheduling, time-off management and staffing coverage.

• Experience hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing teams, setting expectations, delivering feedback and supporting mandatory training.

• Demonstrated success leading operational change and training teams on new clinical or administrative workflows.

• Ability to use data and dashboards to set goals, track results and improve quality measures and patient outcomes.

• Strong cross-functional partnership, problem-solving, communication and listening skills; comfortable navigating ambiguity in a growing organization.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams) and ability to learn new technologies.

• Ability to work in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, respond appropriately to emergencies and travel regularly among Twin Cities clinics.

• Authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

• Knowledge of value-based care and fee-for-service healthcare models; experience with project management.

• Experience with learning and development in a clinical or nonclinical setting; ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Location and schedule

Work arrangement: On-site clinic leadership in the Minneapolis–Saint Paul market; regular local travel between clinics is required.

Schedule: Full-time; specific clinic assignment and hours to be confirmed.

Travel: Regular local travel to Herself Health clinic locations across Minneapolis and Saint Paul.

Equal opportunity

We support Equal Employment Opportunities (EEO). We are committed to an inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, parental status, political affiliation, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Compliance expectations

All employees of Herself Health are expected to fully understand and abide by the practice's compliance policies and procedures. Employees are provided training upon hire and annually and regularly notified of changes as needed. It is expected that all employees will report any suspected violations of any federal or state laws to their direct supervisor, Human Resources, or the Compliance Officer.

 - Turn new features and core product use cases into launches, tutorials, showcases, recurring series, and content people share because it’s entertaining.

 - Build a content program across 75+ niches: find the right creators, understand the audience, develop the formats, and keep the work specific to each community.

 - Recruit and manage a team of 100 content producers and video editors, supported by strong creative leads, clear briefs, and a production system that keeps everyone moving.

 - Stay hands-on: pitch ideas daily, write scripts and briefs, make example videos, and jump into edits when something needs a stronger hook or a better ending.

 - Build workflows for AI generation, editing, motion graphics, review, publishing, and rapid iteration.

 - Partner with product to showcase new capabilities and bring creator feedback into product development.

 - Track reach, retention, shares, product visits, signups, and activation to learn what gets attention and what gets people creating.



What You’ll Bring:

 - Experience building and running high-output social content teams and managing multiple accounts with 100,000+ followers.

 - Ability to recruit and manage a large (20+ person) creator operation.

 - A track record of viral content, especially on X, and an understanding of the platform’s culture and how video, copy, and conversation work together.

 - Excellent taste: you can spot a great concept early and explain exactly why an almost-good piece isn’t there yet.

 - Strong writing and storytelling skills across briefs, scripts, social copy, and educational content.

 - Hands-on experience with video editing, motion graphics, and AI-native production workflows.

 - The ability to work across very different niches without making everything sound or look the same.

 - Operational discipline around production calendars, review cycles, creator feedback, and publishing cadence.



Compensation:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is between $225,000-$300,000. When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.



Benefits:

 - Competitive salary and generous company equity

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina

   - 15 PTO days
   
   - 10 sick days

 - Generous parental leave & fertility support

 - 401(k) retirement savings plan

 - Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like

 - Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees

 - One Medical membership, and more!

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Company Overview: Sustainment is an AI-native software platform that helps US-based manufacturers easily find and work with the critical suppliers they need to build and manage their supply chains. Our vision is to reimagine American manufacturing as a hyperconnected, secure, and resilient ecosystem of local and regional suppliers who can more easily connect, interact, and do business with the industry and government customers that rely on them. We are a dual-use technology platform that supports both DoD and commercial customers in pursuit of our vision.

The Role

We are hiring a Product Designer (or Senior Designer) to continue to progress the overall user experience of the Sustainment platform, which provides Supplier Relationship Management, Supply Chain workflows, and Supplier Intelligence to some of the world’s most innovative manufacturers. Our team works at the forefront of AI-driven design with human creativity and design expertise setting the standard. You will report to the VP of Product and work as an equal partner with product and engineering.

We are also open to hiring at the Senior Product Designer level. If you have more experience, see the Senior Product Designer section below for the added scope and qualifications. Everyone applies to this one posting, and we will set the level based on your experience and interviews.

What You Will Own

• Delivery of user experience and visual design across all Sustainment products

• Consistent development and use of our AI-driven prototyping and design system and shared patterns across the areas you work on.

What You Will Do

• Work with product management and engineering to deliver exceptional design based on the functional needs of the user

• Plan and run user research with manufacturers and suppliers: interviews, rapid prototype tests, and clear synthesis of what you learned.

• Produce clear UX artifacts, from journey maps and interaction models to high-fidelity UI built on our design system.

• Use AI model-driven design tools, such as Claude, to generate UI and working prototypes from our design system, test ideas fast, and put concepts in front of users early.

• Design data-dense procurement screens and AI-assisted decision flows that keep users in control and keep trust high.

• Write design specs that cover edge cases, and stay involved through QA and launch.

• Present your designs and rationale to the team, and give and receive critique.

What You Bring

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally on B2B SaaS products.

• A portfolio that shows shipped work and how you moved from problem to solution.

• Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces for business users.

• Hands-on experience with AI model-driven design and prototyping, using tools such as Claude to turn a design system into working UI.

• Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to take a rough problem to a shipped design.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills with engineers and product partners, and the ability to explain your decisions with clear rationale.

• Craft across interaction design and visual design, held to a consistently high bar.

Nice to Have

• Experience at an early-stage company.

• Background in procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or operations software.

Senior Product Designer

At the senior level, everything above applies, plus the following.

Additional Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end design coherence across the platform, so the product feels like one system and not a set of features.

• Own the information architecture and reusable patterns that connect the core workflows.

• Set the long-term design vision for how buyers and suppliers use the platform, including AI-assisted decision making, and get it reflected in the roadmap.

• Set the research agenda and run a steady research cadence that shapes product priorities.

• Present designs and rationale to company leadership.

• Strengthen the design system so AI models can build from it reliably, build a strong critique culture and research habits, and mentor other designers as the team grows.

Additional Qualifications

• 5+ years of product design on B2B SaaS products, with clear ownership of major workflows or product areas.

• A portfolio that shows end-to-end workflow thinking, product leadership, and measurable shipped outcomes.

• Strength in system design: information architecture and reusable patterns that hold up across a whole product.

• A record of leading work from rough problem framing to shipped product, and of persuading leadership and influencing the roadmap.

• Experience mentoring designers or raising the design practice on a team.

Location

This is an on-site role at our Austin, Texas office. We are hiring candidates who live in the Austin area.

Sustainment offers a competitive benefits package for full time employees including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, company holidays, and 401K matching.

Sustainment is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Sustainment participates in E-Verify.

jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

Chamberlain College of Nursing needs qualified Mental Health Clinical Faculty (part-time) in our Bachelors of Science in Nursing program in Tulsa, OK.

Teaching is onsite (in clinical setting) with one of our clinical partners. Schedule: most commonly 12-hour rotations (7a-7p) for three to four consecutive days.

Mental-Health Nursing course overview:

Emphasis is on the dynamics of an individual’s ability to function in society. The course focuses on content relative to anxiety, self-concept, thought disorders, mood alterations, addictive behaviors, organic brain dysfunction, abuse and violence issues. It also incorporates health promotion and wellness issues such as stress management and personal growth. Therapeutic communication techniques, individual and group therapy practices and community mental-health resources are also incorporated.

Today, more than ever before, the next generation of nurses needs you. Your passion. Your expertise. Your heart.

If you are passionate about nursing and advancing your career through the power of education, we eagerly invite you to step forward and apply today. Will you join us?

Responsibilities

In this role, the clinical instructor:

• Implements the College's philosophy, curriculum, program outcomes, and course objectives through clinical teaching and service to the College, community, health system and profession.
• Assumes responsibility for all autonomous aspects of individual teaching assignments.
• Plans clinical experiences for and provides direct supervision and evaluation of nursing students delivering nursing care to an individual or group of individuals.
• Evaluates and provides documented feedback to student on level of performance based on course objectives.
• Is available for remediation of students as required or needed.
• Orients and maintains current knowledge related to agency/clinical policies, procedures, and expectations with the assistance of the agency/clinical personnel.
• Develops and posts written clinical assignments consistent with student's knowledge base, skill competency and individual learning needs.
• Grades homework, quizzes, tests, lab assignments, clinical paperwork and other written work in a timely manner
• May teach didactic course content under supervision of course coordinator.
• Keeps course coordinator informed of all student and agency issues and concerns.
• Reports to the dean or assistant dean: a course coordinator will also provide direct oversight.

You are encouraged to explore this opportunity if you have:

• A master's or doctoral degree in Nursing from a regionally accredited college or university
• An unencumbered professional nursing license in the state of Oklahoma.
• At least two years professional experience within last five years in the area of instruction as a registered nurse
• Teaching or precepting experience is preferred but not required
• Have genuine passion for nursing, education, and lifelong learning
• Have exceptional subject matter expertise with excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Are eager to serve students and colleagues with passion, respect and care
• Operate with a sense of responsibility and purpose with the desire to enrich colleagues, students and the broader community.

Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Associate (Contract) - NY
jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions—and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do.



As a Marketing Operations Associate, you’ll own the operational and administrative work that supports NerdWallet’s Student Loans business. Reporting to the Senior Staff Marketing Lead as an individual contributor, you’ll work across the full Student Loans portfolio, handling the recurring execution that keeps our marketplace running—from lender compliance and external partner communications to revenue and cost reporting, affiliate campaign operations, partner contracts, and invoice reconciliation.



Your work will provide a reliable operational foundation that enables the team to scale marketing channels and pursue growth initiatives while helping consumers make informed financial decisions.




WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

 - Process lender-initiated compliance updates, including APRs, disclosures, and regulated content, across landing pages and internal systems. Coordinate with external partners to maintain marketplace accuracy and regulatory compliance.

 - Build and maintain marketing reports and Google Sheets dashboards, including ad hoc month-over-month and year-over-year analyses, campaign and partner performance breakdowns, and monthly billing sheet accuracy reviews.

 - Investigate and resolve discrepancies between reports and data sources.

 - Manage landing page content and lender display order across the Student Loans marketplace. Set up new pages, update existing content, and support internal and lender requests, including logo split tests and partner-provided landing pages.

 - Set up and configure affiliate campaigns in Voluum and share creative assets with traffic partners to support affiliate-driven acquisition.

 - Reconcile partner billing and invoices across both sides of the marketplace. Validate inbound traffic-partner invoices, approve or deny invoices as appropriate, follow up on discrepancies, submit partner requisitions, audit lender-side invoices, and surface issues to marketing leadership.

 - Maintain payout rates and revenue terms in internal administrative systems to support accurate reporting, bidding systems, partner reconciliation, and internal tracking.

 - Manage the partner contract pipeline in Ironclad, tracking contracts through each workflow stage, identifying next steps, and following up with internal and external stakeholders to keep onboarding and renewals moving.

 - Coordinate across lenders, traffic partners, Finance, Marketing, and internal teams to keep operational work moving from start to finish.


YOUR EXPERIENCE:

 - Approximately 0–3 years of relevant experience preferred; candidates with additional experience will also be considered. Relevant backgrounds include marketing operations, affiliate or performance marketing, financial reconciliation, project coordination, account management, or other operational or administrative roles.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Finance, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

 - Proficiency in Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and dashboard creation.

 - Comfort working with numerical data, reconciling figures, spotting discrepancies, and maintaining accurate financial and operational records.

 - Ability to quickly learn and use new platforms and internal tools, such as Voluum, Ironclad, WordPress, Amplitude, Databricks, and custom internal systems.

 - Clear, professional written communication for correspondence with lenders, traffic partners, and internal teams.

 - Exceptional attention to detail when working with regulated content, financial reconciliation, contracts, and external communications.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to track multiple concurrent workstreams and follow through on outstanding items.

 - A proactive approach to following up with external partners and internal teams to keep work moving.

 - Sound judgment about when to act independently and when to ask questions or escalate.

 - Adaptability and comfort switching between compliance, content, reporting, billing, contracts, and affiliate operations.

 - Initiative in learning systems and processes and a willingness to seek and incorporate feedback.

 - A collaborative approach, with open communication that supports shared decision-making.

 - An ability to connect day-to-day operational work to broader business goals and NerdWallet’s mission of helping consumers make smart financial decisions.

 - A commitment to building a team environment grounded in trust, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Hands-on experience with affiliate tracking, attribution, or click-tracking platforms such as Voluum, Impact Radius, Everflow, CAKE, or TUNE.

 - Exposure to performance or affiliate marketing concepts, including cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), attribution, and conversion tracking, along with basic familiarity with Google Ads or Meta Ads.

 - Experience in fintech, lending, financial services, or another regulated industry where compliance, disclosures, and content accuracy are part of daily work.

 - Familiarity with financial operations, such as accounts payable or receivable, invoice reconciliation, and billing audits.

 - Working knowledge of SQL or experience pulling data from a data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

 - Hands-on experience with a contract management platform such as Ironclad or DocuSign CLM.

 - Familiarity with a content management system, particularly WordPress, for landing page updates.

 - Comfort using AI tools or lightweight automation, such as Claude Code, Zapier, or other LLM-based assistants, to streamline repetitive operational workflows.


PAY TRANSPARENCY & CONTRACT DETAILS:

 - Hourly rate: $30-50/hr based on experience and location

 - Engagement type: 3–6-month W-2 contract, with the intent to convert to a full-time employee based on performance.
   
   - Location: Candidates based in or near Manhattan, New York, are strongly preferred. If converted to full-time employment, working from the Manhattan office approximately once per month is preferred, but will remain remote otherwise

 - Estimated engagement period: November 2026–April 2027.

 - Schedule: Up to 40 hours per week, with preferred working hours of 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.


WHERE:

 - This role will be remote (based in the U.S.).

 - We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.


WHAT WE OFFER:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

 - Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

 - Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

 - New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

 - Mental health support

 - Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests

 - Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution

 - Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend)

 - Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends)

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

 - Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

 - Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

 - Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction 

 - Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

 - 401K with 4% company match

 - Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

 - Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

 - Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Urology Physician, Lancaster, PA
jobs.description:
Urologist Opportunity – Lancaster, PA

Opportunity Summary

Discover the advantages of advanced independent practice with Keystone Urology Specialists (KUS), powered by Urology Alliance (UA).

KUS is seeking a Board-Certified or Board-Eligible Urologist to join our established and growing practice in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. This opportunity offers clinical autonomy, a collaborative physician-led environment, a pathway to partnership, and an attractive compensation package.

As part of Urology Alliance, KUS combines the personalized approach of private practice with the resources and operational support of a leading national urology network. Whether you're completing training or are an experienced urologist, KUS provides an excellent opportunity to build a rewarding, long-term career.

Why Join Keystone Urology Specialists?

• Flexible Schedule: Optional four-day workweek supporting work-life balance.

• Partnership Opportunity: Employed position with a defined One-year pathway to partnership and long-term growth.

• Clinical Autonomy: Maintain local clinical decision-making with the support of a national network.

• Collaborative Environment: Work alongside experienced Urologists, APPs, and dedicated clinical support staff.

• Comprehensive Urology Practice: Practice general urology with opportunities to pursue specialized interests, including female urology.

• Competitive Financial Package: Attractive compensation, signing bonus, relocation assistance, and comprehensive benefits.

• Professional Growth: Annual CME allowance and opportunities for continued clinical development.

Compensation & Benefits Highlights

• Competitive base salary and production incentive

• Generous signing bonus and relocation assistance

• Employed position with One-year partnership track

• Optional four-day workweek

• Comprehensive insurance benefits

• Employer-paid professional liability insurance

• 30 days of paid time off (PTO)

• Annual CME allowance

Ideal Qualifications

• Board Certification/Eligibility: Board-certified or board-eligible in Urology.

• Clinical Expertise: Strong foundation in general urology; interest or experience in female urology is a plus.

• Patient-Centered Care: Commitment to delivering exceptional, personalized patient care.

• Collaborative Mindset: Strong communication skills and a team-oriented approach.

• Professional Growth: Desire to contribute to a growing practice while advancing clinical expertise.

Why Physicians Love Lancaster, Pennsylvania

Located in the heart of scenic Lancaster County, Lancaster, Pennsylvania, offers an exceptional combination of small-town charm, vibrant cultural attractions, and modern conveniences. Situated approximately 70 miles west of Philadelphia and within convenient reach of Baltimore, Lancaster provides easy access to major metropolitan areas while maintaining a welcoming, community-oriented atmosphere. The region is known for its picturesque countryside, historic neighborhoods, thriving downtown district, and diverse selection of restaurants, shops, and entertainment. Residents enjoy access to excellent public and private educational options, attractive residential communities, and a cost of living that can be more affordable than neighboring major metropolitan markets. Whether you prefer outdoor recreation, cultural experiences, or a relaxed suburban lifestyle, Lancaster offers an outstanding place to live, work, and build a future.

Build your future with Keystone Urology Specialists—where clinical autonomy, collaboration, and long-term professional growth come together. Apply today!

Patients Come First.
Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve.

A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level.
Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence.

True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients.
Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage.

Outcomes Matter.
Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide.

Interested in learning more?
We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care.

Be empowered to make your best next career move!

The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com.

The Specialty Alliance Corporate Headquarters, 550 Reserve St., Suite 550, Southlake, TX 76092, USA
