jobs.title: Senior Manager, Center of Excellence
jobs.description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:



The Senior Manager, Center of Excellence, runs the day-to-day work of a new team responsible for the accuracy of contract, subscription, and renewal data in Salesforce across Instructure and Parchment product lines. This role shares the Director's remit and acts as an extension of that leadership, with a hands-on focus on data hygiene and on building and enforcing the quote-to-cash governance that drives the right behavior from field reps.



Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll help design how it operates: who owns what, how the work is divided, and how the team works with other back-office functions and the field. You'll also help shape business logic, testing, and rollout for our migration from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud. You'll manage a group of individual contributors, directing their daily work, coaching them, and supporting their career growth.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


OPERATING MODEL DESIGN

 - Partner with the Director to design the team's operating model from the ground up: roles, ownership, intake, and how work is divided across contract review, audits, and remediation.

 - Define handoffs and working agreements with Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Enterprise Systems, Global Shared Services, Legal, Finance, and Accounting so each team knows where its work starts and stops.

 - Set up how the field engages with the team, including request channels, escalation paths, and response expectations.

 - Revisit the model as volume, products, and systems change, and recommend adjustments to the Director.




DATA HYGIENE AND REMEDIATION

 - Run daily review of new quotes and contracts at the point of creation in Salesforce, making sure they meet clean data standards before they're saved.

 - Lead systematic audits of active contracts: consolidate contracts on accounts, confirm the accurate active contract, fix linkage, and validate available to renew values.

 - Prioritize the remediation backlog by business impact, with input from Sales and Renewals on high-value accounts, co-terming corrections, and consolidations.

 - Own the team's SLAs for reviews, audits, and remediation. Track performance weekly and resolve bottlenecks as they come up.

 - Write and maintain the playbooks, SOPs, and checklists the team uses for contract entry and data validation.




QUOTE-TO-CASH GOVERNANCE AND ENFORCEMENT

 - Turn quote-to-cash policies into clear, enforceable rules for the field, covering opportunity types, contract structure, co-terming, bundling, and approvals.

 - Enforce standards consistently. Flag non-compliant deals, work with reps and their managers to correct them, and track repeat issues by team and rep.

 - Identify root causes behind recurring data problems and propose preventative fixes, such as validation rules, required fields, approval steps, or targeted training.

 - Partner with Revenue Operations on field enablement so reps understand the standards and why they matter.

 - Report monthly on compliance rates, top data issues, remediation progress, and field feedback.




AGENTFORCE REVENUE MANAGEMENT MIGRATION

 - Support the Director in representing the Center of Excellence in the migration from Salesforce CPQ to Agentforce Revenue Managemnt (i.e., ARM fka Revenue Cloud)

 - Help define business logic and requirements for contracts, subscriptions, renewals, amendments, and co-terming, based on what the team sees in day-to-day work.

 - Support the creation of test scenarios and take part in user acceptance testing, including edge cases from legacy and Parchment contracts.

 - Support data migration readiness by identifying records that need cleanup before cutover.

 - Help with rollout: update SOPs, train the team, support field adoption, and triage issues after go-live.




PEOPLE LEADERSHIP

 - Manage a team of contract specialists and analysts. Assign and prioritize daily work, and keep the team focused on the highest-impact items.

 - Hold regular one-on-ones, give direct feedback, and coach team members on judgment calls in contract review and field conversations.

 - Support career growth through development plans, stretch assignments, and clear expectations for each role level.

 - Help the Director hire, onboard, and train new team members as the team grows.

 - Build a team culture of accuracy, ownership, and practical service to the field.




CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP

 - Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Sales and Renewals leaders on contract data and governance questions.

 - Work with Enterprise Systems to document requirements for Salesforce improvements, validation rules, and automation.

 - Collaborate with Deal Desk and Revenue Operations on policy updates and approval standards.

 - Escalate systemic issues and policy gaps to the Director with clear data on impact.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, Order Management, or Data Governance within B2B SaaS.

 - 3+ years of people management experience, including directing daily work, coaching, and supporting career development.

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce, including CPQ, opportunities, quotes, contracts, and subscription data.

 - Strong understanding of SaaS subscription models, multi-product bundling, contract structure, co-terming, amendments, renewals, and usage-based contracts.

 - Experience building or running a team, process, or function from the ground up, including defining roles and workflows.

 - Track record of enforcing policy with field teams while keeping working relationships strong.

 - Experience participating in a CPQ or quote-to-cash system implementation, including requirements and user acceptance testing.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to find root causes in data and processes.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort holding firm on standards with sales leaders.

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud (Revenue Lifecycle Management), or a migration from CPQ to Revenue Cloud.

 - Experience in the EdTech or education software industry.

 - Background in billing, revenue accounting, or bookings, where data accuracy feeds financial reporting.

 - Experience building SOPs, playbooks, and training for operations teams.

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce reports, dashboards, and validation rules.

 - Familiarity with process automation tools and an eye for automation opportunities.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The People team’s goal is to make Plaid the highlight of every employee’s career. To do that, we’re rebuilding HR for an AI-first company. We want HR to be seamless, proactive, and personal at scale, so employees get support when they need it and the People team can spend its time on higher-value work.

As People Operations Manager, you’ll lead the team that runs onboarding, employee lifecycle changes, HR case management, compliance, and immigration, and you’ll redesign those processes for AI and automation. You’ll manage a team of three Operations specialists, including an Immigration Specialist, and report to the Head of People Technology, AI and Operations.


This is a hands-on role. You’ll map processes, configure workflows, and lead your team through change, working closely with People Systems, Finance, Tech Ops, and HR Business Partners.

Responsibilities

Redesign People Operations for an AI-first model

 - Define and own the multi-year People Operations strategy and roadmap, in line with our broader HR AI strategy.

 - Own the redesign of core processes (onboarding, job and pay changes, leave, offboarding, employment verification, and HR case handling) so AI and automation handle routine work and the team handles exceptions.

 - Partner with People Systems to expand what the AI assistant, ticketing, and knowledge management systems can resolve, and keep the knowledge base accurate.

 - Define and own team metrics, including self-service resolution rate, time to resolution, employee satisfaction, and HR capacity freed up.

 - Pilot new tools and workflows, and decide what to scale or stop.

Lead and develop the team

 - Manage and develop three direct reports.

 - Shift the team’s work from transaction processing to process design, quality control, and exception handling.

 - Build the team’s AI skills through hands-on use.

Run reliable, compliant operations

 - Own the accuracy and auditability of employee data and transactions in our HR systems.

 - Manage the Immigration Specialist who runs our U.S. immigration program, and provide high-level guidance on decisions, priorities, and compliance risk.

 - Support audits, policy administration, and regulatory requirements.

Cross-functional partnership

 - Partner with Finance on payroll inputs, headcount changes, and reconciliations.

 - Partner with Tech Ops on access, equipment, and onboarding and offboarding handoffs.

 - Partner with HR Business Partners to turn recurring employee and manager issues into process fixes.

 - Represent the employee experience in decisions about HR tools and workflows.

Qualifications

 - 7+ years in People Operations, including experience managing a People Operations team and setting People Operations strategy, ideally at a fast-paced tech company.

 - Experience implementing tools that improved People Operations efficiency, such as ticketing, a knowledge base, or workflow automation, with measurable results.

 - Ability to redesign processes from first principles for AI and automation, not just digitize existing steps.

 - Direct, hands-on experience with Workday and working familiarity with the wider People tech stack, including the ability to configure workflows, document processes, and work with data.

 - Track record of working with Finance, Tech Ops, People Technology, and HR Business Partners.

 - Clear communication, sound judgment on sensitive employee matters, and the ability to lead a team through change.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools at work, with judgment on which ones deliver real efficiency gains, is a plus.

 - Experience building automations, AI agents, or no-code workflows is a plus.

 - Familiarity with ticketing and knowledge management platforms and AI-enabled HR tools is a plus.

 - Experience managing a specialist or working with outside counsel on U.S. immigration matters is a plus.

 - Experience partnering with People Analytics or data teams on reporting and data quality is a plus.

jobs.title: RF Engineer
jobs.location: Broomfield, Colorado, United States; Fort Collins, Colorado, United States
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

RF Engineer

Location: Broomfield, Colorado, United States; Fort Collins, Colorado, United States

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Anduril Battlespace Awareness Radar team develops state-of-the-art radar systems, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The Radar team is seeking an experienced RF Engineer to help us design, test, and deploy the next generation of US radars. The Radar team is responsible for all aspects of radar system development, from the ideation stage through initial production. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define RF architectures, design, build, and test prototypes, and mature these prototypes into products.

About the Job

Anduril is seeking an RF Engineer to build active electronically scanned arrays (AESAs) for radar applications across a range of frequency bands (depending on the program) — from architecture definition through hardware bring-up, field testing, and initial production. The team owns the full stack: antenna element design, RF front-end (RFFE) electronics, array integration, and the test infrastructure to verify it all. We move fast, hold high standards, and are looking for engineers who want their fingerprints on fielded systems.

What You'll Do

• Design: Develop the RF design of analog beamforming AESA subsystems — incorporating T/R modules, beamforming ICs, corporate feed networks, and front-end filtering — for radar applications. Conduct trade studies, RF simulations, and prototyping to drive innovation and ensure optimal system performance.

• Cross-Domain Collaboration: Work across antenna, digital, mechanical, and systems engineering to define array architectures that meet the needs of users in the field. Bake in design excellence, including DFM and DFT, so that our systems can support the warfighter for the long-haul.

• Test: Drive RF characterization of AESA hardware — including near-field antenna range measurements, RFFE performance mapping, and system-level radar mode verification. Conduct the troubleshooting process when hardware doesn't behave and drive root cause to closure.

• Support: Provide engineering support at field tests to display product capabilities to customers.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, computer engineering or related field.

• 4+ years of professional experience in developing RF electronics, phased arrays, antennas or related radar electronics.

• Experience with electronic systems engineering, including design specification, part selection, and test planning for RF systems.

• Proficiency in RF design and analysis tools such as Ansys HFSS, Keysight ADS, or comparable tools.

• Experience in PCB design (schematic capture, specifying and reviewing layout), with experience in tools like Altium.

• Proven ability to break down complex problems and implement innovative solutions with attention to detail.

• Proficiency with RF measurement equipment, including Network Analyzers, Signal Analyzers, and Near Field Scanners.

• Familiarity in programming languages such as Python, C++, or similar for design, simulation, and automated testing.

• Demonstrated experience working across multidisciplinary teams in fast-paced environments.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's in RF/Microwave Engineering.

• Experience designing and testing active phased array radar with beamforming technologies.

• Knowledge of antenna array simulation, design, and manufacturing.

• Experience with PCB technologies for high-frequency RF and high-density interconnect routing, such as microvias, multiple sub-laminations, etc.

Transcripts

We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

US Salary Range

$114,000—$152,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Quality Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Quality at Dealpath is evolving with the product, and you will help lead the next stage.

Our product is becoming more AI-powered, and our approach to quality is moving with it. We are shifting from a centralized QA team to a model where delivery teams own quality end to end, supported by embedded Quality Engineers. This role helps lead that shift. You will see across our people, process, and systems, choose where to invest next, and bring the Quality Engineers together around a shared vision.

This is a player-coach role. You will stay close to the technical work and use it to coach and guide the Quality Engineers across our delivery teams. As the team comes together, you will shape how it works and grows, and the standards you help set will carry across every delivery team.

This is a full-time role with a hybrid schedule that includes three days a week in the office in San Francisco.

What you’ll own

• Find the next gains: Study our people, process, and systems to spot where issues can be caught earlier, then decide what changes, whether that is automation, process, tooling, or people.

• Set the standard: Define test strategy, release criteria, and tooling that every delivery team builds on.

• Coach and grow the team: Guide the embedded Quality Engineers, run the QE community of practice, and set the hiring bar.

• Choose what to automate: Review test design and code, and build shared frameworks where the team needs them.

• Shape how we test AI: Define how we test AI-powered and agentic features, and coach the team on AI tools.

• Show the results: Run blameless postmortems and publish a scorecard of escape rates and trends for engineering leadership.

• Shape engineering strategy: Work with the VP of Engineering and Engineering Managers on quality culture and where engineering goes next.

What we’re looking for

• Quality team experience: 7+ years in quality engineering, SDET, or similar roles, including leading or guiding a QA team or function. Heads of QA and leaders of QA divisions often do well in this role.

• Hands-on technical work: You stay close to the work, from analysis to test design to automation. Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar, and one language used in modern SaaS (TypeScript, Python, or Go).

• Evidence-based approach: A record of analyzing a quality process, choosing the metrics that matter, and cutting escaped defects.

• Cross-team influence: Experience building adoption of quality practices across Engineering, Product, Design, and Customer Success.

• AI fluency: Regular use of tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude, with a deliberate review step before relying on the output.

• Root cause methods: Experience with blameless postmortems and structured RCA, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone, or CAPA.

• Startup pace: Comfort in a fast-moving, growth-stage environment.

• Education: BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

• AI evals: Evals for LLM-based or agentic features (datasets, graders, LLM-as-judge, regression suites in CI), with tools such as LangSmith, Braintrust, or DeepEval.

• Observability and analytics: Sentry, Datadog, Pendo, or Amplitude used to guide test strategy.

• Domain: Real estate, fintech, or enterprise B2B SaaS.

• Transformation: Led a move from manual testing to automation.

• AI-native company: Experience at an AI-era startup.

• Specialty depth: Performance, security, or chaos engineering.

• Public work: Conference talks or open source contributions.

The Perks & Culture:

• Medical, dental, & vision insurance coverage

• Hybrid 3-days in office policy in San Francisco

• Flexible Spending Account

• Paid Parental Leave

• 401(k)

• Company-sponsored commuter benefits

• Flexible time off policy

• Catered lunches and snacks

• Monthly wellness reimbursement

• The estimated pay range for San Francisco candidates for this position is $ 180,000– $230,000 base.

• This position is also eligible for Dealpath’s equity plan. Your compensation will be based upon several factors including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and the skills assessed in Dealpath’s interview process.

• Your actual compensation will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.

• Dealpath’s compensation ranges are determined by current market data, so compensation data posted on our job posts may change as new market data becomes available.

About Dealpath

Dealpath is the world’s largest and most trusted AI-powered operating system for real estate investing. To date, the platform has powered more than $10 trillion in transactions, partnering with hundreds of firms, including leading global institutions such as Blackstone, Nuveen, LaSalle, CBRE IM, MetLife, Newmark, New York Life, UBS, Manulife, DWS, and Principal.

By bringing together the only private exchange for institutional real estate listings, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows into a single platform, Dealpath enables firms to capture more opportunities, make faster decisions, execute efficiently, and deliver superior returns.

Our company is led by an experienced team and backed by a combination of top tier venture capital firms and strategic industry partners including: Blackstone, Nasdaq, 8VC, JLL Spark, WTI, GreenSoil Investments, LeFrak, Milstein, Bechtel, and Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital.

We value your voice! If you get excited about solving real business challenges and working closely with other smart folks in a winning culture — we’d love to meet you!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Pontera is a fintech company on a mission to help people retire better. Our software platform enables retirement savers to get the help they need managing their 401(k) and other retirement plan accounts as part of a personalized strategy by their trusted financial advisor.

Pontera is used by financial advisors across the nation– from SMB to Fortune 500 RIA firms, independent broker-dealers, plan custodians, and plan advisors.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including ICONIQ Growth and Lightspeed Venture Partners, Pontera is built by talented individuals who share a dedication to helping people retire with greater security.

Our team is fast-growing and driven to become one of the largest fintech companies in the world.  Our culture is built on a people-first principle: in a complex and numbers-driven industry, we never lose sight of the people we serve and work alongside. That’s where you come in.

DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build the data foundation and AI tools that help teams across Pontera work more effectively. You will build reliable pipelines, develop semantic models that make business data understandable to people and AI agents, and turn that foundation into useful applications and automated workflows.

You will work directly with our Data and go-to-market teams, including Sales, Marketing, RevOps and Customer Success. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with the autonomy to shape solutions and see their impact in everyday business use.

About the Team

We have moved from traditional, dashboard-led BI to conversational analytics. Business teams across Pontera use our agents to explore data, ask follow-up questions and get answers independently, within their access permissions. We are now taking the next step: building automated workflows that help colleagues act on those insights and complete work with less manual effort.

Data has become a central partner to the business. From customer support copilots to sales intelligence and client preparation, we build for practical value: better decisions, time back for business teams and stronger outcomes.

AI adoption and literacy are high within the team. We work with Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran and use AI tools like Claude and Cortex Code (CoCo) throughout development, investigation and problem-solving. We continually share what we learn and help colleagues across the company use AI confidently and effectively through hands-on enablement, reusable tools and ongoing support.

We are a team of strong, independent individual contributors who own their work from understanding the problem through delivery and adoption. We also share context, review each other's work and help one another get past obstacles. Everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas, question assumptions and influence decisions. We value different backgrounds and perspectives, make room for respectful disagreement and expect people to listen as thoughtfully as they speak.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build and maintain data pipelines and integrations using SQL, Python, DBT and Snowflake. Bring together operational, CRM and third-party data, and create reusable models that support analytics and business workflows.

• Develop semantic models and views with clear metric definitions, entity relationships, business rules and verified example queries. Make the same trusted definitions usable across agents, applications and reporting.

• Build and improve AI agents, copilots and automated workflows that combine structured data, documents and business tools. Work on use cases such as client intelligence, call preparation, customer support and sales productivity.

• Partner directly with business teams to understand their processes, question assumptions and identify where better data or automation will help. Turn ambiguous requests into practical solutions and support them after launch.

• Use AI coding assistants and development tools in your own work, and help the Data team develop repeatable practices for using them well. Review generated code, validate results and share what works.

• Help technical and business colleagues use AI tools effectively through hands-on sessions, documentation, reusable examples and coaching. Use their feedback to improve the tools and workflows you build.

• Build quality and reliability into the full solution, including data tests, monitoring, agent evaluations, version control and deployment practices. Work with Engineering and Security on appropriate access, permissions and human review.

• Measure whether solutions are useful in practice through sustained adoption, output quality, time saved and improvements in business workflows. Balance new development with maintenance, performance and cost.

REQUIREMENTS

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a closely related role, with ownership of production data pipelines and models.

• Strong SQL and Python skills, experience with cloud data warehouses, and a solid understanding of dimensional modeling, ELT, API integrations and data quality. Hands-on experience with Snowflake and DBT is preferred.

• Practical experience building an AI agent, LLM application or automated workflow that uses real data. You can explain how it was evaluated, where it failed and what you learned. You use AI tools in your own development and can recognize when their output needs correction.

• Strong business judgment and the ability to learn unfamiliar processes quickly. You can connect technical choices to what users need and explain tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Experience helping others adopt new tools or practices through mentoring, training, documentation or direct support. You are comfortable working with users whose technical experience varies.

• An ownership mindset: you take work from discovery through implementation and ongoing improvement, collaborate openly, and care about whether people actually use what you build.

Nice to Have

• Experience with semantic layers or conversational analytics.

• Experience with Snowflake Cortex or similar agent tooling.

• Experience with GTM systems such as Salesforce, Gong or Zendesk.

• Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech is helpful.

What Success Looks Like

The solutions you build become part of how teams at Pontera work every day. You partner with business stakeholders to define the problem and what improvement would look like, then deliver tools that save time, improve decisions or increase the team’s capacity. You can explain what changed and show evidence of the value created.

Your data pipelines and semantic models provide a dependable foundation for analytics, agents and automated workflows. Business definitions are clear, outputs are tested, and teams can trust the answers they receive. New use cases build on reusable models and components, making each subsequent solution easier to deliver and maintain.

Business teams become more independent in how they use data. They can explore questions, understand the answers and take informed action within their permissions. Recurring questions and manual requests increasingly become opportunities for better self-service, giving the Data team more time for deeper problems and new capabilities.

The agents and workflows you deliver work reliably beyond the initial launch. They have appropriate evaluation, monitoring, documentation and access controls, with clear handling of failures and situations that require human review. You use feedback and observed usage to improve quality, usefulness and cost over time.

You raise the AI capabilities of the people around you. Through practical guidance, shared examples and collaboration, colleagues become more confident using AI, evaluating its output and applying it to their own work. Within the Data team, the approaches you develop help others build faster while maintaining sound engineering judgment.

You take ownership from discovery through ongoing improvement. You identify opportunities, make thoughtful tradeoffs, communicate progress and surface risks early. Your work is documented and understandable to others, and you actively share knowledge, support teammates and contribute to an environment where different perspectives improve the decisions we make.

WHAT WE OFFER

• Compensation: The compensation range for this role is $180,000 to $220,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

• Opportunity: Build data and AI solutions that directly improve how business teams work.

• Team Culture: A collegial, collaborative, fun work environment with frequent team events

• Equity: All new hires are eligible for equity grant participation

• Healthcare: Comprehensive & affordable insurance benefits with a variety of plan options

• Retirement: 401(k) with employer match & employer-sponsored access to a retirement advisor

• Family Benefits: Paid parental leave & reimbursement program for family planning services (such as fertility treatments, adoption, or surrogacy

• Professional Development: Sponsored learning & development program (to cover classes, certifications, and more!)

• Food Perks: Fully stocked kitchen & lunch reimbursement program

• Work Flexibility: A hybrid office work model (In-Office Tues/Weds/Thurs and WFH Mon/Fri) & generous PTO day

Pontera is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:

Do you remember the professor who encouraged you to believe in yourself and in your ability to be the successful nurse professional you are today?  Now you have the unique opportunity to be that professor  and create the "a-ha" moment of sudden insight and comprehension that will change a nursing student's life forever. As a Part-Time Visiting Professor, you will inspire our motivated students to realize their educational and career goals while enjoying a flexible schedule, excellent compensation, strong mentorship and support programs, plus significant opportunities for career growth. From individual professor support and student-led study groups to diverse clinical and career networking opportunities, the institution's community shares a common goal: to give each other the care we need to succeed and make a difference by transforming healthcare.   If you are passionate about nursing and advancing your career through the power of education, we want to talk with you today.

Teaching is onsite (in clinical setting) with one of our clinical partners. Schedule: most commonly 12-hour rotations (7a-7p) for three to four consecutive days.

Fundamental Nursing Skills- Content focuses on health promotion and the rehabilitative aspects of patient care. Students provide direct patient care in the acquisition of skills and concepts of professional nursing. The nursing process is utilized as the student implements basic aspects of nursing practice.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Enablement
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

Justworkers are already using AI to solve problems, build applications, and automate their work. They know their challenges best, and we're building an AI Enablement team to give them the tools, engineering expertise, and support to turn their ideas into reliable, secure, production-ready solutions.

As our Senior Manager, AI Enablement, you'll lead a new team focused on making AI-powered development and automation more accessible across Justworks. You'll start with one senior engineer, help hire another, and build a collaborative environment where both can grow, learn from each other, and do their best work.

Together, your team will own our core employee AI platform, develop purpose-built AI agents and automation, and establish the engineering foundations that help Justworkers build and deploy applications independently. You'll bring together expertise in applied AI, enterprise systems, and software engineering to deliver solutions that make a meaningful difference in how people work.

We're looking for a people-first leader who genuinely enjoys developing engineers and hasn't lost their curiosity for building things. Someone who can guide technical decisions, get hands-on when needed, and knows when to step back and let their team take ownership. You'll lead with trust, coaching, and thoughtful feedback while helping your engineers grow beyond their individual areas of expertise.

This is a new function within IT Services, with a clear mission and plenty of room to shape how it operates. You'll have the opportunity to build a team, establish its culture and technical direction, and make a lasting impact on how Justworkers use technology to get things done.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop the AI Enablement Team

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of senior engineers with complementary expertise in enterprise AI platforms, integrations, applied AI, and software engineering.

• Establish the team's technical direction, priorities, engineering practices, and delivery processes.

• Remain hands-on with solution architecture, development, debugging, and technical problem-solving.

• Partner with stakeholders across Justworks to understand business needs, prioritize opportunities, and deliver solutions with measurable impact.

• Build a culture of technical ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

Own and Evolve the Employee AI Platform

• Oversee the administration, integration, reliability, and ongoing evolution of Claude and Cowork as Justworks' core employee AI platform.

• Guide the development of integrations, MCP servers, APIs, and automation that extend platform capabilities and connect AI to enterprise systems.

• Partner with Security, Governance, and other technical teams to establish appropriate controls for data access, authentication, authorization, and responsible AI usage.

• Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can improve employee productivity or unlock new workflows.

Build Agentic AI Solutions

• Lead the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of AI agents and applications that solve real business problems.

• Build systems that go beyond conversational AI, enabling agents to interact with tools, execute workflows, and take actions across enterprise applications.

• Establish engineering approaches for agent orchestration, tool calling, context management, error handling, evaluation, and observability.

• Work with business and technical partners to translate opportunities into practical, maintainable solutions.

• Balance rapid experimentation with the security, reliability, and operational requirements of production systems.

Enable Employee-Built Applications

• Help employees successfully develop, deploy, and maintain applications created using AI-assisted development tools.

• Provide technical leadership when employee-built applications encounter challenges involving dependencies, runtime environments, APIs, authentication, deployment, or application architecture.

• Establish reusable deployment patterns, templates, tooling, and CI/CD practices that reduce friction between local development and production.

• Develop engineering standards and guardrails that make secure, reliable application development easier for employees.

• Ensure the team provides targeted engineering assistance without becoming the default owner or support team for every employee-built application.

Drive Education, Adoption, and Continuous Improvement

• Guide the development of office hours, workshops, documentation, and self-service resources that help employees build and operate solutions independently.

• Identify recurring development and deployment challenges and turn them into reusable tools, guidance, or platform improvements.

• Establish meaningful measures of AI platform adoption, agent performance, deployment success, employee enablement, and business value.

• Use employee feedback and operational data to continuously improve the team's capabilities and priorities.

What We're Looking For

• Significant professional experience in software engineering, applied AI, or platform engineering, with enough depth to architect systems, review code, and contribute directly to the team’s technical work.

• A minimum of 4 years managing engineers directly, with full responsibility for hiring, performance, and career development. Tech lead experience alone is not a substitute.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered applications or agents using modern large language models.

• Strong understanding of agentic AI architectures, including tool calling, agent orchestration, APIs, and integrations with external systems.

• Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language, with the ability to review code, troubleshoot unfamiliar applications, and contribute directly to engineering solutions.

• Experience building and operating production applications, including deployment, dependency management, CI/CD, monitoring, and incident troubleshooting.

• Strong understanding of software architecture, API design, authentication, authorization, and secure development practices.

• Experience with cloud platforms, containerization, and modern application deployment patterns.

• Ability to balance hands-on technical contributions with engineering leadership, prioritization, and team development.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with employees and stakeholders who have varying levels of technical experience.

• A practical approach to AI: focused on solving real problems, improving workflows, and delivering sustainable solutions rather than adopting technology for its own sake.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Claude, Anthropic APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or comparable AI platforms and integration frameworks.

• Experience with agent development frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK, or similar orchestration tools.

• Experience establishing internal developer platforms, engineering enablement programs, or self-service development capabilities.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools and the challenges of moving generated applications into production.

• Experience implementing evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and reliability controls for AI agents.

• Experience working in regulated environments where security, privacy, and compliance are important considerations.

• Experience building or scaling a new engineering team or technical function.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you'll have:

• Established a clear technical roadmap and operating model for the AI Enablement team.

• Built a collaborative team where engineers share expertise and can contribute across the team's responsibilities.

• Improved the reliability, capabilities, and accessibility of Justworks' employee AI platform.

• Delivered production-ready AI agents or automation that solve meaningful business problems.

• Introduced reusable engineering tools and deployment standards that help employees successfully move applications into production.

• Established education and self-service resources that reduce recurring technical barriers.

• Developed visibility into AI adoption, employee-built applications, recurring engineering challenges, and the impact of the team's work.

Above all, success means more Justworkers can confidently build and ship reliable applications, whether they're powered by AI or built with AI.

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $188,000.00 - $242,000.00 per year.

Use of AI Tools. We may use artificial intelligence and other automated tools to process your personal information as part of the recruitment process. For example, we may use these tools to record, transcribe, and summarize interviews, to help organize and review applications, and to help us assess candidates by comparing their skills, experience, and qualifications against the criteria for open roles. These tools support, but do not replace, human review. We do not make hiring decisions based solely on automated processing, and all final hiring decisions are made by Justworks recruiters and hiring managers. Depending on where you reside, you may have rights regarding our use of automated tools. For more information, please contact us at privacy@justworks.com.#LI-Hybrid #LI-RG1

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks.

Diversity At Justworks

Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at accommodations@justworks.com. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.

jobs.title: DRG QA/Training Manager
jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

About the Opportunity

The DRG QA/Training Manager leads the quality assurance and training team supporting Machinify’s DRG Clinical Validation function, including MS-DRG and APR-DRG validation. Reporting to the Sr. Director, DRG Operations, this role manages the DRG QA/Trainers, owns the audit program for new and existing DRG Reviewers, and directs onboarding and ongoing training so reviewers apply current clinical, coding, and organizational standards. The manager works with the DRG Clinical Educator, DRG Managers, and cross-functional partners to turn audit findings into training, process changes, and measurable quality improvement.

What you’ll do

Team Leadership:

• Lead the DRG QA/Trainer team by setting goals, assigning and prioritizing audit and training work, and coordinating daily activities

• Provide guidance, counsel, and development plans that support long-term retention and professional growth of QA/Trainer staff

• Communicate priorities, updates, and expectations through regular one-on-one and team meetings

• Monitor individual and team results to ensure audits and training are completed on time and in accordance with department standards

Quality Assurance:

• Own the QA audit program for new and existing DRG Reviewers, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with established coding and clinical validation guidelines

• Review QA/Trainer audit findings for consistency and calibrate the team on audit criteria and feedback

• Ensure DRG Reviewers receive constructive, detailed feedback that highlights areas for improvement and recognizes high-performance results

• Identify problems and trends in audit results, determine root causes, and implement corrective action plans

• Collaborate with leadership to drive continuous improvement in audit accuracy, workflow efficiency, and reviewer performance

Training & Education:

• Partner with the educator to plan and deliver new-hire training on DRG methodologies, clinical validation, and proprietary tools

• Oversee ongoing training for existing staff, focusing on policy updates, skill development, and performance enhancement

• Direct the development and maintenance of training materials and resources, using audit trends to target content where it is needed

• Evaluate the effectiveness of training sessions and adjust content based on quality results

Policy, Documentation & Reporting:

• Develop departmental QA policies, processes, and training standards

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of audit findings, feedback sessions, and training activities

• Provide reports on key performance indicators, including quality scores, audit outcomes, and training effectiveness, on a predetermined schedule

• Set timelines, communicate progress, track delivery, and escalate roadblocks or dependencies

• Serve as an expert resource for DRG Reviewers, QA/Trainers, and other staff members, answering questions and offering guidance on complex cases or procedures

• Provide internal and external partners with evidence and references supporting industry standards, auditing guidelines, and review stances

Qualifications:

• Previous supervisory experience required

• Experience in production and team management

• Experience conducting training for clinical or coding staff

• Experience with readmission reviews

• Deep curiosity and analytical skills to understand root causes of events and behaviors

• Strong experience in data use and insights, including independently structuring and executing complex analyses

jobs.title: Senior Staff Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Mechanical Engineering team at Form is focused on designing the battery cell, module, and full pack system that forms the foundation of our innovative utility-scale multi-day energy storage system.  We strive to deliver designs that are optimized for performance, quality, reliability, and cost for high-volume manufacturing at Form Factory.



We're hiring a highly experienced Senior Staff Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the architecture and design of our air handling systems. This is a critical part of Form’s iron-air battery technology and it is vital to the system’s successful operation. In this role, you will be a technical cornerstone for the product architecture, detailed design stages, first-of-a-kind build activities, strategic vendor engagement, and design for cost. You can expect to oversee the building and validation of complex system models, direct prototyping efforts across the company, drive us through a series of internal system prototypes, and act as a technical leader bridging cross-functional teams of chemical, electrical, and mechanical engineers. You will hold ultimate technical responsibility for design validation before the final manufacturing release.



If this sounds like the right position for you, apply now! This opportunity will help shape and scale our multi-day energy storage system, contributing to the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission, contributing to a sustainable future!

 

Relocation assistance is available. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Lead the architecture, design, prototyping, and testing of air handling systems, ensuring they meet and exceed critical performance and strategic requirements

 - Oversee the development of complex thermal flow system analytical models that drive fundamental design architecture decisions

 - Direct the fabrication and testing strategies for first-of-a-kind prototypes to validate system design choices and mitigate technical risks at scale

 - Drive the overarching strategy for high volume production, ensuring product designs are optimized for scale, cost, and reliability

 - Lead complex system-level collaboration with the Electrical and Controls teams to optimize actuator and sensor integration

 - Serve as a technical pillar within the organization, mentoring engineers across levels, elevating our mechanical engineering best practices, and championing safety, especially in the development of new laboratory processes

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field; Bachelor's with 12+ years (or Master’s/PhD with 10+ years) of industry experience in mechanical design of equipment, liquid or gas handling systems

 - Deep expertise in first-principles modeling and design, with a proven track record of optimizing complex designs for high-volume manufacturing and cost-down

 - Extensive experience leading projects in a manufacturing environment and managing strategic relationships with manufacturing engineering teams.

 - Industry-leading experience optimizing mechanical design, thermodynamic systems, and complex interdisciplinary interfaces of fluid systems

 - Sense of urgency and self-driven to hit difficult schedule targets

 - Direct experience in product development within an early-stage environment ramping into production, with a history of driving technical strategy.

 

#LI-Onsite

#LI-EH1



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: SSC AR Lead
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Supports centralized delinquency and legal/eviction operations across AIR’s portfolio. Acts as a subject matter expert and point of escalation for delinquency-related questions, resident concerns, and administrative support needs. Provides day-to-day operational support to onsite and central teams to ensure delinquency follow up, legal tracking, FMO, and service standards are consistently met.

Essential Functions: Resolves complex and escalated resident delinquency-related issues requiring independent judgment, coordination, and problem-solving. Uses internal property management systems (e.g., Entrata) to generate demands, process legal cases, manage and close FMOs, audit and troubleshoot workflows. Serves as a central support resource to onsite and SSC teams by providing process guidance, responding to escalated inquiries, and supporting operational initiatives.

Key responsibilities include:

• Uses computerized system for tracking, information gathering, auditing, and/or trouble-shooting to monitor, process and/or audit stages of the resident payment and eviction cycle
• Communicates with internal and external partners, and current residents; assist with peer coaching, handle escalated and unresolved calls from less experienced representatives
• Utilizes internal systems to monitor account activity, track performance, and ensure accurate notations and follow up throughout the delinquency lifecycle. Investigates and resolves discrepancies in accordance with established policies and procedures
• Provides guidance, coaching, and support to team members, including assisting with training, workflow coordination, and performance management
• Supports changes in legislation as communicated by counsel, communicating with team and ensuring compliance against changes in process
• Maintains active ownership of a designated delinquency portfolio by engaging residents, addressing delinquency concerns, and ensuring timely, accurate completion of delinquency related processes

• Serves as escalation point for resident matters and complex issues; ensure timely resolution and maintain data integrity through audits and corrections
• Support team operations through training, coaching, workflow distribution, and daily prioritization
• Partner with onsite teams and SSC functions to drive alignment and operational efficiency

Supervisory Responsibilities: Non-supervisory; provide guidance and support to team members.

Education & Experience: High School Diploma or equivalent required. Minimum of 3 years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of property management systems (Entrata preferred)
• Proven experience with delinquency and legal follow up, resident communication, and closing accounts
• Excellent customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to manage a personal workload and portfolio while supporting broader team needs
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
• Aptitude to work independently, prioritize tasks, and adapt to changing operational demands in a fast-paced environment
• Ability to interpret and apply policies and procedures

Work Environment: Office environment

AIR offers attractive total compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance at the individual, team and company levels. We start with a competitive base salary and add bonus opportunities and benefit choices topped off with:

• Expected base pay range of $31-34/hr. You will be provided a pay rate that is in line with your skills and experience as they relate to the requirements of the job.
• Paid time off including vacation, sick time, and 14 holidays.
• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options, HSA/FSA plans, short and long-term disability paid by the company.
• 25% Rent Discount at any AIR community (a rental application is required, and certain exclusions apply).
• 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer contribution.
• Paid parental leave of up to 16 weeks.
• Tuition assistance program and up to 100% reimbursement for job-related certifications and licenses.
• 15 hours of paid time annually for community service.
• Commuter benefits and pet insurance.
• Consumer discounts on various products and services.
• Opportunities for ongoing professional development, leadership training, and career growth.

jobs.title: Principal Privacy Biostatistician - Risk Analytics
jobs.description:
Senior Privacy Biostatistician - Risk Analytics

Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.

This position is based out of our headquarters in the Greater Seattle area. #LI-remote

Who We Need

We're looking for a principal-level statistical privacy expert who sets the direction for disclosure risk strategy across Truveta's entire data platform — structured, imaging, clinical notes, and emerging areas like genomic data — and who already holds the judgment, track record, and credibility to sign Expert Determinations under HIPAA. Beyond deep technical mastery, we're seeking a recognized leader who defines the methodological standards others follow, serves as the final technical authority on the most complex and novel determinations, develops senior and junior team members toward independent signing authority, and represents Truveta's privacy rigor to health system partners, customers, regulators, and the broader scientific community.

This Opportunity

The Principal Privacy Biostatistician reports to the Senior Director of Risk Analytics and serves as the senior technical authority for statistical disclosure control across Truveta. This individual owns the de-identification methodology framework for the platform, signs Expert Determinations under 45 CFR §164.514(b)(1) for the highest-complexity, highest-visibility, and first-of-their-kind data products, and acts as the final reviewer and co-signer for determinations prepared by other members of the team.

There is no professional license or certification that confers this signing authority — it is earned through demonstrated, documented judgment, expertise and experience. This role is designed for someone who already holds that track record, has defended their determinations under scrutiny, and is ready to shape how the organization exercises that authority at scale.

Responsibilities:

• Set the vision and own the end-to-end statistical disclosure control framework for Truveta's data platform, defining the methodological standards, risk thresholds, and documentation requirements used by the entire Risk Analytics team.

• Serve as a signing Expert Determiner for the most complex, novel, and high-visibility data products, applying generally accepted statistical and scientific principles to determine that re-identification risk is "very small," and documenting the reasoning to a standard that stands on its own under audit, regulatory review, or legal challenge.

• Act as the final technical reviewer and co-signer for Expert Determinations prepared by Senior and staff Privacy Biostatisticians; establish and run the peer review and case-defense process that governs the team's signing authority.

• Lead the development of risk methodology for new and emerging data modalities (e.g., genomic data, linked multi-modality data, and AI/ML-derived data products), partnering with clinical informatics, Legal, and Product to define Truveta's approach before these products go to market.

• Own and continuously evolve profile-level risk justification methodology — dynamic k-anonymity thresholds, quasi-identifier importance ranking, suppression hierarchies, drift-triggered re-determination thresholds, and process-level Expert Determinations — ensuring it scales with platform growth.

• Integrate Truveta's HIPAA Security Rule posture into Privacy Rule risk determinations; partner with security and engineering leadership to influence infrastructure, architecture, and regulatory change strategy.

• Partner with Legal/Contracts to define the organization's standards for supplementary recipient-side controls on higher-residual-risk modalities, while consistently reinforcing that these controls do not serve as a substitute for the statistical "very small risk" determination.

• Represent Truveta as the privacy statistics subject-matter expert with health system members, customers, auditors, and regulators; contribute to external publications, conference presentations, and industry standards.

• Mentor and develop Senior and staff Privacy Biostatisticians, building a clear, documented pathway toward independent signing authority and growing the team's overall bench strength.

• Influence product and data strategy by identifying opportunities to improve data utility and usability while managing residual risk and mitigating controls across the platform.

Key Qualifications

• PhD in biostatistics, statistics, epidemiology, or related quantitative field; or Master's degree with equivalent depth of experience and demonstrated technical leadership.

• 10+ years of experience in statistical methods applied to patient health information, including extensive hands-on experience in statistical disclosure control and de-identification.

• Prior formal Expert Determination signing experience under HIPAA (internal or as an external consultant/expert witness), with a documented case history across multiple data modalities.

• Proven track record of defining and implementing de-identification methodology at an organizational or platform level, not just on individual datasets.

• Deep experience with multiple non-structured data modalities (imaging and/or clinical notes) in addition to structured EHR/claims data, including risk across linked modalities.

• Expert-level ability to reason across the HIPAA Privacy Rule / Security Rule boundary when estimating risk.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including producing documentation that stands alone under audit and explaining complex risk concepts to executives, partners, and regulators.

• Experience analyzing Real World Data in a research setting.

• Demonstrated success mentoring senior technical staff and developing others toward independent signing authority.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience defending Expert Determinations in regulatory, audit, litigation, or expert-witness settings.

• Experience designing and governing process Expert Determinations at scale.

• Advanced hands-on experience with SDC tools such as sdcMicro and dynamic/continuously-revalidated risk methodologies.

• Working familiarity with clinical informatics standards (HL7, FHIR, DICOM PS3.15 Annex E).

• Hands-on experience with genomic data privacy (e.g., VCF-level re-identification risk, familial risk, etc.).

• Record of peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or contributions to industry standards in privacy, disclosure control, or health data.

• Experience building or leading a privacy statistics or risk analytics function.

Why Truveta?

Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.

We Offer:

• Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage

• Great benefits package

• Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans

• 401K plan

• Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning

• Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off

• Generous parental leave

• Regular team activities (virtual and in-person)

Pay is based on several factors including location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles are eligible for additional compensation such as incentive pay and stock options.
