jobs.title: Graduate Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Graduate Product Analyst, you’ll join our North America Regional Analytics team in September 2027.

This full-time role is a chance to make a real impact early and kickstart your career. You’ll be onboarded with the global Graduate cohort in one of our offices and learn the basics of being a Wiser.

The Role:

We’re hiring three graduates to work as analysts inside our North America product teams, which build Wise for personal and business customers in the US and Canada. Our analysts don’t sit in a central reporting team: each one works day to day with product managers & engineers and helps them decide what to build next and whether it worked.

You’ll join one of four teams: Onboarding, Send, Account or Growth. Each owns a different stage of the customer’s journey with Wise, and each is described below. You won’t be on your own. A senior analyst will mentor you, review your work and help you grow, and you’ll be part of a team of analysts covering the whole North America product.

What you’ll be doing:

• Shape Strategy & Prioritization: You’ll help your team understand where customers struggle and what is worth fixing first. That means digging into funnels and customer behavior, reading customer feedback and survey responses, and sizing opportunities so the team can prioritize the work with the biggest impact. As you grow, you’ll lead your own discoveries and present recommendations to your product manager.
• Learn Launch Rigor & Experimentation: You’ll help design and analyze A/B tests and pre/post comparisons for new features, and learn to turn the results into a clear call: roll out, iterate or roll back. You’ll keep an eye on your team’s core metrics and flag when something looks wrong.
• Build on the Semantic Layer: We believe analysts add the most value when they focus on product discovery, not ad-hoc requests. You’ll learn to build and maintain the data models and dashboards that let your team answer their own questions, using Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow, Python and Lightdash, and help improve the AI skills that run our routine reporting.
• Share What You Learn: You’ll explain your findings to your team and the wider NorthAm squad, in writing, in charts and in person, so that your work leads to a decision.

How we work with AI:

We lean hard into AI: AI skills produce our routine work and deep dives, so our analysts can focus on discovery. You’ll use AI tools every day, and you’ll own the answer, not the tool: checking the data, the logic and the conclusion before anyone acts on it.

Where you could join:

Onboarding Onboarding owns the first steps of a customer’s journey: creating a profile, getting verified (Know Your Customer / Know Your Business checks) and taking a first action with Wise. It also keeps financial crime out at the front door. The core challenge is letting genuine customers through quickly while stopping bad actors. You might work on questions like:

• Where do new customers drop out between signing up and their first transfer, and what would bring them back?
• Which verification steps slow genuine customers down without catching more fraud or financial crime?

Send Send covers what happens when a customer sends money, and is made up of three teams:

• Pay-in: how customers pay money into Wise, for example by bank transfer (ACH) or card. Which payment methods help customers complete their transfer, and what does each one cost us?
• Payout: how money reaches recipients’ bank accounts in the US and Canada, balancing three levers: cost, speed and conversion. What would make these payouts faster or cheaper, and how much more volume would that bring? You’ll also help track the health of our banking partners.
• Payment Risk: transfer suspensions and ACH and card chargebacks. How do we cut losses from chargebacks and fraud without blocking good customers?

Account Account owns how customers use Wise as an account, not only for one-off transfers: getting paid into Wise with USD and CAD local account details, spending with the Wise debit card, and earning a return on money held with Wise. You might work on questions like:

• What makes a customer start getting paid into their Wise account, and what makes them keep doing it?
• Who uses the Wise card, for what, and what stops others from using it?
• Does holding money with Wise change how customers send money abroad?

Growth Growth owns the top of the funnel: how people find Wise and decide to try it. That covers landing pages, the promotion engine, corridor strategy (which country-to-country routes we focus on) and pricing, where you’ll work with our Pricing Data Science team to understand how price affects demand. You might work on questions like:

• Did a promotion bring in customers who stay, or customers who leave once it ends?
• Which corridors should we focus on next, and why?

Your first six months:

• By three months: you own part of your team’s regular metrics and have delivered your first analysis.
• By six months: you’ve led a discovery or an experiment readout from question to recommendation and presented it to your team.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring:

• Education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative field such as economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science or engineering, completed by your start date, or equivalent practical experience.
• Technical Foundations: You’ve used SQL, Python or R to answer a real question with data, in a course, a project, an internship or on your own. You understand the basics of statistics, such as distributions, hypothesis tests and confidence intervals, and can tell when a difference is real rather than noise.
• Curiosity & Product Sense: You want to know why customers behave the way they do, and you ask “so what should we do?” about every result.
• Clear Communication: You can explain a finding to someone who isn’t technical, in writing and in conversation, and you’re comfortable saying “I don’t know yet”.
• Ownership: You finish what you start, ask for help early and act on feedback.
• AI with Judgment: You use AI tools to work faster, and you check their output before you trust it.
• Right to Work: You must be authorized to work in the US. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have but not essential:

• Hands-on experience with any of Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow or Lightdash.
• Exposure to A/B testing or causal inference, in a course or in practice.
• An internship or project in analytics, data science, product or finance.
• An interest in payments, fintech, or how people move and manage money across borders.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

The Expansion Central Ops team is a global sub-function within Delivery Commercial Operations (DCO). We are the \"Scale Engine\" for the Account Management (AM) organization. Our mission is to empower every Account Manager to maximize their portfolio's growth at scale by ruthlessly eliminating capacity and operational friction, while building the unified tooling and operational infrastructure that enables them to save time and multiply their market impact.

As a Senior Central Operations Manager focusing on AM Tooling & Digital Transformation, you are a key architect of the daily digital experience for our Account Managers. Your mission is to move beyond routine tool maintenance into continuous operational innovation-eliminating software friction by equipping AMs with integrated insights and streamlined workflows. Preferred Qualifications

• Proven track record of leading end-to-end operational or tech implementation projects, including milestone management, risk mitigation, and tracking deliverables against key business metrics
• Direct experience acting as a bridge between commercial users and Product/Engineering teams, collecting user feedback, and shaping UI/UX requirements
• Proven track record of executing tool rollouts, migrations, or software adoption programs across global or multi-regional teams
• Proficiency in SQL to pull metrics and independently evaluate feature utilization and rep behavior within tools

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Us

Observe.AI is the enterprise-grade Customer Experience AI platform that unifies conversations, intelligence, and action to turn contact centers into performance engines. Built to optimize the full lifecycle of human and AI agents, Observe.AI enables enterprises to automate customer interactions, augment agent performance, and deliver governed AI at scale.

On a single platform, Observe.AI combines Voice and Chat AI Agents, real-time AI Copilots, and Conversation Intelligence with 100% interaction coverage for quality, compliance, and performance management. Trusted by leading brands, Observe.AI delivers fast time-to-value, measurable ROI, and consistent, high-quality customer experiences across every channel.

Why Join Us

You will build and own an enterprise territory, selling a technically complex AI platform to contact center owners and to the CIO, CTO, finance and, at times, CEO sponsors who fund the change. We sell to companies with 1,000 to 10,000 employees and roughly 300 to 2,000 contact center agents. In these companies the buying group is small enough to reach the executive who decides, and you are expected to reach them.

This is a high-ownership role with a high bar. You will land the platform through the intelligence that shows where automation pays off, then expand into AI agents. You will also help set the playbook that the next hires follow.

What Success Looks Like

• Land 5 or more new logos per year at a target ACV of $250K or more.

• Win one or two expansions or upsells inside your existing account base each year.

• Hold 4 to 5x pipeline coverage, with a meaningful share self-sourced in your own territory.

• Forecast within 10% of actual, using Commit, Strong Upside, Upside, and Pipeline.

What you'll be doing:

Own your territory like a CEO

• Build and run a territory plan for enterprise accounts that fit our profile, and say no to accounts that do not.

• Source your own pipeline through multi-threaded outreach to operations leaders and executives. Personally run outbound campaigns, with AI doing the heavy lifting on research and personalization.

• Navigate large, matrixed organizations with technical and business stakeholders.

Lead complex, technical sales cycles

• Sell to two buying centers: contact center operations (CX, quality, workforce, and support leaders) and the technology and finance executives who own architecture, security, and budget.

• Explain how voice and chat AI agents and copilots work, in plain terms, to a skeptical CIO. Cover guardrails, data handling and residency, integration with CCaaS platforms (such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, and Amazon Connect), and how performance is measured.

• Run proof-based evaluations. Work with Solutions Engineers and forward-deployed engineers to scope use cases and win the technical and security evaluation, and keep the process honest from first call to signature.

• Build ROI cases that a CFO will sign off on, tied to cost per contact, containment, quality, and agent productivity.

• Run deals on MEDDPICC, and hold every deal to our Five Wins gates (business, product, technical, security, and commercial) before it advances.

Build and scale the AI agent motion

• Turn what works in your deals into repeatable plays, and share what you learn with Product, Engineering, CX, and Marketing.

• Mentor Enterprise AEs on technical selling and executive engagement.

• Show up in person for executive roundtables and customer events, and help turn happy customers into references.

Operate with discipline

• Keep CRM and deal records current. Our goal is for AI to maintain most of the record, so what you put in should be accurate and brief.

• Run account plans and expansion strategies, and take pricing through our deal desk and discount tiers.

How We Work

Observe.AI is an AI-native company, and we expect you to be too. You will build your own AI workflows for account research, outbound, deal strategy, and forecasting, and pick up new tools as they appear. You do not need a specific stack. You need curiosity and a record of changing how you work when something better arrives.

We move at startup speed, debate openly, and expect people to hold a position and change it when the evidence changes. We want people who welcome deal inspection and coaching, ask for help early, and partner closely with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, and forward-deployed engineering. Everyone follows the process, leaders included.

What you'll bring to the role

• 8 or more years in enterprise SaaS with complex, technical sales cycles.

• A record of closing six- and seven-figure net-new deals, with ACVs of $250K or more, in the last three years.

• Experience selling AI/ML, automation, workflow, infrastructure, security, or contact center technology (CCaaS, workforce, or quality management). Agentic AI experience is a strong plus.

• Credibility with technical buyers: you can discuss architecture, security, and integration without a rehearsed script, and you know when to bring in an engineer.

• A record of self-sourced pipeline in a greenfield or lightly covered territory.

Skills & Attributes

• Mastery of MEDDPICC or an equivalent framework, and the discipline to use it when it slows a deal down.

• Comfort with usage-based and committed-spend pricing models.

• Executive presence, and the ability to simplify technical value for a CIO and an operations leader alike.

• A builder's mindset: scrappy, resourceful, and resilient, with high urgency and high accountability.

Why You'll Love It Here

• Competitive compensation including equity: Market-aligned base pay, performance incentives, and meaningful equity ownership.

• Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance options: Comprehensive coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

• Flexible paid time off: Our flexible PTO policy lets you take the time you need to recharge, keep your balance, and perform at your best.

• Additional time to recharge: 10 company holidays, an annual company-wide Winter Break, and paid parental leave to support life outside of work.

• 401(k) plan: Long-term financial planning support with tax-advantaged retirement savings.

• Quarterly Lifestyle Spending Account: A flexible quarterly stipend for wellness, learning and professional development, and personal growth.

• Monthly mobile and internet stipend: Support for remote and hybrid work connectivity.

• Pre-tax commuter benefits: Tax-efficient transit and commuting support for hybrid and in-office employees.

• Autonomy and agency: Play a meaningful role in scaling a category-defining GenAI platform that is transforming the future of customer experience.

Salary Range

The on-target earnings (OTE) for this role are $270,000-$300,000 with a target 50/50 split between base and variable, plus equity in the form of options. Compensation varies based on qualifications, skills, location and experience.

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging

Observe.AI is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Observe.AI does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. Observe.AI also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

We welcome all people. We celebrate diversity of all kinds and are committed to creating an inclusive culture built on a foundation of respect for all individuals. We seek to hire, develop, and retain talented people from all backgrounds. Individuals from non-traditional backgrounds and historically marginalized or underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

If you are ambitious, make an impact wherever you go, and are ready to shape the future of Observe.AI, we encourage you to apply. For more information, visit www.observe.ai.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $190,000.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

In this role, the clinical instructor:

jobs.title: Customer Retention Specialist (Pacific Time Hours)
jobs.description:
At Trupanion, our Contact Center is powered by passionate Care, Sales, Retention, and Team Support Specialists who work together to deliver exceptional service. We’re looking for people who are excited to educate pet owners and champion the value of protecting their pets with Trupanion coverage. Our Contact Center is open 24/7, 365 days a year – including nights, weekends, and federal holidays – so team members should be prepared to support pet parents whenever they need us most.

As a Customer Retention Specialist, you’ll play a vital role in deepening relationships by engaging with customers during the moments that matter most. You’ll approach each interaction with empathy and care. Listening actively, thoroughly investigating concerns, and taking thoughtful, timely actions to provide meaningful support. Through impactful phone conversations and personalized email follow-ups, you’ll reeducate pet parents on the long-term value of coverage, helping them fully understand the benefits of protecting their pets with Trupanion. You’ll skillfully navigate objections and sensitive situations, working with customers to overcome barriers, identify solutions, and ensure they feel seen, heard, and valued. Whether you’re de-escalating an emotional conversation or reinforcing the peace of mind our coverage provides, your goal is to ensure every customer feels informed, supported, and confident in their decision to continue protecting their pet with Trupanion.

Schedule (Pacific Time):

This is a full-time position consisting of five 8-hour shifts per week. Our Retention department operates seven days a week, from 5:00 AM to 7:00 PM Pacific Time. The permanent schedule will fall within these operating hours and will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

Weekend availability is required, including both Saturdays and Sundays, with two consecutive days off during the week. Schedules are set and do not rotate.

Training Schedule: Training takes place Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time. The duration of training will vary based on Property and Casualty (P&C) licensing status. The specific training timeline will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

Attendance and active participation, including being on camera, are mandatory during training. These expectations remain an important part of the role, supporting engagement, connection, and collaboration in a remote environment.

At Trupanion, we believe in a flexible workplace! We know that talented pet-loving professionals are everywhere. This is a remote position open across the United States, subject to the following state-specific hiring requirements:

• Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada & New York: You must already hold an active P&C license to be eligible for consideration.
• California, New Jersey, Oregon, Texas and Massachusetts: We are currently unable to consider applications from those residing in these states.

You must have a reliable and stable internet connection, delivered through a hard-wired Ethernet connection (cable or fiber). Wireless connections, including Wi-Fi, satellite, and mobile hotspots, are not permitted. If you enjoy a mix of on-site and remote work, you may choose to have a hybrid schedule in our Seattle office.

What you will do

• Educate and support Trupanion customers who are requesting to cancel their policy by delivering exceptional service through inbound calls and email
• Manage high call volumes while balancing empathy, efficiency, and productivity under tight deadlines
• Provide outstanding customer support by actively listening, investigating concerns, and taking solution-oriented action to support retention
• De-escalate challenging situations with empathy and professionalism, using strong communication skills while embodying Trupanion’s core values
• Educate pet parents on the lifetime value of coverage to empower informed decision-making
• Build authentic connections by tailoring your communication style to meet individual customer needs
• Thrive in a fast-paced environment by adapting quickly to evolving responsibilities, processes and workflows
• Navigate multiple systems and tools to deliver a seamless and efficient member experience
• Prioritize and manage time effectively to provide exceptional customer service in a fast-paced contact center
• Accurately document customer interactions and maintain detailed records in the customer relationship management (CRM) system
• Demonstrate strong technology acumen in a remote setting, including the ability to independently troubleshoot common technical issues and adapt to new tools or system updates
• Take a proactive, solution-oriented approach when facing technical challenges, such as identifying alternate ways to continue work while awaiting IT support
• Consistently meet or exceed productivity and quality targets while maintaining a minimum of 90% schedule adherence
• Engage in on-camera video calls to collaborate and connect with your team, and contribute to a strong, inclusive remote culture

Experience you have:

• 3 years of experience in a customer retention, account management, or similar role in a fast-paced call center environment is essential
• Proven track record of success in retaining customers, handling cancellations and renewing services
• Demonstrated ability to de-escalate difficult situations, handling complaints and sensitive or emotional topics with empathy
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Experienced in navigating multiple digital platforms simultaneously, with a strong aptitude for diagnosing and resolving technical issues in real time while maintaining a great customer experience
• Proficient in using CRM systems to document and manage customer interactions
• Strong technical troubleshooting skills and comfort using technology independently in a remote environment
• Experience working remotely in a private setting with a reliable hard-wired internet connection and a distraction-free home-office setup

Requirements:

• Must hold or be able to obtain and maintain an active P&C license in your state of residence.
• Must be willing and able to obtain and maintain additional licenses in other U.S. states and applicable Canadian provinces, as required for the role. Trupanion will facilitate the additional licensing process.

Compensation:

• The pay for this position is $23/hour on a full-time schedule. Along with the hourly pay, Trupanion employees may be eligible for uncapped monthly bonuses based on individual performance.
• We want all employees to be invested in Trupanion’s success, so we grant Restricted Stock Units to all new team members. Our new hire grants vest over 4 years.
• P&C Licensing: If you currently hold an active P&C license, you are eligible for a $1,500 sign-on bonus. If you are not currently licensed, Trupanion provides licensing coursework and paid study time during the first three weeks of P&C training.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Benefits and Perks:

• Full medical, dental, and vision benefits at no cost to the employee
• Four weeks of paid time off and 9 paid float holidays (you can decide which days are most important to you!)
• Five-week sabbatical after five years of employment
• Open, casual, pet-friendly, and fun office environment
• Free medical health insurance for your pet (1 dog or cat)
• Paid time off to volunteer at nonprofit organizations
• Seattle Office Amenities: Free on-site gym, free dog walking services for office pets during business hours, free parking, and paid ORCA cards.

For more information about Trupanion, visit https://trupanion.com/about

Learn more about how Trupanion has revolutionized our industry and the reimbursement model: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vdWZ4KHiPTQ

Trupanion is an equal-opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, abilities, perspectives, and skills.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

jobs.title: Business Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Business Applications Administrator, Entrata Systems | Multifamily Real Estate Technology

Job Type: Full-time | Work Environment: In-office | Industry: Multifamily real estate, property operations, business applications, Entrata, and property management technology

Saturday – Sunday remote, Monday – Wednesday in the office.

Role Summary

The Business Applications Administrator supports AIR Communities’ Property Operations teams by administering, configuring, troubleshooting, and improving key business applications, with a primary focus on Entrata Systems. This role partners with business stakeholders, IT, and vendors to resolve issues, maintain system integrity, and support technology initiatives that improve property operations.

This is an in-office role designed for candidates who prefer regular face-to-face collaboration, building strong business relationships, and taking long-term ownership of critical systems within a growing real estate organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Administer, configure, and support Entrata and other business applications used by Property Operations.
• Provide Tier 3 functional and technical support for escalated user issues, system questions, and troubleshooting needs.
• Configure settings, security roles, permissions, workflows, document mapping, and automated document tools.
• Maintain application data integrity, change control documentation, directories, process records, and reporting support.
• Partner with IT, business teams, and third-party vendors to resolve system issues and improve application performance.
• Support property operations technology initiatives, including project coordination, meeting facilitation, timeline tracking, and budget awareness.

Preferred Candidate Profile

• Demonstrated consistency, follow-through, and interest in building deep subject-matter expertise over time.
• Comfortable collaborating in person with cross-functional teams and building strong stakeholder relationships.
• Customer-focused mindset with sound judgment, accuracy, and responsiveness.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Successful candidates are detail-oriented, service-minded, and comfortable becoming a trusted systems resource for Property Operations. They enjoy solving complex application issues, improving workflows, collaborating in person, and growing with a stable, high-performing real estate company.

Minimum Requirements

• 3–5 years of hands-on experience with Entrata Systems, property management software, or business applications in a multifamily real estate environment.

• Experience configuring application settings, security roles, permissions, workflows, or administrative controls.

• Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and internal customer support skills.

• Ability and interest to work in office as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team.

Relevant Experience

Relevant backgrounds may include:

Business Applications Administrator, Entrata Administrator, Property Management Software Administrator, Business Systems Analyst, Application Support Specialist, Systems Administrator, Tier 3 Support, Real Estate Technology, Property Operations Technology, database configuration, user support, and project coordination.

What We Offer

AIR offers attractive total compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance including :

• Expected base salary between $62,000-$73,000 plus target annual 10% bonus. You will be provided a pay rate that is in line with your skills and experience as they relate to the requirements of the job.
• 25% Rent Discount at any AIR community (a rental application is required, and certain exclusions apply).
• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options, HSA/FSA plans, short and long-term disability paid by the company.
• 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer match contribution.
• Paid time off including vacation, sick time, and 14 holidays.
• Paid parental leave of up to 16 weeks.
• Tuition assistance program and up to 100% reimbursement for job-related certifications and licenses.
• 15 hours of paid time annually for community service.
• Commuter benefits and pet insurance.
• Consumer discounts on various products and services.
• Opportunities for ongoing professional development, leadership training, and career growth.

What You Need to Know

Application Deadline: The initial deadline for applications is 11/30/2026. Applications submitted after this date may still be considered on a rolling basis until the position/program is filled. We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.

jobs.title: Learning and Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
Purpose of the Position:

The Learning & Enablement Specialist, Financial Aid is responsible for developing and enabling employees and leaders who support the financial aid lifecycle. In this role, you will serve as a Financial Aid subject matter expert, designing and delivering learning experiences, resources, and ongoing support that help employees understand  expectations, apply processes correctly, and perform their roles confidently and consistently.

Beyond traditional training, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Financial Aid enablement at Unitek. You will help advance how employees access knowledge, develop proficiency, collaborate with colleagues, and receive support in the flow of work. Through emerging technologies, innovative learning approaches, and continuous improvement, you will help build a more effective, scalable, and responsive enablement experience.

Working closely with Financial Aid leadership, campus teams, and business partners, you will help accelerate role readiness, strengthen performance, and promote consistent, compliant Financial Aid practices across Unitek.

Job responsibilities:

Training delivery & facilitation

• Deliver onboarding, role-specific orientation, and ongoing training for Financial Aid employees and leaders.

• Facilitate live virtual and in-person training, workshops, practice sessions, and

reinforcement activities.

• Provide coaching and follow-up support to help employees apply learning effectively in

their day-to-day work.

• Adapt delivery based on learner experience, performance needs, and changes to

Financial Aid processes or requirements.

• Support new employees through role readiness and transition from training into

independent performance.

Learning design & role enablement

• Design and maintain Financial Aid learning experiences, training materials, job aids,

process guides, practice activities, and role-based resources.

• Translate complex regulations, policies, processes, and system workflows into clear,

practical guidance employees can use in their work.

• Contribute to the development and ongoing improvement of Financial Aid RoleReady

resources, including role toolkits and readiness experiences.

• Create learning solutions that emphasize application and performance rather than

information alone.

• Ensure learning materials remain current as processes, systems, regulations, and

organizational expectations change.

Financial Aid subject matter expertise

• Maintain strong working knowledge of Financial Aid operations, including federal Title IV

requirements and applicable institutional policies and procedures.

• Serve as a trusted resource for Financial Aid processes, workflows, systems, and

common employee questions.

• Partner with Financial Aid leadership and appropriate compliance or policy owners to

ensure training accurately reflects current requirements.

• Identify areas where employees may be experiencing confusion, inconsistency, or

performance risk and recommend enablement solutions.

• Escalate policy, compliance, or process questions that require interpretation or decisions

from the appropriate business owner.

Knowledge sharing & continuous enablement

• Administer and support Financial Aid peer-to-peer learning and knowledge-sharing

channels to encourage collaboration, problem-solving, and consistent practices.

• Monitor employee questions and discussions, providing timely answers, guidance, or

escalation to appropriate subject matter experts.

• Identify recurring questions, knowledge gaps, and opportunities to improve existing

training, processes, and role-based resources.

• Translate insights from employee interactions into updates and enhancements to

Financial Aid toolkits, job aids, and other enablement resources.

• Promote awareness, adoption, and ongoing use of available learning and performance support resources.

Innovation & future-state enablement

• Help shape the evolution of Financial Aid enablement by identifying opportunities to

improve how employees learn, access information, and perform their work.

• Explore and contribute to the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled knowledge and performance-support solutions, where appropriate.

• Partner with Capability & Enablement leadership to pilot new approaches, evaluate their

effectiveness, and scale solutions that improve employee readiness and performance.

• Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce repetitive questions, and make rolespecific knowledge easier to access and apply

Business partnership & performance support

• Build strong relationships with Financial Aid leaders and employees to understand

business needs and performance challenges.

• Partner with leaders to distinguish knowledge or skill gaps from process, system, policy,

or other performance barriers.

• Recommend training, resources, reinforcement, or other enablement approaches based

on identified needs.

• Support leaders in reinforcing role expectations and effective practices following

training.

• Participate in launches or changes that require Financial Aid employee training,

communication, or adoption support.

Measurement & continuous improvement

• Gather employee and leader feedback to understand the effectiveness and usability of

Financial Aid learning experiences and resources.

• Monitor training participation, readiness indicators, learner feedback, and other

available measures of effectiveness.

• Identify opportunities to simplify, improve, consolidate, or retire training and resources.

• Use insights from employee questions, recurring errors, and performance trends to

continuously improve Financial Aid enablement.

• Contribute to broader Capability & Enablement initiatives and share effective practices

across functions.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Demonstrated experience working in Financial Aid within a postsecondary education

environment.

• Strong working knowledge of federal financial aid requirements, including Title IV

regulations and related Financial Aid processes.

• Experience using Financial Aid systems, tools, and federal aid platforms.

• Ability to translate complex or highly regulated processes into clear, practical instructions

for others.

• Strong facilitation, presentation, and communication skills.

• Ability to coach employees and provide constructive, actionable feedback.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, compliance, and consistency.

• Ability to build productive relationships with employees, leaders, and cross-functional

partners.

• Comfort working in an environment where processes, systems, and regulatory

requirements evolve.

• Curiosity about emerging technologies and a willingness to experiment with new

approaches to employee learning and performance support.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables.

Preferred Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Experience training, onboarding, coaching, or developing Financial Aid professionals.

• Experience developing training materials, job aids, process documentation, or other

performance-support resources.

• Experience supporting employees across multiple campuses or locations.

• Experience with adult learning, instructional design, or learning technology.

• Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent relevant education and experience will be

considered.

What success looks like

• Financial Aid employees understand what is expected of them and have the knowledge

and resources needed to perform their roles.

• New employees reach role readiness more quickly and with greater consistency.

• Training and resources accurately reflect current Financial Aid processes and

requirements.

• Employees apply Financial Aid processes consistently and know where to go when

exceptions or questions arise.

• Employees actively use knowledge-sharing channels to ask questions, exchange

expertise, and solve problems.

• Recurring questions and knowledge gaps lead to improvements in the quality and

usability of enablement resources.

• Leaders have greater visibility into employee readiness and areas requiring

reinforcement.

• New enablement approaches and technologies contribute to improved employee

performance, efficiency, and access to knowledge.

• Financial Aid employees view Capability & Enablement as a practical partner in helping

them perform successfully

We Offer:

• Medical, Dental and Vision starting the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment
• 2 Weeks’ starting Vacation per year. Increasing based on years of service with company
• 12 paid Holidays and 2 Floating Holidays
• 401K with a Company Match
• Company Paid Life Insurance at 1x’s your annual salary
• Leadership development and training for career advancement
• Tuition assistance and Forgiveness for you and your family up to 100% depending on program

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

We’re seeking a transformational Solutions Engineering leader to lead our Mid Market and Enterprise SE teams in North America. You’ll be a pivotal figure in helping Intercom scale its AI-driven support platform to some of the world’s most well-known brands. This role will shape how we engage with large, complex organizations, defining our go-to-market, building a world-class team, and delivering tangible customer outcomes through innovation and credibility.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will lead a Solutions Engineering team focused on winning complex deals, creating vertical-specific solution architectures, and building repeatable playbooks. We believe in leaders who are open to be a player and a coach, regardless of seniority. You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Success, Product, Engineering, and Services to deliver customer transformation through Intercom’s AI-first platform – be it through strategic guidance as a senior leader on the team, or securing deals with your own technical credibility where needed.

What will I be doing?

• Define and evolve the strategic vision and go-to-market (GTM) approach for the Solutions Engineering function.

• Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing SE team across global regions and core verticals.

• Operate as a player-coach, actively engaging in strategic deals while developing team capabilities.

• Support complex, six-figure sales cycles with technical guidance, architecture, demos, and product evaluation support, as well as sales expertise.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor and executive point of contact for large customers.

• Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D to shape verticalized GTM motions and solution strategy.

• Champion a customer-obsessed culture across the pre-sales journey – from outbound to implementation.

• Lead discovery, design, and delivery of tailored technical solutions, including PoCs and business value assessments.

• Build reusable, scalable solution frameworks, and industry-specific technical assets.

• Advocate for customer needs and insights internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.

• Represent Intercom and the SE function externally through executive meetings and strategic events.

• Foster strong relationships with C-level stakeholders, translating AI product capabilities into tangible business impact.

What skills do I need?

• 5+ years of pre-sales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer/Architect, or related individual contributor role.

• Having 3+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales teams, with a proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and managing high-performing teams.

• Ideally, experience selling AI, data, or highly technical products; or at the very least, deep curiosity and utilization of AI on your day-to-day.

• Comfortable with ambiguity in environments with an ability to stay focused and thrive under pressure while working with customers to solve their most challenging issues.

• Have a humble attitude, and a passion to help others, with a willingness to learn whatever it takes to support the team and help our customers thrive.

• A track record of consistently delivering revenue numbers, producing accurate forecasts, while maintaining a focus on team development and growth

• Able to travel internationally on average once a month

• Ability to flex working hours to partner with teams in EMEA and APAC.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

The OTE salary range for candidates within the Greater Chicago Area is $251,100-$299,925. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Pediatric Clinical Faculty (Part Time): Honolulu, Hawaii
jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

Chamberlain College of Nursing has immediate need for qualified Pediatric Clinical Faculty (part-time) in our Bachelors of Science in Nursing program.

Teaching is onsite (in clinical setting) with one of our clinical partners. Schedule: most commonly 12-hour rotations (7a-7p) for three to four consecutive days.

Pediatric Nursing course overview:

Family-Centered care of children is the focus of this course, exploring issues of normal childcare as well as health alterations of children from infancy through adolescence. Students participate as members of the multidisciplinary health team to provide health promotion, illness prevention, health restoration and maintenance and rehabilitative care to children and families.

In this role, the clinical instructor:

• Implements the College's philosophy, curriculum, program outcomes, and course objectives through clinical teaching and service to the College, community, health system and profession.
• Assumes responsibility for all autonomous aspects of individual teaching assignments.
• Plans clinical experiences for and provides direct supervision and evaluation of nursing students delivering nursing care to an individual or group of individuals.
• Evaluates and provides documented feedback to student on level of performance based on course objectives.
• Is available for remediation of students as required or needed.
• Orients and maintains current knowledge related to agency/clinical policies, procedures, and expectations with the assistance of the agency/clinical personnel.
• Develops and posts written clinical assignments consistent with student's knowledge base, skill competency and individual learning needs.
• Grades homework, quizzes, tests, lab assignments, clinical paperwork and other written work in a timely manner.
• May teach didactic course content under supervision of course coordinator.
• Keeps course coordinator informed of all student and agency issues and concerns.
• Reports to the dean or assistant dean: a course coordinator will also provide direct oversight.

You are encouraged to explore this opportunity if you have:

• A master's or doctoral degree in Nursing from a regionally accredited college or university.
• An unencumbered professional nursing license in the state of Hawaii.
• At least two years professional experience within last five years in the area of instruction as a registered nurse.
• Teaching or precepting experience is preferred but not required.
• Have genuine passion for nursing, education, and lifelong learning.
• Have exceptional subject matter expertise with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Are eager to serve students and colleagues with passion, respect and care.
• Illinois RN License will be required to teach all courses (course assignments prioritized to professors who are currently licensed in Illinois)

Operate with a sense of responsibility and purpose with the desire to enrich colleagues, students and the broader community.

Chamberlain Visiting Professor Position - Campus

jobs.title: Sr. Internal Communications Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

We’re looking for an exceptional Internal Communications Manager to join our Communications team! We’re looking for someone who is a Swiss Army knife for Internal Comms, with experience in doing everything from newsletters and large scale employee meetings, to change management and program communications. We are looking for someone who will partner closely with our Head of Internal Communications and work closely with a variety of departments across the organization. This is a great opportunity to get experience working across many different stakeholders, learning about the different parts of the company, and shape internal communications for a high-growth organization with a great culture and leaders.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

• You want to have an outsized impact on the industries that run our world: Helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by building something: You get excited about stepping in and establishing new processes and channels and building an Internal Communications engine that can scale with the company over time.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to become the best you can be.

In this role, you will:

• Execute the internal communications strategy for Samsara, helping communicate the company’s vision and strategy to our employees and demonstrating progress throughout the year, amplifying our global brand, and supporting the needs of the business.

• Support a wide range of internal communications working closely with key stakeholders such as leadership, People team, Legal, Go-to-Market, etc. You should be as comfortable working on a variety of comms, from writing change and organizational announcements to producing a newsletter or video.

• Keep a pulse on the organization and run feedback loops as you go, in order to optimize communications updates and channels.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team).

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 5+ years of internal communications experience – building and executing strategic internal communications programs. Start-up experience preferred.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills (written, verbal, and visual) with experience originating creative content across a variety of channels.

• Experience partnering and proven track record working cross-functionally.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment with continuous change.

• Design and video editing skills are a plus

• You’re curious about AI and use it regularly, whether that’s drafting, synthesizing, or automating, and you’re excited to keep learning as the tools evolve.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Tech and SaaS company experience (strongly preferred)

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$95,200—$128,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.title: Director of IT
jobs.description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst – Commercial
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Senior Financial Analyst – Commercial
Location: Stamford, CT or Las Vegas, NV
Job Type: Full Time | Exempt

Who You Are:

You're a technically skilled financial analyst with advanced financial modeling capabilities, strong analytical instincts, and a talent for solving complex business problems. You enjoy building models from the ground up, working with large datasets, and figuring out how to approach questions that don't always have a clear answer. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and developing creative, data-driven solutions to support business decisions. You bring a strong understanding of financial planning and analysis, along with the technical expertise to build scalable tools, automate processes, and translate complex information into meaningful insights. You're naturally curious, adaptable, and confident taking ownership of projects that require both independent thinking and cross-functional collaboration.

What You’ll Do:

As a Senior Financial Analyst – Commercial on Curaleaf's Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team, you'll serve as a technical financial modeling and analytics resource supporting our national Markets organization. You'll develop sophisticated financial models, analyze commercial performance, and lead ad hoc analytical projects that help leadership evaluate opportunities, understand business drivers, and make informed decisions. You'll work across financial and operational datasets to build scalable reporting tools, improve forecasting capabilities, and support strategic commercial initiatives. You will:

• Develop and maintain advanced financial models to support commercialization strategies, revenue forecasting, business planning, and strategic decision-making.

• Build financial models to evaluate product launches, pricing strategies, market expansion, sales opportunities, and other commercial initiatives.

• Lead ad hoc financial analysis and special projects, independently developing analytical approaches to complex or undefined business questions.

• Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis to evaluate financial outcomes, identify risks, and support strategic planning.

• Support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range financial planning through detailed financial modeling and performance analysis.

• Analyze commercial performance, including revenue trends, sales results, brand performance, market share, and competitive activity.

• Develop and maintain recurring management reporting covering retail presence, wholesale performance, market trends, and key commercial KPIs.

• Build, automate, and improve financial models, dashboards, and analytical tools to increase reporting efficiency and support data-driven decision-making.

• Leverage SQL, Snowflake, Omni, Vena, and other financial and analytical platforms to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.

• Evaluate financial and operational data to identify trends, test assumptions, and develop actionable business recommendations.

• Partner with Commercial, Finance, and cross-functional leadership to support financial analysis, strategic initiatives, and evolving business needs.

• Ensure data accuracy and integrity across financial models, reporting tools, and internal and external data sources.

• Present complex financial analysis and modeling results to leadership, translating technical findings into clear, actionable insights.

What You’ll Bring:

• 3+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), corporate finance, commercial finance, or a related analytical role.

• Advanced financial modeling experience, with the ability to independently design, build, maintain, and troubleshoot complex financial models from scratch.

• Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, and working with large datasets.

• Strong SQL skills and experience querying, manipulating, and analyzing complex datasets.

• Experience with revenue modeling, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and performance reporting.

• Strong technical aptitude and experience using financial planning, reporting, or business intelligence platforms.

• Ability to independently structure analytical approaches, identify relevant data, test assumptions, and develop solutions to complex business questions.

• Experience developing scalable financial models, improving reporting processes, or automating analytical workflows.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage projects without established processes or clearly defined direction.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial and technical information into meaningful insights for cross-functional stakeholders.

• A proactive, adaptable approach with the ability to manage competing priorities, take ownership of special projects, and influence business decisions.

Even Better If:

• You have experience with commercialization modeling, product profitability analysis, pricing strategies, or market expansion analysis.

• You're familiar with commercial finance, revenue analytics, market intelligence, or competitive analysis.

• You have experience with financial reporting and analytics tools such as Snowflake, Omni, Vena, Power BI, or Tableau.

• You have experience building automated reporting solutions, integrating multiple data sources, or improving financial modeling processes.

• You have experience supporting strategic financial projects, including business case development, investment analysis, or M&A modeling.

• You're familiar with the cannabis industry or other fast-growing, highly regulated industries.

$90,000—$115,000 USD

jobs.title: Remote Cold Calling Rep - Part-Time, Set Your Own Hours (Independent Contractor)
jobs.description:
Remote, United States · Independent contractor (1099) · Part-time or full-time · For students, sales professionals, and anyone looking for flexible work

 

Represent well-known brands and fast-growing startups to sharpen the phone skills AI can't replace, and earn uncapped commission in USD on your own schedule.

 

At Sellfire, our mission is to help the next generation of sales professionals build great sales careers in a world of AI. This role is where that starts.

What you'll do

 - Make live outbound calls for fast-growing B2B tech companies, reaching gatekeepers and decision-makers

 - Use Sellfire's AI-enabled platform. It handles lead lists, call prep, dialing and coaching insights, so your time goes into real conversations

 - Book qualified meetings for our customers' sales teams

 - Get call-by-call feedback and coaching from Logic-Based Selling, our proven calling methodology

Why this beats a typical side job

 - Earn real money. You're paid for results: Commission for every qualified meeting that you set that the prospect attends. The better you get, the more you make.

 - Control your hours. Work any hours you choose between 8 AM and 9 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. Fit it around classes, another job, or family. Work as much or as little as you want. No shifts and no minimum schedule.

 - Choose your accounts. Pick which customer programs you call for.

 - Work with brands that are going places. You'll call on behalf of well-known brands and fast-growing startups. That's real experience with venture-backed startups and brands hiring managers recognize.

 - Build a résumé recruiters notice. Entry-level SDR roles are among the most common first jobs in tech sales, and they usually ask for experience you can't get in a classroom. You'll walk away with real numbers like dials, connects and meetings booked.

 - Train like a pro before you dial. Learn through short video lessons, test what you know with quizzes, and practice live calls with AI prospects that act like real gatekeepers and decision-makers.

Your first step on the sales career ladder

In tech, the SDR (sales development rep) role is the most common way into sales. Many of today's top account executives, sales leaders and founders started there. A typical path looks like this:

 - SDR / BDR. Open conversations, qualify prospects and book meetings. This is where you start.

 - Account Executive. Run demos, manage deals and close revenue, often after a year or two as an SDR.

 - Senior AE, Sales Manager or Sales Leader. Bigger deals, a team of your own, or a seat in leadership.

The hardest part is getting that first SDR job without experience. This role gives you real experience and results to point to, whether you're in school, working another job, or switching careers.

Why build a career in sales

 - High earning potential. Sales pay is tied directly to results, so strong performers can out-earn their peers early in their careers.

 - Fast, merit-based growth. Your numbers speak for themselves, so promotions come from performance, not tenure.

 - Skills that transfer anywhere. Persuasion, listening, resilience and handling objections help in any job, or in starting your own company.

 - Demand in every industry. Every company needs revenue, so good salespeople are needed everywhere.

 - A path to leadership and entrepreneurship. Many founders and executives got their start in sales.

 - Skills AI can't easily replace. As AI takes over routine work, the ability to build trust in a live conversation becomes more valuable.

Who we're looking for

 - Based in the United States

 - Anyone looking for flexible, part-time work they can fit around school, another job, or family

 - College students and recent grads

 - Sales professionals looking to refine their skills and make extra money

 - Anyone looking to start their sales career

 - Competitive, coachable, and comfortable hearing "no"

 - Clear, confident speaker

 - A quiet place to work, a reliable computer, a headset, and stable internet (you'll pass a short equipment check)

About the contractor role

This is an independent contractor (1099) position, not employment with Sellfire. As a contractor:

 - You set your own hours within the 8 AM to 9 PM US Eastern Time window and decide how much you work

 - You provide and maintain your own equipment

 - You choose which customer programs to work on

 - You're paid 100% commission for results, not hourly, and you're responsible for your own taxes

 - You don't receive employee benefits such as health insurance or paid time off

The only things we require: pass screening and the equipment check, complete certification, and meet our quality standards on every call, including sticking to each customer's approved script.

How it works

 1. Apply (5 minutes)

 2. Complete a short screening and equipment check

 3. Finish Sellfire training and certification

 4. Start calling on your own schedule

jobs.title: Integration Build Engineer
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for an Integration Build Engineer, to help develop the systems behind our human-rated space stations. You will drive the development and execution of human-rated vehicle processes as Haven-1 transitions from design to a flight-ready station.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

Responsibilities:

• Support operations with Integration Technicians and supporting Engineering REs

• Be a permanent engineering presence to ensure operations are unblocked and to find solutions to keep work moving if blockers or Non Conformances arise

• Plan, schedule, prepare, coordinate, direct, and exercise functional authority for completion of tests

• Ensure integration procedures are continuously evolving to reflect the most efficient assembly practices

• Develop, qualify, and refine manufacturing processes to meet all requirements including safety, quality, efficiency, and delivery

• Collaborate with other engineers, subject matter experts, and technicians to solve complex production issues

• Document and provide resolution to non-conformances and collaborate with the quality team to implement root cause corrective actions

Minimum Qualifications:

• B.S. in mechanical, aerospace, manufacturing or electrical engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field

• Manufacturing experience (including internships) managing a product/product line across multiple work centers and/or departments, fluid, pressurized, propulsion, or environmental control hardware in design, manufacturing, or test

• 2-4+ years of experience for Manufacturing Engineer II

• 4-6+ years of experience for Senior Manufacturing Engineer

• Hands-on fabrication, assembly, and/or integration experience; CAD proficiency (NX preferred)

Preferred Skills & Experience:
