jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Workflow Automation
jobs.description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

What You'll Do

We're looking for someone who can proactively define business processes worth automating next, then turn that into reliable, production-grade automations. You'll partner with teams across the company to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, scope requirements, and build automations leveraging AI. In addition you will:

• Proactively identify and prioritize automation opportunities across the business, then partner with stakeholders to define requirements and align on priorities.

• Design, build, test, and maintain automations (e.g., using n8n) that connect systems and automate processes across the organization.

• Write design documents that scope technical approaches, surface tradeoffs, and set expectations with partners.

• Write code for custom logic, data transformation, and API integrations.

• Monitor production workflows, troubleshoot failures, and build in error handling and alerting from the start.

• Document workflows so they can be understood, maintained, and extended by others.

Who You Are

You're a product-focused senior data scientist who is excited to build AI-powered workflows that help teams move faster with more standardized and informed processes. You’re a kind, passionate and collaborative problem-solver who seeks and gives candid feedback, and values the chance to make an important impact. In addition:

• You have 4+ years of relevant working experience as an applied data scientist or similar technical data-oriented role. Prior experience with LLMs is required.

• You proactively identify and scope what we should automate next — rather than simply executing pre-defined specs — then drive execution end-to-end.

• You hold a bachelors, masters, and/or Ph.D. in computer science, data science, or a related field.

• You understand how AI systems are evaluated and can analyze an existing system to understand the quality of its output, assess where improvements are needed, and communicate the impact of those improvements to stakeholders.

• You have curiosity and knowledge to investigate, discover, and evaluate new and emerging AI architecture and design.

• You have collaborated with other technical team members in a production development environment using formal version control, Python or Javascript.

• You have experience working with data: parsing JSON, transforming payloads, connecting to databases or third-party services (e.g., via REST APIs).

• You’re impact-oriented, and care deeply about creating real change for customers, users, and ultimately patients. You choose the right, rather than the flashiest, method available to reach your goals.

• You are a clear and confident communicator who can break down complex data analyses to tell a compelling story.

Extra Credit

• Familiarity with workflow automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, Airflow).

• Deeper understanding of APIs (REST, webhooks, authentication patterns like OAuth and API keys).

• Background in consulting, data analysis, solutions engineering, data engineering, or a similar hybrid technical/product role.

Where You’ll Work

In this hybrid role, you’ll have a defined work location that includes work from home and 3 office days set by you and your team. For more information on our approach to hybrid work, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

• Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive compensation package

• 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals

• Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice

• Mental well-being tools and services

• Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave

• Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy

• Travel support for safe healthcare services

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate inclusion and belonging in the workplace.

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. jobs.title: Partnerships Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT DUST



Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.



With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.



With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.



We're serving great customers https://dust.tt/customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.



Dust is backed by Sequoia https://techcrunch.com/2024/06/27/dust-grabs-another-16-million-for-its-enterprise-ai-assistants-connected-to-internal-data/ with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dust-tt_were-honored-to-be-recognized-on-the-generalists-activity-7359284343929741313-Rq04.




THE ROLE



We're looking for a Partnerships Solutions Engineer to help build the technical foundation of Dust's partner ecosystem in the US.



You'll work closely with our Partnerships, Sales Engineering, Product, and partner teams to turn relationships into repeatable solutions and customer outcomes. You'll help partners develop AI offerings on Dust, establish the frameworks to deliver them successfully, and build the technical capabilities to bring those solutions to market.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, technical implementation, and go-to-market strategy.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



Build partner offerings

 - Collaborate with consulting and technology partners to develop packaged AI solutions and service offerings built on Dust.

 - Translate partner expertise and customer workflows into reusable agent templates, demos, and solution blueprints.

 - Help identify compelling use cases that partners can take to market and replicate across customers.
   
   

Develop repeatable delivery frameworks

 - Create practical implementation playbooks covering discovery, solution design, deployment, and customer onboarding.

 - Build reusable technical assets and reference architectures that help partners deliver Dust-powered solutions more efficiently.

 - Work with partner delivery teams to establish the skills and processes needed to implement solutions independently.
   
   

Enable partners technically

 - Lead technical workshops, solution design sessions, demos, and proofs of concept with strategic partners and customers.

 - Help partners understand Dust's capabilities, integrations, APIs, and MCP ecosystem.

 - Equip partners with the knowledge and materials to confidently position, demonstrate, and deliver Dust.
   
   

Drive cross-functional execution

 - Partner with Sales Engineering, Product, and Engineering to address technical blockers and improve partner solutions.

 - Bring feedback from partner implementations into product and integration priorities.

 - Work with Partnerships to support joint opportunities and identify where repeatable solutions can drive pipeline and adoption.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



 - Experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Forward Deployed Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

 - Hands-on experience building AI applications, agents, automations, or enterprise software integrations.

 - Strong understanding of MCPs, APIs, technical architecture, and connecting business systems and workflows.

 - Ability to translate customer problems into practical technical solutions and repeatable implementation approaches.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, consultants, and business stakeholders.

 - A builder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, able to prioritize, and motivated to create repeatable processes from scratch.
   
   

Nice to have

 - Experience working with consulting partners, systems integrators, or technology alliances.

 - Familiarity with MCP, LLMs, and modern AI tooling.

 - Experience developing partner solutions, implementation playbooks, or packaged consulting offerings.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Partners can confidently demonstrate and implement Dust-powered solutions.

 - Partners have repeatable offerings and delivery frameworks they can use across multiple customers.

 - Successful implementations translate into reusable assets, faster delivery, and less reliance on Dust's internal teams.

 - Partner-led opportunities and deployments increase as the ecosystem matures.




LOCATION



We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.



We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.




WHY DUST



The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.



We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.



If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.



Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 



Learn how we think and work.

 - Our product constitution, https://blog.dust.tt/a-first-version-of-our-product-constitution/ a story about our mission

 - Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xIvlRWEXqqw, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

 - Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/dust, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

jobs.title: Integration Engineer, Avionics Test
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for an Integration Engineer, Avionics Test, to help develop the systems behind our human-rated space stations. You will drive the development and execution of human-rated vehicle processes as Haven-1 transitions from design to a flight-ready station.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

Responsibilities:

• Develop, execute, and maintain test procedures for flight hardware

• Evaluate if testing processes meet all requirements including safety, quality, function, and efficiency; if they do not, rectify the situation

• Plan technical and logistical details to enable efficient completion of tests

• Enable day-to-day execution of the vehicle integration and test flow

• Collaborate with distributed engineering organizations, subject matter experts, and technicians to define and manage test plans, requirements, and schedules, design tests, and assess risks in an ambiguous environment

• Act as test director and exercise technical authority for testing events

• Disposition non-conformances, make risk-informed corrective actions, and exercise engineering judgment in ambiguous situations

Minimum Qualifications:

• B.S. in mechanical, aerospace, manufacturing or electrical engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field

• Manufacturing experience (including internships) managing a product/product line across multiple work centers and/or departments, fluid, pressurized, propulsion, or environmental control hardware in design, manufacturing, or test

• 2-4+ years of experience for Manufacturing Engineer II

• 4-6+ years of experience for Senior Manufacturing Engineer

• Hands-on fabrication, assembly, and/or integration experience; CAD proficiency (NX preferred)

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Hands-on experience building or testing hardware, in industry or through student teams such as Formula SAE, rocketry, CubeSat, or robotics

• Experience with aerospace, spacecraft, propulsion, or other safety-critical or high-reliability hardware

• Experience taking designs or processes from concept through build or test, and from R&D to production

• Familiarity with CAD tools, ideally Siemens NX, and PLM tools such as Teamcenter

• Exposure to thermal or structural analysis using Ansys, or similar tools

• Awareness of aerospace workmanship, design, and environmental test standards such as IPC, SMC-S-016, NASA-STD-5001, or MIL-STD-810

• Proficiency applying GD&T

• Strong problem-solving skills, including troubleshooting and structured root cause analysis

Job Title: Family Therapist

Location: Castle Rock, CO

Work Environment: Adolescent Residential Treatment Facility

Schedule:  Full Time | Sunday to Thursday or Tuesday to Saturday Schedule

Compensation: $60,000 - $79,000 (Dependent on Licensure / Experience)

**This is a new facility opening in July of this year - We are looking for candidates who are able to start in late May / early June

About The Role

As a Family Therapist, you will collaborate with primary therapists to provide comprehensive family-focused treatment. You will lead individual, group, and experiential family therapy sessions, addressing substance abuse, mental health challenges, and dual diagnoses. Your role will include creating treatment plans, coordinating care, and fostering a supportive environment for clients and their families.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct individual, group, and family therapy sessions using evidence-based modalities tailored to client and family needs.

• Collaborate with primary therapists to develop and manage family treatment plans that align with client goals.

• Participate in team discussions on treatment progress, discharge planning, and follow-up care.

• Represent the organization positively in interactions with families, referral sources, and community partners.

Qualifications:

• Candidates applying for this position should be aware that an offer for employment in this position is contingent upon passing a comprehensive background check, encompassing criminal records and motor vehicle reports.

• A master’s degree in behavioral health science (Clinical Social Work, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or related field) is Required

• An active license in the state of CO in good standing is required LPC / LPCC / LSW / LCSW / MFTC / LMFT

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

 - Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

 - Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Run red and purple team operations emulating advanced threat actors across our networks, data center OT, and applications, extending the offensive program alongside the team's other specialists.

 - Pen test the networks behind our GPU clusters, from frontend and backend fabrics to out-of-band management and site connectivity, with a focus on segmentation and tenant isolation.

 - Test data center OT, including building management, power monitoring, cooling controls, and the IT/OT boundary, in partnership with site operations so testing never puts a live site at risk.

 - Break the customer-facing platform, including the console, public APIs, and identity and access controls, hunting for any path from one tenant to another.

 - Assess internal and employee-built applications and the CI/CD pipelines that ship them, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults engineers adopt.

 - Partner with security and engineering teams on AI-specific attack scenarios, including agentic systems and other novel AI-enabled risks, and contribute to AI-assisted offensive testing tools and workflows.

 - Present findings to technical and executive audiences as clear, actionable risk that shapes the security roadmap.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You have years of hands-on experience in red teaming and offensive security operations.

 - You have deep expertise in at least two of: enterprise and data center networks, OT/ICS, web and API applications, cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines.

 - You've found novel attack paths and chained vulnerabilities into full compromise, crossing network, application, and identity boundaries to get there.

 - You've run red team operations and adversary simulations against well-defended environments.

 - You've found authentication, authorization, and multi-tenant flaws in web applications and APIs through hands-on testing.

 - You write quality code in Python, Go, or similar languages, and you build your own tooling when off-the-shelf tools fall short.

 - You've put AI to work in real offensive engagements, using LLMs and agents to speed up recon, vulnerability discovery, exploit development, or attack-path analysis.

 - You write findings that get fixed, and you've worked closely with blue teams to turn your operations into detections and hardening.

 - Bonus: State-nexus threat models (frontier AI, government, critical infrastructure). Data center facility systems (BMS, EPMS, cooling controls, Modbus, BACnet). High-performance and data center networking (InfiniBand, RoCE, BGP, out-of-band management). Testing AI and ML systems (agentic workflows, model serving). Defensive experience (detection engineering, SIEM, EDR).



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.


Applicant Privacy Notice https://fluidstack.io/legal/applicant-privacy-notice
AI Screening Notice https://fluidstack.io/legal/ai-screening-notice
Ashby Bias Audit https://fluidstack.io/legal/ashby-bias-audit



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: Head of Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Braintrust is the agent observability platform. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them.

Teams at Notion, Stripe, Box, OpenAI, and Cloudflare use Braintrust to trace their agents, find the issues in their observability data, and run evals that tell them how to improve.

About the role

We're looking for a Head of Sales Enablement to build the programs that help our sales team ramp, develop, and succeed. In this role, you'll partner closely with our GTM org to improve how we sell to technical teams.

This is a hands-on role for someone who brings sales experience and a real commitment to developing others. Ideally, you've been in sales and understand how to navigate complex deals. You enjoy helping reps build those skills and can turn what you see in calls and deals into focused training and coaching.

What you will do

 - Own sales onboarding and ramp. Build learning paths and practical milestones that prepare new hires to explain Braintrust's value, lead discovery, and engage technical customers.

 - Lead a hands-on training program for SDRs, AEs, and SEs, and build ongoing enablement with Sales and Solutions Engineering leaders. Use real customer scenarios, discovery and demo practice, deal reviews, and clear feedback.

 - Coach reps on account research and pipeline creation through complex deal execution. Help them develop champions, build relationships across the buying team, and connect technical evaluations to a clear business case.

 - Partner with frontline managers to reinforce MEDDPICC and value selling in calls and deals. Make coaching a regular part of how the team works, with practical guidance managers can use.

 - Work with Solutions Engineering to develop reps' understanding of AI and Braintrust. Help AEs and SEs run evaluations with shared customer goals, success criteria, and next steps.

 - Partner with Product Marketing on product launches, positioning, and competitive training. Build and maintain decks, talk tracks, and examples that reps can find and use in customer conversations.

 - Set enablement priorities using call reviews, deal outcomes, and feedback from the field. Work with RevOps and Sales leadership to measure readiness, ramp time, and conversion in the parts of the sales process you're focused on improving.

Ideal candidate credentials

 - You have a track record of success in quota-carrying B2B sales, ideally as an Account Executive selling technical products to enterprise customers.

 - You have helped other sellers improve through onboarding, training, or coaching, and can explain what changed. This experience may come from an enablement role or from developing peers and new hires as a seller.

 - You enjoy helping people get better at selling. You listen carefully, give specific feedback, and invest time in helping reps practice and improve.

 - You are curious about AI and willing to learn our product deeply. You can explain technical concepts clearly and connect them to customer problems.

 - You can build a program from an incomplete starting point, manage projects and deadlines, and prioritize as needs change. You take ownership of both the plan and the work required to deliver it.

 - You build strong relationships with Sales managers and partners across teams. You seek feedback, use data to assess your work, and adapt when an approach isn't working.

 - You use AI in practical ways to support research, preparation, and learning, with good judgment about accuracy and quality.


BENEFITS INCLUDE

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages

 - Flexible time off

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Wifi & cellphone stipend 


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Braintrust is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE INFRASTRUCTURE TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Design the fabrics the frontier trains on. Lossless, non-blocking backend networks for clusters of 100k+ accelerators, re-derived for every new generation of silicon, often before the chip is public.

 - Multiple fabrics, one system. Frontend, backend, backbone, management, enterprise, and BMS, designed as a single coherent architecture.

 - Generate the design, don't draw it. Topologies, addressing, BGP/ASN schemas, and golden configs produced from a source-of-truth model, a full site network design in days instead of quarters, correct by construction.
   
    


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the network design lifecycle from customer requirements (GPU shape, workload, scale, tenancy) through deployable, validated architectures for AI training and inference.

 - Produce topology designs, IP/addressing schemes, routing policy, and fabric configuration specs across front-end, back-end (GPU-to-GPU training fabric), and storage networks.

 - Adapt architectures to different GPU platforms (NVIDIA, AMD, custom accelerators), form factors, and workload profiles, each with its own rack layout, power envelope, and cabling approach.

 - Translate logical designs into physical reality: rack elevations, power constraints, structured cabling and fiber budgets, pathway routing, and airflow that affect equipment placement.

 - Design lossless Ethernet fabrics for RDMA (RoCEv2): PFC, ECN tuning, traffic classes, and congestion management, reasoning about ECMP and collective-communication patterns in distributed training.

 - Produce HLDs, LLDs, cutsheets, BOMs, cabling matrices, and design decision records, and lead design reviews and reusable reference architectures.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've designed data center network fabrics from requirements through deployment, not just configured them, and can explain the tradeoffs behind every decision.

 - You have deep L1 to L3 expertise: CLOS/fat-tree topologies, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and the fundamentals underneath them.

 - You design lossless RDMA (RoCEv2) fabrics and understand congestion management at training scale.

 - You reason from first principles through novel design challenges rather than pattern-matching to one reference architecture.

 - You partner across Hardware, DC Operations, ICT, Software, and Validation so designs are buildable and operationally sound.

 - Bonus: Source-of-truth-driven design generation. Multi-vendor GPU platform integration. Large-cluster (100k+ accelerator) experience.

jobs.title: Integration Engineer, Fluid Systems Test
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for an Integration Engineer, Fluid Systems Test, to help develop the systems behind our human-rated space stations. You will drive the development and execution of human-rated vehicle processes as Haven-1 transitions from design to a flight-ready station.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

Responsibilities:

• Own design, build, and commissioning of fluid system GSE and test stands

• Develop clear and robust test plans for on-vehicle checkouts, fluids, instrumentation, and high-pressure testing

• Act as test director, providing status updates and leading handoff meetings

• Conduct PDRs, CDRs, and TRRs before design and test execution

• Produce professional documentation including mechanical, fluid, and instrumentation schematics

• Document non-conformances and collaborate with the quality team on root cause corrective actions

• B.S. in mechanical, aerospace, manufacturing or electrical engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field

• Manufacturing experience (including internships) managing a product/product line across multiple work centers and/or departments, fluid, pressurized, propulsion, or environmental control hardware in design, manufacturing, or test

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Program Manager, Escalation Management
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

We are seeking a Program Manager to orchestrate how Instacart responds to its most critical escalations, including executive-raised issues and issues from our most strategic retail partners. When something is urgent, ambiguous, and spans multiple teams, you bring clarity, drive resolution, and make sure it doesn’t happen again. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Experience.

You’ll be responsible for moving our model from reactive to proactive. That means defining the risk signals that trigger early intervention, building recovery paths for known risk vectors, and turning recurring issues into data-backed product change requests. This is a strategic and analytical role for a resourceful professional with strong judgment under pressure. It is critical for building a scalable escalation process that earns the trust of internal stakeholders and key retail partners.

The Customer Experience team ensures that critical issues affecting our retailers, customers, and shoppers are resolved quickly and permanently. The team operates globally across a network of BPO partners and works closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business Development to provide immediate resolution and address systemic root cause issues.

About the Job

Program Operations & SLA Governance:

• Run the escalation operating rhythm end to end: daily case review, weekly escalation review, monthly business review, and quarterly calibration of severity criteria.

• Keep meeting hygiene tight: agendas, decisions logged, and action items assigned with named owners and due dates.

• Manage a central tracker that captures every escalation signal and root-cause action and routes each to a named owner.

• Publish and drive SLAs, and report adherence, escalation cycle time, and signal-to-action lag to leadership weekly. [Targets to be set]

Proactive Service Recovery:

• Define and maintain risk-detection signals that support early intervention.

• Design recovery paths for known risk vectors, so issues are resolved before users have to escalate.

Root-Cause & Program Delivery:

• Identify and size the frequency and impact of patterns across escalations, and turn them into effective solutions that reduce repeat issues.

• Drive cross-functional execution with Product, Engineering, Operations, and the rest of Customer Experience so every signal has a destination, every action has an owner, and every outcome is measured.

Data, Analytics & Reporting:

• Write SQL queries to investigate spikes, isolate root causes, and answer ad-hoc questions from CX, Product, and Operations leaders.

• Build and maintain dashboards and automated reporting tracking escalation volume, time to resolution, recurring themes, SLA adherence, and partner impact.

• Prepare leaders for key partner meetings, business reviews, and incident readouts with clear, quantified impact.

Process & Playbook:

• Define and improve escalation intake, severity criteria, SLAs, and communication standards.

• Build repeatable processes that scale beyond the team.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

• [5+] years of program or escalation management experience, preferably in customer experience, contact center, or partner operations.

• Proven ability to run cross-functional programs with named owners, published service-level agreements, and measurable outcomes, without direct authority in fast-moving, high-pressure situations.

• Hands-on analytical skills, including strong SQL and experience with visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Mode, Tableau, or similar) to find patterns and prioritize.

• Understanding of contact center metrics (e.g., Consumer Sentiment, first contact resolution, average handle time, Internal Quality Score) and the operational levers that move them.

• Ability to identify the root causes behind changes in key metrics and recommend a mitigation strategy.

• Track record of building reporting that an executive audience actually uses to make decisions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to synthesize complex topics into a compelling narrative for executives and external partners.

• Sound judgment on what to escalate, to whom, and when, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities, including direct conversations with upset customers, shoppers, and partners.

• Strategic mindset: able to think ahead of where the program is today and help stand up a new operating model rather than maintain an established one.

• High accountability and ownership, with a driven, self-starter approach.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience writing product feedback or change requests that Product teams accepted and shipped.

• Experience building or scaling an escalation or incident-management process.

• Experience with de-escalation strategies, including customer relationship management.

• Experience with retail, grocery, e-commerce, or marketplace partners.

• Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, JIRA, Slack, etc.

• Highly collaborative, with a track record of building trust across teams and a desire to help others learn.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

jobs.title: Data Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
About the job

Delart is home to a team of world-class engineers and project leaders dedicated to developing the next generation of advanced networking technologies, consumer devices, and innovative technology solutions. Trusted by some of the world’s leading technology companies, we deliver highly scalable, mission-critical solutions that power both consumer and business applications globally. Since our founding in 2017, we have been at the forefront of designing cutting-edge networking, telecommunications, and consumer products, while driving end-to-end project execution and creating transformative technology applications.

Overview

Join our team as a Data Quality Engineer, where you'll be the guardian of benchmark data integrity supporting continuous large-scale device testing operations. This hands-on role combines advanced data analysis, Python-based test automation, and operational ownership, ensuring the health, reliability, and actionable insights of benchmark datasets used by product engineering teams.

Responsibilities

• Define and implement data-quality checks, acceptance criteria, and validation plans grounded in benchmarking requirements and product-team expectations.

• Run daily operational reviews of 50+ devices under continuous test automation—investigating anomalies, debugging automation issues, and addressing lab-environment variances.

• Systematically validate large-scale benchmark datasets, leveraging statistical analysis to identify regressions, anomalies, and misaligned results.

• Develop, deploy, and maintain automated data-quality checks, alerting systems, and interactive dashboards to track data integrity, device health, and operational trends.

• Generate, review, and communicate clear analytical reports on benchmarking outputs, highlighting quality risks and actionable findings for stakeholders.

• Build and support Python-based automation and operational tooling for continuous benchmarking and data validation across multiple device form factors, collaborating directly with scenario and platform developers.

• Conduct in-depth investigations and monthly analytics to diagnose the root cause of anomalous data, distinguishing genuine device performance from automation artifacts.

• Review video capture logs from test runs to validate outcomes and troubleshoot scenario failures.

• Methodically debug data discrepancies, triaging systematically across lab configuration, application settings, wireless conditions, and device defects, and escalate issues to the proper owners.

• Operate and monitor CI/CD-driven test environments, ensuring stability and rapidly resolving operational failures.

• Document validation protocols, triage guides, and reporting workflows to facilitate operation at scale.

• Collaborate closely with lab operations, networking, and product teams to address environment and device issues, and help establish robust data-quality standards and practices.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in data quality engineering, QA automation, test engineering, data analysis, or similar roles.

• Demonstrated expertise in validating large datasets, identifying anomalies and regressions with statistical techniques, and clearly communicating findings to stakeholders.

• Proficiency with Python for automation, test scripting, and advanced data analysis (including debugging and maintaining codebases).

• Solid knowledge of SQL for querying, inspecting, and validating measurement and test-run data.

• Prior experience developing and operating automated data-quality checks, dashboards, alerting, or analytical reporting.

• Experience working with CI/CD-driven test infrastructures or modern data pipeline environments, monitoring system stability and resolving failures.

• Strong troubleshooting ability, with a record of isolating root causes across software, configuration, environment, and hardware domains.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, particularly for technical reporting and conveying quality risks to engineering and product stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Transaction Monitoring Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT ASTRA

Astra is building mission-critical infrastructure for moving money at scale. Our platform processes billions in annual transaction volume with 99.9%+ uptime, powering real-time transfers, bank debits, card disbursements, and complex financial compliance systems. We provide APIs and automation tools that enable businesses to move money programmatically while maintaining strict regulatory requirements.




THE ROLE

Astra is an instant-payments platform powering developers and product teams across banking, BaaS, payroll, lending, crypto, and other financial services. We're hiring a Senior Transaction Monitoring Analyst to build, operate, and improve our transaction monitoring program.

You'll design and tune monitoring rules, analyze payment activity, investigate escalated alerts, and prepare suspicious activity referrals to our sponsor banks. This is a hands-on role for someone who pairs financial crimes expertise with technical skill: comfortable working directly in transaction data and able to independently disposition complex cases. You'll report to the Head of Compliance and work closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


DESIGN AND IMPLEMENT TRANSACTION MONITORING RULES

 - Design, build, test, and maintain monitoring rules across ACH, RTP, FedNow, debit networks, and other payment rails.

 - Develop risk-based scenarios for typologies such as structuring, velocity anomalies, and rapid movement of funds, and close gaps in coverage.

 - Translate financial crimes risks into monitoring logic and thresholds, configuring rules with Product and Engineering as needed.

 - Backtest and tune rules to improve detection and reduce false positives.

 - Document each rule's rationale, configuration, testing results, and change history.


MANAGE TRANSACTION MONITORING ALERTS AND INVESTIGATIONS

 - Investigate potentially suspicious transactions and customer activity using transaction histories, customer data, and other sources.

 - Document findings and dispositions with clear investigative narratives and recommendations.

 - Prepare and submit suspicious activity referrals to sponsor banks, coordinating with the Head of Compliance.

 - Respond to sponsor-bank requests for information and support follow-up reviews.

 - Track alert volumes, backlogs, and case aging to keep operations timely.

 - Feed investigation insights back into rules, scenarios, and workflows.


ANALYZE TRANSACTION DATA AND OPTIMIZE MONITORING

 - Use SQL and other tools to query transaction data and evaluate monitoring performance.

 - Analyze activity across customers, rails, and use cases to identify emerging risks and coverage gaps.

 - Report on alert volumes, false-positive rates, rule performance, and investigation outcomes.

 - Recommend changes to thresholds, scenarios, and segmentation as products and customers evolve.


PARTNER ACROSS THE BUSINESS

 - Work with Product and Engineering on new monitoring capabilities, data availability, and case management workflows.

 - Partner with Compliance and Operations on complex investigations, emerging risks, and escalation procedures.

 - Support sponsor-bank inquiries, audits, and examinations with documentation and analysis.

 - Define monitoring requirements for new products and payment flows before launch.

 - Improve internal compliance tooling through automation and operational feedback.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required Experience

 - 4+ years in BSA/AML, financial crimes compliance, or transaction monitoring within fintech, payments, or banking.

 - Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and tuning monitoring rules — not just reviewing alerts.

 - Track record of independently conducting complex investigations and escalating suspicious activity.

 - Strong command of BSA/AML requirements, financial crimes typologies, and risk-based monitoring.

 - Working knowledge of payment rails, particularly ACH, RTP, and debit networks.

 - Experience managing alert queues while maintaining quality and timeliness.

 - Comfortable working independently and cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment, with rigorous attention to detail and documentation.

Education

 - Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, criminal justice, or a related field preferred; exceptional relevant experience counts equally.

 - CAMS, CFE, or equivalent certification preferred.

Technical Skills

 - Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing large transaction datasets.

 - Experience configuring, testing, and optimizing rules in platforms such as Unit21, Sardine, Actimize, or Verafin.

 - Ability to translate detection requirements into rule logic — thresholds, velocity calculations, aggregation windows, and behavioral patterns.

 - Experience using data to evaluate rule effectiveness and reduce false positives.

 - Working knowledge of API-driven payment architecture and rails including ACH/NACHA, RTP, FedNow, and Visa Direct.

Preferred Experience

 - Experience at a payments fintech, BaaS company, or processor operating under a sponsor-bank model.

 - Prior experience building or significantly improving a transaction monitoring program.

 - Exposure to complex use cases such as embedded finance, payroll, lending, card disbursements, or real-time payments.

 - Python or similar tools for transaction analysis, rule testing, or automation.

 - Familiarity with model validation, rule governance, and sponsor-bank expectations.

 - Startup experience spanning technical implementation and day-to-day compliance operations.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Astra's promise of fast, secure transfers depends on the trust we've built with banking partners, payment networks, and customers. Compliance isn't a secondary function here — it's part of our operating infrastructure.

As transaction volume and complexity grow, effective monitoring is essential to managing risk and supporting responsible growth. You'll own a critical function, building the controls that protect Astra and its customers, with direct, visible impact on our ability to scale.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation with equity in a growing fintech company.

 - Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements.

 - Small team, big impact — your work directly supports Astra's ability to scale responsibly.

 - Professional growth opportunities in compliance and risk management.

 - Mission-driven — build infrastructure that powers financial innovation while meeting the highest regulatory standards.




REMOTE WORK AND CULTURE

Astra is a remote-first company hiring only within the U.S. We value thoughtful collaboration, clarity, and initiative. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

WHO YOU ARE

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

Job Description

The New York Times is looking for an Associate Creative Director, Culture and Communications. You will conceive, art direct, design, and socialize a wide range of materials that connect and elevate the identities and initiatives of the Culture and Communications team, the External Comms team and the Brand Messaging team. This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Creative Director, Culture and Communications and Live Experience. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

About the Role

You will be part of the Internal Communications team led by the SVP, Culture and Communications. As an Associate Creative Director, you will lead and contribute to comms design work across the company, articulating identity needs and visual strategies in collaboration with various leadership and their teams. You will also lead creative development and art direction for our company sites, At The Times and NYTCO.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the creative for our internal events—including All Company meetings, State of The Times and the Ochs Awards—briefing the creative agencies, maintaining creative clarity across all content and developing the CEO and Publisher's presentations.

• Lead the art direction and visual maintenance for our company sites, At The Times and NYTCO.

• Set and uphold visual standards for visual design and video work supporting the Brand Messaging and Trust teams, in partnership with the Executive Producer in the Newsroom.

• Manage and mentor a small design team dedicated to the same body of work.

• Have an awareness of and strong POV on what makes for effective, mission-focused branding and identity systems.

• Actively monitor and understand social media communications and an ability to design for them.

• Be adept and imaginative at creating, curating and/or assigning appropriate visuals that originate or extend visual systems with thoughtful impact.

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

jobs.title: Employer Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
XO Health believes healthcare is fixable. Become part of the community changing the face of the industry.

XO Health is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone – from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.

We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

Employer Client Account Manager

About XO Health

Headquartered in Alpharetta, GA, and founded in 2022, XO Health Inc. is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone—from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.

We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees who are ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

Position Overview

The Client Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and overall client experience for assigned XO Health employer clients. This role serves as a primary point of contact for clients, ensuring timely communication, issue resolution, effective execution of client requests, and successful delivery of ongoing services and commitments.

The Client Account Manager will develop strong working relationships with employer clients and their key stakeholders.  The role will collaborate closely with internal XO Health teams and external partners to address issues, coordinate activities, deliver reporting, and execute client initiatives.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that requires strong judgment, organization, communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced startup environment. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of self-funded employer health benefits and is comfortable taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, identifying solutions, and stepping outside of traditional role boundaries when needed to support the client and the business.

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

• Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned employer clients.

• Develop and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients and key stakeholders.

• Ensure client questions, requests, and concerns are acknowledged, coordinated, and resolved in a timely manner.

• Own client issues through resolution by partnering closely with Network, Operations, Member Experience, Claims, Clinical, Technology, Finance, Sales, and other XO Health teams to support client needs

• Proactively communicate status, risks, issues, and opportunities to clients and internal leadership.

• Facilitate regular client meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up and accountability.

• Lead and participate in client Open Enrollment meetings and activities.

• Prepare and deliver recurring client reporting packages, presentations, and operational updates.

• Prepare materials and presentations for client meetings, business reviews, Open Enrollment, and other client-facing activities.

Project Management

• Lead client-specific projects and initiatives as requested by the client or XO Health leadership.

• Develop project plans, timelines, deliverables, and communication strategies.

• Coordinate cross-functional resources and maintain accountability for project milestones.

• Facilitate project meetings and provide regular status updates.

• Ensure successful transition of completed projects into ongoing operational processes.

Industry & Regulatory Knowledge

• Maintain a deep understanding of self-funded medical and pharmacy benefit design and how benefits are administered and delivered to employer groups.

• Maintain knowledge of applicable regulatory requirements, including the Affordable Care Act (ACA), Consolidated Appropriations Act (CAA), ERISA, Mental Health Parity requirements, and other applicable federal and state regulations.

Startup & Continuous Improvement

• Operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment where priorities may change quickly.

• Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to take on responsibilities outside of traditional account management functions when needed.

• Bring a solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to operate effectively when processes or answers are not yet fully defined.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in employer client account management, self-funded health plan administration, health insurance operations, or a closely related role.

• Active Life and Health insurance license, or ability to obtain the license within 90 days of hire.

• Demonstrated experience managing relationships with employer clients and key stakeholders, including brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, or other healthcare partners.

• Demonstrated understanding of self-funded medical and pharmacy benefit design.

• Working knowledge of ACA, CAA, ERISA, Mental Health Parity, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

• Experience leading or participating in employer Open Enrollment meetings.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and client needs simultaneously.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, senior leadership, and cross-functional teams.

• Ability to travel up to 25%, based on season and client needs.

• Experience and proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint, and AI platforms such as Claude and ChatGPT.

Compensation

Bonus/Commission: This position is eligible for bonus/commission under XO Health's applicable incentive compensation program.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.

$115,000—$135,000 USD

XO Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender reassignment, citizenship, immigration status, protected veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under applicable federal, state or local law. XO Health promotes a drug-free workplace.

jobs.title: Controls & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Controls & Automation Engineer, to help develop the systems behind our human-rated space stations. You will drive the development and execution of human-rated vehicle processes as Haven-1 transitions from design to a flight-ready station.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

Responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain a data acquisition and controls stack to support a wide range of partnering test teams at the Long Beach site—creating software tools and setting standards for test assets and practices.

• Design, implement, and own complex control systems for testing space-rated hardware, with responsibility for both hardware and software components.

• Collaborate across disciplines—including software, thermal, manufacturing, propulsion, ECLSS, and mechanical test teams—to drive robust testing practices, gather upgrade requests, and define new capabilities for the test stack.

• Troubleshoot and debug test assets to resolve issues quickly and ensure optimal test system performance.

Minimum Qualifications:

• B.S. in mechanical, aerospace, manufacturing or electrical engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Manufacturing experience (including internships) managing a product/product line across multiple work centers and/or departments, fluid, pressurized, propulsion, or environmental control hardware in design, manufacturing, or test.

• 2-4+ years of experience for Manufacturing Engineer II

• 4-6+ years of experience for Senior Manufacturing Engineer

• Hands-on fabrication, assembly, and/or integration experience; CAD proficiency (NX preferred).

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Hands-on experience building or testing hardware, in industry or through student teams such as Formula SAE, rocketry, CubeSat, or robotics.

• Experience with aerospace, spacecraft, propulsion, or other safety-critical or high-reliability hardware.

• Experience taking designs or processes from concept through build or test, and from R&D to production.

• Familiarity with CAD tools, ideally Siemens NX, and PLM tools such as Teamcenter.

• Exposure to thermal or structural analysis using Ansys, or similar tools.

• Awareness of aerospace workmanship, design, and environmental test standards such as IPC, SMC-S-016, NASA-STD-5001, or MIL-STD-810.

• Proficiency applying GD&T.

• Strong problem-solving skills, including troubleshooting and structured root cause analysis.

• Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to work well in cross-functional teams.

• Senior Level: experience mentoring engineers or technicians and managing multiple projects at once.

Additional Requirements:

• Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones.

Pay Ranges:

• Engineer/ Level I: $86,100.00 - $122,220.00

• Engineer/ Level II: $112,340.00 - $159,468.00

• Senior Engineer/ Level III: $137,760.00 - $195,552.00

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Workforce & Experience, you will develop schedules, reports, dashboards and operational plans in complex environments. • Coordinate EVS, Volunteer Operations, Logistics, Technology and venue stakeholders on staffing risks, operational testing, simulations, exercises and test events.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications, with experience developing schedules, reports, dashboards and operational plans.

Valued Experience

• Experience with volunteers and large temporary workforces.

jobs.title: Sr Linux Administrator
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The IT team is responsible for the full scope of computing infrastructure, end-user systems, servers, virtualization, cloud, networking, software services, telecommunications, and information security. You’ll support every function across the company, from the production floor to flight operations, enabling Relativity’s world-class team to design, build, and launch rockets. The team balances near-term execution with long-term vision, developing scalable solutions and processes to enable the company's growth. The evolving complexity of our IT environment offers opportunities to stretch and sharpen problem solving and hands-on technical skills. We invest in our people, encouraging ownership, cross-training, and advancement, so our team can grow as fast and ambitiously as the company itself.

About the Role:

• Act as the primary escalation point for Linux issues across engineering, from routine to complex, and own first triage of incoming requests

• Troubleshoot the daily reality of a mixed fleet: authentication and access, services, storage and filesystems, performance, and remote connectivity

• Provision Linux hosts end-to-end against established procedures, from laptops and workstations to rack-mounted servers and lab systems

• Own access and authentication operations and recurring fleet maintenance — patching, health checks, backup verification, and capacity management

• Maintain the configuration management codebase with small, reviewed changes, freeing the senior engineering side of the team for architecture work.

About You:

• 5+ years of hands-on Linux systems administration in production, owning fleet health rather than ticket-by-ticket task work

• Configuration management experience — reading, modifying, and debugging automation, not just running it — in an infrastructure-as-code model with peer review

• Medium-to-advanced troubleshooting across services, networking, storage, authentication, and performance, with the judgment to recognize when documentation runs out

• Enterprise directory services integration on Linux, credential and key management, and scripting proficiency

• Proven ability to be an escalation point for technical teams: triaging ambiguous reports and managing competing priorities without losing requests.

Nice to haves but not required:

You should still apply even if you don't have all of these!

• Automated bare-metal and VM provisioning at scale, with image and template management

• Precision time synchronization for test and measurement systems

• Kernel and driver-level depth: module management, hardware troubleshooting, or performance tuning

• Containerization, CI/CD, observability, or hardening to a published security baseline

• Aerospace, manufacturing, or test operations environments
