jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Platform (Product Management)
jobs.description:
The AI Platform team builds the foundational agentic infrastructure, runtime engines, and developer experiences that power intelligent digital workers across the entire Freshworks ecosystem. As the Senior Director of AI Platform Product Management, you will own the end-to-end strategy, roadmap, and execution of our AI agent platform—from agent creation and authoring to shared runtime architectures. Based in San Mateo in a hybrid capacity, you will lead a team of product managers and partner closely with Engineering, Forward-Deployed teams, and executive leadership to scale enterprise-grade autonomous agents and shared digital workers across global product lines.

What You'll Do

• Define and execute the end-to-end AI agent platform strategy and roadmap, spanning agent studios, natural-language builders, agentic workflows, and the shared runtime powering digital workers across our product suite.
• Direct the product vision for the core agent framework, including agent authoring interfaces, reusable skills and workflow libraries, runtime routing engines, and ambient (proactive) capabilities.
• Establish open standards and protocols for agent interoperability, cross-platform integrations, agent identity, safety guardrails, and enterprise security policies.
• Architect the quality and lifecycle infrastructure for agents, establishing rigorous evaluation frameworks, continuous testing, performance telemetry, custom model training, dynamic routing, and token/inference cost optimization.
• Oversee the context and knowledge foundation, defining strategies for knowledge curation, real-time context retrieval, memory systems, state management, and context-window optimization.
• Drive the product lifecycle for shared digital workers (e.g., workplace concierge orchestration, email-based agents, and domain-specific HR/IT vertical agents) from concept to scaled customer adoption.
• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product managers, establishing clear quarterly OKRs, aligning roadmap priorities with executive leadership, and cultivating a high-trust, outcome-oriented product culture.
• Partner with engineering, forward-deployed engineering, and customer-facing teams to translate real-world enterprise requirements into scalable platform capabilities, serving as the senior product authority on AI to executives and customers.

• 15–20 years of progressive experience in product management, with significant leadership experience defining platform architectures, developer platforms, or AI/ML systems at scale.
• Proven track record leading with vision and strategy, translating complex AI technological advancements into clear functional charters, roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
• Strong leadership acumen in investing in people, with demonstrated success coaching, mentoring, and developing product managers while fostering cross-functional alignment.
• Deep commitment to executing with excellence, with experience establishing disciplined operating rhythms, robust evaluation metrics, and clear accountability for platform reliability and delivery.
• Strong customer obsession with the ability to champion customer outcomes, identifying enterprise friction points and transforming direct user feedback into platform-level solutions.
• Deep technical comprehension of modern AI ecosystems, including LLMs, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model routing, inference economics, and agent safety protocols.

Nice to Have

• Prior experience building and scaling developer-facing platforms, workflow automation engines, or multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform architectures.

jobs.title: Sales Director - Team Independents
jobs.description:
About Teads

Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform building the future of digital advertising where quality content, trusted publishers, ambitious brands, and human creativity can thrive. Operating at true scale - processing 18 billion ad opportunities every single day - we connect global brands with a monthly reach of over 2.2 billion unique users.

At Teads, we believe your impact travels further. We are a borderless team of 1,700+ innovators across 30+ countries who favor outcome over tenure, value trusted autonomy, and use predictive AI to amplify human ingenuity rather than replace it. We move at pace, tackle genuinely complex problems, and foster a high-accountability culture that stays genuinely human. If you are looking for room to build and meaningful scope, you belong here. Learn more at www.teads.com.

About the Opportunity & Team

This role sits in Austin driving our growth strategy across the Independent agency ecosystem. As a Sales Director dedicated to Independent Agencies, you will act as the primary strategic commercial partner across mid-sized to large independent media and digital agencies (e.g., Horizon Media,pmg, Tinuiti, Known, VaynerMedia) as well as brand-direct accounts.

This team is responsible for driving our advertiser-first strategy and accelerating revenue growth through strategic agency partnerships. You will collaborate daily with cross-functional partners across Insights, Customer Experience, and Technical Solutions to turn client objectives into high-performing, innovative media strategies.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, excel at building deep relationships across complex agency networks, and are excited to bring Teads’ cutting-edge adtech solutions to life, this is your stage.

About the Role

As a Sales Director, your core mission is to expand Teads' commercial footprint and accelerate revenue growth across Independent agencies and associated brand-direct accounts. You will take full accountability for managing the complete commercial lifecycle, from navigating complex agency trading desks to delivering consultative pitches and driving ongoing campaign performance.

Success in this role means achieving regional revenue targets, deepening partner adoption across CTV, online video (OLV), display, and programmatic solutions, and maximizing client renewal rates.

What You’ll Do

Commercial Growth & Account Ownership

• Identify and close high-potential revenue opportunities to grow our market footprint across Independent agencies and brand-direct accounts.

• Navigate and establish deep, multi-threaded relationships across complex independent agency structures—from programmatic trading desks and media planning teams to executive leadership

• Educate agency partners and brand clients on Teads' cutting-edge offerings across CTV, OLV, digital display, and programmatic advertising.

Consultative Strategy & Solution Alignment

• Align Teads’ omnichannel product portfolio with the evolving business needs of Independent agency prospects and clients to deliver tailored, high-impact campaign solutions.

• Partner seamlessly with internal cross-functional teams—including Insights, Customer Experience, and Technical Solutions—to execute flawless campaigns and optimize client satisfaction.

Pipeline Management & Operational Excellence

• Maintain a disciplined, accurate sales pipeline and pipeline hygiene within internal CRM systems to ensure precision in revenue forecasting.

• Review and analyze key operational and campaign inputs—such as RFPs, trade agreement margins, and performance metrics—to optimize account growth and renewal rates.

What Will You Bring to the Team?

• Core Experience: 7–10 years of proven digital media sales experience, ideally focused on video, CTV, or programmatic channels.

• Agency Network & Domain Expertise: Strong existing network across Independent agencies (e.g., Horizon Media,pmg, Tinuiti, Known, VaynerMedia) and direct advertiser contacts, paired with a solid understanding of CTV, OLV, digital display, and programmatic buying.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation capabilities, with demonstrated skill in negotiating and influencing key agency and brand decision-makers.

• Mindset & Execution: Proactive, collaborative, and self-directed approach with comfort navigating a fast-moving, rapidly evolving adtech landscape.

What You’ll Get

At Teads, your scope is bigger than your title. Here is what you can count on in return:

• Meaningful scope & real ownership — direct accountability for driving growth across high-profile Independent agency accounts with trusted autonomy.

• Global exposure and genuinely complex challenges at real scale — reach 2.2Bn users/month across 18Bn ad opportunities/day.

• Smart, ambitious peers across 30+ markets in a collaborative, cross-border setup.

• A genuinely human culture — high care alongside high accountability.

• Real investment in your growth — structured mentorship, coaching, courses, workshops, certifications, and leadership development programs.

At Teads, your impact travels further.

The pay range for this position is USD $290,000 to $340,000 annually including on target earnings. The actual amount offered may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, job-related knowledge, skills, and abilities. In addition to salary, you may be eligible for our competitive benefits and perks to support you and your family as part of Teads’ total rewards package.

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-BAILEY

Life at Teads

At Teads, we don’t just offer jobs. We blend creativity, technology, and cutting-edge data to shape the future of media.

As a Teadster, you’ll work alongside smart humans, collaborate with meaningful brands, and leverage advanced AI and automation to redefine how advertising works in a transparent, privacy-first world.

We are builders, innovators, and future-thinkers. If you are excited by the evolution of technology and ready to embrace the future of AI-driven media, you belong here.

Why Join Us?

• A New Era of Media: We’ve merged two open internet category leaders, Outbrain and Teads to create a unified omnichannel platform. Together, we drive results from branding to performance across CTV, mobile, and web.

• AI-Powered Innovation: We actively embrace AI and next-gen technology to solve complex industry challenges. We look for curious minds who aren't afraid to experiment, adapt, and lead the charge into the future of digital advertising.

• Growth & High Performance: Our culture is dynamic, global, and built on excellence. We are committed to your success, offering the modern tools, mentorship, and development opportunities you need to thrive.

• Belonging & Impact: We foster a welcoming, diverse environment where approachable, resourceful, and passionate people excel. Through our employee-led Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), you can actively drive change in areas like sustainability, women’s empowerment, charitable initiatives, and DE&I.

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Construction Mechanical Engineer II
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Construction Design and Delivery team is at the core of Relativity's growth and development. Through our collaboration and expertise, we deliver projects that lay the foundation for Relativity's future success. In essence, we build the factory that builds the rockets! We are responsible for cross functional relationships with reams such as Manufacturing, Propulsion, PBF, Avionics, Machine Shop, Facilities, EHS, and Security to name a few, working through design specification and execution of critical infrastructure projects that supports the mission of work centers. Our relationships don't stop there, working daily with government agencies, utility suppliers, vendors and contractors who support our factory build out. Our team ensures that all projects meet operational requirements, safety and environmental codes, all the while remaining within budget, delivering on time, and to the highest quality as we help to drive production forward.

About the Role:

• Support the design and development of mechanical systems, including HVAC, plumbing, process gas distribution, and specialized systems such as cryogenic, high-pressure, and oxygen monitoring systems.

• Perform engineering calculations, equipment sizing, load analyses, and system performance evaluations to support efficient, reliable, and code-compliant mechanical designs.

• Develop and maintain mechanical design documentation, including AutoCAD drawings, Revit models, Basis of Design narratives, technical specifications, and as-built drawings.

• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, construction, manufacturing, and facilities teams to ensure mechanical systems are properly coordinated, constructible, and aligned with operational requirements.

• Support mechanical and plumbing projects from initial concept and design through construction, commissioning, and final handoff, including scheduling, budgeting, risk assessment, and documentation.

• Review designs, drawings, and submittals from external consultants and vendors to ensure compliance with applicable codes, industry standards, project specifications, and safety requirements.

• Conduct site inspections, troubleshoot technical issues, respond to RFIs, and coordinate with contractors and internal stakeholders to resolve field challenges and maintain project timelines.

• Support system startup, testing, commissioning, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency, reliability, and maintainability of manufacturing and office facilities.

About You:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering field.

• Minimum 2+ years of experience in mechanical design and engineering for infrastructure, manufacturing, or commercial building systems.

• Experience in the design and specification of HVAC, hydronic/chilled water, plumbing, drainage, compressed air, and exhaust systems.

• Experience developing Basis of Design (BOD) documentation, mechanical load calculations, and equipment sizing.

• Familiarity with mechanical codes and standards, including ASHRAE, Title 24, NFPA, and Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC).

• Experience in creating and reviewing permit-ready mechanical drawings and specifications.

Nice to have but not Required:

• Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

• Engineer In Training (EIT) Certification.

• LEED GA or LEED AP accreditation.

• Background in supporting cleanroom ventilation, specialty gas systems, or critical environment design.

jobs.title: Director, BI & Data Engineering
jobs.description:
At Salud Healthcare, we are transforming how value-based care is delivered by empowering clinical and operational teams with data-driven insights. As a growing MSO, we serve provider groups, supporting better patient outcomes through smart infrastructure, modern technology, and people-first innovation.

We are seeking a hands-on Director of BI & Data Engineering to own the Salud Enterprise Datawarehouse (EDW) on Databricks and the BI solution that sits on top of it. This is a player / coach role: you will personally design and build permanent EDW tables, data models, ETL, and stored procedures, while leading a small team through a disciplined agile delivery process.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


EDW Permanent Table Development (Databricks)

 - Design, build, and own the permanent tables of the Databricks EDW — dimensional and normalized data models across the Bronze / Silver / Gold medallion layers and curated data marts.

 - Develop and maintain production ETL / ELT pipelines and stored procedures (SQL, Spark / PySpark), and set standards for ingestion from payer, claims, clinical, and Salesforce sources.

 - Govern the platform through Delta and Unity Catalog: lineage, access, performance tuning, and per-workload cost management on Azure and Databricks.

 - Put data-quality gates in place — freshness, completeness, and reconciliation checks — so upstream disruptions never propagate downstream, and failures are loud and traceable.

Product Owner, Semantic Layer & BI Solution

 - Serve as product owner of Salud’s BI solution: own the vision, roadmap, prioritized backlog, requirements, and user acceptance.

 - Build and govern the semantic / metrics layer — including Databricks-native semantic capabilities — as the single source of truth for business metrics, so every consumer sees the same numbers.

 - Lead development on an enterprise BI platform (e.g., Looker, Omni, MicroStrategy): governed, reusable models and the dashboards leadership and operations run the business on.

 - Partner with clinical, operations, finance, and growth stakeholders to translate business questions into data products, and drive adoption across the organization.

Healthcare & Value-Based Care Data

 - Bring deep working knowledge of healthcare data — payer, claims, eligibility, membership, and clinical — and model it to support value-based care performance.

 - Deliver the analytics that matter in Medicare Advantage and value-based arrangements: HCC / risk adjustment, HEDIS / Stars quality, utilization, MLR, and capitation.

 - Enforce HIPAA-aligned controls across the data estate: least-privilege access, private networking, encryption, audit logging, and access review.

Team Leadership & Agile Delivery (Player / Coach)

 - Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers and BI developers, and direct offshore engineering resources; build hiring pipelines and lead interview loops.

 - Run a 2-week sprint cadence (JIRA, GitHub, Confluence): requirements defined and frozen per sprint, backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

 - Set engineering standards — PR review, tests that assert effect, CI/CD, and dev / QA / prod parity — and champion AI-assisted development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) under human review.

 - Stay hands-on: contribute code, models, and reviews alongside the team while protecting focus with a single, prioritized roadmap.

Required Qualifications:

 - 10+ years in data warehousing, data engineering, and business intelligence, including 3+ years leading teams.

 - Strong, hands-on experience building enterprise data warehouse permanent tables: data modeling (dimensional and normalized), ETL / ELT development, and stored procedures; expert SQL.

 - Hands-on Databricks experience — lakehouse, Delta, Unity Catalog, SQL warehouses — including semantic layer development.

 - Proven experience with an enterprise BI and semantic modeling platform such as Looker (LookML), Omni, or MicroStrategy.

 - Experience acting as product owner for a BI or data platform: roadmap, backlog, requirements, and stakeholder adoption.

 - Healthcare industry experience is REQUIRED — payer, claims, eligibility, and clinical data and its sensitivity (HIPAA, HITECH, PHI, BAAs). Value-based care experience strongly preferred.

 - Proven ability to lead a team through agile processes — sprints, code review, testing, and CI/CD — while remaining a hands-on contributor.

 - Excellent communication with executives and business users; you translate between the two.Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data/Information Systems, Statistics, or related field required; Master’s preferred but not required.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Direct experience at a healthcare MSO, IPA, ACO, or other value-based-care organization.

 - Medicare Advantage specifics: HEDIS, HCC / risk adjustment, MMR, eligibility, and claims (X12 837/835/834/270/271).

 - dbt, Airflow / Astronomer, or comparable data-platform tooling; Azure cloud data services.

 - Salesforce data pipelines; FinOps / cloud cost management.

 - Experience leading distributed or offshore teams across time zones.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

 - Salary range: $165,000–$195,000

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k).

 - Paid time off and company holidays.

Please note: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, ethnicity, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Director, Revenue Accounting
jobs.description:
Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all.

About the Role:

Ooma is seeking a hands-on revenue accounting leader to lead revenue accounting operations, revenue-related financial reporting, and internal controls across our product and service lines. This role offers the opportunity to lead a team, strengthen processes and systems, and serve as a trusted accounting partner to Sales, Legal, FP&A, Billing, and Operations.

We’re open to candidates at either the Senior Manager or Director level. Your title, responsibilities, and compensation will reflect your experience, technical expertise, and leadership skills. If you’re ready to take on broader leadership responsibilities, we encourage you to apply.

You will oversee accurate and timely revenue recognition in accordance with U.S. GAAP, including ASC 606, and support applicable SEC reporting requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong technical judgment with a practical understanding of the business, takes ownership of outcomes, anticipates issues, and drives improvements in how the team operates.

**This is a hybrid position that is required in the office Mondays and Tuesdays

What You’ll Do:

• Own revenue accounting and the monthly and quarterly close end to end, from revenue recognition and general ledger recording through preparation and review of journal entries, reconciliations, supporting schedules, and financial reporting. Ensure accurate, complete, and timely results by maintaining a comprehensive understanding of the order-to-cash cycle—including order management, fulfillment, billing, and collections—and partnering closely with cross-functional teams.

• Investigate and resolve complex accounting discrepancies and unusual transactions independently, bringing sound judgment and a solutions-oriented mindset to issues before they become problems.

• Build and maintain a deep understanding of Ooma's revenue streams, pricing models, and the order-to-cash cycle, partnering closely with Sales, Billing, and Operations to keep revenue accounting accurate and complete.

• Lead revenue performance analysis, clearly explaining results, key drivers, and business implications to senior management. Prepare and review audit schedules, revenue disclosures, and financial metrics supporting SEC reporting and external audits, keeping the team audit-ready year-round.

• Serve as the team's go-to expert on ASC 606, US GAAP, and SEC guidance, anticipating the accounting implications of new products, contracts, and business changes before being asked.

• Partner proactively with Sales, Legal, FP&A, Billing, and Operations on new products, pricing, acquisitions, and business changes, balancing compliance with practical business needs.

• Own the design, documentation, and ongoing effectiveness of internal controls over revenue recognition, ensuring SOX compliance and resolving control gaps before they surface in audit.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors on revenue matters, communicating clearly and confidently through walkthroughs and audit inquiries.

• Challenge inefficient processes and drive improvements in revenue systems and automation, partnering with IT and Finance Systems to raise the bar on accuracy and scale.

• Coach and develop the revenue accounting team, setting clear expectations and accountability while building a capable team that Finance leadership and cross-functional partners trust.

Experience We’re Looking For:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent preferred.

• 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 5 years in revenue accounting and 3+ years directly managing and developing accounting professionals. For Director-level consideration, 10+ years of progressive accounting experience and 5+ years of people leadership are preferred, with demonstrated ownership of a revenue accounting function.

• Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP, ASC 606, and SEC reporting requirements; Big Four or combined public/industry experience strongly preferred.

• Experience owning or significantly managing revenue accounting operations in a public-company or similarly complex environment, with strong SOX compliance and audit readiness.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciliations, revenue analyses, and reporting schedules, and independently managing close cycles and related internal controls.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end revenue processes — order management through general ledger reporting — ideally in a SaaS, subscription, or recurring-revenue business.

• Experience evaluating complex customer contracts and new revenue arrangements; experience supporting acquisitions or new product launches a plus.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with strong ERP, systems, and Excel/data analysis skills, and the adaptability to manage competing priorities under tight deadlines.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to explain complex accounting matters clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences and build trust as a partner to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.

What We Offer:

Working at Ooma means being a team player, while allowing your individual voice to come through. And, you'll receive competitive compensation, benefits and generous company perks.

• Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision insurance for you and eligible dependents HMO, PPO’s or a PPO with a HDHP (including HSA, which Ooma helps fund)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

jobs.title: Product Application Scientist
jobs.description:
At Alamar, we are passionate about enabling our customers to make scientific discoveries that translate into clinical outcomes and benefit patients. Our team is growing quickly as we develop innovative approaches to measure critical protein biomarkers from liquid samples that can enable the earliest possible detection of disease. We believe the next frontier in biology is enabled by measuring proteins at higher sensitivity in highly multiplexed assays at the push of a button, which is something only Alamar can do. As we build our team, we seek collaborative, driven, intellectually curious people committed to solving complex challenges. Our culture rewards accountability and cross functional teamwork because we believe this enables the kind of breakthrough thinking that will accelerate our mission.

We are seeking a highly motivated and scientifically driven Product Application Scientist to support custom assay development, assay transfer activities, and technical customer support for advanced immunoassay platforms. This role serves as a critical bridge between assay development, technical support, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams to ensure successful implementation and transfer of custom assays and workflows. The ideal candidate combines deep immunoassay expertise with strong communication, troubleshooting, and cross-functional collaboration skills to drive technical excellence across custom assay development projects and method transfers.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Serve as an internal scientific expert for custom assay development projects and Technical Access Program (TAP) initiatives.

• Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to customers, FAS, PAS, and internal stakeholders using NULISA platforms.

• Respond to customer inquiries and technical escalations related to assay design, optimization, conjugation, controls, and workflows.

• Support data interpretation, experimental design, and troubleshooting discussions with internal teams and customers.

• Partner with FAS, PAS, Product Management, and R&D to develop training materials, SOPs, workflow guides, and technical content.

• Contribute to development of technical notes for novel assay formats, conjugation strategies, and emerging applications.

• Support development and validation of AI-driven assay development tools and experimental design templates in collaboration with software teams.

• Coordinate method transfer activities including reagent preparation, inventory management, shipping, and equivalency testing.

• Design, execute, and troubleshoot immunoassay experiments to support assay validation and transfer readiness.

• Support development of workplans and Statements of Work (SOWs) for custom assay development projects.

• Facilitate cross-functional communication to ensure smooth transfer of assays into support environments.

Qualifications

• PhD or MS in Immunology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Bioengineering, or related life sciences field.

• 2+ years of experience in immunoassay development, bioanalytical sciences, or technical applications support.

• Hands-on experience with immunoassay platforms such as ELISA, bead-based assays, or digital immunoassays.

• Experience troubleshooting complex assay workflows and interpreting experimental data.

• Strong scientific communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced environment.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 - $140,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The ranges displayed on each job posting reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries but are subject to change if the leveling of the role is adjusted. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Digital Innovation
jobs.description:
Definium Therapeutics is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company and our mission is to forge a new era of psychiatry by applying scientific rigor to psychedelics, with the goal of developing accessible treatments that unlock healing at scale.

Our lead product candidate, lysergide tartrate (our proprietary orally disintegrating tablet form of lysergide (LSD) D-tartrate), represents a highly differentiated, potential best-in-class opportunity for patients suffering from generalized anxiety, major depressive disorder, and posttraumatic stress disorder. Our early stage pipeline includes DT402, the R-enantiomer of MDMA and is under development to target the core symptoms of autism spectrum disorder (ASD), specifically addressing social communication challenges.

Guided by the recognition that patients deserve more than better, Definium is relentlessly advancing a new generation of therapeutics intended to address the underlying causes of psychiatric and neurological disorders. By turning evidence into impact, Definium aims to change the trajectory of today’s mental health care crisis and enable a healthier future. Headquartered in New York, Definium Therapeutics trades on Nasdaq under the symbol DFTX.

Together we are moving psychiatry forward—beyond better, into a boundless future. Join us!

As the company grows, we are building the digital capabilities, data foundation, and operating model needed to support development, launch readiness, and future commercialization.

The Senior Director, Digital Innovation will serve as a strategic bridge between Enterprise Technology and the business, translating needs across Clinical, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Finance, and Corporate functions into a pragmatic digital roadmap. This is not simply a technology delivery role. The successful leader will help Definium determine where digital, data, automation, and AI can create meaningful business value, then orchestrate the people, platforms, vendors, governance, and change required to deliver it.

What You’ll Do

Set the Digital Strategy & Roadmap

• Partner with business and technology leaders to define an enterprise digital innovation strategy aligned with Definium’s 3-5 year growth and commercialization plans.

• Assess current digital capabilities, platforms, vendors, consultants, AI initiatives, and spend; identify gaps, overlap, underutilized capabilities, and opportunities to simplify.

• Build and maintain a prioritized multi-year roadmap that sequences investments based on business value, readiness, risk, and scalability.

• Continuously benchmark emerging practices across biotech, specialty pharma, and adjacent industries, separating durable opportunities from technology hype.

Enable Commercial & Patient-Focused Capabilities

• Partner with Commercial, Market Access, Patient Services, Medical Affairs, and Enterprise Technology to define capabilities required for launch readiness and post-launch operations.

• Help shape the future digital patient and provider experience, including capabilities supporting patient services, reimbursement, engagement, adherence, and omnichannel interactions.

• Partner with data and functional leaders to strengthen analytics and decision support so leadership can effectively manage the business as commercialization approaches.

Advance Responsible AI & Automation

• Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging digital capabilities across the enterprise.

• Create a practical intake and prioritization approach for experimentation and scaled adoption, with clear business ownership and measurable outcomes.

• Partner with Enterprise Technology, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and business stakeholders to promote responsible, secure, and sustainable adoption of new capabilities.

Build the Operating Model

• Clarify decision rights and responsibilities across Enterprise Technology, Digital Innovation, and functional teams so solutions have clear ownership from idea through adoption and lifecycle management.

• Establish lightweight governance for demand intake, prioritization, architecture alignment, vendor decisions, investment, and value realization.

• Determine where capabilities should be built internally versus sourced through strategic partners; manage key consultants and vendors and help evolve the internal team as needs grow.

Lead Through Influence

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, bringing an enterprise perspective while staying close to functional needs.

• Translate business problems into clear capability requirements and technology opportunities, and translate technical choices into business implications for non-technical stakeholders.

• Drive cross-functional alignment, adoption, and change in an environment where priorities and capabilities are evolving quickly.

What You Bring

• 12+ years of relevant experience spanning digital strategy, enterprise technology, product, data/analytics, or technology-enabled business transformation, ideally within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated industry.

• Experience leading digital strategy or transformation programs that connect enterprise technology with business functions; experience supporting a company approaching commercialization or launch is highly valued.

• Working knowledge of commercial life sciences capabilities, particularly patient services, market access, omnichannel engagement, commercial analytics, and related data flows; exposure to Clinical and Medical Affairs is a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate and apply AI, automation, data, and emerging technologies to real business problems rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.

• Experience developing roadmaps, business cases, operating models, governance, and investment priorities, with a strong orientation toward measurable outcomes.

• Strong vendor and partner management skills, including the judgment to determine when to build, buy, or partner.

• Exceptional cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

• Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment with ambiguity, competing priorities, and a need to balance near-term delivery with long-term capability building.

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant technical/business training is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

• Definium has a clear, business-led digital roadmap tied to development, launch, and growth priorities.

• Digital investments are prioritized consistently, with clearer ownership, less duplication, and stronger visibility into value and spend.

• Commercial, Clinical, Medical, and corporate teams have a trusted partner who can connect business needs to scalable technology solutions.

• AI and automation move beyond isolated experiments toward responsible, repeatable adoption where they can materially improve work or decision-making.

• Definium builds only the digital organization it needs, at the right time, using an effective mix of internal talent and external partners.

Individual compensation within the range is determined based on factors such as relevant skills, experience, qualifications, scope of the role, and other legitimate business considerations.  In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus and equity opportunities. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k) with company match, flexible time off and additional wellness benefits and perks.  Learn more about our benefits on our Careers page.

$230,000—$320,000 USD

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sr. Quality Engineer – Dolls
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Mattel is currently seeking a Sr. Quality Engineer in El Segundo, CA. This role is a key member of the corporate Quality Engineering leadership team, reporting to the Sr. Manager of Quality Engineering - Dolls. This role supports global brand teams and works cross-functionally with Product Development, Design, Packaging, Regulations, Play Labs, Quality Data Analytics, and Manufacturing partners.

The Senior Quality Engineer plays a key role throughout the product development lifecycle—from concept and design reviews through product launch and post-market support—by translating design intent into robust, risk-based quality and testing strategies. The role contributes through technical expertise, independent judgment, cross-functional influence, and mentoring.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Lead development, implementation, and maintenance of Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and Primary Concerns Documents (PCDs) within eQMS systems, ensuring alignment with product safety, performance, and brand expectations.
• Drive translation of product concepts, play patterns, and consumer use conditions into robust validation strategies, including mechanical, physical, chemical, and abuse testing.
• Lead and influence concept and design reviews, providing expert input on safety, durability, regulatory compliance, and consumer experience.
• Apply advanced working knowledge of global toy safety regulations and standards (ASTM F963, CPSIA, EN71, ISO, etc.), driving compliance across programs and ensuring clear interpretation and communication to cross-functional teams.
• Lead risk management activities (e.g., FMEA), developing and executing risk-based strategies across product categories, features, and manufacturing processes.
• Utilize and integrate multiple data sources (test results, consumer complaints, returns, field data, play testing) to proactively identify risks and drive product and process improvements.
• Independently lead complex investigations into product failures, safety issues, and manufacturing defects using structured root cause analysis tools (5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.), ensuring thorough resolution and documentation.
• Partner with internal labs and third-party testing facilities to define testing strategies, review complex test results, and ensure compliance with regulatory and brand requirements.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Design, Development, Packaging, Regulatory, Manufacturing) to ensure quality requirements are embedded early and effectively executed.
• Identify downstream impacts, risks, and opportunities across functions and proactively drive alignment and resolution.
• Lead supplier and manufacturing quality efforts, including issue resolution, corrective actions, and performance monitoring.
• Mentor and support junior engineers in technical problem solving, regulatory understanding, and cross-functional engagement.
• Lead continuous improvement initiatives across product development, testing strategies, and manufacturing processes, ensuring compliance is maintained while improving efficiency and quality outcomes.
• Support and lead investigation of consumer complaints and field issues, ensuring timely, data-driven, and effective resolution.
• Periodic travel to global manufacturing sites and development partners as needed

What We’re Looking For:

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Materials, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
• 5+ years of experience in quality engineering, product development, or manufacturing (toy or consumer products industry preferred)..
• Deep knowledge of global toy safety standards and regulations (ASTM F963, CPSIA, EN71, etc.).
• Experience working with internal labs and third-party testing laboratories.
• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes (plastics, textiles, electronics, packaging).

• Advanced knowledge of statistical analysis and data interpretation.
• Experience leading risk management activities (FMEA) and root cause analysis.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with statistical tools (e.g., Minitab) preferred.
• Strong leadership and collaboration skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
• Advanced ability to interpret and apply global toy safety and consumer product regulations.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently drive complex decisions.
• Ability to determine, analyze, and synthesize multiple data sources into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
• Proven ability to lead investigations, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance technical depth and business impact.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead projects in a fast-paced environment.
• Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop less experienced engineers.
• Proactive, results-oriented mindset with strong ownership and accountability.
• Demonstrated a growth mindset by staying curious and continuously learning, embracing challenges, and improving themselves.

jobs.title: Oracle Database Administrator
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The Work:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) to manage, maintain, secure, and optimize Oracle database environments supporting mission-critical applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in database administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting across development, test, staging, and production environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle databases across multiple environments.

• Monitor database performance, availability, security, storage, and backup/recovery processes.

• Implement and support backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions.

• Troubleshoot and resolve database incidents, outages, and performance issues.

• Collaborate with application and development teams to support deployments and optimize database operations.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and standards.

• Participate in change management activities, system upgrades, and Agile project initiatives.

• Monitor and analyze database performance to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

• Perform SQL and PL/SQL tuning using Oracle performance tools such as AWR, ASH, Statspack, and execution plans.

• Optimize queries, indexes, partitions, and database schemas.

• Monitor and improve CPU, memory, I/O, and network utilization.

• Establish performance baselines and implement proactive monitoring and alerting.

Here’s What You Need:

• Minimum 3 years of Oracle Database Administration experience.

• Strong experience administering Oracle databases in enterprise environments.

• Proven expertise in database performance tuning and optimization.

• Experience with Oracle RMAN, Data Pump, backup/recovery strategies, and database security.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Bonus Points If You Have:

• Experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and high-availability architectures.

• Experience supporting large-scale production environments.

• Knowledge of Linux/UNIX administration and shell scripting.

Eligibility Requirements:

US Citizen

Clearance Requirements:

Secret Clearance

jobs.title: Bilingual Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description:
Our Story: 

Short Story is an award winning, technology powered retailer dedicated to petite women 5'4" and under. Our mission is to create a seamless shopping experience for millions of petite women so they can dress with effortless confidence. 

As a fast-growing startup, we're revolutionizing retail with a data driven learning system that leverages customer feedback to create tailored products. We've been recognized by top publications like Forbes, Fortune and are backed by leading investors who share our vision of building the world's next great consumer brand.



Our Values: 

We're building a company with intention and purpose. Our culture thrives on data insights, exceptional commitment to fit, and the urgency to move quickly on what matters.

 - ✨ Transform Lives. We're customer-first. Everything we create exists to give her confidence.

 - ⚡️ Demand Excellence. We deliver only our best work, in Fit and Finish. We obsess about details others overlook.

 - 💪 Embrace Challenges. We see obstacles as opportunities to invent better solutions.

 - 💡 Think Differently. We get a thrill from finding better solutions others haven't seen.
   
   

Short Story is seeking a Bilingual (Spanish/English) Warehouse Supervisor to lead teams at our South San Francisco fulfillment center. Your mission is to help us build a well-oiled, customer-centric machine. You'll lead a team of exceptionally talented, bright, and committed people. As Warehouse Supervisor, you will help us deliver our promise to our customers. You will oversee receiving, handling, storing, picking, and packing activities within the warehouse, ensuring we meet quality standards at every turn. You must be an exceptional people manager and operationally savvy. You will lead a large team of associates and several functional Team Leads. You must have the ability and vision to help us scale rapidly. Our ideal candidate is exceptionally detail-oriented and can track multiple facets of the warehouse at once. 



Your primary responsibilities will be:

 - Ensure the warehouse operates at peak efficiency, with customer satisfaction being the primary goal, by supervising, organizing, directing, and training warehouse employees and establishing, monitoring, and managing operational goals

 - Support development of warehouse operations systems by determining product handling and storage requirements, equipment utilization, inventory management, gate processes, and shipping

 - Review and prepare workflow, manning and space requirements, equipment layout, and action plans while ensuring productivity, quality and customer service standards are met

 - Inspire, develop, and support your direct reports and warehouse associates

 - Connect your team to our vision and bring focus & intention to delivering on our stated goals

 - Manage the labor planning needs for your team to meet weekly goals through accurate planning for current and future hiring needs

 - Review daily performance data and analyze for trends and opportunities. Make informed decisions and respond to changing operational needs effectively e.g. staffing and process changes.



You will support some of these functional areas:

 - Outbound: manage the entire outbound shipping process, including picking, folding, and shipping orders. You will ensure that every detail is perfect in our Short Story curations. This team also processes Client exchanges.

 - Returns: ensure all returned items are of the highest quality before returning them to inventory to delight another Client.

 - New Merch: receive new inventory from our vendor partners, tag, categorize, and bin 100% of it.

 - Support: enable overall operational success by resolving fulfillment issues, repairing and restoring inventory, and keeping equipment running smoothly. 



Minimum Qualifications:

 - The ability to work onsite in South San Francisco from 6 am Mon - Fri

 - You are an exceptional people manager with 3+ years leading large teams

 - You are proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) or G Suite (Google Sheets, Docs, Slides)

 - This is a 100% in-person role. You must be able to work in our warehouse in South San Francisco

 - Comfortable delivering frequent written and oral feedback

 - Eligible to work in the United States



Other Qualifications

 - Bilingual English & Spanish

 - You thrive in fast-moving environments where you will move quickly 

 - You are energetic and ready to be on-the-go -- leading your team from the floor for 8 or more hours per day

 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think analytically while working in a fast-paced startup environment

 - Leadership: You must be comfortable and confident leading a team of 25+ people where your ideas and efforts will have a direct impact on company processes

 - Expertise in verbal and written communication with internal and external stakeholders

 - Previous experience working in ecommerce or a tech startup is a plus

 - Must be able to wear many hats with a hands-on, ready to go attitude

 - Must be flexible and accept change readily with a driven and positive mindset

 - Eager to learn and excited to help build a company from the ground up



Why You'll Love Working at Short Story:

 - You'll get to work at an early-stage start-up, to build the culture, and to have an outsized impact on our company and society

 - You'll be a key part of the company with the ability to make high-impact decisions

 - You'll get the opportunity to try your hand at new things. We deeply believe in giving people the opportunity to venture into new areas

 - We are a successful, fast-growing startup solving problems that have not been solved before and reinventing fashion for an underserved segment

 - We are a group of smart, passionate hustlers with a wealth of diverse experiences

 - We are motivated by unique challenges and opportunities

 - We are our own customers; many of us on the team are petite women who love our products

 - We are driven by the mission of helping petite women find their perfect fit so they can dress with total confidence



Benefits

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits

 - 401k with company match

 - Flexible PTO policy

 - Catered lunch on Fridays and company events

 - Employee discount on merchandise

Short Story is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and a work environment free of discrimination and harassment for all employees and applicants. We work diligently to ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:

Rubrik’s sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional development through our world class sales enablement program and our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something that truly matters, protecting the world's data.

As a Strategic Sales Engineer, you will provide technical direction and business guidance to the regional sales team. We are seeking a self-starter who will exceed sales quotas by driving innovative technical programs, pipeline generation alongside AEs, customer demonstrations, POCs, and overseeing day-to-day account-level activities. You will be responsible for evangelizing, positioning, and architecting Rubrik’s Data Resilience, Observability and Remediation tools to a targeted list of new & existing customers throughout the Northwest Region.

What You'll Do:

• Provides technical leadership and direction to customers and internal staff in the development of fully integrated technology solutions in support of pre-sales activities in the assigned market.

• Assists in the analysis, design and development of fully integrated technology solutions.

• Demonstrates technical leadership and subject matter expertise on Rubrik’s products, distributed architectures, file systems, and competitive storage offerings in the SAN product space.

• Acts as technical expert and consultant to develop and propose solutions that meet the technology and business requirements of assigned customers.

• Makes technical and sales presentations to customer's technical staff and senior management.

• Successfully builds relationships with the account team, partners and customers in support of sales team objectives and engages and leverages corporate resources, abilities, budgets and personnel as appropriate.

• Leads technical sales calls

Preferred Qualifications:

• 5+ years of sales engineering experience preferably in a software or data center environment.

• Driven – need for success, highly energetic with a strong hands-on, “can do” approach.

• The successful candidate must have a fundamental breadth of technical knowledge in cloud data management, backup and disaster recovery and data analytics.

• Entrepreneurial - willing to go the extra mile, strong work ethic, resourceful, “get it done” attitude

• Strives in moving in a fast-paced environment; including handling multiple calls/demos per day with immediate follow up.

• A high level of business acumen and experience working with Cx0 level personnel, bringing technology solutions to solve business challenges.

• Smart, adaptable and open-minded

Our goal is to ensure that all students have access to flexible learning environments and educators have the tools they need to support their students. We are on a mission to create innovative, proven learning technology, partnering with educators to ignite student potential. We are a Remote First organization with a strong commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

• Cultivate new and long-term customer relationships, identifying key contacts and conducting impactful meetings.

• Expand existing programs and add new implementations through strategic cross-selling of Edmentum’s full portfolio.

• Navigate complex sales cycles and influence high-level decision makers to close deals.

• Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations tailored to customer needs.

• Develop and execute a strategic territory plan to achieve ambitious objectives.

• Stay informed on funding options and market trends to maximize opportunities.

• Maintain accurate sales activity and forecasts in CRM systems.

• You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in K-12 education.

• You bring at least two years of sales experience, including presentations and outreach.

• You are skilled in using CRM systems and managing client relationships.

• You possess strong communication, presentation, and time management skills.

• You are adept at articulating technical concepts and translating customer needs into solutions.

• You have a solid understanding of education and software markets.

• You excel at planning, organization, and multitasking.

• You are willing to travel within your territory.

jobs.title: Full-Time Keyholder - Fifth Avenue
jobs.description:
KEYHOLDER  - FULL-TIME

New York City, NY - Fifth Avenue

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Keyholder, you will help bring our company values to life by creating a service-first culture on the sales floor and supporting smooth store operations. You’ll act as a role model for your peers, delivering exceptional customer experiences, coaching in the moment, and upholding operational excellence. As part of the leadership team, you may serve as Manager on Duty, ensuring the store reflects our brand standards and values in every interaction.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (80%)

 - Lead and model Rothy’s Experience through exceptional service and selling on the sales floor by coaching and guiding team members to consistently uphold brand standards

 - Drive personal and team sales results, by delivering the Rothy’s Experience to all customers and supporting your teammates through coaching and team selling

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Assist with the execution of in store events and activations that engage the local community, support brand awareness, and drive sales

 - Support with onboarding and training by reinforcing store standards, SOPs, service expectations, selling behaviors, and product knowledge on the sales floor

Team Leadership & Operational Excellence (20%)

 - Act as Manager on Duty when assigned ensuring daily operations, visual merchandising tasks, and service expectations are being met by all team members

 - Own assigned areas of responsibility as part of the Division of Responsibility (DOR) program and communicate progress, opportunities, and feedback to store leadership




YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older




YOU HAVE:

 - 1–2 years of retail or customer service experience, ideally with some leadership responsibility

 - A proven ability to connect with customers and deliver exceptional service

 - Experience supporting operational tasks such as merchandising, shipment, or stockroom leadership

 - A desire to grow your leadership skills

 - Ability to stand/walk an entire shift

 - Ability to lift, push carry or otherwise move up to 25 lbs

 - Ability to frequently bending, reaching, stretching, and safely use ladders and step stools

 - Ability to uphold Rothy’s Experience by following our dress code, including wearing Rothy’s shoes during every shift

 - Availability to work a minimum of 40 hours/week, including peak business days (Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays), holidays, and evening and opening shifts





OUR BENEFITS:

 - Generous paid time off

 - 401k matching

 - Comprehensive health plans for you and your family

 - Supplemental mental health benefits

 - Monthly wellness reimbursement

 - Employee Discount Program!




PAY RANGE

$21.00 - $23.00 per hour

Base pay is one part of the total rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.  This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

Base pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

jobs.title: Executive Protection Specialist – Lateral Hire (3+ Years EP)
jobs.description:
Gavin de Becker & Associates (GDBA) protects the world’s most influential and at-risk public figures.  Founded in 1978 by 3-time Presidential appointee, Gavin de Becker, our firm’s Protectors, Analysts, and Investigators are committed to our mission of protecting human life through the assessment, prediction, and management of violence.

GDBA’s Mission: The Safety, Privacy, and Wellbeing of our Clients

Who You Are:

GDBA is looking to add experienced executive protection professionals to its teams across Menlo Park/Palo Alto. Our ideal applicant for this position has 3+ years of residential or travel executive protection experience working for at-risk clients. Executive protection experience working in roles that require driving, traveling, and providing close protection during public appearances is also highly desirable.

A newly hired Lateral Protector in Menlo Park/Palo Alto will earn no less than $105,000 in base earnings during their first year with GDBA. Los Angeles-based Protectors could earn up to $155,000 in first year earnings when accounting for prior relevant experience, GDBA Training Academy performance, and promotion opportunities.

Your Role as a Protector:

• Monitor property while utilizing the tools and technology of a GDBA Command Center

• Screen visitors and vendors; control all access to protected site

• Coordinate and execute security plans and respond to medical emergencies

• Provide physical protection and logistical support at clients' homes and when they travel

• Provide secure transportation as needed

• Survey and prepare (advance) locations prior to arrival of client

• Prepare detailed documentation of suspicious activity

• Create and maintain readiness to meet any threat

Hiring Process Requirements:

• 12-Day Introductory Training Academy in San Antonio, TX

• Be able to pass physical readiness test (Pull-ups, Push-ups, Sit-ups, 800m run)

• Must be able to swim

• Must be drug and nicotine free

• Background check required

• Must be able to obtain appropriate state firearm and security licensing
