jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
With over 30,000 customers, including a third of Fortune 500 companies, Tempo is trusted by organizations across the globe to make their workflows work better.

We create a suite of integrated solutions for time management, resource planning, budget management, roadmapping, program management, reporting and more. We create the tech that enables the modern team to deliver – for every step from first vision to value.

Since our beginning in 2007 as a project to make a time-tracking tool to help a client – Tempo has expanded to become the #1 time management add-on for Jira, and we have developed and acquired a multitude of tools to become one of the most trusted names in the Atlassian ecosystem.

We want everyone to work better – but we also want to be a tech company with a heart. Join us as we continuously innovate our award-winning products, create new solutions, and help the world work smarter, not harder.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer who will be working at the intersection of LLMs, real-time signal processing, and enterprise decision-making. This is not a research role or an isolated AI team position. You’ll sit alongside domain engineers as you ship production AI systems to enterprise customers.

This is not the typical AI/ML engineering role. We’re looking for someone who uses AI heavily in their own daily work, has built and shipped features powered by LLMs and autonomous agents, and has strong opinions on what good AI product engineering actually looks like. If your go-to move when facing a complex problem is to reach for an agent pipeline rather than a static script, you’re the kind of engineer we have in mind.

You’ll initially pair with our external AI partners to absorb their work and establish the patterns the broader engineering team will follow. Over time, you become the internal anchor for AI engineering — the person the rest turn to for prompt design, evaluation strategy, model selection, and agent architecture decisions.

What you’ll do: 

Signal detection and anomaly detection

Statistical and ML-based detectors that identify meaningful patterns in portfolio signals — velocity changes, capacity saturation, dependency risks — from CDC event streams and external tool integrations. Not simple threshold alerts; intelligent pattern recognition that knows the difference between noise and a real problem.

Insight synthesis engine

An LLM-powered correlation engine that takes raw signals and produces actionable insights with root causes, confidence scores, and evidence chains. Not just “something is wrong” — but “why it’s wrong, what it means, and what you should do about it.”

Planning Rules compiler

A translation layer between natural language planning rules (written by portfolio managers) and the structured parameters that drive our Monte Carlo scheduling engine. The LLM interprets intent; the deterministic engine computes schedules. You’ll design how these two layers communicate reliably.

Evaluation and testing frameworks

The pipelines that ensure AI outputs are reliable, consistent, and improving over time. Regression suites for prompt changes, A/B testing infrastructure for model updates, confidence calibration — because vibes-based testing doesn’t scale at enterprise scale.

MCP tool definitions

LLM-ready tool specs for domain capabilities (Item Store queries, capacity lookups, scenario simulations) that Tempo AI can discover and invoke at runtime within a hub-and-spoke MCP architecture already in production.

Who you are:

Must Have

 - A track record of shipping LLM-powered features or products — prototypes don’t count; we want to see things that real users have relied on.

 - Hands-on experience orchestrating agents — multi-step reasoning, tool use, autonomous action with guardrails. Frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent (including rolling your own).

 - Deep LLM engineering fundamentals: prompt engineering, RAG architectures, function calling / tool use, context management, evaluation-driven development.

 - Production-quality engineering practices — you write code with tests, participate in code review, care about CI/CD and observability. You build systems that run reliably in production, not notebook prototypes.

 - Experience with event-driven or streaming data systems — CDC events, real-time pipelines, and the patterns that come with them.

 - 5+ years in software engineering, with 3+ years focused on AI/ML in production systems.

 - Ability to work embedded in a product team — collaborating daily with domain engineers, product managers, and designers, not just other AI specialists.

Strongly Preferred

 - AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or GCP Vertex AI — we’re running on Bedrock with Claude today.

 - MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-use / agentic frameworks.

 - Anomaly detection, time-series analysis, or statistical signal processing.

 - Building confidence scoring or calibration systems for AI outputs.

 - A track record of absorbing work from external partners and making it your own — you know how to inherit an architecture, evaluate its decisions, and improve what you find.

 - Proficiency in Kotlin or TypeScript alongside Python — our product platform is Kotlin/TypeScript; our AI platform is Python. You’ll work across both.

Nice to Have

 - Monte Carlo simulation, optimization algorithms, or scheduling systems.

 - Background in portfolio management, project management, or resource planning.

 - Experience in enterprise SaaS — multi-tenancy, compliance, audit trails.

 - Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.

Mindset

 - You use AI tools heavily in your own daily work — not as a novelty, but because they make you meaningfully more effective.

 - You have strong opinions (loosely held) about what makes AI products trustworthy versus impressive-but-fragile.

 - You’re energized by a space that’s moving fast, and you track model releases, emerging agent frameworks, and new patterns as they happen.

 - You’re as comfortable writing an Architecture Decision Record as you are writing a prompt.

Why Join Tempo?

 - Impact: Work on meaningful products that empower enterprise users and improve productivity.

 - Innovation: Be part of a culture that values creativity and innovation, with opportunities to make a real impact.

 - Collaboration: Join a supportive, collaborative UX team that values openness, communication, and a continuous learning environment.

 - Growth: Opportunities for professional development, including conferences, courses, and mentorship.

What's In It For You (Org-wide)

 - Remote First work environment

 - Unlimited vacation in most of our locations!!

 - Great benefits including health, dental, vision and savings plan.

 - Perks such as training reimbursement, WFH reimbursement, and more.

 - Diverse and dynamic teams with challenging and exciting work.

 - An opportunity to have a real impact on our business.

 - A great range of social activities (both in person and virtual).

 - Optional in person meet-ups and the ability to travel to our international offices

 - Employee referral program

 - And so much more!

Note: As our hiring teams are global, please submit your resume in English only

Apply today to join the Tempo team and help shape the future of enterprise productivity software.

Join us at Tempo Software, where we proudly foster an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to creating an inclusive culture where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Value-Based Care Platforms
jobs.description:
Salud Healthcare

Salud Healthcare is a tech-forward services organization that helps private practices and provider groups succeed in value-based and alternative payment models. Our in-house platforms, Nexus and Nexo, are central to how we support providers, manage risk and quality, and run our operations. The Product Manager owns the direction of an assigned product area end to end turning healthcare business needs into a clear roadmap and buildable requirements, and deciding what gets built next alongside the business and Software Engineering.

 

Position Summary

Reporting to the AVP, Software Engineering, the Senior Product Manager owns an assigned product area and connects Salud's clinical, operations, finance, provider relations, and payer-facing teams with the engineering team. You set product direction and priorities: running discovery, defining and sequencing the roadmap, shaping and prioritizing the backlog, writing clear requirements with testable acceptance criteria, and accepting finished work against them. This is a hands-on role you still elicit requirements, map workflows, and analyze healthcare data yourself rather than hand it off. It requires deep healthcare experience: the right candidate already understands Medicare Advantage, value-based care, claims, risk adjustment, and quality programs, and can speak credibly with both business users and engineers. The role is remote.

 

Key Responsibilities

Requirements & Workflow Analysis

 - Elicit and document requirements from clinical, operations, finance, provider relations, and payer-facing stakeholders through interviews, workshops, and observation.

 - Map current-state and future-state workflows in Lucid (swimlane / BPMN), identifying gaps, manual workarounds, and opportunities to automate.

 - Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria, business rules, and edge cases that engineering can build from without guesswork.

 - Maintain requirements traceability, data dictionaries, and process documentation.

 - Create mockups and clickable prototypes in Figma to pin down requirements, test workflows with stakeholders, and align on the design before build.

 - Apply design-thinking methods user research, journey maps, and problem framing to make sure we solve the right problem before committing requirements.

Healthcare Data Analysis

 - Analyze healthcare data claims, eligibility, encounters, HCC/risk adjustment, HEDIS/quality gaps, and payer files to define data requirements, mappings, and validation rules.

 - Write SQL queries to profile data, validate assumptions, and confirm that delivered features produce correct results.

 - Support integrations with payers, EMRs, and outside vendors by documenting file specs, interfaces, and data flows.

Delivery, Testing & Adoption

 - Serve as the day-to-day go-between for business users and engineers, answering questions during development and resolving ambiguity quickly.

 - Partner with QA on test scenarios and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) with business owners.

 - Help business teams adopt new features through walkthroughs, release notes, and job aids.

 - Own go-to-market for each release launch communications, release notes, training, and change management so business teams adopt what ships.

Product Management & Roadmap

 - Own the product roadmap and backlog for your product area keep it groomed, sized, sequenced, and ready for upcoming sprints.

 - Set and defend priorities based on business value, regulatory or payer deadlines, effort, and dependencies; make the trade-offs explicit to stakeholders and the AVP, Software Engineering.

 - Run discovery with stakeholders and users to decide what to build next, and hold to one focused roadmap rather than many competing requests.

 - Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews; accept or send back completed stories against their acceptance criteria.

 - Define success measures for each release and report on adoption and outcomes, folding results and new feedback back into the roadmap.

Strategy, Metrics & Agile Delivery

 - Tie the product roadmap to company OKRs and the Technology strategy show how each initiative ladders up to a measurable objective.

 - Define product KPIs and success metrics, instrument them with the data team, and use the numbers adoption, usage, outcomes to decide what gets built next.

 - Run agile delivery for your area and manage JIRA end to end backlog, epics, sprints, and reporting (velocity, burndown, status) keeping tickets clean, estimated, and traceable to requirements.

 - Coordinate across engineering, data, QA, and outside vendors and payers managing dependencies, timelines, and hand-offs so commitments land.

 

Required Qualifications

 - 5+ years in product management, product ownership, or senior product / business analysis on software or data projects, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an Agile/Scrum environment.

 - 5+ years of healthcare industry experience with a health plan, MSO, ACO, value-based care organization, provider group, or healthcare technology company.

 - Hands-on working knowledge of Medicare Advantage and value-based care models, risk adjustment (HCCs/RAF), quality programs (HEDIS, CMS Star Ratings), and claims, eligibility, and encounter data, including X12 EDI transactions (834, 835, 837).

 - Working SQL skills for querying and validating data.

 - Bachelor's degree in business, health administration, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 - Proven ability to map complex workflows and explain them simply to both business and technical audiences.

 - Strong written communication requirements clear enough to build from without a meeting.

 - Experience owning a backlog and roadmap in Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar tool.

 - Fluent in agile / Scrum delivery and JIRA management backlog, epics, sprints, boards, and reporting (velocity, burndown, status).

 - Experience defining and tracking product KPIs / success metrics to guide decisions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in Florida's Medicare Advantage market.

 - Prior product manager or product owner experience, including roadmap ownership and backlog prioritization.

 - Certification such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, or Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO).

 - Familiarity with data warehouses, BI tools, and FHIR or HL7 interfaces.

 - Hands-on with Lucid (or Visio) for workflow and process mapping and Figma for mockups and prototyping.

 - Design-thinking / human-centered design practice, and experience connecting product work to company OKRs.

 

Compensation & Benefits

 - $130K base salary

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k)

 - Paid time off and company holidays.

 - Opportunity to shape the future of healthcare technology within a rapidly growing value-based care organization.

Please note: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion. The Impact You'll Make

As the Lifecycle Marketing Principal, Consumer Growth & Experience, you'll be responsible for the growth of Upside’s automated, full-funnel consumer lifecycle engine that isn't tied to a single merchant bet. You'll build and scale onboarding, habituation, and referral/advocacy programs that compound across every vertical (fuel, grocery, restaurant, and more), and you'll be lifecycle's hands-on partner to our product and product marketing teams as we turn our consumer facing surfaces, on-and-off platform, into a genuine growth channel. You'll report to the Director of Lifecycle Marketing and operate with practitioner-level autonomy: no direct reports, high accountability, hands-on in Braze.



What You'll Do

Own & Scale the Core Funnel

 - Architect the Automated Funnel: Lead "Core Lifecycle" work streams, helping us continue to evolve the program into a robust, automated ecosystem. You will personally design, build, instrument, and optimize sophisticated lifecycle automations across onboarding, habituation (M1–M3 retention), reactivation, high-upside viral referral loops, and more.

 - This is a highly hands-on role requiring deep expertise in CRM and marketing automation platforms to create scalable, "always-on" drivers of MAU and retention.

 - Build with a test-and-learn mindset; every meaningful automation change ships with a control or holdout

Drive Cross-Platform Experience

 - Be lifecycle's primary hands-on partner to Product product and product marketing on Braze-orchestrated experiences, on and off platform (content cards, in-app messages, connected content, etc) and owned off-platform surfaces (email, push, SMS), turning them into a scalable acquisition and engagement channel.

 - In partnership with product marketing, support GTM strategy, feature & capability launches, and experimentation cadences with the goal of deeper product adoption.

 - Define the technical data requirements (events, attributes, etc) these experiences need, in partnership with martech, analytics, and data science teams.

Modernize Referral & Advocacy

 - Support the evolution and optimization of Upside's referral program end to end as a modern, automated advocacy loop, in tight partnership with product marketing and product teams.

Strategic Influence & Autonomy

 - Executive Business Framing: Function as a trusted, high-visibility partner to leadership teams across consumer, product, analytics and executive stakeholders to shape and impact our commercial growth model by turning abstract lifecycle problems into clear strategic roadmaps.

 - Autonomous Operation: Be comfortable operating independently while managing projects of extreme complexity and high risk while serving as an expert resource and mentor for the wider lifecycle team.



Competencies You'll Need

 - 8+ years of progressive experience in Lifecycle Marketing and CRM, with a demonstrated track record of increasing consumer engagement and retention within a relevant mobile-first B2C experience, a marketplace brand, or other related industry.

 - Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.

 - Deep functional knowledge in modern marketing engagement platforms such as Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, specifically with hands-on experience building and architecting solutions in platforms. This role requires ongoing practitioner-level expertise and comfort personally building, troubleshooting, and optimizing sophisticated automation programs.

 - Experience developing and optimizing mobile-first lifecycle marketing programs across push notifications, in-app messaging, content cards, and other app-native engagement channels.

 - AI-forward practitioner with hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to build and refine agents, skills and automation frameworks that accelerate velocity and efficiency across end-to-end lifecycle execution.

 - Data-first decision maker with a test-and-learn mindset. Outstanding analytical and critical thinking abilities, and the capacity to interpret and distribute performance data into practical, digestible insights for stakeholders across the business and inform future strategies.

 - A collaborative mindset with a proven ability to build strong, impactful partnerships across diverse teams.

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and persuade collaborators at all levels.



The fine print:

Location:

This hybrid role is based in our DC or NYC office. In-office attendance is required on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday and may increase based on project-based needs and changes to Upside’s in-office policy over time.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician l (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
Shift: Tuesday- Saturday, 2:00pm- 10:30pm

The Laboratory Technician I receives sufficient authority from, and is accountable to the Laboratory Supervisor or appointed designate for the successful completion of assigned duties and responsibilities and has the authority to take action necessary to carry out the duties and responsibilities of this position and to identify the occurrence of departures from the quality system or from the procedures for performing tests and/or calibrations, so long as such action does not deviate from established company guidelines, is consistent with sound technical and business judgment, and follows the practices of the laboratory.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Demonstrates and promotes the company vision
• Regular attendance and punctuality
• Reads, understands and follows management system requirements as relevant to responsibilities, including but not limited to requirements found in the Quality Manual, SOPs, Local Work Instructions and Methods which in turn ensures compliance with ISO/IEC 17025/AOAC ALACC requirements and relevant government regulatory requirements
• Adhere to all health, safety, and environmental regulations relative to assigned analytical work; maintain and assist others in maintaining a clean, safe work environment
• Registration of incoming samples (as needed), maintaining a neat and accurate record system of work performed on a daily basis and as needed for quality control tests or regulatory purposes
• Enter the sample data into Eurofins eLIMS system in a timely and accurate manner
• Complete laboratory testing on all incoming samples in an accurate, efficient and timely manner; ensure sample turnaround time goals are met or exceeded
• Verify results and submit results to the appropriate personnel for transmission, in a timely manner
• Identify process difficulties and report these together with proposed solutions to supervisor
• Maintain a perpetual state of readiness and willingness to respond to the queries and needs of clients, staff, and co-workers
• Maintain cooperative working relationships with all company employees. Communicate orally and in writing to co-workers. This includes “intra” and “inter” departmental employees
• Promote the company image through the exercising of sound and ethical business practices as related to the public and our customers
• Continually strive to improve the quality of work we provide to our clients through existing and new technologies
• Identify non-conformances and out-of-specifications
• Conducts all activities in a safe and efficient manner
• Performs other duties as assigned

• HS Diploma required
• BA degree recommended but not required
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship

Additional preferences:

• AS or BS Degree in Microbiology, Food Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry or a related field. Experience in plating, plate reading, and sample preparation.

Shift: Tuesday- Saturday, 2:00pm- 10:30pm

What we offer:

• Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Eurofins USA Food Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Project Manager, IMS
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



The Role 

The Project Manager is responsible for the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for key programs and products, serving as the central integrator between program, manufacturing engineering, supply chain, and operations timelines.  

This position partners cross-functionally to ensure alignment between engineering schedules, supply chain lead times, and delivery commitments in a dynamic, high-mix NPI manufacturing environment.  



What You'll Do

 - Own the IMS. Develop Integrated Master Schedules for products, programs, capabilities, and production sites. Sequence development, procurement, construction, equipment installation, and qualification activities across concurrent NPI and factory-buildout workstreams for feasible schedules. 

 - Own updates and ensure the schedule is a trusted tool for decision-making and reliable source of valid data. 

 - Track schedule performance against baseline, proactively identifying risk, quantifying impacts of changes, and surfacing key insights. Drive solutioning to achieve milestones and maintain delivery commitments. 

 - Facilitate cross-functional schedule reviews and ensure stakeholder alignment on milestone dates, deliverables, and resource trade-offs. Drive accountability for on-time delivery. 

 - Support definition of scheduling philosophy, standards, and patterns. Systematize and automate to efficiently scale scheduling.  



What We’re Looking For 

 - 7+ years of experience in integrated scheduling, project management, or engineering or manufacturing planning. 

 - Demonstrated experience developing and managing an Integrated Master Schedule. 

 - Strong knowledge of scheduling methodologies and principles, including for estimating durations and qualifying risk. 

 - Experience using scheduling tools (e.g. MS Project, Primavera P6, Smartsheets, etc) and building automations and connectors. 

 - Ability to partner with stakeholders and drive accountability. Strong communicator and relationship builder. 



What Will Set You Apart 

 - Experience in development and scaling phases of aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or other complex hardware manufacturing industries. 

 - Undeterred by ambiguity and proven delivery of meaningful outcomes. 

 - Ability to bring structure and process to fast-paced environments while maintaining velocity 

 - Experience supporting multi-site or multi-program production environments.


Compensation 

For this role, the target salary range is $160,000-$220,000 (actual range may vary based on experience). 

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a hyper-organized, proactive, and versatile recruiting coordinator to join our collaborative talent acquisition team. As an important partner to our recruiters and hiring teams, you will support and uphold an efficient recruiting process while creating an exceptional candidate experience. You’ll put your organization and communication skills to work to ensure candidates have a seamless visit to our manufacturing facility, that interviews and hiring events go off without a hitch, and that our recruiting data is accurate. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a fast-moving start-up, gain experience in recruiting operations and have a direct impact on the growth of our mission-driven manufacturing efforts!



This is a hybrid role, which will require working onsite from Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV 3 to 4 days a week.


 Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Support recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates throughout the hiring process by managing job postings, coordinating (at times) high volume of screens,  job interviews, and owning candidate communication and experience

 - Organize candidate site visits and travel, serving  as the primary point of contact for candidates visiting our Weirton factory,  troubleshooting last-minute scheduling changes as they arise

 - Demonstrate Form Energy’s values (humanity, excellence, and creativity) in all interactions with candidates, recruiters, business leaders, hiring managers, and interviewers

 - Eager to explore and integrate emerging AI tools and workflows to enhance daily productivity

 - Ensure data integrity by regularly auditing our applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruiting documentation

 - Help plan and execute logistics for recruiting events, such as career fairs, batch interview days, and conferences

 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to support and improve  the recruiting lifecycle for temporary manufacturing staff during critical production scale-up phases

 - Identify and partner to drive process improvements to enhance efficiency and elevate candidate experience




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - BA/BS degree

 -  Experience in Recruiting Coordination, Recruiting or a similar role with calendar management or coordination (Ashby experience is a plus!)

 - Strong written and verbal communication

 - Attention to detail while juggling multiple task

 - Experience with an applicant tracking system and/or Google Suite

 - Demonstrated experience in systematic administrative skills
   




WHERE YOU'LL WORK:


This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.



 #LI-Onsite



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: Director of Technology Partnerships
jobs.description:
ABOUT BLAND AI

Bland AI builds voice AI for enterprises with complex, high-volume call center operations. Our platform helps businesses automate customer conversations and complete the workflows behind them. By developing our own voice AI stack, we give enterprises greater control over the reliability, security, and customization of their deployments.




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 1.  Identify, evaluate, and source new technology partners across complementary software, telecom, and contact center platforms. Build relationships from initial outreach through agreement and launch.

 2.  Own and grow a portfolio of existing technology partnerships, establishing shared priorities and developing relationships across business, technical, and executive stakeholders.

 3.  Build business cases for new partnerships and expansion opportunities based on customer demand, product fit, revenue potential, implementation effort, and ongoing support needs.

 4.  Work with partners and Bland’s Product and Engineering teams to define joint use cases, align integration requirements, coordinate launches, and bring customer and partner feedback into roadmap discussions.

 5.  Lead partnership negotiations with support from leadership, Legal, and Finance, aligning commercial terms, incentives, commitments, and responsibilities around mutual value.

 6.  Develop and execute joint go-to-market plans with Sales and Marketing, including positioning, partner enablement, co-selling, and targeted campaigns that drive adoption and qualified opportunities.

 7.  Establish partner goals and run regular business reviews focused on integration adoption, partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue, and customer outcomes.

 8.  Identify and resolve barriers to partner success, clarify ownership across teams, and maintain momentum from initial launch through ongoing growth.

 9.  Use performance data to identify expansion opportunities, adjust underperforming initiatives, and prioritize where Bland invests time and resources.

 10. Build repeatable playbooks, partner plans, and reporting. Use tools and automation to reduce manual coordination and help the ecosystem grow efficiently.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of product partnership experience, including direct ownership of technology partnerships, platform alliances, or integration partnerships at a B2B technology company.

 - A track record of both sourcing and launching new partnerships from scratch and managing and expanding existing relationships.

 - Examples of partnerships you helped translate into measurable results, such as customer adoption, product capabilities, qualified pipeline, or revenue.

 - Technical fluency sufficient to discuss APIs, integrations, and customer workflows with product and engineering teams and explain their value to commercial audiences.

 - Experience developing partnership business cases, negotiating agreements, and aligning stakeholders around shared commitments.

 - Strong execution across multiple teams: setting priorities, clarifying ownership, resolving blockers, and following through.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously, exercise judgment, and make progress when the path is not fully defined.




NICE-TO-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - Background in voice AI, conversational AI, broader AI, telecommunications, contact center technology, or customer experience software.

 - Familiarity with integration partnerships, joint solution development, co-selling, and co-marketing.

 - Experience building partnership processes or programs at an early-stage or rapidly growing company.

 - Experience navigating enterprise buying processes or working with customers in regulated industries.

Relevant industry experience is valuable, but it is not required. We welcome candidates who bring strong partnership fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn a new market quickly.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Annual cash compensation (OTE): $160,000–$240,000, including base salary and target incentive compensation.

 - Equity: Meaningful equity in a high-growth, well-funded AI company, separate from and in addition to the annual cash compensation range.

 - Full benefits package.

 - Fully remote work within the United States; working from our San Francisco headquarters is a plus.

 - Willingness to travel approximately 25% of the time for partner meetings, joint customer engagements, and industry events.




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Candidates must be able to work in the United States.

Bland is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and do not discriminate based on any legally protected characteristic.

Bland participates in the E-Verify employment verification program. All new hires are required to complete the Form I-9, and employment will be verified through E-Verify as part of the onboarding process.

jobs.title: Hardware Development Engineering
jobs.description:
Western Digital is seeking a motivated Early Career Photolithography Process Engineer to join our wafer manufacturing team. This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about semiconductor manufacturing and processing. development, data analysis, and solving complex technical challenges. As a member of the Photolithography Engineering team, you will work alongside experienced engineers, technicians, equipment specialists, and cross-functional partners to develop, optimize, and sustain advanced lithography processes used in high-volume manufacturing. This position offers excellent opportunities for technical growth, mentorship, and career development in one of the most critical process areas within semiconductor manufacturing.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• • Support photolithography process development, optimization, and sustaining activities for high-volume manufacturing.
• • Monitor process and equipment performance using statistical analysis and data-driven problem solving.
• • Participate in root cause investigations and corrective actions for process excursions, yield issues, and equipment-related events.
• • Execute experiments and process characterizations using Design of Experiments (DOE)
• methodologies.
• • Develop and implement process improvements to improve yield, cycle time, quality, and
• manufacturing robustness.
• • Support qualification of new equipment, materials, and process technologies.
• • Create and maintain process documentation, operating procedures, and engineering reports.
• • Train and support technicians, manufacturing personnel, and equipment owners.
• • Collaborate with Integration, Yield Enhancement, Metrology, Maintenance, Manufacturing, and Product Engineering teams.
• • Utilize Statistical Process Control (SPC), Advanced Process Control (APC), and data analytics tools to monitor and improve critical process metrics.
• • Gain hands-on experience with advanced lithography systems and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

REQUIRED

• B.S. or M.S. degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
• Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, microfabrication, research laboratories, or other technology-focused environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to interpret data and identify trends.
• Experience with data analysis tools such as JMP, Python, SQL, Minitab, SAS, MATLAB, or similar platforms.

SKILLS

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
• Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, learning agility, and ownership of assigned projects.

PREFERRED

• Internship, co-op, research, or manufacturing experience in semiconductor processing or wafer fabrication.
• Familiarity with cleanroom environments and semiconductor manufacturing practices.
• Exposure to photolithography concepts such as photoresist coating, exposure, development, overlay, and critical dimension control.
• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DOE), Statistical Process Control (SPC), and Advanced Process Control (APC).
• Experience with scripting, automation, machine learning, or data visualization tools is a plus.

The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

Team & Development

• Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Site Development
jobs.description:
At Rowan Digital Infrastructure, we are transforming data center delivery for speed and scale. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class data center solutions to hyperscale customers who share our commitment to sustainability, and to do so with an unwavering focus on efficiency, quality, and flexibility.  Our data center solutions are tailored to our customers’ needs and delivered by our exceptional end-to-end team. Rowan is assembling a strategic portfolio of data center sites in Tier 1 markets across the United States at various stages of development, and we’re looking for incredible and passionate people to help us advance our company and our commitment to building a more sustainable future.   



Rowan is backed by Quinbrook, a leading investor in the energy transition, and Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager.  

 

Ready to join us in transforming the future of data centers and sustainability? Apply now to explore exciting career opportunities at Rowan Digital Infrastructure and be a part of our mission to revolutionize data center delivery.  

 

Role Summary

Rowan is seeking a Senior Manager of Site Development to lead the origination and development of data center development activities across our project portfolio. This role is integral to shaping and executing Rowan’s development strategy and rapid expansion—determining which sites to pursue, advancing them through due diligence and entitlements, and delivering them into the leasing and construction pipeline in alignment with business objectives. The ideal candidate brings a strong track record of delivering complex data center projects, has experience in early evaluation of power/energy availability in various regions, exceptional negotiation and communication skills, and can succinctly and accurately provide senior leadership-level updates across their project portfolio. Success in this role requires comfort with ambiguity, a highly organized and proactive approach, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

 

Travel: Ability to travel up to (25%) for company gatherings or to project sites.

Location: Denver, CO (3-day hybrid in-office role)

Compensation: $170K - $205K (Offers Bonus)

 

Essential Responsibilities

 - Collaborate with senior-level deal leads, supporting site development activities for a portfolio of data center projects—from site origination up to construction commencement. Responsibilities include initial site screening, pipeline management, site due diligence, title curative actions, and risk management

 - Independently manage site due diligence contractors for early-stage projects, overseeing contract management, onsite activities, schedules, and budgets

 - Support senior level deal leads with key agreement negotiations, including land acquisitions, development agreements, and other commercial contracts that support risk mitigation and project advancement

 - Coordinate cross-functional evaluation of potential sites by collaborating with a multidisciplinary team of subject matter experts across power/energy, engineering, legal, planning, and other domains

 - Support the advancement of all development activities, including managing complex land transactions, land use and entitlements, permitting, physical and legal due diligence, and other pre-construction workstreams, and relay the impact of these on key investment metrics

 - Collaborate with internal teams—including energy, fiber, finance, water & wastewater, legal, and economic development—to identify and address key project risks and ensure long-term viability

 - Represent the project internally and externally, providing clear, concise updates to project teams and leadership

 - Contribute to team growth and scalability by helping establish strong diligence and reporting practices and continuously improving development processes and systems

 

Education, Skills, and Experience

 - Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., business, real estate, environmental management), or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience

 - Advanced degree (e.g., MBA) or relevant professional certification is a plus, but not required

 - 7+ years of experience leading large-scale, complex site development projects or portfolios in the data center or commercial real estate industry

 - Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial agreements, including land purchase agreements, energy, water/wastewater service, and economic development agreements

 - Demonstrated ability to work with external stakeholders, including authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), utilities, and economic development agencies to advance complex infrastructure projects

 - Strong experience leading cross-functional initiatives, with responsibility for project strategy, budgets, schedules, and risk management

 - Demonstrated trust-based leadership, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence outcomes without formal authority

 - Proficiency in real estate development due diligence, permitting, and entitlements for large-scale developments

 - Prior experience in utility-scale renewables, including large-scale energy projects

 

Fueled by Excellence & Collaboration

At Rowan, we are a distributed team united by a common mission to transform data center delivery. Across our two offices, we offer a hybrid work environment supported by teamwork, technology, and in-office gathering time to help you be successful. We are headquartered in downtown Denver, Colorado and have an office in Seattle, Washington. Our team of talented and passionate individuals is spread out across the U.S.



Here to support you

At Rowan, we want to make sure you can do great work. We offer competitive benefits focused on helping you be and achieve your best.

jobs.title: Logistics Routing Administrator
jobs.description:
Logistics Routing Administrator



Think of your favorite book from childhood. Got it? Great. Now, that warm, joyful feeling you have right now—that’s what we do. Literati is a modern children’s book company focused on helping kids fall in love with reading at every age and stage. We make it easy to find great books through our school book fairs, school store fundraising platform, and book clubs using a unique mix of expert curation and data science. We’re on a mission to help parents ignite a love of learning and a love of life.



Role Summary

As a Logistics Routing Administrator (LRA), you will report to the Transportation-Logistics Manager and play a key role in coordinating and executing transportation activities across the business. Your primary responsibility is to manage the transportation process from initial warehouse route planning and pickup through crossdock planning and execution to final-mile planning and delivery.



You will work closely with carriers, fulfillment centers, crossdocks, customers, Customer Service, and Production to ensure transportation plans are communicated, coordinated, and executed successfully. This includes developing and communicating routes, coordinating pickups and deliveries, monitoring transportation activity, and proactively identifying and resolving issues throughout the shipment lifecycle.



The LRA serves as a central point of communication between internal departments and external transportation partners. This position requires strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain accountability across the transportation process. 



The role also supports the ongoing development and maintenance of transportation databases, reporting, processes, and compliance standards.



The LRA directly contributes to business performance through on-time deliveries, effective fulfillment center execution, carrier accountability, and the successful coordination of inbound and outbound freight.



This is a high-visibility opportunity to make a meaningful impact on business operations and support literacy worldwide. As a growing startup, we anticipate significant year-over-year business growth, creating opportunities for professional development and career advancement. You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced industry professionals while continuing to develop your skills and capabilities.



Starting rate: $21/hr, non-exempt 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong attention to detail.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks simultaneously.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.

 - Ability to coordinate multiple carriers and transportation partners.

 - Strong auditing skills and sense of accountability.

 - Commitment to accuracy and high-quality standards.

 - Strong mathematical and analytical skills.

 - Ability to interpret and execute transportation plans.

 - Commitment to excellence and continuous improvement.

 - Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities with minimal supervision.

WE’D LOVE TO SEE

 - High school diploma or GED.

 - Advanced Excel skills.

 - Experience with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

 - Experience coordinating with carriers, warehouses, or transportation partners.

 - Knowledge of transportation, logistics, routing, and carrier management.

 - Strong task management and organizational abilities.

 - Ability to walk and stand for extended periods.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Transportation Planning & Execution

 - Develop, coordinate, and communicate transportation routes with carriers and fulfillment centers.

 - Coordinate the full transportation lifecycle, including warehouse route planning and pickup, crossdock planning and execution, and final-mile planning and delivery.

 - Ensure fulfillment centers receive accurate routing information in advance of scheduled shipment dates.

 - Coordinate inbound and outbound freight movements, transfers, fair deliveries, and pickups.

 - Monitor transportation execution to ensure routes and delivery plans are completed as scheduled.

Carrier & Stakeholder Coordination

 - Serve as a primary point of coordination with carrier representatives regarding routing, scheduling, pickups, deliveries, and transportation requirements.

 - Coordinate transportation activities between warehouse personnel, crossdock teams, carriers, customers, Customer Service, and Production.

 - Communicate transportation plans, requirements, and changes to all appropriate parties.

 - Follow up with carriers and transportation partners to ensure execution aligns with established plans.

 - Support carrier accountability and maintain effective working relationships with transportation partners.

Issue Resolution & Customer Communication

 - Identify, investigate, and coordinate the resolution of transportation issues throughout the shipment lifecycle.

 - Address service failures, missed pickups, delayed deliveries, routing discrepancies, and other transportation exceptions.

 - Communicate directly with customers to resolve transportation-related questions, delays, and service issues.

 - Provide proactive updates and maintain clear communication between customers, internal departments, and external partners.

 - Coordinate with the appropriate teams to minimize service disruptions and ensure timely resolution of issues.

Transportation Systems, Reporting & Compliance

 - Operate the routing program and maintain the transportation database.

 - Support the development and maintenance of transportation databases, processes, and reporting.

 - Develop and maintain facility-specific transportation reports.

 - Prepare and communicate Bills of Lading (BOLs).

 - Conduct transportation and safety audits.

 - Support driver safety and compliance requirements.

 - Assist with transportation training, process documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

ABOUT LITERATI

We offer competitive salaries, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, short-term disability insurance, parental leave, employee assistance programs, flexible work schedules, and flexible time off.

We are dedicated to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and connectedness that sees, reflects, welcomes, and celebrates the innovation and talent of a diverse array of people. jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst – Supply Chain
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Senior Financial Analyst – Supply Chain
Location: Stamford, CT or Las Vegas, NV
Job Type: Full Time | Exempt

Who You Are:

You have a strong background in financial planning and analysis, with direct experience supporting procurement, supply chain, or similar operational environments. You understand how sourcing decisions, supplier costs, inventory, and purchasing trends impact financial performance. You're analytical, detail-oriented, and confident working with complex financial data to identify cost-saving opportunities, improve forecasting, and influence business decisions. You enjoy building financial models, challenging assumptions, and partnering with cross-functional leaders to turn data into actionable insights. You bring a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and are comfortable taking ownership of financial analysis in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

What You’ll Do:

As a Senior Financial Analyst – Supply Chain on Curaleaf's Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team, you'll serve as a key financial partner to our national Procurement and Supply Chain teams. You'll lead financial analysis, forecasting, and reporting efforts across sourcing, purchasing, and inventory operations, helping leadership better understand cost drivers, evaluate opportunities, and make informed business decisions. You will:

• Lead purchase price variance (PPV) analysis and price forecasting across direct and indirect spend categories, identifying key cost drivers and financial impacts.

• Develop and maintain financial models to evaluate sourcing strategies, supplier costs, and opportunities for cost optimization.

• Partner with Procurement to track, validate, and report cost savings initiatives, ensuring accurate measurement of realized savings.

• Analyze supplier cost structures, contract terms, commodity pricing, and inflation trends to identify risks and opportunities.

• Build financial business cases for sourcing decisions, including make-versus-buy analysis, supplier consolidation, and dual-sourcing strategies.

• Partner with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to analyze inventory movements, cost trends, and their impact on financial performance.

• Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning for Procurement and Supply Chain operations.

• Lead variance analysis and performance reporting, identifying key drivers of cost of goods sold (COGS) and opportunities to improve profitability.

• Develop and track financial and operational KPIs, translating complex data into meaningful reports and dashboards.

• Collaborate with Procurement, Operations, and Commercial teams to improve financial visibility and support strategic decision-making.

• Support COGS improvement initiatives through financial analysis, savings validation, and ongoing performance tracking.

• Build and improve financial reporting tools, models, and processes to increase data accuracy, automation, and efficiency.

• Present financial findings, recommendations, and performance trends to leadership, providing actionable insights that influence business decisions.

What You’ll Bring:

• 3+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), procurement finance, supply chain finance, or a related financial analysis role.

• Direct experience supporting procurement, sourcing, supply chain, or similar operational functions, with an understanding of how purchasing decisions, supplier costs, and inventory impact financial performance.

• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, variance analysis, and financial performance reporting.

• Experience analyzing purchase price variance (PPV), supplier costs, procurement spend, or cost of goods sold (COGS).

• Strong Excel skills and a solid understanding of financial statements, cost accounting principles, and financial reporting.

• Experience working with large datasets and financial reporting, ERP, or business intelligence systems.

• Ability to independently analyze complex financial and operational data, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations.

• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and partner effectively with cross-functional leadership.

• A proactive, collaborative approach with the confidence to challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and take ownership of financial initiatives.

Even Better If:

• You have experience supporting procurement, sourcing, or supply chain operations across multiple facilities, brands, or business units.

• You're familiar with commodity pricing, inventory valuation, supplier negotiations, or sourcing financial analysis.

• You have experience with financial reporting and analytics tools such as Snowflake, Omni, Power BI, Vena, or SQL.

• You have experience evaluating sourcing strategies, validating cost savings, or supporting COGS improvement initiatives.

Curaleaf Pay Transparency

$90,000—$115,000 USD

• Career Growth Opportunities

• Competitive Pay and Benefits

• Generous PTO and Parental Leave

• 401(K) Retirement Plan

• Life/ Disability Insurance

• Community Involvement

• Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts

Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.

Instagram: @curaleaf.usa

As a high-growth cannabis company known for quality, expertise and reliability, the Company, and its brands, including Curaleaf, Select, Grassroots, Find, and Anthem provide industry-leading service, product selection and accessibility across the medical and adult-use markets. jobs.title: Director, Strategic Communications, IT
jobs.description:
At WD, Strategic Communications plays a critical role in connecting business strategy, technology innovation, and employee engagement through clear, compelling storytelling.

We are seeking a Director, Strategic Communications to serve as the communications lead supporting the Chief Information Officer and within the IT organization. This role will partner closely with the CIO and IT leadership team to shape strategic narratives, strengthen leadership communications, engage the global IT organization, and bring greater visibility to IT”s role in enabling the business.

The ideal candidate is an experienced communications leader, trusted advisor, and exceptional storyteller who can translate complex business and technology topics into clear, relevant, and engaging communications. They will set the vision and strategy for CIO and IT communications, build the processes needed to deliver it, and bring leaders and partners along through candid counsel, sound judgment and disciplined execution.

As a member of the Strategic Communications team, this role will collaborate closely with executive leaders, Chiefs of Staff, communications colleagues, HR, and cross-functional partners to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational alignment, and employee engagement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Executive Communications and Strategic Counsel

• Serve as the primary communications advisor to the CIO, providing strategic counsel and executive communications support.
• Develop and execute an integrated communications strategy that strengthens the CIO’s leadership platform and advances key business and organizational priorities.
• Shape compelling narratives around IT strategy, technology, innovation, AI, and the evolving role of IT in enabling WD’s business.
• Develop executive content and messaging, including presentations, speeches, briefing materials, leadership communications, talking points, video, and multimedia content.
• Support the CIO’s internal and external engagements, including employee forums, leadership meetings, industry events, speaking opportunities, social content, and thought leadership.
• Establish effective planning and preparation processes that ensure key engagements are purposeful, consistent, and impactful.
• Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen the CIO’s visibility and engagement with key audiences.

IT Organizational Communications and Engagement

• Lead the communications strategy within the IT organization, partnering with IT leadership and communications colleagues to drive alignment around its strategy, priorities, culture, and business objectives.
• Partner with the Office of the CIO, including the Chief of Staff, to translate priorities into focused communications plans and drive their execution.
• Shape narratives and communications around IT priorities, transformation, innovation, AI, and the function's role in enabling WD's business.
• Lead communications for IT all-hands, leadership meetings, organizational announcements, employee engagement initiatives, and other key moments.
• Create content that helps IT employees understand the organization’s strategy, priorities, progress, and impact.
• Showcase IT innovation and build excitement within the function around AI, emerging technologies, and new ways of working.
• Develop resources that enable IT leaders to communicate effectively and consistently with their teams.
• Partner with HR and IT leadership to support culture, engagement and organizational effectiveness within the function.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Partnership

• Partner across Strategic Communications to align CIO and IT communications with broader WD narratives and priorities.
• Partner closely with Employee Communications and other communications colleagues to connect IT priorities to broader enterprise communications.
• Collaborate with Public Relations, Marketing, HR, and other functions to support CIO visibility and thought leadership.
• Build trusted relationships across IT and the broader enterprise to drive alignment and effective execution.

Measurement and Continuous Improvement

• Assess communications effectiveness through engagement metrics, stakeholder feedback, and other relevant measures, using insights to continuously improve.
• Leverage AI-enabled tools and modern communications technologies to enhance content development, planning, measurement, and team productivity.

• 10+ years of communications experience, including significant executive and internal communications experience supporting senior leaders.
• Demonstrated success serving as a trusted communications advisor and candid coach to senior executives and leadership teams.
• Skilled at bringing structure and focus to fast-moving, ambiguous environments while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.
• Experience leading communications for a large, global function or organization, ideally within a technology-driven environment.
• Exceptional writing, storytelling, and executive content development skills, with the ability to translate complex business and technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives.
• Strong understanding of executive communications, employee engagement, organizational communications, and thought leadership.
• Strong executive presence, business acumen, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of an organization.
• Highly collaborative and adaptable, with strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Proficiency in PowerPoint and experience leveraging modern communications technologies, including AI-enabled tools.
• Experience in technology, semiconductor, infrastructure, cloud, storage, or other complex B2B industries preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Part Time Floor Leader -  ABQ Uptown
jobs.description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

$16.50—$16.50 USD

jobs.description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

• customer service and sales
