jobs.title: Sr Construction Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Construction Design & Delivery team is at the core of Relativity’s growth and development. Through our collaboration and expertise, we deliver projects that lay the foundation for Relativity’s future success. In essence, we build the factory that builds the rockets! We are responsible for cross functional relationships with teams such as Manufacturing, Propulsion, PBF, Avionics, Machine Shop, Facilities, EHS and Security to name a few, working through design specifications and execution of critical infrastructure projects that supports the mission of work centers. Our relationships don’t stop there, working daily with government agencies, utility suppliers, vendors and contractors who support our factory build out. Our team ensures that all projects meet operational requirements, safety and environmental codes, all the while remaining within budget, delivering on time, and to the highest quality as we help to drive production forward.

About the Role:

The Senior Project Manager position is responsible for the planning, design, and execution of capital construction projects supporting rocket manufacturing. This role oversees delivery of complex, high-bay, mission-critical facilities- and supporting infrastructure- ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with aerospace, environmental, and regulatory requirements.

• Work with Design team to orchestrate projects to ensure direct alignment with long-term corporate objectives. Facilitate strategic planning to start and rive work completion

• Direct oversight of large and small-scale budgets. Responsible for rigorous cost-benefit analysis, resource allocation, and maintaining project profitability through proactive financial auditing

• Design and implement comprehensive risk-mitigation frameworks. Predict potential system bottlenecks and engineer sophisticated contingency strategies to safeguard delivery timeliness and quality standards. Aggressively work eliminate// minimize and negative impacts to the company's mission

• Continuous evaluation of project lifecycles ti identify and institutionalize workflow efficiencies. Execute "best practice" methodologies to minimize further operational friction

About You:

• 8+ years of progressive PM experience, with a documented history of delivering high-stakes, million-dollar initiatives

• Proven delivery of capital and development projects, preferably in aerospace, advanced manufacturing, defense, or energy

• Strong understanding of: Heavy equipment foundations and structural systems MEP and process utilities Experience managing A/E firms, contractors, design-build firms, and multiple concurrent projects

Nice to haves, but not required:

• Experience in aerospace, rocket manufacturing, or similarly regulated environments

• Knowledge of hazardous materials, propulsion systems, or test facilities

jobs.title: Maintenance Supervisor
jobs.description:
About Ruggable:

Ruggable is a leading direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand based in Los Angeles, California with an extraordinary track record of high, profitable growth. We pride ourselves on having an extremely loyal customer base and a talented team made up of genuinely caring people who take action and deliver results. We are venture-backed and own a patented washable rug design that's disrupting the home décor industry. Our mission is to empower our customers to live vibrantly with beautiful products that don't compromise on function. If you're passionate about consumer products, e-commerce, and high-growth start-ups, keep reading!

Job Summary:

Ruggable is seeking an energetic, hands-on, and technical Maintenance Supervisor to lead our maintenance technicians and keep our manufacturing and fulfillment operations running smoothly at our Charlotte plant. In this role, you will be directly responsible for the daily execution of mechanical, electrical, and facility maintenance, ensuring maximum uptime, equipment safety, and high-efficiency output across all production lines (including large-scale printing, cutting, finishing, and packaging equipment).

What You’ll Do:

• Lead Floor Operations: Manage work shift schedules, floor presence, and daily job assignments to resolve open maintenance work orders promptly.

• Conduct daily shift handoff meetings with production supervisors.

• Maintain & Troubleshoot Equipment: Coordinate equipment and building repairs, monitor equipment and asset performance, and partner with the Maintenance & Safety Manager and Reliability Engineering teams to conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on repeated machine failures.

• Drive Safety Protocols: Evaluate the safety protocols followed at the production facility. Ensure full compliance with state, local, and OSHA safety regulations (LOTO, arc flash, machine guarding, and standard operating procedures).

• Manage Inventory & Vendors: Coordinate spare parts inventory management, submitting purchase requests to ensure required replacement components are in stock. Oversee third-party external contractors, specialized equipment technicians, and facilities service vendors when on site.

• Support Team Performance: Resolve problems and conflict, including employee performance management, appraisals, and disciplinary practices.

What You’ll Need to Have:

• Bilingual Fluency: Fluent in both English and Spanish (verbal and written).

• Leadership Experience: Experience leading a team, including resolving problems/conflicts, conducting performance appraisals, and overseeing disciplinary practices.

• Manufacturing Background: 2+ years experience in manufacturing maintenance with supervisory experience.

• Technical & Troubleshooting Expertise: Strong troubleshooting background including electrical (PLCs, motor drives, sensors, standard wiring), mechanical, pneumatics, and hydraulics).

• Systems Knowledge: Solid understanding of warehouse, electrical, HVAC, and mechanical systems.

• Proficiency with Google Suite or Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associate Degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering Technology or Trade Certification (Journeyman, Millwright, Industrial Maintenance)

• Active OSHA certification (e.g., OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 General Industry).

• Previous experience in the textile manufacturing industry.

• Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) for managing inventory and work orders.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and climb throughout an 8-hour shift in an industrial manufacturing environment.

• Ability to safely lift and carry up to 50 lbs as required during equipment troubleshooting and maintenance.

Location: Charlotte, NC (On-site)

Department: Operations / Maintenance & Facilities

Reports To: Maintenance & Safety Manager

Shift: Full-Time | Monday – Friday 8-Hour

At Ruggable, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Ruggable is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:

We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare.

Rula is a remote-first company. We currently hire in most U.S. states, with the exception of Hawaii.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced accounts receivable collector to manage assigned payers on the Revenue Cycle Management team. As a Billing Support Specialist, you will tackle complex billing challenges and drive operational excellence. In this individual contributor role, you will leverage your expertise to investigate claim denials, navigate evolving payer requirements, and ensure complex claims are prioritized and resolved accurately.

You will partner with cross-functional teams to investigate operational and denial trends, identifying key opportunities to optimize workflows and claim outcomes. You’ll act as the pod’s go-to expert for payer workflows, claim resolutions, and operational standards, and help guide new-hire onboarding, resolve team questions, and elevate performance by embedding best practices across the pod. This role is ideal for a professional who enjoys using technical expertise, critical thinking, and collaboration to influence results, support peers, and enhance revenue cycle efficiency. If you are passionate about solving intricate problems and improving processes through data-driven insights, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on our operational performance and the overall success of the revenue cycle.

Required Qualifications

 - 2+ years experience in a healthcare billing, insurance, patient relations, or medical claims role

 - Comprehensive understanding of insurance policies, claim processing, appeals, and recoupment procedures

 - Thorough knowledge of Denial Language and Carrier CARC Codes

 - Expert understanding of The Life Cycle of a Claim

 - A noted ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate complex cases, identify solutions, and make informed decisions

 - Intermediate proficiency with Google Sheets/Excel, with the skills to format data, create basic charts, and create pivot tables independently

Preferred Qualifications

 - Previous experience billing and collecting in mental/behavioral health space

 - Working knowledge of medical coding, including the ability to identify coding-related denials, recognize billing discrepancies and support claim resolution (CPC certification a plus)

 - Proficiency with electronic health record (EHR) systems, billing software, and platforms such as AdvancedMD, eClinicalWorks, athenahealth, etc.

 - Ability to multitask, prioritize workloads, maintain a high attention to detail, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment

We're serious about your well-being! As part of our team, full-time employees receive:

Our team

jobs.title: Human Resources Specialist

To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Human Resources Manager, Payroll & Benefits, the Human Resources Specialist is responsible for administering employee benefits and the 401(k) plan, supporting payroll and HRIS operations, and assisting with HR initiatives and special projects. This role requires a high level of confidentiality, attention to detail, and discretion. The Human Resources Specialist partners closely with external vendors, brokers, payroll, finance, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance, accuracy, and an exceptional employee experience across all benefits and HR programs.

Your Impact

• Administer and continuously improve employee benefits programs and processes.

• Maintain current knowledge of applicable federal and state employment, benefits, and leave laws to support compliance efforts.

• Communicate benefit offerings effectively and provide employee education and training across clinical and corporate locations.

• Manage new hire enrollments, qualifying life events, status changes, and benefit terminations.

• Assist with the planning, coordination, and execution of annual open enrollment activities.

• Audit benefit enrollment reports and vendor invoices to ensure accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies.

• Serve as the primary contact for benefit-related claim issues and insurance dispute resolution.

• Coordinate and process benefit invoice payments.

• Work closely with HR team members to manage benefit repayments and reconciliations related to leaves of absence.

• Critical thinking skills that provide an ability to seek out new methods and principles; capable of implementing new practices.

• Able successfully complete all pre-employment screenings/activities in a timely manner.

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

jobs.title: VP of Enterprise Operations
jobs.description:
About Us

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden and empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider.

The Role

We are a $400M+ ARR vertical SaaS and AI company serving solo and small healthcare practices, with a plan to double over the next three to five years. We are in building mode, and we want a culture of speed: process exists only where it makes a decision faster or removes a blocker.

The VP Enterprise Operations is the CEO's partner for how the company runs at the top. You own the executive operating system: which forums exist, what gets decided in each, what information they need, how tradeoffs get surfaced, how commitments are tracked, and how the CEO's time maps to enterprise priorities. You own the integrated planning process, the board operating process, and the AI-native tooling underneath all three. You are a full member of the executive leadership team (ELT) and you report to the CEO.

What the role is not: you do not own functional results, originate corporate strategy, or break ties between executives. The functional leaders own their results, the CEO and ELT own strategic choices, and the CEO breaks ties. Your job is to make sure the choices get made, on time, with the tradeoffs visible, and that what was decided actually happens.

Responsibilities

Run the ELT operating system:

• Design and operate the forums the ELT uses to decide and to hold itself accountable.

• Audit recurring executive meetings to cut what does not earn its time, write the ELT charter that sets decision rights and commitment norms, maintain the central commitments-and-decisions log, ensure decision items arrive framed with recommendations, and escalate open cross-functional issues to the CEO.

Own the integrated planning process:

• Connect company choices into one coherent system from long-term ambition to annual priorities, departmental plans, OKRs, and quarterly reallocation.

• Own the calendar, sequencing, and templates, ensuring strategic choices are made before budgets are built and reconciling functional plans across the enterprise.

Run the board operating process:

• Own the annual board and committee calendar, agenda architecture, and the integrated narrative across strategy, operating performance, financials, talent, and risk.

• Assemble materials, prepare the CEO and executives, anticipate board questions, track follow-ups, and coordinate with investors.

Serve as business owner of the AI-native executive operating system:

• Redesign executive workflows so AI improves signal, preparation, decision memory, and accountability (e.g., weekly ELT briefs, KPI commentary, commitment tracking, decision-memo preparation, strategy-to-OKR traceability, board materials consistency and scenario analysis).

• You decide what gets built, in what order, and drive adoption.

Lead select special projects:

• Manage time-bound, CEO-sponsored, enterprise-level initiatives that cross functions and affect the value-creation plan, each with clear charters, success measures, and handoff plans.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Minimum 10 years in Business/Enterprise operations including direct experience running an annual planning cycle end to end at a software company

• Proven track record of running a board cycle with private equity or growth equity investors.

• Experience holding real operating or business-operations leadership seats (not exclusively staff or advisory roles).

• Demonstrated ability to hold senior executives accountable to commitments while maintaining strong peer relationships.

• Experience eliminating unnecessary meetings, reports, and processes to streamline organizational efficiency.

• Hands-on experience personally redesigning operational workflows using AI tools.

• Strong financial literacy to partner effectively with Finance on resource envelopes and reallocation.

Bonus Points

• Early career background in management consulting or investment banking.

• Experience running an annual planning cycle end to end at a SaaS technology company with 200M-1B in ARR

• Experience with small-business customers, self-serve growth models, or healthcare technology.

• M&A integration exposure.

• Previous experience acting as a product owner for internal tools.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits program including:

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Flexible Time Off (FTO), wellbeing days, paid holidays, and summer Fridays

• Mental health resources

• Paid parental leave & Backup Care

• Tuition reimbursement

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

California Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Thank you for your interest in opportunities at SimplePractice LLC (“SimplePractice” or “us” or “we” or “our”). Please note that when you submit your resume or application materials to us for employment purposes, you are subject to the SimplePractice California Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

For more information about our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@simplepractice.com.

Notice to Candidates

SimplePractice has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team. We do not have any affiliation or connection to these situations and only post open roles on our official Careers page (simplepractice.com/careers) and reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages.

All official SimplePractice recruitment emails will be sent from the domains @simplepractice.com, no-reply@greenhouse.io or no‑reply@linkedin.com email addresses.

Examples of fraudulent domains include careers-simplepractice.com, simplepractices.com, and simplepractice.careers.

Please note that SimplePractice will never ask candidates or new hires for money or payment of any kind at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process.

Base salary is one component of total compensation. Employees may also be eligible for an annual bonus or commission. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay.

The amount below represents the expected annual base compensation range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we’ll consider many factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

Base Compensation Range

$270,000—$315,000 USD

No matter our customer's goal or what they want to achieve, we are on a relentless quest to help them get there. • Push what’s possible. We were named to the prestigious Inc. 5000 list as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 and recognized on Inc’s Best Places to Work list.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Director of Technology & Data Engineering owns Momentous’ enterprise technology, IT operations, data infrastructure, and systems strategy, building the scalable, secure, and reliable foundation needed to support continued growth and AI-driven innovation.

Reporting to the CFO, this role serves as the company’s technology leader, overseeing company-wide IT, cloud data infrastructure, enterprise systems, data integrations, governance, and emerging AI capabilities. A key focus is creating a unified, trusted data ecosystem that connects Momentous’ eCommerce, subscription, Amazon, retail, financial, and operational platforms while enabling accurate, consistent information across the business. This role partners closely with the Data Analytics Center of Excellence in Finance: Analytics defines the metrics, and Technology builds and runs the platform that delivers them to people and AI tools.

This is a highly hands-on, cross-functional player-coach role that combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership. The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial builder who has personally designed and operated modern data platforms, can make pragmatic technology investment decisions, and thrives as a senior technical leader in a lean, high-growth environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Cloud Data Infrastructure & Engineering

• Own the architecture, development, and operation of Momentous’ cloud data platform, preferably leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery.

• Design, build, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and integration pipelines across business systems.

• Establish development and production environments, access controls, monitoring, and engineering standards.

• Ensure data reliability, freshness, and cost efficiency through proactive monitoring, optimization, and hands-on problem-solving.

Enterprise Systems & Data Integration

• Own integrations across core platforms, including Shopify, Recharge, Fulfil ERP, Amazon, retail systems, and syndicated data sources.

• Ensure accurate, timely data flows across eCommerce, subscriptions, Finance, Operations, and omnichannel systems.

• Manage external technology and data vendors, establishing clear service-level expectations and performance accountability.

• Identify opportunities to simplify systems, automate processes, and improve operational efficiency.

Semantic Layer & Analytics Enablement

• Build and maintain a governed data foundation and semantic layer using dbt, MetricFlow, or equivalent technologies.

• Implement and enforce metric definitions set by Finance and the Data Analytics Center of Excellence across revenue, channel, product, customer, and subscription data, with automated tests so numbers can't drift.

• Partner with Finance and the Data Analytics Manager to ensure data integrity, financial reconciliation, and reliable reporting.

AI Infrastructure & Enablement

• Develop scalable, AI-ready architecture that enables secure automation, agent workflows, and data-driven applications.

• Design and implement integrations between enterprise data and AI tools, including MCP servers and related technologies, with appropriate access controls and audit trails.

• Partner with business leaders to identify and implement high-impact AI use cases that improve efficiency and business capabilities.

• Set the governance model for AI tools: which systems and data agents can access, how usage is logged, and how outputs are reviewed.

IT Security, Privacy & Risk Management

• Own enterprise technology security, data privacy, and IT risk management across systems and infrastructure.

• Establish security standards for customer PII, sensitive business data, identity and access management (IAM), and least-privilege access.

• Manage vendor security risk and implement SOC-style controls and documentation that keep the company audit-ready as it scales.

• Maintain business continuity, system recovery, and risk mitigation practices across critical platforms.

Technology Strategy & Leadership

• Own the company-wide technology strategy and roadmap, balancing speed, cost, security, and long-term business objectives.

• Oversee employee technology, device management, SaaS administration, and IT support, primarily through an external IT partner.

• Evaluate technology investments and make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions.

• Serve as a hands-on technology partner to Finance, Analytics, eCommerce, Marketing, Operations, and People, translating business needs into scalable solutions.

• Lead as a player-coach, combining direct technical execution with leadership of external partners and a team that grows over time.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology, or related technical disciplines, including meaningful hands-on engineering experience.

• Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating modern cloud data platforms, preferably within GCP and BigQuery.

• Experience owning enterprise IT systems and managing external technology vendors, implementation partners, and SLAs.

• Experience integrating business systems and data sources, ideally across eCommerce, subscriptions, ERP, Amazon, and omnichannel commerce.

• Experience operating in lean, high-growth environments where strategic leadership and hands-on technical execution are equally important.

Skills & Competencies

• Deep technical expertise in cloud architecture and data engineering; fluent in SQL and Python, with experience in pipeline orchestration and infrastructure-as-code.

• Strong working knowledge of GCP, BigQuery, data pipelines, identity and access management, environment separation, and cloud cost optimization.

• Experience with data transformation and semantic layer technologies such as dbt, MetricFlow, or equivalent solutions.

• Understanding of Shopify, Recharge, ERP platforms such as Fulfil, and omnichannel commerce integrations.

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI-native architecture, including MCP servers, AI agents, secure data access, and workflow automation.

• Knowledge of enterprise IT administration, SaaS management, information security, customer privacy, vendor risk, and SOC-style control frameworks.

• Excellent communication, prioritization, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Attributes

• Hands-on builder and pragmatic leader who is equally comfortable writing code, solving technical problems, and setting long-term strategy.

• Balances technical sophistication with business judgment, cost discipline, and practical execution.

• Comfortable serving as a senior technical leader in a lean organization without extensive resources or established processes.

• Intellectually curious and passionate about emerging technologies, AI, automation, and continuous improvement.

• Strong collaborator who builds trust across technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

• Passionate about health, wellness, fitness, and human performance.

BENEFITS

LOCATION

This is a hybrid role based out of our Park City headquarters.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTHERDUCK

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.








WHAT YOU WILL DO

We’re looking for a Product Marketer who lives at the intersection of words, product, and customers. You’ll take what our engineers build and turn it into stories that make developers and data teams lean in. You’ll own positioning and messaging, write the pages people actually read, and make sure our sales team walks into every conversation ready.

This role can be based in our Seattle, San Francisco or New York City office.



Key responsibilities

 - Write. A lot. Website copy, landing pages, launch posts, product one-pagers, emails. You care about every word and you know when to cut.

 - Help shape how we tell our story. Work alongside product, sales, and leadership on who we’re for, why we’re different, and how to say it in a way a data engineer won’t roll their eyes at... then keep it fresh as the product and market evolve.

 - Build the web and the artifacts. Ship landing pages, comparison pages, demos and interactive assets... ideally hands-on with AI tools rather than waiting in a queue for design and eng.

 - Arm the sales team. Create battlecards, pitch decks, objection handling, and competitive takes that AEs and Customer Engineers actually use in deals. Sit in on calls and bring what you hear back into the messaging.

 - Run launches. Plan and ship product launches end to end with product, engineering, DevRel and growth.

 - Stay close to customers and the market. Talk to users, track competitors (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery and friends), and turn what you learn into sharper stories.

 - Work AI-first. Use Claude and other tools to research, draft, prototype and ship. Help set the bar for how marketing at MotherDuck uses AI.






WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3 to 10 years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B software or developer-focused company

 - Excellent writing. Clear, punchy, and specific... you can make a technical idea land in one sentence

 - A real knack for positioning: you've taken a product to market and can show the before and after

 - Experience building web pages and landing pages, and comfort shipping them yourself with modern tools

 - A track record of sales enablement that sales teams actually used

 - Genuine curiosity about technical products. You don't need to write SQL for a living, but you want to understand how the thing works

 - AI fluency. You already use AI daily to do better work, and you're excited to push that further

 - A bias for action. You'd rather ship a good version this week than a perfect one next quarter

 






WHAT PEOPLE SHOULD BE SAYING IF YOU’RE DOING DUCKING AWESOME

 - “I sent the new landing page to a prospect and they replied ‘this is exactly our problem.’ Didn’t have to explain a thing.”

 - “Honestly, I understand our own feature better after reading the launch post.”

 - “The battlecard came up in the call and I had the answer before they finished the question.”

 - “They showed me a workflow they built with AI last week and now half of marketing uses it.”






WHAT WE PROVIDE

 - Feather-ruffling compensation – competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.

 - Top-notch healthcare coverage – 100% paid medical, dental, and vision for employees, plus 80% coverage for dependents (because we care about your whole nest).

 - Flexible PTO – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.

 - 401k plan – because even ducks need to plan for the future.

 - Flexible work environment - spend most of the week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you're most productive the rest of the time. Specifics are role dependent and as agreed upon with your manager



 


WHY MOTHERDUCK

We're a ~110-person, Series B team building on one of the fastest-growing open source projects in data. We're small enough that your work shows up on the website next week, and growing fast enough that there's always something new to figure out.

How we work comes down to four values:

 - Thoughtfulness. We care about the people we work with and the craft behind what we ship.

 - Flexibility. Plans change. We adapt without drama.

 - Unorthodoxy. We question the default way of doing things, including in marketing.

 - Agency. We own outcomes and don't wait for permission.


PLEASE APPLY

Does this role sound appealing to you, but you’re missing some of the requirements or don’t quite think you’re qualified?  Please apply anyway. Research has shown that underrepresented groups in technology often shy away from roles which aren’t a 100% match. We aim to build a diverse team and will strongly consider applicants who bring many of the requirements plus have other experiences which round out their qualifications.

MotherDuck is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. MotherDuck is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, SDKs, Terraform, & Code Generation
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

Cloudflare’s API Experience team builds the tools and standards that make our API dependable and easy to use. We maintain SDKs and our Terraform provider, build code generation tooling, and are developing API versioning.

We’re looking for a senior engineer who cares about the details developers live with: clear interfaces, predictable behavior, useful errors, and upgrades that don’t break their code. You’ll work across languages and teams, help internal engineers ship better APIs, and respond directly to customers. Their feedback will help shape what you build.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain our SDKs, Terraform provider, and the code generation tooling behind them.

• Develop API versioning and compatibility practices that let our API evolve without leaving customers behind.

• Improve API governance: consistent schemas, clear standards, and checks that catch problems before release.

• Support internal teams daily and work directly with customers to investigate issues and turn recurring friction into lasting improvements.

• Own projects from design through release and ongoing maintenance.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• 5+ years of experience building large-scale software applications.

• Deep Go expertise, with experience building and maintaining production software.

• Fluency across languages such as TypeScript and Python, and an understanding of what makes a library feel natural in each.

• Experience building, maintaining, or contributing to a Terraform provider.

• Experience shipping SDKs or client libraries, including testing, releases, dependency management, and backward compatibility.

• Well-reasoned opinions about API design and developer tooling, paired with the ability to listen, explain tradeoffs, and make practical decisions.

• Strong technical judgment built through experience: you can untangle complex problems, set a clear direction, and lead projects from early design through delivery.

• A track record of helping junior engineers grow through thoughtful feedback, mentoring, and opportunities to take ownership.

• Experience using AI and automation to improve engineering workflows, with the judgment to identify where they add value and verify the quality of their output.

Bonus Points

• Experience versioning an API, building schema-driven code generators, or establishing API governance is especially valuable. We’re interested in what you’ve built, how you’ve maintained it, and what you’ve learned from the people using it.

• Experience managing containerized workloads at scale using Kubernetes, Docker, or similar orchestration platforms.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing strategies for infrastructure.

• Contributions to open-source systems software projects or active participation in the broader systems engineering community.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Senior Advisor, Human-Machine Teaming
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About Anduril

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built, and fielded. Anduril’s products are software-first, autonomous, and powered by Lattice OS—an intelligent software platform that turns thousands of disparate sensors and systems into a unified operational picture.

The Role

The Senior Advisor, Human-Machine Teaming sits at the critical intersection of frontline operations, engineering, and military science. As autonomous systems, distributed sensor networks, and intelligent weapons are fielded across contested domains, understanding how warfighters interact with, trust, and employ autonomous systems under stress is vital to mission success.

In this role, you will lead the applied research through systematic collection and operational analysis of user-operator feedback across global test events, training pipelines, and forward-deployed environments. You will bridge the gap between frontline operational reality (drawing from modern operational doctrines and special operations tactics) and cutting-edge academic inquiry into Human-Machine Teaming (HMT). Your contributions will consist of validated research findings, actionable recommendations, and demonstrated improvements in operator or system performance. Those insights will directly steer Anduril’s training design, accelerate product iteration cycles, and establish Anduril as a thought leader in the employment of autonomous systems in modern conflict.

What You’ll Do

• Lead Operational Data Collection & Field Research: Design and execute structured qualitative and quantitative field research protocols to capture operator experiences, cognitive load, trust dynamics, and human-machine teaming performance during live exercises, operational deployments, and training evolutions.

• Frontline Operational & Training Insights: Embed alongside customer units and Anduril field teams globally to capture ground-truth operational feedback, identifying friction points in doctrine, system utilization, and training delivery.

• Inform Training & Product Architecture: Translate operational data into actionable requirements for training curriculum developers, UX/UI designers, and software/hardware product managers to iteratively refine Lattice OS and hardware interfaces.

• Publish White Papers & Thought Leadership: Synthesize empirical operational findings into rigorous internal analyses and public-facing white papers, driving military doctrine development, CONOPs modernization, and industry dialogue regarding autonomy in contested environments.

• Lead Internal Communications for Global Train & Advise: Own and streamline operational knowledge transfer across the global Train & Advise footprint. Author executive summaries, field intelligence digests, and operational post-mission reviews to ensure distributed teams and executive stakeholders maintain real-time visibility into operator trends.

• Bridge Operational Rigor and Academic Defense Science: (SOF/Academic Aligned) Develop operational frameworks that translate intuitive warfighter behaviors into empirically measurable data points, validating new CONOPs for autonomous swarms, collaborative combat systems, and distributed C2.

• Engage Defense & Research Ecosystems: (SOF/Academic Aligned) Interface with key stakeholders across defense science, research labs, military experimentation offices (e.g., DARPA, DIU, Warfighting Labs), and academic think tanks to benchmark Anduril’s operational insights against emerging military theory.

What You Have

• Operational Credibility: Demonstrated operational credibility with substantial experience working with or as part of Special Operations Forces (SOF) or specialized expeditionary units involving distributed operations, tactical mission planning, and high-stress operational execution. Academic Research Focus: Master’s degree or Ph.D. (or equivalent demonstrated publication track record) in Security Studies, Defense Analysis, Cognitive Science, Military Science, Human Systems Integration (HSI), or a related field focusing on the impact of emerging technologies and autonomy on modern warfare. Methodological Fluency: Demonstrated experience designing mixed-method research frameworks (structured interviews, ethnographic observation, cognitive workload evaluation, operational telemetry correlation) in austere or time-sensitive field environments. Exceptional Communication & Authorship: Proven track record of authoring white papers, field studies, or peer-reviewed operational analyses that bridge deeply technical concepts and real-world military tactics. Cross-Functional Fluency: Ability to speak the native language of both the forward tactical operator (SOF/infantry/operators) and Silicon Valley software/hardware engineers. Flexibility & Travel: Willingness to travel up to 50% globally, embedding in tactical test ranges, partner nation training sites, and forward operating environments. Clearance: Must possess an active U.S. Secret clearance (Top Secret / SCI preferred or eligible).

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience evaluating or designing curriculum for un-crewed platforms (sUAS, C-UAS, UUVs, or counter-autonomous systems). Familiarity with human-in-the-loop (HITL), human-on-the-loop (HOTL), and autonomous C2 software architectures. Experience running experiments or operational assessments alongside military test organizations (e.g., USSOCOM S&T, Service Warfighting Labs, operational test squadrons).

Why Join Anduril Global Train & Advise?

The Global Train and Advise team does not merely teach operators which buttons to press; we define how modern militaries fight with software-defined systems. In this role, you will not be an observer—you will shape the doctrine, interfaces, and tactical employment frameworks for the next generation of deterrence and war-fighting.

US Salary Range

$167,000—$222,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. jobs.title: Laboratory Technician I - GC/GCMS SVOA (W-SU, 1pm - 10pm) Eurofins Environment Testing Southwest - Calscience, Tustin, CA
jobs.description:
Eurofins Environment Testing is seeking a Laboratory Technician I to support our GC and GCMS analytical departments. This role is responsible for sample preparation, instrument loading, laboratory organization, inventory management, quality assurance activities, and routine maintenance support. The successful candidate will help ensure efficient laboratory operations, timely sample analysis, and compliance with quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare laboratory extracts and samples for GC/GCMS analysis, including dilutions, and addition of standards and reagents in accordance with laboratory SOPs.
• Load samples onto analytical instruments and support routine analytical operations.
• Assist with preventive maintenance and upkeep of GC and GCMS instrumentation, including cleaning and replacement of consumable parts.
• Maintain active communication with supervisor, extraction team, analytical team and project managers about job status, rush ETA, sample matrix issues, holding time etc.
• Document required sample preparation details and observations
• Maintain laboratory cleanliness, organization, and operational readiness.
• Wash and maintain laboratory glassware, equipment, and supplies.
• Perform quality control activities, including balance calibration, pipette verification, and log book documentation.
• Monitor and maintain inventory of laboratory standards, consumables, and instrument supplies.
• Support laboratory safety programs and conduct routine safety inspections.
• Collaborate with laboratory staff to meet turnaround times and project priorities.
• Perform daily duties while adhering to the environmental health and safety policies.
• Perform additional duties as assigned.
• Assist other areas of laboratory as needed.

Minimum qualifications

• High School Diploma or equivalent required.
• Coursework or experience in chemistry, environmental science, biology, or a related field preferred.
• Prior laboratory experience is helpful but not required.
• Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.
• Professional proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking).

The ideal candidate would possess

• Previous experience in a fast paced, production. food service or retail type environment preferred
• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to follow written procedures.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to learn new techniques, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, keep accurate records, follow instructions, and comply with company policies.
• Basic mathematical, computer proficiency, and effective communication skills.
• Ability to stand for extended periods and lift up to 30 pounds.
• Ability to work overtime as needed.

The compensation for this position is $18.00 - $22.00 per hour commensurate with experience.

Position is full-time, non-exempt from overtime pay.

The candidate must be able to work Monday - Friday, 9:00AM - 6:00PM for the initial training and then transition to the following shift:

• Wednesday - Sunday, 1:00pm - 10:00pm (eligible for a 10% shift differential when working this shift)

*Overtime may be required based on business needs and sample volume.

• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

Sustainability matters to us! At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

VML, part of WPP, is seeking a smart, inquisitive, and self-driven Senior Data Analyst to join our expanding marketing science team within Wunderman Thompson Data Products. As a crucial part of the Analytics and Marketing Science group, you will be responsible for developing end-to-end data solutions for clients, ranging from creating tagging strategies for web performance to conducting deep-dive analyses using diverse data sources.

In this role, you will actively participate in client meetings, deliver comprehensive health checks of your reports, and provide strategic recommendations to enhance marketing campaign performance and web page effectiveness. You will have the autonomy to influence methodological decisions and the responsibility to develop data solutions that can be implemented across the business.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about data and analytics, driven by a commitment to continuous learning and development, and eager to contribute to the broader data community. Your expertise and enthusiasm will be instrumental in advancing our data capabilities and driving client success.

What you’ll do:

• Convert Client Requirements into Visual Prototypes: Develop clear and insightful data mockups based on client specifications, ensuring alignment with their business objectives.

• Design and Maintain Comprehensive Data Solutions: Integrate various data sources to build robust data solutions, utilizing visualization tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI, and Excel to provide actionable insights.

• Develop and Implement Measurement Strategies: Establish effective measurement strategies aligned with client-provided KPIs or define new KPIs that align with the client's strategic goals.

• Create and Manage Performance Tracking Systems: Implement tracking strategies to monitor site performance, leveraging tools like Google Tag Manager to ensure accurate data collection and analysis.

• Monitor and Ensure Data Integrity: Maintain a focus on data accuracy, promptly identifying and addressing discrepancies in data sources or significant changes in trends, and communicating these issues to vendors or clients as needed.

• Foster Collaboration and Share Best Practices: Actively collaborate with internal and regional teams, sharing best practices and innovative approaches to enhance overall data analysis and reporting capabilities.

• Client-Facing Communication and Presentation: Conduct regular meetings with clients to present data insights, explain results, and provide recommendations, ensuring clear and effective communication of complex analytical findings.

• Who you are:

• Curious | With an inquisitive mindset you embrace the unknown and see as an opportunity to explore and innovate.

• Ambitious | Willing to take calculated risks, stretch yourself and your team to do new things vs. plugging into existing solutions.

• Passionate | You take great pride in your work. You approach our own and our clients’ business challenges with enthusiasm and a commitment to getting it right. You love working in health. You see data science as a way of expressing creativity.

• Humble | Wear any hat that needs to be worn, and you know you do not know everything. You want to learn from

What you’ll need:

• Experience with Web Analytics Platforms: Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics and Adobe Launch, or similar for tracking and analyzing web performance.

• Experience with Data Visualization Tools: Advanced knowledge in using tools like Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar to create insightful dashboards and reports.

• Data Management Skills: Ability to manage and manipulate large datasets, ensuring data integrity and accuracy.

• Knowledge of ETL Processes: Understanding of extract, transform, load (ETL) processes to handle data from various sources

• Statistical Analysis and Modeling: Strong understanding of statistical methods, A/B testing, regression analysis, and predictive modeling.

• Advanced excel skills

• Advanced English level

jobs.title: Sr. Thermal Engineer (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. THERMAL ENGINEER (STARLINK)

At SpaceX, we are applying our expertise in building rockets and spacecraft to create the world’s largest and most advanced satellite broadband system. Starlink delivers fast, reliable internet to millions of users through a vertically integrated network of satellites, receiver antennas, lasers, gateways, and sophisticated software. We design, build, test, and operate every part of the system to serve users everywhere on Earth.

As a thermal engineer, you are responsible for the thermal design, test, and validation of all Starlink hardware. This includes but is not limited to phased array antennas, custom silicon design for chips, consumer WiFi, and other RF systems to be developed in the future. You will use your skills in thermal analysis to make engineering decisions that improve the performance of Starlink hardware everywhere from remote research labs in Antarctica to Mach 0.7 in-flight.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Thermal system design of next-generation phased arrays, gateways, and consumer wireless products – own every component, part, and interface in the design

• Thermal design of semiconductor packages, from high level concepts to detail thermal simulations and lab testing

• Devise, build, and run tests to validate the expected performance of the hardware in extreme conditions

• Automate workflow and pursue operational simplicity to reduce engineering investment in the design cycle

• Utilize first-principles approach to evaluate sizing cases and impact of design decisions

• Perform analysis to make recommendations for performance/robustness improvements

• Produce quality documentation of your work for design requirements and specifications

• Continuous collaboration with mechanical, electrical, software, and RF design teams

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in engineering discipline

• 5+ years of experience in thermal analysis and modeling (internship or project experience is applicable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master's degree in relevant engineering discipline

• Experience using scientific programming languages such as MATLAB or Python

• Experience with Thermal Desktop and ANSYS Workbench

• Experience with 3D modeling and 0-D and 1-D thermal/fluid networks

• Experience with tools like Flotherm or Icepak

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Ability to deliver against an aggressive schedule

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Medical Assistant - West Hollywood

About Tia

Tia is building a new model for women’s healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across both in-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Medical Assistant to support day-to-day clinical care and patient flow at our TIA West Hollywood clinic.

As a Medical Assistant at Tia, you’ll help keep the clinic running smoothly by rooming patients, collecting health information and vitals, supporting providers, preparing exam rooms, performing phlebotomy, and helping ensure each patient feels seen, heard, and cared for. This role is a great fit for someone who is highly organized, calm under pressure, detail-oriented, and energized by delivering an excellent patient experience.

Why Tia

• Opportunity to help reimagine women’s healthcare

• Collaborative clinic environment with providers, MAs, and front-of-house teams

• Mission-driven team focused on high-quality, personalized patient care

• Hands-on role supporting both clinical care and clinic operations

• Opportunity to build experience in an integrated women’s health model

What You’ll Do

• Patient Rooming & Clinical Support: Room patients, collect relevant health information, review health summaries, take vitals, and document accurately in the medical record.

• Provider Support: Help providers prepare for patient visits by reviewing upcoming schedules, capturing relevant patient context, and communicating important updates throughout the clinic day.

• Patient Flow & Clinic Coordination: Monitor the schedule, help move patients smoothly from front of house to back of house, and partner with the care team to keep clinic flow on track.

• Labs, Imaging & Follow-Up: Support lab and imaging workflows, including entering orders, confirming diagnosis codes, updating pharmacy information, and helping ensure follow-up items are completed in a timely manner.

• Phlebotomy & Clinical Procedures: Perform phlebotomy and specimen collection as needed while following Tia’s clinical guidelines and safety standards.

• Clinic Readiness: Prepare, clean, disinfect, and restock exam rooms throughout the day, including supply management, expiration checks, autoclaving, and ordering supplies as needed.

• Personalized Patient Care: Capture relevant patient preferences, needs, and context to help the broader care team deliver thoughtful, individualized care.

What You’ll Bring

Requirements

• Medical Assistant certification or completion of a Medical Assistant training program, as required by applicable state or payer requirements

• 1-2 years of experience in a clinical, ambulatory, primary care, women’s health, or patient-facing healthcare setting

• Phlebotomy experience

• Experience taking and documenting vitals

• Comfort using electronic medical record systems and clinical documentation tools

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow clinical workflows and documentation standards

• Highly organized, calm under pressure, and able to manage multiple priorities in a busy clinic environment

• Strong patient service orientation and ability to communicate with empathy, professionalism, and discretion

• Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements

• Authorization to work in the United States

• Ability to work Monday-Friday opening or closing shifts, with rotating Saturdays as needed

Nice to Have

• Experience in women’s health, primary care, gynecology, dermatology, or integrated care settings

• Experience supporting LGBTQ+ patients or patients from diverse backgrounds and communities

• Experience with DrChrono, TiaMD, or similar EMR systems

• Experience with autoclaving, disinfecting, supply management, and clinical inventory workflows

• Strong understanding of data security protocols and healthcare privacy requirements

Work Location

This role is based onsite in TIA West Hollywood

This role requires an onsite clinic schedule

• Monday - Friday: 8:30 am-5:30 pm

• Rotating Saturdays: 7:30 am-4 pm

Compensation & Benefits

Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions.

The expected compensation range for this role is: $22 - $25 per hour

You may also be eligible for:

• Medical, dental, and vision benefits, if applicable

• Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays, if applicable

• Professional development support

jobs.title: Full Time Virtual Teacher, Science (IN)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Edmentum is a dynamic educator and student-focused company dedicated to tech-enabled learning solutions. Our goal is to ensure that all students have access to flexible learning environments and educators have the tools they need to support their students. We are on a mission to create innovative, proven learning technology, partnering with educators to ignite student potential. We are a Remote First organization with a strong commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

Who We Are

At Edmentum, we’re not just building educational technology … we’re transforming the future of learning. As a dynamic, Remote First company on a mission to ignite student potential, we empower educators with powerful tools and support systems to create flexible, inclusive, and effective learning environments for all students. We’re looking for curious, driven, and impact-focused individuals who are ready to grow with us. Sound like you? Read on.

What You’ll Do

You will be the face and voice of Edmentum for students who depend on you to show up every day, live on camera, fully present and fully prepared. As a Virtual Science Teacher, you bring your classroom to life through a screen: connecting with students in real time, personalizing learning for every individual, and creating an online environment where students feel seen, supported, and motivated to succeed. Live, synchronous, on-camera instruction is the heart of this role — it is what our students, families, and partner schools depend on every instructional day. This role is for educators who thrive in a fast-moving digital environment and who believe that great live teaching is the core of great learning, regardless of the medium.

In this role you will:

• Deliver live, on-camera synchronous instruction for five (5) or more hours per day, every scheduled instructional day, creating an engaging and structured virtual classroom experience that inspires student participation and achievement. This live instructional delivery is an essential function of the role.

• Use student performance data to personalize instruction, identify learning gaps, and adapt your approach to meet each student where they are.

• Provide timely, meaningful feedback on student work and maintain accurate records that keep students and families informed and on track.

• Build genuine relationships with students and families through professional, proactive communication that fosters trust and shared accountability for learning outcomes.

• Collaborate with school partners and Edmentum colleagues to ensure students receive consistent, high-quality support across their learning experience.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Education or a related field and an active state teaching license in Indiana in Science grades 6-12..

• You have experience teaching in virtual and/or in-person settings and are comfortable with the unique demands of a live online classroom.

• You are confident and engaging on camera, able to teach live for five (5) or more consecutive hours per day, every instructional day, and build real connection with students through a screen.

• You have hands-on experience with online learning platforms, virtual instruction tools, and standard productivity software.

• You are data-informed: you know how to read student performance data and use it to adjust your live instruction in meaningful ways.

• You are an excellent communicator, in writing and verbally, and you know how to meet students, families, and colleagues where they are.

• You are highly organized and self-directed, with the time management skills to independently manage a full student caseload in a remote environment.

• You are committed to your own professional growth, maintaining certification and staying current on K-12 curriculum, technology, and best practices.

• You bring integrity, warmth, and a deep belief that every student can succeed, values that align with Edmentum’s mission.

• You are willing to take on evolving responsibilities based on business needs.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• A Remote First culture that values trust.

• A mission-driven team obsessed with improving education for all students.

• Growth opportunities and leadership that truly invests in your development.

• The chance to work with innovative tools and game-changing products.

• The satisfaction of knowing your work is helping shape the future of learning.

Ready to help shape the future of education? Apply now and let’s build something meaningful together.

Pay range for this role:

$45,000—$50,000 USD

At Edmentum, we are committed to pay transparency. The salary range provided reflects market research, the responsibilities of the role, and alignment with our compensation principles. Actual compensation will be determined based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill sets. All compensation decisions are individualized and based on the specific circumstances of each candidate.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your overall well-being and work-life balance. This includes medical, dental, and vision insurance with various plan options, a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and a time away program, volunteer time away, and a winter office closure at the end of December. Additionally, we provide resources to promote wellness, ensuring you have the support you need both professionally and personally. Our goal is to provide a benefits package that helps you thrive in all aspects of life.

Edmentum is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, age, disability, status as a disabled, recently separated, Armed Forces service medal or other protected veteran (“covered veteran”), marital status, status regarding public assistance, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

APPLYING FOR EMPLOYMENT WITH EDMENTUM

Greenhouse is the exclusive location for current job openings with Edmentum. Every candidacy begins by submitting an application through Greenhouse and all interview requests are initiated through the platform. If you are unsure of the authenticity of any job listing with Edmentum, you can verify it on this page or by contacting recruiting@edmentum.com.

We are dedicated to meeting the needs of individuals with disabilities and to creating an environment that supports our employees' physical and mental health. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a covered veteran and need a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please contact recruiting@edmentum.com.
