jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator - Newton, MA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online

• Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly

• Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs

• Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate

• Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.

• Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions

• Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information

• Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

• Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

• 2+ years of experience in a customer service role

• Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail

• A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone

• A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos

• High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly

• Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($19-29/hr), including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Data Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Momentous is a dynamic, fast-growing human performance company offering the highest quality supplements designed to enhance physical and cognitive well-being. At Momentous, we believe that people at their best will produce a positive impact in their personal lives, communities, and, ultimately, the world. No matter our customer's goal or what they want to achieve, we are on a relentless quest to help them get there. We work with some of the greatest minds in science and athletic performance who tap into the latest research and real-world experience to create a portfolio of products designed with one common goal—to help our customers be their best.

What we’re proud of:

• Best in the field. We have built an advanced network of world-renowned experts in the field of human performance.

• Trusted and used by the best. We are honored to work with more than 200 teams in professional and NCAA sports, including Stanley Cup Champions, Tour de France winners, and all NFL Teams.

• Push what’s possible. We were named to the prestigious Inc. 5000 list as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 and recognized on Inc’s Best Places to Work list.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Data Analytics Manager owns Momentous’ data analytics, business intelligence, and reporting capabilities, translating complex data into actionable insights that drive revenue growth, profitability, and informed decision-making across the organization.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, with a dotted line to the VP of Digital, this role anchors Momentous' Data Analytics Center of Excellence and serves as an embedded strategic analytics partner to eCommerce, Growth Marketing, Operations, and executive leadership. A key focus is understanding the drivers of DTC and subscription performance, evaluating marketing effectiveness, and ensuring business metrics are accurate, consistent, and aligned with financial reporting. The role builds analytics on governed, shared metric definitions so that leaders and AI tools get the same trusted answer.

This role combines deep analytical expertise, strong commercial acumen, and technical fluency with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations. The ideal candidate is a proactive, intellectually curious problem-solver who challenges assumptions, identifies growth opportunities, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Metric Governance & Source of Truth

• Partner with Technology & Engineering to define data requirements across eCommerce, subscription, marketing, and financial systems.

• Own shared metric definitions for DTC, subscription, and marketing KPIs, the business semantic layer, in alignment with Finance.

• Reconcile key commercial and customer metrics with financial reporting to establish a consistent source of truth across the organization.

• Follow data security and privacy standards set by Technology, including the handling of customer PII.

DTC & Subscription Analytics

• Analyze customer acquisition, retention, churn, cohort performance, lifetime value, and customer acquisition costs to identify opportunities for profitable growth.

• Develop reporting and insights into subscription health, including subscriber behavior, retention trends, and new versus existing customer economics.

• Evaluate key drivers of eCommerce performance, including conversion, average order value, purchase frequency, and customer profitability.

• Partner with eCommerce, Growth, and Finance leadership to translate customer and commercial insights into actionable strategies and investment decisions.

Marketing Measurement & Experimentation

• Analyze marketing effectiveness using attribution, marketing mix modeling (MMM), incrementality, and other measurement approaches to inform investment decisions.

• Evaluate the strengths and limitations of different measurement methodologies to provide balanced, commercially grounded recommendations.

• Design and analyze experiments across pricing, promotions, conversion optimization, and marketing initiatives, including A/B testing and elasticity analysis.

• Translate test results and performance data into clear recommendations that improve growth, efficiency, and profitability.

Business Systems Intelligence & AI

• Build automated, AI-enabled reporting, including dashboards, self-serve analytics, and AI assistants grounded in governed metrics, so leaders get answers in minutes, not days.

• Provide customer and demand inputs to FP&A forecasting, and track performance against weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual goals.

• Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities across business functions.

• Deliver concise, executive-ready insights and recommendations that translate complex business questions into clear decisions.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Business Optimization

• Support pricing, promotional effectiveness, and margin improvement, and provide customer demand insights to Operations and FP&A.

• Run intake and prioritization for the Analytics Center of Excellence across Finance and Digital.

• Continuously identify opportunities to automate recurring analysis and reporting with AI agents and workflows.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Business, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, preferably within a high-growth DTC, eCommerce, or subscription-based business.

• Deep experience analyzing DTC and subscription economics, including customer cohorts, retention, churn, LTV/CAC, and customer profitability.

• Experience evaluating marketing performance through attribution, marketing mix modeling, incrementality, and experimentation.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into commercially actionable recommendations for business leaders.

Skills & Competencies

• Advanced SQL and Excel; experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery preferred) and transformation tools such as dbt; Python or R for statistical analysis preferred.

• Strong experience in business systems intelligence: building self-serve reporting and analytics across commerce, subscription, marketing, and financial systems, with an emphasis on AI-enabled tools.

• Working knowledge of data warehousing and data quality practices, and comfort partnering with engineering on integrations.

• Experience with marketing measurement platforms such as Northbeam and experimentation tools such as Intelligems or similar solutions.

• Strong understanding of financial reporting, P&L drivers, and the relationship between commercial performance metrics and financial results.

• Ability to design, interpret, and communicate A/B tests, pricing experiments, and other analytical studies.

• Hands-on with AI tools (LLM assistants, AI agents, natural-language analytics) to automate analysis and reporting while maintaining accuracy, governance, and rigor.

• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex analyses, influence stakeholders, and deliver executive-level recommendations.

• Familiarity with Shopify, Recharge, and Klaviyo preferred.

Attributes

• Highly analytical, intellectually curious, and commercially minded, with a strong commitment to data accuracy and integrity.

• Strategic thinker who proactively identifies opportunities to improve business performance through analytics and new ideas.

• Demonstrates strong ownership, sound judgment, and a bias toward action and measurable results.

• Confident challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions, and providing objective recommendations grounded in data.

• Resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Passionate about health, wellness, fitness, and human performance.

BENEFITS

• Our fast-paced, high growth environment creates a strong opportunity for professional development born from evolving experiences

• Competitive cash compensation plus employee stock options

• Health/Vision/Dental/Life/Pet/Accident/Disability/Critical Illness

• Fertility benefits, caregiver concierge, and financial planning benefits

• 401k Match

• Unlimited PTO

• Parental Leave

• Finish Line Fridays - finish at 3:00 every Friday

• Generous set of observed holidays (18 days of office closure in 2026)

• $1,000 annual perks program to support a high-performance lifestyle

• Team workouts and lunches

• Access to Momentous products and merchandise

LOCATION

This is a hybrid role based out of our Park City headquarters.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Momentous provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We are committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives and providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment where everyone can thrive. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Client Accounting Division Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!



ROLE SUMMARY

The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the team’s technical work and client advice.



This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard.   The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution.



This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions.




ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Division Performance and KPI Accountability

 - Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets.

 - Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard.

 - Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level.

 - Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions.

 - Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients.

 - Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability.

 - Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams.

People Leadership and Staffing

 - Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns.

 - Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles.

 - Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team

 - Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations.

 - Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout.

 - Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution.

 - Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount.

 - Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines.

Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight

 - Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the division’s client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly.

 - Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry.

 - Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each client’s business model.

 - Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope).

 - Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand.

 - Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations

Client Relationships and Service Quality

 - Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues.

 - Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards.

 - Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory.

Growth and Operations

 - Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships  and identify service-expansion opportunities

 - Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell

 - Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows



Group and Company Success

A One Burkland mindset:

Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland.

 - Comfort with an increasing pace of change:

Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done.

 - Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency:

Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it.

 - A constructive attitude:

Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance.

 - Full adoption of firm tools and processes:

Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well.

 - Delivery and proactive advisory:

Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers.




CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

 - Financial Acumen — cost management, margin analysis,  fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness.

 - Client Relationships— Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

 - Advisory mindset — Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory.

 - Leading Change — Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team.

 - AI Fluency — Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

 - Cross-functional collaboration — Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities

 - Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise — Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations.  Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations as well as eCommerce operations and cash flows through Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplace solutions.




MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field, and 5+ years of progressive professional experience

 - Direct people management experience, including conducting performance reviews, managing underperformance, and developing team members

 - Exceptional client relationship management skills and the ability to understand client needs

 - Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, team members, and leadership

 - Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an eagerness to take on new challenges involving emerging technology and industries

 - Strong command of GAAP and cost accounting, including inventory accounting (FIFO, LIFO, landed costs, shrinkage, and valuation adjustments)




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - CPA or CMA credential

 - Experience owning or significantly contributing to a team budget, P&L, or book of business

 - Prior experience leading a team within a professional services or client accounting environment

 - Hands-on ERP and inventory system experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Cin7, Fishbowl, or similar)

 - Experience leading or overseeing ERP or inventory software implementations

 


PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.




EEO STATEMENT

Burkland Associates is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Burkland Associates is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The base pay range target for the role described in this job description is 120,000-140,000. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition, full-time regular positions are eligible for, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time.

jobs.title: Principal Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
This role blends the tech and human story. As our Principal Social Media Manager, you'll show what an AI leader in mobility looks like to the insurance, automotive, and public-sector leaders who depend on us, the AI talent who want to build here, and the wider industry watching where mobility AI goes next. You'll put road safety in front of millions of people: drivers, families, and the companies that can change what happens on the road. Behind every number in our data is a person who made it home. Your job is to make people see it, share it, and act on it. Your work will help save lives.

You'll build CMT's social presence from the ground up: start our paid social program, make LinkedIn the place industry leaders follow for mobility AI, and use Instagram and Facebook to show the people and culture behind the work. You'll create amazing content yourself, shape it for each platform, put paid behind what wins and works, and use AI to move faster than teams twice our size.

You'll have a design team, a paid budget, and direct access to leadership. You'll report to the Director of Marketing and work daily with Communications, Design, Product Marketing, Events, and People Operations.

CMT is looking for a Principal Social Media Manager I to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

Responsibilities:

• Use independent judgment and discretion to develop and execute CMT's organic and paid social media strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook, aligning content with business goals and growth opportunities

• Own and manage the social media calendar, supporting product launches, research, company news, events, recruiting, and industry trends

• Create and publish engaging, platform-specific content, including short-form videos, carousels, graphics, and photography

• Partner with AI, Data Science, Product, and Marketing teams to translate CMT's technology, products, and research into compelling, accessible content

• Collaborate with Design and Employer Brand to maintain brand consistency, elevate creative content, and support talent acquisition initiatives

• Plan, execute, and optimize paid social campaigns, including audience targeting, creative testing, budget management, and performance analysis

• Develop employee advocacy initiatives and partner with Sales to expand CMT's reach and engagement with target audiences

• Manage social media engagement, community relationships, and social listening to identify emerging trends, opportunities, and potential issues

• Establish and track social media KPIs, analyze performance, and provide actionable recommendations to Marketing leadership

• Leverage AI tools to streamline content creation, optimize performance, and develop scalable workflows for the Marketing team

• Stay current on platform trends, emerging technologies, and social media best practices to continuously improve CMT's social presence

• Complete any additional tasks as they arise

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in marketing, communications, journalism, film, or a related field

• 7+ years of relevant working experience running social media for B2B technology or AI companies, in-house or at an agency, including paid social

• A portfolio of content you produced yourself, with results for each platform

• Proven record growing audience and engagement on LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook, with numbers to show it

• Hands-on experience running paid campaigns in LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Ads Manager, with budgets you owned

• Strong video skills: plan, shoot on a phone or camera, edit in Premiere, CapCut, Descript, or similar, and caption for each platform

• Expert in the native analytics for each platform; can pull a report, explain what it means, and say what to do next

• At the cutting edge of AI for social: you use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and AI image and video tools every day to make content and improve results

• Fluent in AI and data: you learn complex technology fast, explain how models and data work in plain words, and spot the story in technical work; strong writer and editor

• A self-starter who finds the next idea, tests it, and reports back without being asked

• Experience building or running an employee advocacy program

• Experience with social tools such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or Sprinklr, plus Canva and HubSpot

• Good judgment on brand voice, timing, and risk; calm and fast when something goes sideways

• Able to work from the Cambridge office three days a week and travel up to 15% for events

• Please share links to accounts, campaigns, or posts you have produced

Nice to Haves:

• Experience marketing AI, data, or deep-tech products, or working in insurance, automotive, or mobility

• Experience using paid social for account-based marketing

• Experience working with creators or influencers

Compensation and Benefits:

• Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience, and annual performance bonus

• Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance, matching 401k, short-term & long-term disability and parental leave

• Unlimited Paid Time Off including vacation, sick days & public holidays

• Flexible scheduling and work from home policy depending on role and responsibilities

Base Salary Range

• The base salary range for this position is: $113,200 to $141,500. This range is specifically for Cambridge, MA

Additional Perks:

• Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world

• Join an industry leader — 65 million drivers protected, powering 140+ programs across 25 countries

• Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified

• Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety

• Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters

• High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact

• Unlimited PTO, flexible scheduling, competitive salary, annual performance bonus, RSUs, and full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401k match

• Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge

• Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA+, Women, Book Club, and Health & Wellness

• Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cmtelematics.com and follow us on Instagram @cmt.ai

About Cambridge Mobile Telematics:

Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world’s largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world’s roads and drivers safer. The company’s AI-driven platform, DriveWell Fusion®, proactively identifies and reduces driving risk, leading to fewer crashes and injuries. To date, CMT’s technology has helped prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. CMT enables partners to measure risk, detect crashes, provide life-saving assistance, and streamline claims. Headquartered in Cambridge, MA, CMT operates globally with offices in Budapest, Hungary; Chennai, India; Seattle, Washington; Tokyo, Japan; and Zagreb, Croatia. Learn more at www.cmt.ai.

jobs.title: Medical Assistant - Culver City
jobs.description:
About Tia

Tia is building a new model for women’s healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across both in-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Medical Assistant to support day-to-day clinical care and patient flow at our TIA Culver City  clinic.

As a Medical Assistant at Tia, you’ll help keep the clinic running smoothly by rooming patients, collecting health information and vitals, supporting providers, preparing exam rooms, performing phlebotomy, and helping ensure each patient feels seen, heard, and cared for. This role is a great fit for someone who is highly organized, calm under pressure, detail-oriented, and energized by delivering an excellent patient experience.

Why Tia

• Opportunity to help reimagine women’s healthcare

• Collaborative clinic environment with providers, MAs, and front-of-house teams

• Mission-driven team focused on high-quality, personalized patient care

• Hands-on role supporting both clinical care and clinic operations

• Opportunity to build experience in an integrated women’s health model

What You’ll Do

• Patient Rooming & Clinical Support: Room patients, collect relevant health information, review health summaries, take vitals, and document accurately in the medical record.

• Provider Support: Help providers prepare for patient visits by reviewing upcoming schedules, capturing relevant patient context, and communicating important updates throughout the clinic day.

• Patient Flow & Clinic Coordination: Monitor the schedule, help move patients smoothly from front of house to back of house, and partner with the care team to keep clinic flow on track.

• Labs, Imaging & Follow-Up: Support lab and imaging workflows, including entering orders, confirming diagnosis codes, updating pharmacy information, and helping ensure follow-up items are completed in a timely manner.

• Phlebotomy & Clinical Procedures: Perform phlebotomy and specimen collection as needed while following Tia’s clinical guidelines and safety standards.

• Clinic Readiness: Prepare, clean, disinfect, and restock exam rooms throughout the day, including supply management, expiration checks, autoclaving, and ordering supplies as needed.

• Personalized Patient Care: Capture relevant patient preferences, needs, and context to help the broader care team deliver thoughtful, individualized care.

What You’ll Bring

Requirements

• Medical Assistant certification or completion of a Medical Assistant training program, as required by applicable state or payer requirements

• 1-2 years of experience in a clinical, ambulatory, primary care, women’s health, or patient-facing healthcare setting

• Phlebotomy experience

• Experience taking and documenting vitals

• Comfort using electronic medical record systems and clinical documentation tools

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow clinical workflows and documentation standards

• Highly organized, calm under pressure, and able to manage multiple priorities in a busy clinic environment

• Strong patient service orientation and ability to communicate with empathy, professionalism, and discretion

• Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements

• Authorization to work in the United States

• Ability to work Monday-Friday opening or closing shifts, with rotating Saturdays as needed

Nice to Have

• Experience in women’s health, primary care, gynecology, dermatology, or integrated care settings

• Experience supporting LGBTQ+ patients or patients from diverse backgrounds and communities

• Experience with DrChrono, TiaMD, or similar EMR systems

• Experience with autoclaving, disinfecting, supply management, and clinical inventory workflows

• Strong understanding of data security protocols and healthcare privacy requirements

Work Location

This role is based onsite in TIA Culver City

This role requires an onsite clinic schedule

• Monday, Wednesday and Friday: 8 am-5:30 pm

• Tuesday and Thursday: 10:30 am-7 pm

• Rotating Saturdays 1 or 2 /month: 7:30 am-4 pm

Compensation & Benefits

Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions.

The expected compensation range for this role is: $21 - $24 per hour

You may also be eligible for:

• Medical, dental, and vision benefits, if applicable

• Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays, if applicable

• Professional development support

• Other role-specific benefits

About Tia

Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our “Whole Woman, Whole Life” model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in-person care and a national virtual platform.

jobs.title: Director, Internal AI Operations
jobs.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a strategic, execution-oriented Director of Internal AI Operations to run and continuously improve how our company adopts and scales AI, establish the operational objectives, processes, and work plans that turn AI from a collection of tools into a measurable business capability and work with leaders across several functions to put the company’s AI direction into practice.

Responsibilities:

• Reporting: Build and maintain visibility into AI spend and usage. Develop adoption, efficiency, and cost metrics and report on tool overlap, cost drivers, and open risks. Support Finance with forecasting, budget tracking, anomaly detection, and vendor and model-cost optimization. Functional and technical leaders own efficiency, waste, cost, usage, and ROI within their portfolios; AI Operations prepares regular reporting and flags performance gaps for follow-up.

• Portfolio management: Maintain the inventory of AI tools, initiatives, agents, vendors, integrations, owners, status, spend, risks, and dependencies. Establish the processes and standards that keep it accurate across teams.

• Reviews: Participate in reviewing new AI Vendor requests and own and manage the Internal AI Feature Review process from intake through decision, conditions, approval, exception, or rejection, coordinating inputs from Security, Legal, IT, and business owners.

• Policy operations: Develop and maintain the company’s Internal AI Policy supporting resources with Legal and Security, and the Executive team, along with supporting resources. Recommend policy changes and put approved changes into operation.

• Transformation and migration: Track the AI roadmap, migrations, platform dependencies, adoption milestones, resourcing, risks, and executive decisions.

• Partnership with our technology teams: Collaborate on new AI product initiatives, empowering our product teams with how they identify and deliver value around AI.

• Administration and audit: Define and audit standards for access, ownership, configuration, data controls, logging, retention, vendor settings, and offboarding.

• Communications and enablement: Own the Internal AI communications calendar, stakeholder updates, FAQs, launch materials, training coordination, and policy-change communications.

• CoE coordination: Establish a common cadence and minimum artifacts across distributed AI CoEs without centralizing their technical or domain ownership.

Qualifications:

• 15+ years of progressively responsible experience in AI or technology operations, enterprise systems, data and analytics, FinOps, governance, transformation, or a related field, including 5+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional programs.

• Demonstrated success designing, implementing, or scaling an operating model across multiple functions, including clear ownership, policies, processes, metrics, governance, and measurable outcomes.

• Experience managing an enterprise portfolio of AI or technology tools, vendors, integrations, or platforms, including lifecycle management, access and administration, risk and controls, contracts, usage, and spend.

• Strong financial, analytical, and data-driven mindset, with experience using tools such as Snowflake, Excel, Python, or equivalent; able to define adoption, efficiency, unit economics, ROI, and business-value metrics and turn complex data into executive-ready recommendations.

• Strong financial and operational acumen, with experience building spend visibility, forecasts, budget controls, vendor or model-cost optimization, cost avoidance, waste reduction, and value-improvement plans.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex topics clearly, present recommendations to senior and executive leaders, and persuade diverse stakeholders.

• Experience influencing functional and technical leaders without relying on direct authority, clarifying distributed accountability, benchmarking performance, challenging tradeoffs, and driving follow-through across global, remote, and cross-functional teams.

• Curiosity and a willingness to lean into AI: able to learn emerging capabilities quickly, experiment pragmatically, identify high-value use cases, and apply sound judgment about where AI should and should not be used.

• Practical understanding of responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, vendor risk, and change management, with the judgment to balance innovation, control, scalability, and business value.

• Strong systems thinking, program management, prioritization, and change leadership skills; comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous, company-wide problems.

• Experience hiring, coaching, or developing effective teams and building trusted partnerships across Finance, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, and business functions.

What Success Looks Like:

• Accelerate teams’ work through measurable improvements in cycle time, throughput, or capacity unlocked by AI.

• Partner with functional leaders to demonstrate business value from priority AI use cases—not just increased usage.

• Reduce friction from idea to responsible launch, measured by faster reviews, clearer decisions, and fewer stalled initiatives.

• Improve AI portfolio efficiency through stronger utilization, reduced duplication, and better cost per user or workflow.

• Establish trusted, scalable governance, with clear ownership, timely reviews, and consistent execution of required controls.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M4:

• Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $269,400 - 370,480*

• Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $242,500 - 333,410**

• Zone 3: All other US locations - $229,000 - 314,930*

• All Zones inclusive of 15% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

• Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

• Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

jobs.title: Senior Architect - Data Platforms & Architecture
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs
across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across
teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results.
At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements,
work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns.
You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into
repeatable delivery models.

Responsibilities:
Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership
• Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that
span multiple teams and workstreams.
• Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional
requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes.
• Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns.
• Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a
cohesive end-to-end architecture.
• Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and
code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse.
• Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces,
testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable.
• Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help
teams adopt effective practices at program scale.
Delivery and Consulting Excellence
• Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into
integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies.
• Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and
explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact.
• Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences,
including executives.
• Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape
modernization roadmaps in the client’s best interest.
• Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable
delivery and stable team velocity.
• Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies
are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery.
• Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep
3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones.
• Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable
incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry
and feedback.
• Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to
clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple,
direct language.

Mentorship and Team Development:
• Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural
judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams.
• Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making
and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified.
• Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and
mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects.

Growth and Innovation:

across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them.
• Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify
opportunities to provide additional business value.
• Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision,
contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions.
• Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting
assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction.
• Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter
repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams.
• Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AIassisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way.
• Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help
build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

Requirements:
• 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain.
• 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams,
including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts.
• 8+ years of experience in data engineering, including 4+ years of experience architecting data
solutions on Azure.
• Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure with experience with Databricks and/or Fabric.
• Proven ability to design and implement modern data architectures (data lakes, data warehouses,
lakehouses, data mesh, streaming pipelines).

publishing code).
• Knowledge of infrastructure as code, APIs, security, compliance, and master data management.
• Experience optimizing data pipelines, queries, and architectures for performance and cost.
• Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as
modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs.
• Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and
solid delivery practices.
• Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable
delivery across time zones.
• Deep knowledge of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary
domain, with the ability to apply them at program scale.
• Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into
solutions using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services.
• Experience with Agile or Scrum at scale, including backlog management, work slicing, and
dependency handling.
• Experience in consulting or professional services.
• Familiarity with key Azure services relevant to your domain, such as messaging, compute, data,
security, networking, and integration.

improvements for teams.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Reports to: Director/Snr Director

The Solutions Architect serves as the strategic connective tissue between customers, Sales, Professional Services, Product Management, and Engineering. 

This role is responsible for creating and maintaining the "steel thread" that connects customer challenges and market opportunities to product evolution and successful delivery outcomes. While supporting the sales process is an important component of the role, this position extends well beyond traditional pre-sales activities. 

The ideal candidate brings together technical expertise, consultative problem-solving, business acumen, and a strong customer-first mindset to design solutions that address real-world challenges while influencing the future direction of the Convey platform. In this role, you will also help strengthen the capabilities and processes that enable our Pre-Sales Engineering and Professional Services teams to perform at their highest level. Working closely with both prospective and existing customers, you will gather and translate business requirements into scalable solutions, develop architecture and integration diagrams, create Statements of Work (SOWs) with clearly defined deliverables, guide implementation strategies and timelines, and ensure customer and field insights continuously inform product priorities and roadmap decisions.

What you’ll do:

Solution Design & Customer Advisory 

 - Support discovery sessions with customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, technical requirements, and success criteria, when required.

 - Design scalable, deliverable, and commercially viable solutions leveraging Convey's platform and services.

 - Facilitate architecture workshops, solution reviews, and technical validation

 - Translate business requirements into solution designs, implementation approaches, and technical specifications.

 - Identify product gaps and provide recommendations and estimates on LOE to remediate

 - Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the customer journey—from evaluation through deployment and expansion.

Field-to-Product Leadership 

 - Act as the primary conduit between the field and Product Management, ensuring customer reality continuously shapes product direction.

 - Capture recurring customer needs, emerging market trends, competitive insights, and product enhancement opportunities from across the field.

 - Advocate for customer requirements while balancing platform scalability and strategic product direction.

 - Help Product and Engineering teams understand the operational realities and business drivers behind customer requests.

 - Maintain a continuous feedback loop that ensures customer insights directly influence product evolution.

 - Flag and document instances where internal product messaging is misaligned with actual product capabilities and work cross-functionality to correct them.

Solutioning Excellence  

 - Enable the Professional Services team on pre-sales collaboration practices, including how to enter deals early, contribute to solution scoping, and take clean handoffs from Sales.

 - Build and document reusable solutioning assets (e.g., playbooks, discovery frameworks, integration pattern libraries, and SOW templates) that PSEs and PS can operate from independently.

 - Serve as a go-to resource and thought partner for PSEs on complex or high-stakes deals.

Sales Partnership & Opportunity Development 

 - Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success teams on opportunities, providing advisory-level technical guidance.

 - Support solution positioning, technical validation.

 - Identify implementation risks, dependencies, and success factors early in the sales cycle.

 - Provide effort estimates, implementation recommendations, and scope guidance that improve win rates through realistic solution design.

 - Position Professional Services offerings that are prescriptive, repeatable and predictable.

Requirements Definition & SOW Development 

 - Own the creation of technical requirements documents, solution blueprints, and Statements of Work.

 - Define project scope and timelines, assumptions, deliverables, success metrics, and implementation responsibilities.

 - Collaborate with Professional Services leaders to ensure solutions are executable, scalable, and aligned with delivery best practices.

 - Establish clear alignment between customer expectations and implementation outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Customer Success, and Sales leaders.

 - Align stakeholders around solution direction, customer outcomes, and delivery expectations.

 - Support new product introductions, platform enhancements, and acquisition integrations.

Practice Development 

 - Develop templates, frameworks, standards, and repeatable solution patterns that raise the capability floor across Pre-Sales Engineering and Professional Services.

 - Help mature Convey's solutioning capabilities across Sales and Professional Services.

 - Mentor team members on solution architecture, customer engagement, and requirements gathering.

 - Contribute to strategic initiatives that improve customer onboarding, implementation quality, and time-to-value.



Qualifications 

What you have - Required Skills: 

 - 5+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, Professional Services, Product Strategy, or related customer-facing roles.

 - Experience designing and delivering enterprise SaaS solutions.

 - Strong ability to translate business challenges into technical and operational solutions.

 - Demonstrated experience developing technical requirements, solution designs, and Statements of Work.

 - Experience working directly with executive stakeholders and enterprise customers.

 - Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

 - Proven ability to influence and lead across multiple teams without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications 

 - Experience in customer engagement, customer operations, workflow automation, communications, or customer experience platforms.

 - Familiarity with regulated industries such as utilities, healthcare, insurance, financial services, or government.

 - Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

 - Consulting or professional services background.

 - Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or product portfolio integrations.

 - Understanding of APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, AI-enabled workflows, and enterprise software architecture.

Success in This Role 

 - Within your first year, you will:

 - Become a trusted advisor to both customers and internal stakeholders.

 - Establish a repeatable solutioning process that improves alignment between Sales, Professional Services, and Product.

 - Increase the quality and consistency of technical requirements and SOW development.

 - Help accelerate customer time-to-value through stronger solution design and implementation planning.

 - Create a measurable feedback loop that influences product roadmap decisions with real-world customer insights.

 - Strengthen the strategic partnership between the field and product organizations.

US-BASED ROLES ONLY - BENEFITS

 - Fully covered Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees

 - Fully covered STD/LTD

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

 - 12 paid holidays throughout the year, including winter recess for all employees between December 25th-January 1st

jobs.title: VP, Communications

About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

AlphaSense is seeking a Vice President of Communications to lead the company’s global external reputation and influence strategy and strengthen AlphaSense’s leadership in AI.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, the Vice President of Communications will lead AlphaSense’s communication strategy to drive brand awareness, share of voice, and thought leadership at this critical stage of the company. This individual will oversee both internal and external communications and will work closely with the executive team and cross-functional leaders to support the company’s growth objectives, manage crisis communications, and enhance the brand’s narrative across key stakeholders, including customers, investors, and the media. The VP of Communications will also be responsible for AlphaSense’s prestigious Media Access Program that brings hundreds of reporters access to our platform resulting in thousands of media exposures. The VP of Communications will also be responsible for leading, developing, and mentoring a high-performing communications team.

What You'll Do:

• Communications Strategy: Develop, execute, and lead a comprehensive global communications strategy aligned with AlphaSense’s OKRs, brand story, and values.

• PR/Media Relations: Oversee media relations strategy to increase AlphaSense’s visibility and share of voice in key markets and sectors. Oversee and manage key agency partners.

• Executive Communications: Advise and support the entire executive team, including the CEO, on external engagements, media interviews, speeches, written content, as well as internal communications, ensuring clarity and consistency in messaging.

• Internal Communications: Ensure clear, engaging, and consistent communication across the organization, identifying the right cadence, channels, and messaging to motivate and engage employees.

• Team Leadership: Build and lead a high performing communications team, providing guidance, feedback, and development opportunities to foster their growth and ensure alignment with overall communications strategy.

• Crisis Management: Lead crisis communication efforts, providing clear and decisive leadership to mitigate risk and protect AlphaSense’s reputation during sensitive situations.

• Content Creation: Oversee the development of high-quality written content from the company and the executive team, including press releases, blogs, and social media posts.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family, and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners, and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue


ABOUT THE ROLE

Handshake is hiring a Revenue Operations Manager reporting to the Director of Strategy & Operations who leads our Revenue Operations team. You will be the day-to-day operating partner for our new business sales teams (Mid-Market, Strategic Corporate and Public Sector), owning the pipeline, forecast and productivity insights that help us win new logos. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You will build the analysis yourself, run the operating cadence, and use AI and automation to take manual work off reps and managers so they spend more time selling.

In this role, you will:

 - Partner with new business sales leaders as their go-to operator, turning bookings goals into pipeline, coverage and productivity targets, and helping managers act on them

 - Run the new business operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and monthly and quarterly business reviews, bringing an independent, data-backed view of the forecast

 - Own new business reporting on pipeline health, stage conversion, sales cycle, coverage, attainment and rep productivity, with one clear definition for every metric

 - Find and fix funnel friction: diagnose where deals stall, and partner with Marketing, Sales Development and Enablement on programs that improve conversion and velocity

 - Support annual and quarterly planning, including capacity models, territory and account assignment, and quota inputs, in partnership with Finance and the RevOps leader

 - Keep the sales process clean: stage definitions, rules of engagement, lead and account routing, and Salesforce data quality

 - Model and monitor new business comp plans with Finance and Commissions, and track whether plans drive the behavior we intend

 - Build AI and automation programs that drive pipeline: partner with GTM Engineering to launch and scale programs that generate new business leads, testing in short build, test, learn sprints

 - Automate the manual work: use AI to automate reporting and deal inspection, and build internal tools that give managers and reps time back


YOU HAVE

Must-Haves:

 - 4 to 7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS company, supporting new business or acquisition sales teams

 - A track record as the trusted operating partner to frontline sales managers and sales leaders

 - Strong analytical skills: you build models and dashboards yourself, using SQL and a BI tool (Omni, Looker, Tableau, Hex or similar)

 - Advanced Salesforce skills, plus experience with forecasting and pipeline inspection tools

 - Experience running forecast and pipeline cadences and managing funnel performance (conversion rates, sales cycles, coverage)

 - Experience supporting territory, capacity and quota planning

 - Clear, concise written and verbal communication; you turn analysis into a recommendation and present it to senior leaders

 - Hands-on use of AI tools (LLMs such as Claude or ChatGPT, Clay or similar) to automate your own work, with a builder mindset

 - An ownership mentality, a bias toward action, and comfort working through ambiguity in a high-growth environment

 - The ability to influence without authority across Sales, Finance, Marketing and Product

Bonus Points:

 - Hands-on experience with Gong, Nooks, Clay, Gainsight or comparable tools

 - Experience supporting multiple sales segments

 - Experience building automations or lightweight tools (Python, Zapier, Workato, n8n or similar)

 - Experience supporting sales enablement programs that improve rep productivity

 - Management consulting, investment banking or private equity experience paired with in-house operating experience


PERKS

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

The below benefits are for full-time US employees.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend

📚 Growth: $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days

🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

jobs.title: Full Time Virtual Teacher, English/Language Arts  (IN, MN)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Edmentum is a dynamic educator and student-focused company dedicated to tech-enabled learning solutions. Our goal is to ensure that all students have access to flexible learning environments and educators have the tools they need to support their students. We are on a mission to create innovative, proven learning technology, partnering with educators to ignite student potential. We are a Remote First organization with a strong commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

Who We Are

At Edmentum, we’re not just building educational technology … we’re transforming the future of learning. As a dynamic, Remote First company on a mission to ignite student potential, we empower educators with powerful tools and support systems to create flexible, inclusive, and effective learning environments for all students. We’re looking for curious, driven, and impact-focused individuals who are ready to grow with us. Sound like you? Read on.

What You’ll Do

You will be the face and voice of Edmentum for students who depend on you to show up every day, live on camera, fully present and fully prepared. As a Virtual English/Language Arts Teacher, you bring your classroom to life through a screen: connecting with students in real time, personalizing learning for every individual, and creating an online environment where students feel seen, supported, and motivated to succeed. Live, synchronous, on-camera instruction is the heart of this role — it is what our students, families, and partner schools depend on every instructional day. This role is for educators who thrive in a fast-moving digital environment and who believe that great live teaching is the core of great learning, regardless of the medium.

In this role you will:

• Deliver live, on-camera synchronous instruction for five (5) or more hours per day, every scheduled instructional day, creating an engaging and structured virtual classroom experience that inspires student participation and achievement. This live instructional delivery is an essential function of the role.

• Use student performance data to personalize instruction, identify learning gaps, and adapt your approach to meet each student where they are.

• Provide timely, meaningful feedback on student work and maintain accurate records that keep students and families informed and on track.

• Build genuine relationships with students and families through professional, proactive communication that fosters trust and shared accountability for learning outcomes.

• Collaborate with school partners and Edmentum colleagues to ensure students receive consistent, high-quality support across their learning experience.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Education or a related field and an active state teaching license with an endorsement in English/Language Arts, grades 6-12. Preferred state licensure in Indiana and/or Minnesota.

• You have experience teaching in virtual and/or in-person settings and are comfortable with the unique demands of a live online classroom.

• You are confident and engaging on camera, able to teach live for five (5) or more consecutive hours per day, every instructional day, and build real connection with students through a screen.

• You have hands-on experience with online learning platforms, virtual instruction tools, and standard productivity software.

• You are data-informed: you know how to read student performance data and use it to adjust your live instruction in meaningful ways.

• You are an excellent communicator, in writing and verbally, and you know how to meet students, families, and colleagues where they are.

• You are highly organized and self-directed, with the time management skills to independently manage a full student caseload in a remote environment.

• You are committed to your own professional growth, maintaining certification and staying current on K-12 curriculum, technology, and best practices.

• You bring integrity, warmth, and a deep belief that every student can succeed, values that align with Edmentum’s mission.

• You are willing to take on evolving responsibilities based on business needs.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• A Remote First culture that values trust.

• A mission-driven team obsessed with improving education for all students.

• Growth opportunities and leadership that truly invests in your development.

• The chance to work with innovative tools and game-changing products.

• The satisfaction of knowing your work is helping shape the future of learning.

Ready to help shape the future of education? Apply now and let’s build something meaningful together.

$45,000—$50,000 USD

Actual compensation will be determined based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill sets. All compensation decisions are individualized and based on the specific circumstances of each candidate.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your overall well-being and work-life balance. This includes medical, dental, and vision insurance with various plan options, a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and a time away program, volunteer time away, and a winter office closure at the end of December. • Maintain a safe and clean work environment. Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations. Report deficiencies to supervisor immediately. Assist in rectifying deficiencies as requested. Assume responsibility for and supervision of the appropriate care of medical equipment.
