jobs.title: Operations Program Associate
jobs.description:
Weight Watchers is the global leader in science-backed weight management, offering an integrated support system built for the GLP-1 era that combines scientific expertise, medication, cutting-edge technology, and human connection. With more than 60 years of experience, Weight Watchers is the most studied commercial weight management program in the world, delivered through its No. 1 U.S. doctor-recommended weight-loss program. Its holistic, personalized approach also includes U.S.-based clinical interventions and access to GLP-1 medications when clinically appropriate, and a global network of coaches and community support. Since 1963, the company has led with science to deliver its members the personalized support they need to reach and sustain their goals. Members can access these solutions directly, or through Weight Watchers for Business’ full-spectrum platform for employers, health plans, and payers. In a landscape crowded with contradictory advice, isolating apps, and one-size-fits-all solutions, Weight Watchers offers a proven path forward that is rooted in research, grounded in empathy and designed to help every member feel better in their body and live a longer, healthier life.

ABOUT THE TEAM

WeightWatchers for Business, the enterprise facing brand of WeightWatchers, delivers the value of WeightWatchers directly to employers and health plans. Our programs offer all of the benefits of WeightWatchers, packaged as population health benefits. The solution starts with WeightWatchers’s award winning app and provides access to various levels of coaching while providing state-of-the-art integration, reporting and marketing support to enterprises.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Operations Program Associate is responsible for overseeing partner programs inclusive of  managing cross-functional implementations, and ensuring successful implementation of system integrations, processes, operational solutions and post launch services. This role acts as the central liaison between partners, technical teams, operations,  marketing, leadership and other matrix partners to coordinate timelines, manage deliverables, and drive initiatives from initiation through completion.  Post implementation operational management is also essential to this role.

The ideal candidate combines strong external facing presence and strong implementation management skills with experience coordinating technical integrations, partner onboarding, and operational execution in a fast-paced  environment.

Key Responsibilities

Implementation  Management

• Lead multiple implementations simultaneously from planning through execution and post-launch support; external and internal implementations

• Develop execution plans, timelines, milestones, and implementation strategies

• Monitor implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and deliverables

• Facilitate implementation meetings and provide regular status updates to stakeholders

• Ensure implementations are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives

Integration Implementations

• Coordinate system integrations between clients/partners, vendors, and internal platforms

• Serve as the primary point of contact for integration-related communication internally and externally

• Gather and document business and technical requirements where appropriate

• Collaborate with technical teams on data mapping, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment

• Craft client and member use cases to support and test the integration model/s

Client/Partner & Stakeholder Management

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients/partners and internal stakeholders

• Manage implementation expectations and communicate project updates proactively

• Partner with matrix teams across the organization (i.e. Commercial, Operations, Product, IT, Finance, Marketing and Customer Success teams)

• Address operational escalations and drive issue resolution effectively

Process & Operational Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, implementation processes, and communication

• Create and maintain SOPs, initiative documentation, and integration guides

• Support operational scalability through process standardization

• Track KPIs related to project delivery, client satisfaction, and integration performance

WHO YOU ARE

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, or related field preferred

• 3–5+ years of experience in project management, implementation, integrations, or operations

• Experience managing client implementations and system integrations

• Strong understanding of project management methodologies and lifecycle management

• Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills

• Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Experience with CRM, ERP, or project management platforms such as HubSpot, Jira, or Smartsheet preferred

• Familiarity with APIs, data mapping, EDI, or system connectivity concepts is a plus

Base salary may vary depending on, but not limited to: skills, experience, and location.  This role is also eligible for a comprehensive benefits package and annual bonus program.

US Pay Range

$70,000—$80,000 USD

At WeightWatchers, our mission is to build a worldwide community connected by healthy habits. If that resonates with you, then we would love to talk. WeightWatchers values developing community within our employee population as well.  We have a hybrid work environment to allow our employees to find the right work-life balance.

At WW, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace is a priority. We are committed as individuals, as an organization, and as fellow humans to advocate for and support our employees, our members, and our communities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, creed, national origin, marital status, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

By agreeing to participate in our process, you agree that any information we collect is subject to our Privacy Policy.

Maryland

Under Maryland law, an employer may not require or demand, as a condition of employment, prospective employment, or continued employment, that an individual submit to or take a polygraph examination or similar test. An employer who violates this law is guilty of a misdemeanor and subject to a fine not exceeding $100.

Massachusetts

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

WeightWatchers complies with all applicable Rhode Island Workers' Compensation laws (Chapters 29-38 of the R.I. General Laws).  Eligible employees are covered by worker's compensation insurance for work-related injuries or illness.

RECRUITMENT SECURITY & FRAUD PREVENTION

At WeightWatchers, we prioritize the security of our candidates. To ensure you are communicating with a legitimate representative of our team, please keep the following security standards in mind:

• Verified Email Domain: All official correspondence from our recruiting team will originate from an @ww.com email address.

• Live Engagement: Our hiring process requires live interaction. We do not conduct interviews or extend employment offers solely through text message, chat apps, or automated email-only exchanges.

• Financial Integrity: WeightWatchers will never ask for any form of payment from a candidate. We will never send you a check with instructions to purchase equipment or "start-up kits" on our behalf.

• Secure Data Collection: Sensitive personal information (such as banking or identity tax info) is only requested through our official, secure onboarding portal after a formal offer has been extended, never during the interview phase.

Stay Vigilant: If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent WeightWatchers and the process deviates from these standards, please do not share any personal information. You can verify any open position by visiting our official careers page at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/ww

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Warehouse Associate to join our Mayer Team in Pompano Beach, FL!

Summary:

Employee’s level and pay will be dependent on their level of experience, knowledge, and capabilities. The Warehouse Associate is responsible for efficiently and accurately filling customer orders, receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material in a manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity. Responsible for all warehouse transactions, as well as the upkeep and maintenance of the branch warehouse environment and equipment. This role is not permitted to make deliveries.

What You'll Do:

• Contribute to a culture and environment focused daily on employee safety and a safe work environment
• Follow established Standard Operating Procedures, Environmental Health and Safety Rules, and immediately address safety concerns
• Receive material coming into the building by vendors, customers, or other warehouses and verify the quantity and description of materials received by checking merchandise against the packing list
• Keep incoming orders stocked on shelves orderly and in designated area and report freight damage claims
• Prepare branch orders from the warehouse and ensure that the correct number and type of product is being shipped
• Process paperwork regarding shipments including but not limited to verifying that the merchandise to be shipped is correct, applying the correct postage tape and label, following customer shipping instructions, and insuring the shipment when necessary
• Operate machinery including forklift, reach truck, and wire cutting machine when required
• Load common carrier and company vehicles
• Inspect and perform minor maintenance on equipment
• Perform inventory counts and reconcile any discrepancies
• May be required to perform other job functions within a branch when required including but not limited to counter sales and customer support
• Perform other duties as assigned

Job Duties Disclaimer:

The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. Please note that management retains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrate commitment to effective customer service delivery, integrity, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Rexel USA.

What You'll Need

• No experience required
• Prior warehouse experience a plus
• Certification to operate forklift, hand truck, pallet jack, and other warehouse equipment preferred
• High School or GED - Preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• General knowledge of electrical products a plus
• Ability to effectively communicate with co-workers and customers
• Ability to handle basic issues and problems

• Basic computer knowledge

Physical Demands:

jobs.title: Manager, Capital Events
jobs.description:
About Alumni Ventures

Alumni Ventures is one of the world’s most active venture capital platforms, with $1.4B+ in assets raised and investments in 1,600+ companies. Our network of 850,000+ members and 40+ dedicated investors connects accredited individuals to high-quality venture deals—typically reserved for institutions—through our alumni-driven communities and diversified co-investment strategy. With offices in Boston, New York, Chicago, Menlo Park, Manchester, NH, London and Tokyo we’re rapidly growing and committed to fueling entrepreneurial success while developing the next generation of VC professionals.

We believe our best work happens when we’re together. AV operates as a 5-day-a-week, in-office culture because collaboration, mentorship, and shared momentum matter.

About the Role

Alumni Ventures is launching a new platform to connect prospective investors with the opportunity to invest directly in the AV management company. We're looking for a Manager, Capital Events to turn that inbound interest into meaningful investor relationships and completed investments, playing a direct role in supporting AV's growth and long-term capital strategy.

Reporting to the EVP of Investor Relations, you'll own the investor journey from initial conversation through close. With approximately 30–40 inbound calls per week, you'll have a steady flow of opportunities to build relationships, educate prospective investors, and guide them through the investment process. You'll join an established three-person Capital Events team responsible for raising equity and debt for the AV management company.

This is a consultative, education-first sales role for someone who enjoys connecting with people, can make complex financial concepts accessible, and takes pride in thoughtful, consistent follow-through. Success requires balancing a high volume of investor conversations with the personalized attention and credibility needed to build trust and convert interest into investment.

What You’ll Do

• Own the inbound investor pipeline. Manage approximately 30–40 inbound calls per week with prospective AV management company equity investors, guiding each relationship from initial conversation through completed investment.

• Make every conversation count. Research each prospect's background and prior interactions to prepare for relevant, personalized discussions that build trust and uncover investment goals.

• Educate and advise prospective investors. Clearly explain Alumni Ventures, the venture capital asset class, and the opportunity to invest in the AV management company, while listening closely to investor questions, interests, and concerns.

• Drive thoughtful, consistent follow-through. Maintain timely, personalized communication with every prospect, address outstanding questions, and help investors navigate the next steps toward an investment decision.

• Keep the pipeline organized and moving. Maintain accurate CRM records, track investor activity and next steps, and proactively manage a high volume of relationships without losing attention to detail.

• Improve the investor experience and conversion process. Partner with the EVP of Investor Relations and Capital Events colleagues to share investor feedback, refine messaging, identify opportunities to improve the process, and increase conversion.

• Deliver measurable results. Take ownership of converting qualified inbound interest into completed AV management company equity investments, with accountability for pipeline progression and conversion outcomes.

• Contribute across Capital Events. Support additional equity and debt capital-raising initiatives throughout the year as team priorities evolve.

Who You Are

• You bring 3–5 years of client-facing experience in financial services, including experience discussing financial markets and investment-related topics with clients.

• You have experience working with accredited and high-net-worth individuals and understand the importance of credibility, discretion, and trust in investor relationships.

• You're a natural relationship builder who is personable, curious, and genuinely interested in understanding people's goals and perspectives.

• You have demonstrated sales ability and take a consultative, education-first approach, using thoughtful questions, active listening, and clear explanations rather than high-pressure tactics.

• You're an excellent verbal and written communicator who can make complex financial concepts approachable and adapt your style to different audiences.

• You're highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage a large, active pipeline while maintaining personalized communication and consistent follow-through.

• You're motivated by measurable outcomes, comfortable owning a conversion goal, and proactive about moving opportunities forward.You're comfortable using AI tools to research prospects, prepare for conversations, personalize follow-up, and improve efficiency while applying your own judgment to investor interactions.

A Note to Candidates

We recognize that talent comes from many backgrounds. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you'd be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed above.

Our Culture & How We Work at AV
Regardless of title, this is what great looks like at AV.

• Put team and stakeholders first. We win together and measure success by the value we create for our investors, founders, and each other.

• Take extreme ownership and bias toward action. We act like owners, move with urgency, and follow through.

• Debate rigorously and commit fully. We welcome diverse views, use data and sound judgment, and once aligned, execute as one team.

• Focus on what matters most. We prioritize impact, simplify where possible, and channel energy where we have a real advantage.

• Be AI-forward and tech-optimistic. We actively use AI and emerging technologies to work smarter, make better decisions, and amplify human judgment — not replace it.

• Stay curious and think big. We are continuous learners, aim high and build for long-term impact.

Benefits & Perks
We offer a flexible, employee-first benefits program designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits begin shortly after hire and are designed to give you choice and flexibility based on your needs.

• Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options, including employer-funded deductible support and HSA contributions

• Dental and vision plans with multiple coverage tiers

• Tax-advantaged accounts including HSA, FSA, and commuter benefits (with monthly employer contribution)

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting

• Company-paid life and disability insurance, plus optional supplemental coverage

• Additional support programs including EAP, health advocacy, and wellness resources

• Flexible, unlimited PTO and generous paid parental leave

• 10 company holidays

Compensation

Compensation includes base salary plus equity and corporate bonus.

Privacy Policy

All employment is subject to passing a background check. Alumni Ventures is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Chief of Clinical Operations
jobs.description:
Reports to: Chief Medical Officer
Compensation: $200,000+ annually, plus equity
Position: Full-time | Clinical Leadership

About the Role

Midi Health is seeking an exceptional clinical leader to help shape the future of women's healthcare. We're looking for someone intellectually curious, ambitious, entrepreneurial, and energized by the opportunity to build, innovate, and scale care in a rapidly growing healthcare company.

This is not a traditional clinical leadership position. We're looking for a forward-thinking physician who combines deep clinical expertise with an innovative, builder's mindset to challenge existing processes, embrace emerging technologies, and translate medical evidence into innovative, scalable care models.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally bright, learns quickly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to invest their expertise, creativity, and energy into helping Midi grow.

This is a highly influential, non-patient-facing role. Your work will directly shape the care delivered by Midi clinicians and the experience of patients nationwide.

What You'll Do

Lead Clinical Protocol Development & Innovation

• Own and lead Midi's clinical protocol development, review, and approval processes, ensuring care remains evidence-based, current, and scalable.

• Lead a multidisciplinary committee of clinical experts, facilitating discussions, building consensus, and translating emerging medical research into actionable clinical protocols.

• Continuously evaluate new medical literature, emerging treatments, and innovations in women's health to identify opportunities to expand and improve Midi's care.

• Engage external specialists and subject matter experts when needed to inform clinical decisions.

• Partner with Clinical Education to ensure new and updated protocols are effectively translated into clinician training.

• Streamline and modernize protocol development through technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

Partner with Product & Engineering to Transform Care Delivery

• Serve as a key clinical partner to Midi's Product and Engineering teams, helping design, expand, and optimize our care model.

• Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve clinical workflows, clinician efficiency, and patient experience.

• Help shape the development and utilization of Midi's proprietary AI tools, including Prism, to ensure clinical protocols can effectively inform scalable care delivery and content generation.

• Bring creative, practical solutions to complex challenges, balancing clinical excellence with operational efficiency and growth.

• Anticipate emerging healthcare trends and help translate them into new opportunities for Midi.

Own Clinical Oversight of Marketing & Medical Content

• Design, implement, and lead a scalable clinical review process to ensure medical accuracy and alignment across Midi's marketing materials, educational content, and external communications.

• Establish the infrastructure, workflows, and clinical resources necessary to support a high volume of content production, including articles, blogs, campaigns, and other marketing initiatives.

• Partner directly with Marketing and Engineering leadership to design and implement AI-enabled clinical content review systems, enabling Midi to scale content production while ensuring clinical accuracy, consistency, and alignment with our care protocols.

• Build and manage an efficient review structure, which may include clinical committees, internal subject matter experts, or contracted clinical reviewers.

• Ensure Midi's external clinical messaging consistently reflects our protocols, standards of care, and evolving medical expertise.

Who You Are

We're looking for a clinical leader who brings both exceptional medical judgment and a builder's mindset.

• Clinically exceptional: You have a strong foundation in internal medicine, deep expertise in menopause care, and the ability to critically evaluate research, engage subspecialists, and translate complex evidence into practical clinical guidance.

• Intellectually curious: You're constantly learning, reading, questioning, and exploring what's next in medicine, particularly in women's health, longevity, and emerging therapies.

• Entrepreneurial and ambitious: You're excited by growth, move quickly, take ownership, and see opportunities where others see obstacles. You want to help build a company, not simply manage an established function.

• A natural leader and collaborator: You can bring together diverse clinical perspectives, facilitate productive conversations, build consensus, and confidently drive decisions.

• Highly organized and solutions-oriented: You know how to create structure, streamline complex processes, and build systems that scale without sacrificing quality.

• Technologically fluent: You're comfortable adopting new platforms, leveraging AI tools, collaborating with technical teams, and finding innovative ways to make work more efficient.

• Adaptable and action-oriented: You thrive in a dynamic environment, balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and don't wait for someone else to solve a problem.

Qualifications

Required

• Internal Medicine Physician

• Active, unrestricted, unencumbered MD or DO license

• Board certification in Internal Medicine

• Substantial clinical experience and demonstrated medical leadership.

• Leadership experience within a healthcare organization, ideally in a high-growth healthcare startup, digital health company, or innovative care delivery organization.

• Significant expertise in menopause management and women's health.

• Strong working knowledge of medication-assisted weight management, including GLP-1 therapies.

• Broad clinical knowledge grounded in internal medicine.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate medical literature, develop clinical guidance, and collaborate with multidisciplinary clinical experts.

• Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Comfort with healthcare technology, digital collaboration tools, and AI-enabled workflows.

Preferred

• Experience in digital health, telehealth, or a rapidly scaling healthcare organization.

• Interest or expertise in emerging women's health topics, including longevity medicine, peptide therapies, wearables, at-home diagnostics, genetic testing, and other innovations.

• Experience building or optimizing clinical protocols, governance processes, or medical content review systems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, or Marketing teams.

• Public speaking, media, or social media experience.

• Licensure in multiple states.

About Midi Health

Midi Health is the nation's leading virtual healthcare clinic dedicated to transforming women's healthcare. Founded by women, for women, Midi combines expert, evidence-based medicine with personalized, insurance-covered care to address the unique health needs of women through midlife and beyond.

We're building the future of women's healthcare through clinical excellence, innovation, and AI-powered technology, expanding access to specialized care while empowering clinicians to deliver exceptional patient outcomes.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for ambitious, forward-thinking leaders who want to build, innovate, and help shape the next generation of women's healthcare.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Field Marketing
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




ROLE SUMMARY

The Senior Field Marketing Manager will drive pipeline and revenue growth through strategic field marketing execution, owning the entire field marketing portfolio, budget, and team. You'll develop and execute field marketing strategy across 150-200 events annually, lead the OpenGov Conference and user groups, manage a team of field marketers, and own the pipeline number and ROI for all field initiatives.



You'll be a strategic field marketing leader who combines ABM expertise with event portfolio management, team leadership, and P&L accountability. You'll decide which events to attend, build the business case for each, optimize ROI across the portfolio, and lead your team to execute field marketing at scale using AI and marketing automation.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Field Marketing Strategy & Portfolio Management

 - Develop and execute annual field marketing strategy aligned with company revenue targets and market priorities.

 - Curate the event portfolio: evaluate and select from 150-200+ potential events annually. Build business cases for events based on target account density, market opportunity, and expected ROI.

 - Manage the field marketing budget—allocate resources across events, staffing, collateral, technology, and team. Track spend and optimize for positive ROI across the portfolio.

 - Own the total field pipeline number and ROI metrics. Set targets for each event and the portfolio; track performance and optimize based on data.



OpenGov Conference & User Groups

 - Own the OpenGov Conference strategy, planning, and execution—including registration, ticketing, content, sponsorships, attendee engagement, post-event follow-up.

 - Develop and manage the user groups and roundtable program strategy. Determine frequency, topics, locations, and engagement tactics.

 - Ensure these signature events drive pipeline, customer advocacy, and market presence.



Team Leadership & Development

 - Lead and manage a team of field marketers. Set expectations, provide coaching and feedback, develop skills, and ensure accountability for outcomes.

 - Delegate event ownership to your team; provide strategic guidance while they execute.

 - Work with Operations and Finance to manage budget, hiring, and team tools.



ABM & Demand Generation Integration

 - Ensure each event is grounded in ABM strategy: identify target accounts by product and region, develop pre-event engagement tactics, and build comprehensive post-event follow-up campaigns.

 - Build relationships with Growth Marketing, Product, Sales and Sales Development to align on field strategy and execution.

 - Leverage AI and marketing automation (Claude, MCPs, marketing platforms) to scale pre-event targeting, post-event sequences, and demand generation.



Performance, Optimization & Reporting

 - Conduct post-event analysis for each event: track ROI, pipeline contribution, attendance quality, follow-up conversion, and SDR handoff metrics.

 - Identify optimization opportunities and best practices; apply learnings to future events.

 - Present field marketing performance and strategic recommendations to leadership quarterly. Influence GTM strategy based on market insights and event learnings.



Cross-Functional Leadership

 - Collaborate with Sales, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Product, and Finance on field strategy, account targeting, and event execution.

 - Represent field marketing at leadership meetings; shape overall GTM strategy with insights from the field.

 - Partner with external vendors (event organizers, catering, logistics) and negotiate contracts that protect ROI.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of field marketing, event marketing, or ABM experience in B2B SaaS, ideally at a high-growth company managing event portfolios at scale.

 - Proven track record managing and optimizing event portfolios (20+ events annually) for pipeline and ROI.

 - Experience leading and managing teams; demonstrated ability to develop talent and drive accountability.

 - Strong financial acumen: ability to build budgets, track ROI, and optimize spend across a portfolio.

 - Deep understanding of ABM strategy, account segmentation, and target account marketing.

 - Experience with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and analytics tools.

 - Proficiency with event marketing platforms and CRM systems.

 - AI-forward mindset: Comfortable leveraging Claude and marketing MCPs to scale field marketing execution and demand generation.

 - Strategic thinker; able to develop field marketing strategy, build business cases, and measure impact.

 - Executive presence; proven ability to influence stakeholders, present findings to leadership, and shape organizational decisions.

 - Results-driven with a passion for owning pipeline numbers and measuring ROI.

 - Flexible and willing to travel regularly to field events.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience owning and executing user conferences or signature events.

 - Background in user group development and community building.

 - Experience with budget management and P&L accountability for a marketing function.

 - Track record building and managing event marketing teams.

 - Understanding of government or public sector marketing.



Compensation:

Chicago, IL: $145,000-$160,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.title: Director of Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOSS

 


DOSS IS BUILDING AN OPERATIONS CLOUD FOR THE REAL WORLD.

A modern, AI-native platform for physical product businesses to manage the flow of goods, dollars, and data in real time, across:

 - Procurement

 - Inventory

 - Orders

 - Fulfillment

 - Finance

Built to replace spreadsheet chaos and rigid, consultant-heavy ERPs. Fast time-to-value, adaptable as the business evolves.

Through our Adaptive Resource Platform (ARP) and unified operational data model, teams deploy quickly, automate workflows, and make changes without months of re-implementation.

We recently raised a $55M Series B https://www.doss.com/news/doss-raises-55m-series-b, co-led by Madrona and Premji Invest. Participation from Intuit Ventures, Theory Ventures, General Catalyst, Contrary Capital, and Pathlight VC.

DOSS is trusted by fast-growing operators to run critical operations with speed, control, and confidence.




ABOUT THE ROLE

DOSS's Forward Deployed Services (FDS) team is the core engine of DOSS and the success of our customers. The Director of Solutions Architecture sits at the intersection of product, data, operations, implementation, and customer partnership, leading a team of our most technical Forward Deployed Product Managers while staying deeply hands-on yourself.

You'll own a portfolio of DOSS's most complex, high-value client relationships and lead your team through the full post-sales lifecycle:

 - Discovery: partnering with cross-functional client leadership to analyze operational and financial workflows (flow of goods, information, and money)

 - Product Design: data model, workflows, and integrations

 - Build/Configure on the DOSS/ERP platform

 - UAT and Go-live

You'll manage a team of our most technical Forward Deployed Product Managers, setting the standard for quality and pace while staying in the weeds alongside your team. This is a player-coach role - you're not just directing, you're doing.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead a team of FDPMs across a portfolio of upper mid-market and enterprise clients — you're accountable for team output, client outcomes, and individual development

 - Stay hands-on across the e2e post-sales lifecycle: discovery, design, implementation, and go-live — this is a player-coach role and you'll be in the work, not above it

 - Own the success of DOSS's most complex client relationships; your portfolio is a direct reflection of your team's execution

 - Conduct and lead cross-functional deep dives across customer organizations to map end-to-end business processes and workflows

 - Drive and contribute to new product capabilities that support DOSS's push to upper mid-market and enterprise

 - Set the standard for best-in-class practices and processes across the team — build what doesn't exist, improve what does

 - Translate process flows into product design and configuration within the DOSS platform

 - Partner with technical teams on integrations and data migrations

 - Lead the portfolio through UAT, training, and go-live support across your portfolio; build relationships that drive retention and expansion

 - Coach your FDPMs on client management, problem-solving frameworks, and delivery quality — and create the feedback loops that accelerate their growth

 - Drive automation and AI-forward improvements to DOSS's product and customer lifecycle processes — we're an AI-native company and team




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of leadership experience in engineering, consulting, finance, operations, product operations, or technical program management — leading or mentoring others; ERP experience is a major plus but not a requirement

 - Systems Thinker. Everything in our business is highly interconnected across people, process, and technology. You can traverse it, untangle it, and put it back together — and you can teach others to do the same.

 - Player-Coach Mentality. You lead by doing. You're not the person who delegates everything and manages from a distance — you roll up your sleeves, model the work, and hold the bar.

 - High-Intensity. You've thrived in high-pressure environments — startups, consulting, finance — and that's a real preference, not a stated one.

 - Technical from First Principles. You can grok hard engineering and logic problems from intuition, not memorization — and you can break them down for your team.

 - Intellectual Firepower. You cut through noise, synthesize fast, and make good calls under ambiguity.

 - Strong analytical mindset; SQL experience is a plus (not required)

jobs.description:
fairlife, LLC is a Chicago-based nutrition company that creates great-tasting, nutrition-rich and dairy products to nourish consumers.

With over $3B in annual retail sales, fairlife’s portfolio of delicious, lactose-free, real dairy products includes: fairlife® ultra-filtered milk; Core Power® High Protein Shakes, a sports nutrition drink to support post-workout recovery; fairlife® nutrition plan™, a nutrition shake to support the journey to better health.

A wholly owned subsidiary of The Coca-Cola company, fairlife, LLC has been recognized by both Fast Company and Nielsen for its industry leading innovation.

To learn more about fairlife and its complete line of products, please visit fairlife.com.

shift schedule:

12 Hour Days: This is a day shift position, with hours from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. The role follows a rotating 2-2-3 schedule: two days on, two days off, three days on, followed by two days off, two days on, and three days off. Team members will work every other weekend, including Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

job purpose:

Operate Aseptic Tank and Ultra-High-Temperature (UHT) equipment in the processing area in a safe and sanitary manner following all GMP’s. This includes monitoring and maintaining process controls of heat exchangers process variables and documenting accurate recordings of process parameters while in operation.

responsibilities:

• Follow all safety, working, and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) rules.

• Report to and follow the direction of Processing Supervisors.

• Know proper established start up and shut down procedures.

• Accurately operate Human-Machine Interface (HMI) maintaining process controls within operational limits.

• Responsible for proper regulatory recording of control production parameters and integrity of state seals.

• Clean process equipment such as tanks, lines and pasteurizer, which includes, but isn’t limited to, hand cleaning parts, Clean-In-Place (CIP) and Clean-Out-of-Place (COP) operations on a daily basis.

• Take accurate samples to monitor Clean-In-Place (CIP) system for chemical concentration.

• Take accurate samples of products for QA testing.

• Effectively operate two different operational systems, each with unique sets of parameters and procedures.

• Service pumps, valves and heat exchangers to maintain operational state and per routine Preventative Maintenance (PM) schedule.

• Follow escalation protocol based on production and quality triggers.

• Aid in the training of new personnel or upskilling of team members.

• Effectively follow proper standard operating procedures (SOP).

• Complete every shift Master Sanitation Schedule (MSS), Centerline (CL), and Clean, Inspect, Lubricate (CIL) tasks on a timely manner and accurately.

• Communicate with upstream processing and packaging on any anticipated schedule delays and/or changes

skills/qualifications required:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Must work in a safe, efficient manner and follow all safety procedures including the use of safety equipment.

• Must have the ability to troubleshoot small problems and be able to discern when issues may require input from levels of authority within the corporation.

• Must be willing to ask for assistance when the process is unclear.

• A high school diploma or General Education Degree (GED) is required

• High School level verbal and written communication skills.

• Basic computational skills required. Simple math reasoning required.

• Must be able to operate the equipment effectively after the appropriate break-in period.

• Must possess or be able to obtain an Industrial Truck Operator License.

• Proficiency in English: Comfortable with both written and verbal communication, including reading and writing.

working conditions and physical requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Sitting/Standing/Walking/Lifting/Carrying: The operator stands throughout their shift and walks on uneven concrete and tile surfaces. The operator lifts up to 60 pounds on an occasional basis. Two or more employees complete lifts of greater than 100 pounds.

Pushing/Pulling/Bending/Stooping: The operator occasionally pushes/pulls a variety of objects which may include empty pallets, and brooms during cleanup activities. The operator will push/pull pipe-fittings during hook up. The operator bends and stoops occasionally throughout the workday, when servicing equipment, picking supplies or waste product off the floor.

Squatting/Kneeling/Crawling/Twisting/Turning: The operator may squat when picking up supplies and during cleanup duties, including kneeling on the floor and crawling under equipment. Occasional twisting and turning at the waist while changing dryer lances, or making CIP connections.

Climbing/Balancing/Reaching: The operator occasionally climbs approved stairs or ladders. The operator reaches below shoulder level to pick up pipe-fittings from the floor or while servicing product pumps and related equipment. The operator may reach at or above shoulder level when making equipment adjustments, or during cleanup duties.

Grasping/Manipulation: Frequent use of the hands and fingers is required of the operator when servicing pumps, using scrub brushes, and connecting pipe-fittings.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties. Employees will be subject to ambient temperatures as well as elevated temperatures, up to 110 degrees, due to equipment operation and cleaning.

food safety requirements:

• Notify supervision of any repairs or adjustments that are required that may affect product quality or food safety.

• Understand, observe, and comply with the handling and usage of the color-coded container policy while in the Production Areas.

• Perform all duties necessary to meet Company, Customer and/or Government requirements/standards as prioritized by the Company.

• Ability to initiate action to prevent the occurrence of nonconformities relating to Food Safety and the Quality of the product, processes, quality system, or safety system.

• Identify and record any problems relating to Food Safety and the Quality of the ingredients, processes, quality system, or safety system.

• Control further processing or delivery of nonconforming product in terms of Food Safety and Quality issues until the deficiency or unsatisfactory condition has been corrected.

• In the event of absence, another employee with the same skill level will assume the duties and responsibilities as required.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician I (Multiple Shifts) Eurofins Environment Testing Northern California - Air Toxics, Folsom, CA
jobs.description:
Eurofins Environment Testing Northern California - Air Toxics is looking for a Laboratory Technician I to join our Folsom, CA team.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Prepare samples for analysis in accordance with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), analytical methods, client requirements, and internal procedures.
• Pressurize, screen, and otherwise prepare samples as required for analytical testing.
• Perform routine laboratory support activities and assist analysts with sample handling, preparation, and other analytical needs.
• Serve as a laboratory runner, transporting samples, standards, supplies, paperwork, and other materials throughout the laboratory as needed.
• Perform administrative and clerical tasks associated with laboratory operations, including documentation, data entry, sample tracking, and record maintenance.
• Read, understand, and accurately follow SOPs, Air Toxics methods, client requirements, and internal procedures.
• Ensure all sample preparation, documentation, data handling, and laboratory activities are completed accurately and in accordance with applicable procedures.
• Prepare calibration standards and other materials required for analytical testing.
• Operate and utilize the Air Toxics LIMS system for sample tracking, documentation, data entry, and other applicable laboratory functions.
• Maintain accurate and complete records of work performed and ensure documentation is completed in a timely manner.
• Assist analytical personnel with routine laboratory tasks and provide support as needed to maintain efficient workflow.
• Monitor sample and workload status and communicate production, quality, equipment, or sample-related issues to management.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area in accordance with laboratory safety requirements.
• Demonstrate accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency when handling samples, documentation, and laboratory materials.
• Demonstrate effective written and verbal communication skills.
• Prioritize and manage multiple assignments while meeting established deadlines and turnaround requirements.
• Demonstrate and promote the company's vision, values, quality standards, and commitment to customer service.
• Perform other laboratory, administrative, and support duties as assigned.

Minimum Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree is preferred but not required.

Experience working in a fast paced environment similar to food service or production setting.

Ability and/or Skills

Adherence to safety protocol and operation procedures; Excellent customer service; resourceful and collaborative approach in solving problems; function in an environment of constant change and conflicting priorities; communicate well with coworkers and management; read, understand and comply with SOPs; concentrate, focus, and be attentive to details; use a keyboard to enter data; work under medium to high stress level; ability to exercise independent judgment and effectively use resources to solve problems; ability to lift up to 25 pounds on a continuous basis, stand for prolonged periods; work upright, bend and use hands and arms repetitively to perform moderate physical work duties; the ability to push carts with objects on board weighing up to 50 pounds; hearing and speaking are needed to listen effectively and talk with individuals in person or on the phone; specific vision abilities required by this job include; close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Hazardous Material Handling

The Eurofins Air Toxics laboratory houses chemicals necessary for the analysis of various environmental samples. These chemicals can be harmful if not properly handled. The list includes but is not limited to; cryogenic Dewars of liquid nitrogen, compressed gasses including helium, nitrogen and hydrogen, sharps and liquid solvents such as methylene chloride, acetonitrile and acetone.  This position requires the ability to safely handle and transport these bulk chemicals. The employee will be required to read and reference the Chemical Hygiene Plan and Injury and Illness Prevention Program for additional information and instruction.

Compensation Range: $19 - $21 per hour depending on experience and qualifications.

Position is full-time and non-exempt from overtime pay, candidates must be able to work one of the following shifts:

• Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
• Monday - Friday, 3:00pm - 11:30pm

Weekends and overtime as needed.

We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays and vacation, personal days, and dental and vision options.

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.title: Office Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT CONDUIT HEALTH

Conduit Health is transforming one of the most outdated corners of post-acute care—getting essential medical equipment and supplies into patients' homes. We're the first vertically integrated, AI-powered platform to unite ordering, telehealth, prescriptions, insurance, and fulfillment into one seamless experience. In seconds, case managers and providers can say "yes" to patients who would otherwise wait weeks — while we handle every step behind the scenes.

The Role
We're looking for an Office Coordinator to run the day-to-day of our Briarcliff Manor satellite office - keeping our records organized and audit-ready, serving as the on-site face of the company for regulatory inspectors and visiting patients, and making sure the office itself runs smoothly.

This is a hands-on, on-the-ground role: you're the person compliance can count on to have documentation in order, the person an auditor meets at the door, and the person a patient turns to when they walk in with a question. You'll work closely with our compliance, operations, and clinical teams to keep the office running like clockwork.

This role also offers exposure to a broader range of projects across a fast-growing health tech startup, with real opportunity for growth as the company scales.

Who You Are

 - Organized & Detail-Oriented: You keep records, files, and documentation clean and current - and you notice when something's missing before it becomes a problem.

 - Poised Under Scrutiny: You're comfortable being the on-site point of contact for inspectors and auditors, and you know your way around the documentation they'll ask for.

 - Patient-Facing & Personable: You're a warm, steady presence for patients who visit the office, and you genuinely enjoy helping people.

 - Reliable & Self-Directed: You can own the office's day-to-day operations without needing to be micromanaged.

 - Curious & Growth-Minded: You're interested in stretching beyond the core role and picking up projects across a health tech startup.

 - Mission-Aligned: You care about healthcare access and take pride in supporting the patients and team behind it.

What You'll Do

 - Maintain company records: Organize and maintain company records, coordinating with the compliance team to ensure all documentation is current and accurate.

 - Own inspections and audits: Serve as the primary on-site point of contact for regulatory inspectors and auditors, including managing access to and familiarity with all documentation required for DME office assessments.

 - Run the office: Oversee the setup and day-to-day management of the office space, keeping it functional, presentable, and audit-ready.

 - Manage mail: Monitor and manage incoming mail on a regular basis, routing items to the right person or team.

 - Support patients in person: Provide in-person support to patients who visit the office location on an as-needed basis.

 - Pitch in beyond the office: Take on opportunities to assist with various projects at a health tech startup, based on your interests and company need.

What You'll Bring

 - Experience in office management, administrative coordination, or a similar organizational role.

 - Comfort handling sensitive records and documentation, ideally in a regulated or compliance-driven environment.

 - Confidence serving as a point of contact for external parties such as inspectors, auditors, or visitors.

 - Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine willingness to help patients face-to-face.

 - Ability to manage multiple ongoing responsibilities independently in an on-site setting.

 - Healthcare, DME, or startup experience is a plus but not required.


OUR VALUES

 - Excellence, Not Perfection: We set a high bar for our work and impact, but we don't get lost in endless polish for polish's sake. We focus on results that matter.

 - Urgency, Not Chaos: We move fast because speed drives our advantage. We pair urgency with clarity to avoid noise and burnout.

 - Systems, Not One-Offs: Every solution should eliminate the root cause so the problem never returns. Wins are good; scalable systems are better.

 - Committed, Not Just Here: We show up engaged, proactive, and ready to go above and beyond. The outcomes you drive are what matter most.

 - Crush Goals, Not Souls: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Be yourself, bring positivity, have fun, and laugh often.

Compensation & Benefits

 - Competitive Salary

 - On-site role based out of our Ft Lauderdale, FL office (Monday-Friday).

 - Unlimited PTO + 9 company holidays.

 - Direct mentorship and growth opportunities with senior leadership.

 - Exposure to cross-functional projects across a fast-growing health tech startup.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Conduit Health is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Incident Response Lead
jobs.description:
At Stoke, we believe a thriving space economy will enable a vibrant, sustainable, and equitable future here on Earth. That is why we’re building Nova, our fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle. Designed for daily flight, Nova tackles the core challenges of space transportation by reducing cost, increasing availability, and improving reliability. By radically lowering launch costs and increasing flight cadence, we’re helping create a truly scalable space industry.

Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and empowered to take ownership of their work. If you want to work alongside some of the most dedicated and talented people on Earth, we’d love to have you join us.

Description

Reusable launch systems depend on secure, resilient information systems. As a Cybersecurity Incident Response Lead, you will lead the detection, investigation, containment, and recovery of cybersecurity incidents affecting Stoke’s infrastructure, engineering environments, manufacturing systems, and sensitive aerospace data.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with ownership of incident response readiness and execution. You will lead complex investigations, coordinate response across teams, and translate findings into practical improvements that reduce risk and strengthen our ability to respond. You will provide technical direction and mentorship while working closely with IT, security, software engineering, manufacturing, and operations.

We are a small, highly motivated team. You will balance decisive response with operational safety and continuity, keeping technical teams and leadership informed as incidents evolve. You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly.

Responsibilities

• Lead cybersecurity incidents from initial triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and closure; establish severity, scope, response priorities, and escalation paths

• Serve as the technical incident lead, coordinating responders, assigning actions, maintaining decision records, and escalating business risks and resource needs

• Investigate endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application activity to reconstruct timelines, identify initial access and persistence, and assess affected systems and data

• Collect and preserve logs, forensic artifacts, and other evidence with documented handling, chain of custody, and appropriate access controls

• Coordinate containment and recovery with system owners, validating remediation and monitoring for recurrence; align actions affecting manufacturing, test, or launch systems with operational and safety requirements

• Maintain the incident response plan, escalation procedures, and playbooks for scenarios such as compromised accounts, ransomware, data exfiltration, and cloud compromise

• Improve detection coverage and response workflows using SIEM, endpoint detection and response, threat intelligence, and automation; identify telemetry gaps and tune alerts

• Conduct threat hunting and translate investigation findings into detection rules, control improvements, and prioritized remediation with accountable owners

• Provide clear incident updates and reports that distinguish confirmed findings from uncertainty and explain business impact, response actions, and outstanding risks

• Coordinate with leadership, legal, compliance, and external response partners to support evidence requests and applicable notification obligations

• Lead tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews; track corrective actions and measure response effectiveness, readiness, and recurring failure patterns

• Mentor responders, maintain investigation standards, and participate in on-call coverage and after-hours response for critical incidents

• Perform additional duties as assigned to support organizational goals and objectives

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, digital forensics, or a related technical field, including hands-on leadership of complex security incidents

• Demonstrated ability to investigate and contain security incidents, determine scope and impact, and coordinate recovery across multiple technical teams

• Strong understanding of Windows and Linux systems, identity and access management, networking, cloud infrastructure, and common attacker techniques

• Hands-on experience with SIEM and endpoint detection and response platforms, log correlation, forensic triage, and evidence preservation

• Ability to write investigation queries and automate repeatable analysis or response tasks using tools such as KQL, Python, PowerShell, or Bash

• Sound judgment under pressure, including the ability to prioritize actions based on threat activity, business impact, and operational constraints

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing investigation reports and briefing technical and nontechnical stakeholders

• Ability to lead through influence, mentor colleagues, and drive corrective actions to closure across organizational boundaries

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and investigations in AWS or Azure environments

• Experience with disk and memory forensics, malware triage, threat hunting, or investigations involving ransomware, identity compromise, and data theft

• Experience building an incident response program, running exercises, or coordinating external incident response providers

• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and incident response practices aligned with NIST; experience supporting NIST 800-53/171, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or CUI protection requirements

• Experience supporting aerospace, manufacturing, operational technology, or other environments where response actions must account for safety and availability

• Relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, or equivalent demonstrated expertise

• Prior experience in a startup environment, demonstrating adaptability, resourcefulness, and a hands-on approach to security

Benefits

• Equity – We know that our employees are the reason we succeed. To give everyone a stake in our future, we are pleased to offer equity in the form of stock options to all regular, full-time employees.

• Comprehensive benefits program including subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Company-paid life and disability insurance

• 401(k) plan with employer match

• 4 weeks’ Paid Time Off

• Holidays – 11 days (including an end-of-year closure)

• Paid Family/Parental Leave

• On-site gym or monthly wellness stipend (depending on location)

• Dog friendly offices!

Compensation

Target Levels:

• Level 3 Range: $133,560 - $200,340

• Level 4 Range: $160,230 - $240,450

Our job posts are intentionally written to attract a wide variety of experience levels, and we make decisions about the right fit on a per-candidate basis.

Your actual level and base salary will be decided based on your specific experience and skill level.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S. (i.e., current Green Card holder), or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Equal Opportunity

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including with respect to disability and veteran status.  It is committed to compliance with all equal opportunity laws, including the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) and Title VII.   It does not discriminate on the basis of nationality, race, citizenship, immigration status, or any other protected class when it comes to employment practices, including hiring.

Employment at the Company is contingent upon satisfactory completion of reference and background checks, and on your ability to prove your identity and authorization to work in the U.S. for the Company.  Employees must comply with the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services employment verification requirements, and, therefore, they must complete an Employment Eligibility Verification Form I-9 at the start of employment and re-verify authorization to work periodically.

Separate from this I-9 process, as noted above, this position entails access to certain technology and technical data that is restricted under U.S. export control laws and regulations.  Employment or continued employment may be conditioned on your legal authorization to work with or have access to export control materials as necessary to perform your job.

jobs.title: REMOTE - Actuarial Forecasting Lead / Principal Actuary | C2H
jobs.description:
Role: Actuarial Forecasting Lead

Duration: 12 months C2H

Location: Remote USA

Job Purpose

• The Principal Actuary is the senior individual-contributor specialist responsible for developing an integrated quantitative risk framework linking insurance-driven mobile-device claims, rapidly depreciating inventory assets, and future physical supply and disposition commitments. The role converts uncertainty in demand, recoverable value, and market conditions into actionable risk management decisions.
• This is a hands-on modeling position with no direct reports. The successful candidate must combine credentialed actuarial expertise in insurance claims and exposures with practical experience valuing physically delivered forwards, optional-volume agreements, or comparable structured physical supply arrangements. Physical settlement is the immediate focus; potential cash settlement is a longer-term capability.

Primary Job Accountabilities / Responsibilities

Insurance claims and exposure modeling | 25%

• Build and validate probabilistic claims-frequency, cohort, and exposure models using insured-device populations, claims history, policy conditions, product mix, device age, churn, and external drivers.
• Produce calibrated time-phased demand distributions by client, program, model family, and horizon; distinguish insured claims incidence from repair, replacement, substitution, and SKU-level fulfillment outcomes.
• Backtest assumptions, explain forecast error, and partner with Data Science to translate predicted claims into decision-ready forecasts.

Inventory valuation and financial risk | 25%

• Model depreciation, residual values, recoverability, liquidation discounts, price volatility, liquidity, obsolescence, and concentration across mobile-device inventory.
• Assess the joint impact of claims, future supply, secondary-market prices, repair yields, and inventory holdings using stochastic scenarios, Monte Carlo simulation, expected loss, tail-risk metrics, and stress tests.
• Provide forward-looking risk estimates and evidence for Finance-owned monthly inventory reserve assessments while distinguishing economic-risk outputs from accounting measurements.

Physical contract valuation and risk transfer | 20%

• Price and assess physically settled forward purchases and sales, structured supply or offtake agreements, volume-flex commitments, and deliverable purchase/sale options.
• Model strike or delivery prices, optional quantities, exercise timing, specifications, grading, counterparty performance, delivery terms, and embedded optionality; compare contract economics to spot transactions and inventory carry.
• Partner with Procurement, Treasury, Legal, and Accounting on risk controls and commercial structures; support exploration of cash-settled products only after adequate benchmark and governance capabilities exist.

Inventory portfolio optimization | 15%

• Integrate demand and market-value simulations to evaluate risk-adjusted buy, hold, repair, transfer, sell, and hedge decisions at model-family and portfolio levels.
• Quantify working capital, stockout exposure, purchasing premiums, expected depreciation, and tail-risk tradeoffs to propose practical exposure limits and hedging thresholds.

Technical modeling and governance | 10%

• Write reproducible Python and SQL models and document data lineage, parameters, validation, backtesting, assumption changes, and model limitations.
• Coordinate with the Forecasting Lead on integrated work-product quality; retain ownership of actuarial methodology, assumptions, and specialist model judgments.

Cross-functional leadership and capability development | 5%

Establish common risk terminology, influence planning and procurement decisions without direct authority, and help develop the enterprise inventory-risk methodology.

Communicate complex probability and valuation findings to Supply Chain, Finance, Actuarial, Risk, and executive stakeholders.

Management Responsibility

• Individual contributor; no direct or indirect people-management responsibility. Serves as the senior technical authority for actuarial and risk valuation methodology, mentors colleagues, and may coordinate cross-functional working groups.

Financial Responsibility

• No independent purchase, trade, or reserve-approval authority. Develops quantitative recommendations influencing inventory working capital, economic risk limits, contract valuation, and reserve inputs; Procurement, Treasury, Legal, Risk, and Finance retain approval authorities.

Required Experience, Skills, and Knowledge

• Hold an active professional actuarial credential (ACAS, FCAS, ASA, FSA, or recognized international actuarial equivalent). A CERA designation alone does not replace the base actuarial credential.
• Demonstrated hands-on professional experience developing or materially validating insurance claims-frequency, exposure-based, or comparable insurance predictive-risk models.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience valuing or pricing physically delivered forward, offtake, volume-flex, commodity, or asset supply contracts with meaningful delivery obligations or embedded optionality; theoretical coursework alone is insufficient.
• 8+ years of relevant experience spanning actuarial modeling, enterprise or asset risk, physical-market contract economics, and quantitative decision support.
• Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, statistics, mathematics, quantitative finance, economics, engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• Advanced stochastic simulation, financial risk modeling, calibration, sensitivity analysis, tail-risk measurement, and evaluation of correlated exposure.
• Strong hands-on Python and SQL proficiency; ability to design models, independently inspect model code, and explain methods and commercial implications.
• Demonstrated ability to work with incomplete market data, communicate uncertainty, and navigate cross-functional decisions with strong ethical judgment.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Knowledge

• CERA or advanced enterprise-risk/financial-risk credential in addition to a base actuarial credential.
• Experience in mobile devices, electronics resale, inventory financing, physical commodities, or another market with steep depreciation and limited liquidity.
• Experience with risk-adjusted optimization, supply chain planning, repair operations, or secondary-market pricing.
• Familiarity with inventory valuation accounting and derivative accounting review processes, while recognizing Finance and Accounting as decision owners.
• Experience implementing governed enterprise quantitative models and collaborating with commercial supply or procurement teams.

Measures of Success

• Calibration and accuracy of claims distributions; quality and explainability of economic inventory-risk estimates; usefulness of physical-contract pricing decisions; repeatable model controls; measurable risk-adjusted inventory outcomes.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
