jobs.title: Head of Solutions Architecture
jobs.description:
ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. 

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll build and lead Exa's Solutions Architecture team, starting in San Francisco. Solutions Architects own the technical side of presales: discovery, demos, workshops, POCs and competitive evaluations that win new business. You'll hire the first SAs, set how the team works, and grow it as the business grows. You're measured on the new revenue your team helps close.

This is a player-coach role. You hold the same technical bar as the people you hire: you can build a demo, run a competitive eval and review a POC architecture yourself, and you step into the most important deals when it matters.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Build the SA team in San Francisco: hire the first Solutions Architects and keep the bar high as the team grows

 - Own the technical win in partnership with Sales leadership, and coach the team on discovery, demos, POCs and competitive evaluations

 - Drive the SA team's key metrics: revenue closed with the team, pipeline generated, technical win rate, POC conversion and time to technical win. Set the targets, track them weekly and coach the team to hit them

 - Get hands-on in key deals: join strategic evaluations, review architectures and help the team win competitive bake-offs

 - Drive pipeline generation with Marketing: webinars, technical content, demo apps, events and meetups that create new pipeline

 - Build the SA playbook: discovery guides, demo environments, reference architectures, evaluation playbooks and the SA to FDE handoff

 - Feed the field back to Product, ranking product gaps by the pipeline and revenue that depend on them




REQUIREMENTS

 - Several years of hands-on programming experience, at the same level as the SAs you'll hire: you can build demos, implement POCs and run rigorous competitive evals yourself

 - 5+ years in presales or technical sales, including experience leading SA, solutions engineering or sales engineering teams, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company

 - A track record of hiring strong technical people

 - Clear communication with CTOs, engineers and executives, and a strong working partnership with Sales leadership

 - Comfort with ambiguity and building process from scratch in a fast-growing company

 - Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings, events and team time




YOU MIGHT EXCEL IF YOU...

 - Have built an SA or SE team from the ground up at an API, developer-tools, AI or modern database company

 - Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

 - Have owned or co-owned a revenue number as a technical leader

 - Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLAY

AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential.

Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. We're already helping thousands of customers — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Visa — go to market with unique data, signals, and AI research.

In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nytimes.com%2F2026%2F09%2F09%2Fbusiness%2Fdealbook%2Fclay-ai-fundraising.html%3Fsmid%3Durl-share%26unlocked_article_code%3D1._1A.E5rN.MeYsbgEsUKbB&urlhash=XS4q&mt=4bpSf4a8omAKuAHqAqZx6C11QpbLK_QwIhSV7gSf4Wf9aywPF_KBSiX9IkWE1AhXBEjPH8mK6fAEN7CMFlpvo0lPAtKRjs-dhgzYqHiVKUMCRtw0jScFgxWCRRfYs4HCX0YL9L6PCQz-edBLinvRdU_TaVUL2dA3&isSdui=true&lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Ad_flagship3_feed%3BoQmIsufoRJm7X2HC5Rqd%2Fw%3D%3D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education.

Some things to know about us:

 - Our community http://community.clay.com includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs https://luma.com/claylive, and 30k members on Slack.

 - Our culture https://nextplayso.substack.com/p/spotlight-clay is unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more.

 - All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more.

 - Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/685d83a71452245cc1129791_4d770abfd83e276ec15315a2e06945bd_Clay2025_OperatingPrinciples.pdf.

 - Read about us in the NYT https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/05/business/dealbook/clay-ai-marketing-fundraise.html, Forbes http://google.com/search?q=forbes+clay&rlz=1C5OZZY_enUS1155US1155&oq=forbes+clay&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQABiABDIHCAIQABiABDIHCAMQABiABDIHCAQQABiABDIHCAUQABiABDIHCAYQABiABDIHCAcQABiABDIHCAgQABiABDIHCAkQABiABNIBBzkzM2owajSoAgOwAgHxBVAe8UAxJx_p&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8, First Round Review https://review.firstround.com/podcast/inside-clays-unconventional-path-to-1-25b/, and more https://www.clay.com/press.
   
   

Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Clay-EI_IE9850794.11,15.htm page!






ABOUT THE ROLE

Clay is scaling fast and the IT function is new. The IT Support Team will be the first point of contact for requests, the team that keeps the queue moving, and a key partner to the Head of IT in building out how the helpdesk operates.

The core of the support engineer role is service delivery: triaging incoming requests, resolving issues quickly, and making sure employees get reliable, responsive support. Alongside that, you'll work closely with the Head of IT to configure workflows and build process in our AI-powered ITSM platform, so the function gets more efficient as Clay grows.

This is a good fit if you take pride in running a clean queue, communicate clearly with employees, and are genuinely interested in building better process, not just executing it.

What You’ll Do (Job Responsibilities)

 - Be the face of IT at Clay. Triage and resolve incoming requests across access, software provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, hardware support, and general helpdesk needs. Employees should feel like IT is fast, reliable, and easy to work with.

 - Own onboarding and offboarding execution. Provision and deprovision accounts, coordinate hardware, and make sure new hires are set up from day one and departing employees are fully off-boarded without gaps.

 - Help build the helpdesk function. Partner with the Head of IT to configure and improve our ITSM platform — define request categories, build intake workflows, and manage queues as the function takes shape and scales.

 - Keep the office running. Support conference room AV, networking equipment, peripherals, and general office tech so employees can do their best work without technology getting in the way.

 - Administer the SaaS stack. Manage day-to-day administration across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and other core tools — provisioning users, managing settings, and keeping things clean.

 - Handle hardware logistics. Coordinate device provisioning, shipping, receiving, and basic asset tracking so employees have what they need when they need it.

 - Build process, not just runbooks. Document what you own, identify patterns in incoming requests, and flag opportunities to improve or automate recurring work. The goal is a helpdesk that gets smarter over time.

What You’ll Bring

 - 3 to 5 years in IT support, helpdesk, or a closely related role

 - Strong service delivery instincts; you prioritize well, keep queues clean, and close requests with clear communication

 - Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms; you understand how to configure and manage one, not just work inside it

 - Broad SaaS admin experience: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and similar platforms; you've provisioned users, managed settings, and handled admin tasks across a modern SaaS stack

 - Familiarity with office technology: conference room AV setup and troubleshooting, Meraki or similar networking equipment, common peripherals

 - Experience supporting onboarding and offboarding workflows end to end

 - Technical fluency: comfortable in SaaS platforms, macOS, and basic identity and access management tasks (provisioning, deprovisioning, group management)

 - AI-forward mindset: you use AI tools to work faster, handle volume more intelligently, and improve the support experience

 - Process-oriented: you notice what's inefficient and want to fix it

 - Clear communicator: employees trust you and know their issues are being handled


BONUS POINTS IF YOU

 - Experience with Serval ITSM, either launching it or working within it day to day

 - Experience at a fast-scaling startup where IT processes were being built out

 - Familiarity with Okta or similar identity platforms at a user/admin level

 - Experience building workflows or automations in an ITSM or similar platform

 - Exposure to broader automation tooling


WHY THIS ROLE

You'll handle the most visible function in IT and have a real hand in shaping how it works. Clay is an AI-forward company and this role reflects that — we're building a helpdesk that runs well and gets smarter over time. If you want to do solid IT support work at a fast-moving company and help build the process that makes it scale, this is a good fit.

jobs.title: BestDrive Service Lead
jobs.description:
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT -

The Service Lead is an hourly, hands-on leadership role responsible for coordinating and leading daily commercial tire service activities within a retail and fleet service environment. This position provides working leadership to service technicians while actively participating in service operations, including shop work, road service coordination, workflow execution, safety compliance, and customer service support.

The Service Lead works under the direction of the Store Manager and focuses on execution, technician guidance, and operational consistency, rather than independent departmental management. This role does not have final authority over hiring, termination, compensation, or disciplinary decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Service & Operations Leadership

• Lead and participate in daily service operations, including shop workflow, road service dispatch coordination, drive-up service, and emergency fleet calls.
• Perform hands-on tire service work as needed, including mounting, balancing, repairs, inspections, and related service activities.
• Provide real-time direction and task coordination to service technicians during shifts.
• Ensure service work is completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with established procedures and safety standards.
• Monitor service workflow and productivity to support customer turnaround and uptime expectations.
• Escalate operational issues, staffing challenges, or service delays to the Store Manager.

Customer & Fleet Service Support

• Serve as a first-level escalation point for service-related customer and fleet concerns.
• Assist with inbound service calls, scheduling, and coordination of service activities.
• Support accurate communication of service offerings and tire pricing in accordance with approved pricing structures.
• Promote a consistent, professional customer experience focused on safety, reliability, and service quality.

People Leadership & Training Support

• Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and direction to service technicians.
• Lead by example through active participation in service work and adherence to safety and quality standards.
• Support onboarding and training of new technicians and service staff.
• Reinforce productivity, attendance, conduct, and safety expectations.
• Communicate performance observations and concerns to the Store Manager and Human Resources.

Safety, Compliance & Asset Support

• Enforce all safety programs, including OSHA, DOT, and internal safety standards.
• Ensure compliance with torque procedures, PPE usage, lock-out/tag-out, and hazardous material handling.
• Maintain the Hazardous Materials (HazMat) Book and ensure required documentation is current.
• Verify service truck tools, equipment, and inventory are properly maintained.
• Support preventive maintenance, inspections, and safe operation of service vehicles.
• Maintain accurate mileage, fuel usage, and vehicle-related documentation as required.

Inventory & Administrative Support

• Assist with monitoring tire, supply, and service material inventory levels.
• Complete required service documentation, timekeeping inputs, and operational reporting.
• Support shop, yard, and service area housekeeping, organization, and safety standards.

Store Support & Coverage

• Provide operational support to the Store Manager as directed.
• Assist with execution of company initiatives, operational standards, and process improvements.
• Serve as a designated point of contact during Store Manager absences when assigned, with decision-making authority limited to routine operational matters.

Key Competencies

• Commercial Tire & Fleet Service Operations
• Hands-On Service Leadership
• Service Dispatch & Workflow Coordination
• Safety Compliance & Risk Awareness
• Technician Coaching & On-Shift Guidance
• Customer Service & Issue Resolution
• Inventory & Asset Awareness
• Time Management & Prioritization
• Problem Solving
• Team Accountability

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE -

• Automotive or commercial tire industry experience in a service or operations role
• Demonstrated ability to lead and guide technicians in a fast-paced service environment
• Strong communication skills with technicians, customers, and leadership
• Working knowledge of tire service procedures and fleet service operations

ADDITIONAL WAYS TO STAND OUT -

• High School Diploma or equivalent; technical training or military experience preferred
• 3–5+ years of experience in the commercial tire industry
• Prior experience as a lead technician or informal team lead
• Experience supporting training and technician development

Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

Additional information

Work Environment & Expectations

• 100% on-site role in a commercial tire shop and outdoor service environment
• Exposure to varying weather conditions, noise, heavy equipment, and moving vehicles
• Regular interaction with fleet customers, technicians, and delivery vehicles
• Flexible scheduling required, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and on-call service support as business needs require
• Strong emphasis on safety, compliance, attendance, and operational accountability

Physical Requirements

• Ability to occasionally lift 150+ lbs
• Ability to occasionally push or pull 200+ lbs
• Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and work in a physically demanding environment

THE PERKS -

• Immediate Benefits
• Paid Time Off
• Employee Discounts, including tire discounts
• Employer 401(k) Match
• Diverse & Inclusive Work Environment
• Employee Assistance Program
• Future Growth Opportunities
• And more benefits that come with working for a global industry leader!

Bring your expertise, your love of coaching and passion for the craft - and get ready to be at the center of a culture that is unique, high-energy and fun. Let’s build great teams together!

About us

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters. • Develop and implement best practices and effective strategies for lead generation, qualification, conversion, and pipeline development. Align sales activities with overall sales goals and objectives.

• Coordinate with senior sales management to maximize team collaboration and attain aggressive pipeline goals.

• Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to position the company effectively in the marketplace.

About you:

• 3+ years sales management experience; with experience and/or excitement about working in a transactional SaaS environment

• Experience leveraging prospecting tools and platforms (lead generation, email, phone, video, data enrichment & cleansing, etc.)

• Ability to hire, onboard, and continuously train team members

• Flexibility and adaptability to changing conditions at a fast-paced, growing company

• Ability to successfully manage people, providing coaching and feedback necessary for performance management and achieve performance goals

• Highly collaborative with strong communication, organizational, and time management skills

• A commanding desire to succeed in sales leadership

• Team player attitude who also enjoys and thrives in healthy competition

• Self-motivation to learn fast and pivot as the business demands

• Able to build meaningful connection with potential customers and maintain confidence in the full sales lifecycle

• Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation.

• Based in Austin, TX with the ability to work hybrid from our Austin office.

Why 8am:

At 8am, our culture is shaped by the people who bring it to life every day. Together, we build a company rooted in continuous learning, genuine community, holistic wellness, and meaningful engagement—values that empower us as individuals and unite us as a team. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Work Smart, Win Fast; Outshine Ordinary, and We Find a Way. These values drive how we serve our customers and work with each other in a collaborative, inspiring, and empowering environment, every day.

Here’s how we support our 8Team:

• Health Insurance Coverage: We offer our 8Team a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit your needs, including a 100% company-paid HDHP plan for employees.

• Financial perks: We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including annual bonuses, equity options and 401(k) or RRSP if in Canada, with a company match for all team members.

• Learning and Development: Continuous learning through 8am.edu, leadership programs, professional development funds, and individually focused talent development.

• Giving back to the communities around us: Participate in our charitable matching gift program, paid time off for volunteer service, and company-sponsored volunteer events (both local and virtually).

• Engagement: Virtual and in-person team-building events, quarterly award recognition through our Rise & Shine Award of Excellence Program, and our peer-to-peer appreciation platform.

We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Company description:

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a meaningful role in behavioral health and have the desire to work with an organization that puts people first? If you have a passion for helping others along their recovery journey, then we invite you to join our Crestwood family!

For more than 50+ years Crestwood has been committed to creating innovative recovery programs and developing compassionate communities that support each client in their journey.  Our model of care focuses on a personal and self-directed process that empowers the people we serve and helps them to develop the skills to thrive!

Title: Licensed Mental Health Professional (Enhanced STRTP)

Job Duties: Under the supervision of the Administrator or Designee, the Licensed Mental Health Professional provides clinical oversight in the Enhanced Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (E-STRTP), a 24-hour, short-term (typically 10 to 30 days) intensive residential treatment program serving youth ages 10 through 17 experiencing a mental health or behavioral health crisis who require more support than a family-based setting can provide but who do not meet criteria for inpatient psychiatric hospitalization. The Licensed Mental Health Professional meets directly with youth, oversees staff responsible for treatment, transition, and discharge planning, and ensures compliance with CDSS Community Care Licensing STRTP Interim Licensing Standards, DHCS mental health program requirements, and established policies and procedures, including timely completion of reporting requirements. The Licensed Mental Health Professional helps in the supervision of program staff by providing therapeutic guidance and assists the Clinical Director in coordinating and implementing the core program.

Campus Opening: February 2027

Schedule: Full-Time

Qualifications:

• Must hold a current, active California license as an LCSW, LMFT, Psychologist, or Psychiatrist.

• A minimum of 2 years in a healthcare setting at least one of which must have been in a mental health setting serving children or adolescents; experience in residential treatment, crisis stabilization, or child welfare preferred.

• Demonstrated knowledge of DSM-5-TR.

• Familiarity with the STRTP Interim Licensing Standards, CCR Titles 9 and 22, Medi-Cal specialty mental health services, the Child and Family Team (CFT) process, and other governmental regulations.

• Valid CA Drivers License.

Additional trainings provided for Professional CEUs: DBT, Motivational Interviewing, WRAP, etc.

• Qualifying Supervision for BBS Associates

• Competitive Pay

• Service Awards

• Jury Duty Pay

About the Campus: Crestwood San Luis Obispo’s new Enhanced Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (E-STRTP) will provide specialized, intensive behavioral health services and 24-hour support for youth experiencing a mental health crisis. This four-bed program will primarily serve foster youth ages 12–17 who need a highly structured therapeutic setting but do not meet the criteria for psychiatric hospitalization. Through individualized assessment, stabilization, and treatment, the program will help youth strengthen coping skills, improve emotional and behavioral regulation, and safely transition to a lower level of care. As part of San Luis Obispo County’s children’s continuum of care, the E-STRTP will help bridge an important service gap between hospitalization and home- or community-based care.

jobs.title: Customer Care Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Manager, Customer Care is the accountable operational leader for California Closets’ centralized Customer Care function. This hands-on role leads the internal Central Support team and owns the operational relationship with the First Contact Call Center vendor, TLS. The Manager is responsible for day-to-day service performance, departmental KPIs, quality, lead-management operations, customer escalations, market support, operational risk, and continuous improvement.

The role maintains a strong working knowledge of contact-center workforce management principles to evaluate TLS forecasts, staffing and capacity recommendations, identify performance risks, and hold the vendor accountable for corrective action.

The Manager also serves as the business and operational owner for Customer Care Salesforce campaigns and lead-routing requirements. The role defines and validates operational requirements, coordinates setup and testing with appropriate technical partners, monitors routing performance, and remains accountable for business impact, escalation, communication and validation when issues occur.

Success requires equal strength in people leadership and operational management. This individual is expected to operate with minimal day-to-day direction, use data to identify root causes and recommendations, and drive issues through resolution even when execution requires support from TLS, Salesforce/Technology resources, Service Delivery or other business partners.

Pay - $95K or more depending on experience

Duties and Responsibilities

• Independently lead the day-to-day operation of the Central Support team, establishing priorities and ensuring business goals, service expectations and customer experience standards are met.
• Directly manage Customer Liaisons, Specialists and Team Leads responsible for consultation scheduling, technical support and back-office administration across supported communication channels.
• Own departmental performance and KPIs, including lead-management metrics, complaint and feedback handling, quality, team NPS and applicable contact-center service metrics; identify root causes and establish measurable corrective actions when results fall below expectations.
• Serve as the primary operational point of contact for markets supported by Customer Care. Prepare performance reporting, analyze trends, conduct regular business reviews and translate findings into clear recommendations, owners and follow-up actions.
• Lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, payroll administration, schedules and rosters for the internal Central Support team; build a culture of accountability, customer focus and continuous improvement.
• Manage the Quality Assurance program and provide guidance to the Quality Assurance Team Lead. Audit and monitor customer interactions, identify trends and ensure coaching and corrective actions are completed for internal and external teams.
• Lead customer escalations with sound judgment, customer focus and solution-oriented decision making.
• Partner with Service Delivery to develop and maintain departmental SOPs, training and operational documentation, and ensure consistent execution across Central Support and applicable vendor teams.
• Communicate recurring issues, trends, risks and key learnings to leadership and internal partners, including Marketing, Product, Service Delivery and Technology, and drive follow-through on agreed actions.
• Perform other duties aligned to the scope and accountability of the role.

Vendor Performance

• Own the day-to-day operational relationship with TLS, including service performance, quality, lead-management expectations, issue escalation, action-plan follow-through and adherence to agreed operating standards.
• Maintain a strong working knowledge of workforce-management principles, including forecasting, capacity planning, staffing, scheduling and intraday management, sufficient to evaluate vendor recommendations and performance.
• Review and challenge TLS forecasts, staffing and capacity plans; understand forecast-versus-actual performance and escalate material staffing or service-level risks.
• Hold TLS accountable for investigating performance gaps, presenting recovery plans and demonstrating sustained improvement. Ensure operational issues remain actively managed through resolution rather than relying solely on ticket creation or vendor escalation.
• Use vendor performance, quality and operational data to identify trends and recommend changes to processes, training, staffing assumptions or service-delivery practices.

Salesforce Campaign & Lead Routing Operations

• Own the business and operational requirements for Customer Care lead management and customer service campaigns, queues and lead-routing processes.
• Guide and coordinate campaign setup, routing changes, testing, launch readiness and post-launch validation with appropriate Salesforce/Technology partners and TLS.
• Maintain current documentation of campaign purpose, routing logic, operational dependencies, ownership and escalation paths.
• Monitor lead-routing and campaign performance for exceptions, failures or unintended outcomes that may affect customer response, lead handling or market performance.
• When campaign or routing issues occur, assess business impact, coordinate containment or interim procedures, engage the appropriate technical owner, communicate status to stakeholders, and validate operational recovery before closure.
• Provide operational input into Salesforce enhancements and process changes that affect Customer Care, lead management, routing or call-center workflows.

Operational Risk & Incident Management

• Identify and escalate material operational risks based on customer, lead, service, revenue or brand impact, developing and following established escalation protocols.
• Own business-side incident coordination through containment, technical or vendor escalation, operational workaround, validation and closure.
• Communicate issue scope, business impact, current status, ownership, interim actions and next steps to affected stakeholders and leadership.
• Lead or participate in post-incident reviews for material or recurring issues and ensure preventive actions, documentation, controls, testing or training are implemented.

• 7+ years of progressive customer care or contact-center experience, including demonstrated responsibility for contact-center operations and people leadership.
• Demonstrated experience managing outsourced contact-center or BPO relationships and holding partners accountable for service, quality and operational performance.
• Strong understanding of contact-center workforce-management principles and ability to evaluate forecasts, staffing plans, capacity recommendations and service-level performance; direct ownership of vendor agent scheduling is not required.
• Experience working with Salesforce or a comparable CRM in a lead-management, campaign, queue or routing environment. Ability to define business requirements, validate operational outcomes and partner effectively with technical resources.
• Thorough understanding of contact-center KPIs and performance drivers, with the ability to interpret operational data, identify root causes and turn findings into executable, measurable plans.
• Experience leading operational incidents or cross-functional escalations and maintaining accountability through resolution.
• Strong process-management and continuous-improvement capabilities, including development and maintenance of SOPs and operating controls.
• Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to clearly communicate performance, risks, recommendations and decisions to team members, vendors, markets and leadership.
• Proven people leadership capability, including hiring, coaching, performance management and development of team members and leads.
• Strong working knowledge of contact-center and CRM technologies and the ability to distinguish operational issues from technical issues and engage the appropriate owner.

Key Success Characteristics

• Operational ownership: takes accountability for business outcomes and drives issues through resolution, even when another team or vendor performs the technical work.
• Analytical judgment: uses data to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
• Proactive communication: identifies and communicates material risks early, with impact, ownership and an action plan.
• Vendor leadership: establishes clear expectations and follows through on corrective actions and sustained performance.
• Process discipline: ensures campaign, routing, escalation and service processes are documented, tested and consistently executed.
• Customer focus: balances operational efficiency with the quality of the customer and market experience.

Find us on Facebook, YouTube, and Instagram

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.

Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software must all work at micron-scale precision across thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.

That’s what we do.

At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA.

Your Impact:

Our technical leads drive the decisions that make our products great. From the system level to the details of each subsystem, you will sit at the intersection of technical challenges and high-impact product design decisions. You will be the main technical leader who drives the overall design of a shipping product.

What you’ll do:

• Partner with the Product Team to define product-level performance goals, providing the technical perspective needed to ensure targets are ambitious, achievable, and grounded in sound engineering.

• Lead architectural down-selection across all engineering domains (mechanical, optical, electrical, etc.), identify technological risk, and output a performant, robust system architecture.

• Champion shipping a great product. Ultimately, you’ll be responsible for the product's final performance.

• Own technical readiness for any new technologies and ensure we’re ready to incorporate them into a product.

• Work with domain experts to define subsystem requirements and interfaces.

• Guide team members through the technical implementation. Help them frame technical problems in terms of customer value, make design decisions through engineering rigor and objective data, and think beyond purely technical solutions.

• Identify program risks and keep the team focused on the most important work.

About you:

• You’ve led the technical development of a complex electro-mechanical product.

• You are familiar with a broad range of technologies, including mechanical, electrical, thermal, optical, material science, motion control, and embedded code

• You have demonstrated success across the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept development to high-volume manufacturing

• You are comfortable with a culture of healthy debate and can defend design decisions with objective data

• You maintain high standards for engineering work and offer constructive feedback that helps teammates improve outcomes.

Bonus:

• The products you led were high volume

• The products you led achieved commercial success as well as technical success

Compensation:

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

The annual base pay range for this role is:

$150,000—$250,000 USD

jobs.title: Customer Engineer, Enterprise - Austin/Dallas,TX or Raleigh, NC
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

• Austin, TX

• Dallas, TX

• Raleigh, NC

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

What you will do as a Customer Engineer

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise commerical clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

• Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.

• Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.

• Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.

• Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.

• AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.

• Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

• Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).

• Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.

• Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.

• Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.

• Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.

• Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:

• Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.

• Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.

• Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.

• AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.

• Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.

• Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")

• Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms.

• Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.

• Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.

Education

Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Travel

This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.description:
The Senior Sales Manager position is an individual contributor responsible for managing all aspects of component sales (sensors and semiconductors) including management of the relationship with automotive OEMs and automotive Tier-1 customers.

Key Responsibilities:

• Commercial Management: You will oversee the commercial activities for defined directed-buy Tier customers, OEM business, and foundry business. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth business operations with these accounts including but not limited to: sales (price and volume) reporting by calendar year, logistics and sample coordination, special sales tracking, price and contract negotiations, and all other commercial related topics.
• Quotations & Order Management: You will manage the end-to-end process for customer quotations, purchase order confirmations, and order management. This will include handling inquiries, preparing accurate quotes, and ensuring timely confirmation of orders to meet customer expectations.
• New Acquisition & Price Negotiations: You will lead negotiations on applicable price adders with Tier customers, ensuring that pricing is competitive and aligned with business objectives. You will maintain strong relationships with your customers to facilitate successful outcomes. Ascertaining new business opportunities and acquisition of Bosch’s Semiconductors and Sensor components with new and existing customers.
• Collaboration with OE Sales Teams: You will work closely with original equipment (OE) sales teams to ensure alignment on business strategies and customer requirements. Your collaboration will be critical to ensuring seamless communication between the Tier customers and OE teams.
• Account Receivables Management: You will take ownership of account receivables for your Tier customers, foundry customers and OEM customers, actively monitoring payments, and initiating escalation steps when necessary. Your goal will be to maintain healthy cash flow and resolve any payment-related issues.

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Business Administration OR 7+ years of relevant Sales experience in the Semiconductor space
• 5+ years of experience working in a commercial sales role in the automotive or mobility space, with a focus on semiconductors and sensor components
• Ability to build relationships with internal and external stakeholders, both locally and globally
• 15-20% travel nationally/internationally as required for customer meetings, training, and customer support (May be required to spend 2 weeks in Germany for initial commercial and technical training)

Preferred:

• Sales experience with silicon carbide, power electronics, semiconductors and/or MEMS semiconductor devices
• An understanding of the major Automotive OEM customers, Tier-1 suppliers, and related semiconductor electronics market
• Knowledge of vehicles systems utilizing power electronics (i.e. inverters, onboard chargers, converters etc.)
• Knowledge of other vehicle systems including, navigation and mobility, safety systems including airbag systems, and/or braking systems
• Ability to work both independently and as part of a global team
• Excellent organizational skills to properly track and report customer account progress to management
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey detailed messages to customers and to international audiences
• Experience in customer account management including negotiations and commercial functions
• Strong entrepreneurial mindset with a clear understanding of the business environment

jobs.title: Cientista de Dados Especialista - Busca
jobs.description:
Nosso modo de fazer no time

Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. Buscamos sempre fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e atuando com agilidade e responsabilidade! Temos fome de diversidade, conhecimento e compartilhamento. Trabalhamos em um ambiente de muita versatilidade. Sabe o que promove a nossa receita especial? As pessoas! Vem fazer parte disso.

Atuar no desenvolvimento e na melhoria contínua do pipeline de busca do iFood, contribuindo para a qualidade e a relevância dos resultados apresentados aos usuários — desde o entendimento da consulta até o reranking dos resultados — por meio de modelagem de Machine Learning, processamento de linguagem natural e experimentação orientada a dados.

Seu Cardápio Diário

• Gerar modelos que irão atuar em diversas etapas da busca, como entendimento e classificação da consulta, reranqueamento e personalização dos resultados.

• Definir a abordagem analítica para os problemas mais complexos do negócio: estruturar formulações que vão além do óbvio, escolhendo com profundidade entre modelagem preditiva, causalidade, experimentação ou sistemas de IA e estabelecendo as métricas de sucesso que realmente capturam o fenômeno de interesse.

• Construir e validar modelos com robustez estatística de nível de produção: não apenas modelos que funcionam no experimento, mas soluções que generalizam, são auditáveis e sustentam decisões de alto valor sem colapsar sob pressão de dados reais.

• Liderar o design e a análise de experimentos de alta complexidade: conduzir A/B tests e quasi-experimentos em contextos com efeitos de rede, sazonalidade e interferência — com controle rigoroso de vieses, poder estatístico adequado e interpretação de efeitos heterogêneos.

• Ser a referência de rigor analítico da organização: revisar hipóteses, premissas e conclusões de times de produto, negócio e engenharia antes que se tornem insumo para apostas estratégicas, protegendo com decisões bem embasadas.

• Dar forma ao que a organização investiga: com value narrative clara junto à liderança, definir quais problemas valem a pena resolver e quais validações a organização precisa antes de apostar, conectando cada experimento a impacto de negócio mensurável.

• Criar produtos analíticos que servem cada consumidor de forma intencional: desde stakeholders de negócio até agentes de IA, projetando sistemas analíticos que assumem consumo agent-first e entregam validações de forma programática.

• Estabelecer padrões metodológicos que escalam com o time: documentar abordagens, criar frameworks de validação, liderar RFCs/ADRs de experimentação em escala organizacional e elevar o nível analítico coletivo — para que o rigor não dependa de uma pessoa, mas esteja institucionalizado.

Ingredientes que buscamos

• Modelagem estatística e preditiva em profundidade: domínio avançado de técnicas supervisionadas e não-supervisionadas, com julgamento metodológico sólido. Possuir capacidade de questionar a formulação do problema antes de modelar, e de saber quando a solução mais simples é a mais correta.

• Inferência causal e experimentação em ambientes complexos: experiência real com métodos quasi-experimentais (diff-in-diff, propensity score, variáveis instrumentais, synthetic control) em sistemas com interferência e efeitos de spillover não apenas teoria, mas aplicação com consequência.

• Construção de métricas que resistem ao escrutínio: histórico de definir OECs e KPIs que capturam o fenômeno real, identificar proxies enganosas em uso e convencer stakeholders a abrir mão de métricas fáceis em favor de métricas corretas.

• AI-powered workflows como referência organizacional: não apenas usar GenAI como ferramenta pessoal — mas ter construído workflows de AI que o time e a organização adotam, transformando a prática de Data Science com automação que amplifica rigor sem substituí-lo.

• Convergência com engenharia em escala: capacidade de criar bridges entre Data Science e Engineering, estabelecendo patterns que viram convenção organizacional para code quality, reprodutibilidade e production-readiness em trabalhos analíticos.

• Consciência de custos e eficiência analítica: referência em eliminar waste em experimentação em nível organizacional, com desenhos experimentais eficientes, amostragem inteligente e eliminação de re-trabalho analítico.

• Influência técnica sem autoridade formal: capacidade de alinhar times de engenharia, produto e negócio em torno de abordagens analíticas rigorosas, mesmo quando isso desafia o caminho mais rápido ou mais conveniente.

Para Realçar o Sabor

• Vivência prévia no desenvolvimento de sistemas de busca ou recomendação em larga escala — incluindo fluxos de query understanding, reranking, métricas de relevância (NDCG, MRR, Recall@K) e aplicação de modelos modernos de embeddings (como Sentence-Transformers ou arquiteturas similares). Experiência prática com pipelines de dados distribuídos, ferramentas de MLOps (como MLflow e Databricks) para deploy e versionamento, bem como inglês avançado para acompanhar literatura técnica e documentações

• Impacto em escala cross-company: não apenas valida dentro de um domínio: cria capabilities analíticas que múltiplos domínios e áreas da empresa consomem, com flywheels de aprendizado que influenciam o roadmap organizacional.

• Visão de futuro que influencia estratégia: antecipa novas capabilities e influencia a estratégia de Data Science da organização com base nessa antecipação.

• Multiplicação técnica escalável: mentora múltiplas pessoas com crescimento mensurável, cria learning materials que escalam além de interações 1:1, e introduz novas metodologias que mudam como a organização opera.

Sobre nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD, queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar onde vão se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether.

Conheça nossas iniciativas →

jobs.title: Integrated Campaigns Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers. We're just over 2 years old, and more than 7 million teachers from all over the world have joined our platform. Join a top team at a fast growing company that is working towards real social impact. Make an account and try us out at our website https://www.magicschool.ai and connect with our passionate community on our Wall of Love https://love.magicschool.ai/all.



MagicSchool is hiring someone to own the full campaigns engine from start to finish. This person will consistently plan, kick off, and track every campaign with clear owners and timelines, tracking the progress directly to building the pipeline. This role owns the campaign engine. You'll plan and project manage national and seasonal campaigns, build the toolkits our Sales and Customer Success teams use, and create pipeline through owned campaigns and third-party partnerships.

You'll sit on the Marketing team and work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Creative, Product Marketing, and Corporate Marketing. You'll also present to senior leaders, so this role comes with real visibility.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own national and seasonal campaigns (Back to School, Teacher Appreciation Week, Customer campaigns, and others) from first idea through launch, measurement, and debrief.

 - Build and maintain campaign toolkits that give Sales and Customer Success what they need for both prospecting and customer marketing.

 - Work with the regional campaigns team so national campaigns localize well and regional needs shape national planning.

 - Keep one campaign calendar with clear owners and timelines, and share status updates before anyone has to ask.

 - Coordinate email, paid, events, content, social, and web so campaigns feel like one effort instead of separate workstreams.

 - Report on performance against pipeline and ROI goals, then turn the results into recommendations for the next campaign.

 - Support the Senior Manager of Demand Generation in the campaign execution for partner-driven programs, including partnership paid ads, co-hosted webinars, and trade publication placements, in coordination with the teams that own partner relationships and communications.


QUALIFICATIONS, COMPETENCIES, AND SKILLS

 - Ownership: You create campaigns in Asana and kick them off without being asked. You don't wait for Sales or Customer Success to come to you.

 - Collaboration: You surface Sales and Customer Success needs early and keep regional, events, ABM, and digital teams aligned.

 - Bias to results: You define the pipeline goal before launch and report against it.

 - Project management: You run a campaign from kickoff to completion and keep a calendar full of moving parts on track.

 - Communication: You write and present well, you raise risks early, and you're comfortable updating senior leaders.

 - Mission alignment: You care about improving education through technology.


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience running multi-channel campaigns from concept to completion, with strong project management in Asana or a similar tool.

 - A data-minded, ROI-driven approach. You set goals up front and measure against pipeline, not just opens, attendance, or lead volume.

 - Salesforce experience, including pulling campaign and pipeline data.

 - Experience across both prospecting and customer marketing, and experience working directly with Sales and Customer Success.

 - Experience in a fast-growth or product-led growth environment.

 - Background in EdTech or K-12, or familiarity with seasonal buying cycles.

Nice to have: experience building third-party partnership or co-marketing campaigns, ownership of a seasonal campaign tied to pipeline, a content or creative background that helps you brief and direct creative well, sales enablement or toolkit-building experience, marketing automation experience (Pardot, Marketing Cloud, or HubSpot), and exposure to attribution tools like HockeyStack or Amplitude.



Why Join Us?

 - Work on cutting-edge AI technology that directly impacts educators and students.

 - Join a mission-driven team passionate about making education more efficient and equitable.

 - Flexibility of working from home, while fostering a unique culture built on relationships, trust, communication, and collaboration with our team - no matter where they live.

For full time employees:

 - Unlimited time off to empower our employees to manage their work-life balance. We work hard for our teachers and users, and encourage our employees to rest and take the time they need.

 - Choice of employer-paid health insurance plans so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Dental and vision are also offered at very low premiums.

 - Every employee is offered generous stock options, vested over 4 years.

 - 401k match & monthly wellness stipend.



Our Values:

 - Educators are Magic:  Educators are the most important ingredient in the educational process - they are the magic, not the AI. Trust them, empower them, and put them at the center of leading change in service of students and families.

 - Joy and Magic: Bring joy and magic into every learning experience - push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

 - Community:  Foster community that supports one another during a time of rapid technological change. Listen to them and serve their needs.

 - Innovation:  The education system is outdated and in need of innovation and change - AI is an opportunity to bring equity, access, and serve the individual needs of students better than we ever have before.

 - Responsibility: Put responsibility and safety at the forefront of the technological change that AI is bringing to education.

 - Diversity: Diversity of thought, perspectives, and backgrounds helps us serve the wide audience of educators and students around the world.

 - Excellence:  Educators and students deserve the best - and we strive for the highest quality in everything we do.

jobs.title: Manager - Family Intake and Enrollment
jobs.description:
MeBe is a provider of evidence-based therapies for children with autism and other special needs. Our mission is to empower families, professionals, and communities by educating and training them on evidence-based approaches. Our secret sauce? Play-filled, research-based care across multi-disciplines including ABA, Speech and OT.



At MeBe, you’ll be offered more than a job. You’ll receive training and support to develop your career and grow as an individual. You’ll work with extraordinary team members who share a common goal—to help children with autism be their best selves. Your days will be filled with meaning and purpose.



MeBe is seeking a Manager – Family Intake & Enrollment to lead the first chapter of a family’s experience with us. You’ll lead the Family Success Liaison team and own the family journey from initial inquiry through service start, including family discovery, outreach quality, team performance, technology, workflows, and lead-to-enrollment results.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives on building structure, developing people, using data to improve performance, and creating an exceptional experience during what can be an emotional and complex decision-making process for families. Success means building a predictable, high-quality path to enrollment while ensuring families feel informed, supported, and confident at every step.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Family Discovery: Ensure families receive a comprehensive, whole-child discovery experience that explores developmental, communication, sensory, social, behavioral, and educational needs and helps them understand the full range of MeBe services that may benefit their child.

 - Family Access Operations: Ensure families move smoothly through insurance verification, benefits education, and funding workflows, with accurate guidance on coverage, accepted payers, service availability, and alternatives when coverage limitations exist.

 - Systems & Technology Ownership: Demonstrated success hands-on managing and optimizing CRM and customer communication systems—ideally Zoho CRM, Zoho Bookings, RingCentral, or comparable platforms—including workflow configuration, automation, data quality, reporting, troubleshooting, and team adoption.

 - Quality Systems & Controls: Establish and continuously improve the standards, templates, workflows, quality controls, and reporting that create clear guardrails for FSL execution. Monitor CRM hygiene, response times, outreach cadence, documentation, appointment progression, and journey-stage movement to identify breakdowns and drive consistent quality.

 - FSL Team Leadership & Performance: Hire, train, coach, and performance-manage the FSL team. Routinely review calls, emails, texts, CRM activity, and family progression to identify performance gaps, provide timely feedback, and ensure consistent execution against established standards.

 - Lead-to-Enrollment Performance: Own performance and reporting across the lead-to-enrollment funnel, including response time, contact rates, discovery calls, site tours, assessment conversion, authorization progression, service starts, lead aging, and journey-stage drop-off. Use data to identify barriers, improve conversion, and hold the team accountable for timely follow-through.

 - Clinical Capacity & Site Partnership: Partner with Site Directors and Operations to align family intake and enrollment with clinical capacity, service availability, and site-specific growth goals.

 - Referral Partner Collaboration: Partner with Business Development to strengthen referral relationships and ensure FSLs provide responsive, professional communication with referring providers regarding family status, service availability, and referral outcomes. Use insights from family and referral interactions to identify opportunities to improve the referral experience and support long-term partnerships.

 
 

Qualifications and Skills:

 - Team Leadership & Development: Demonstrated success leading and developing a client-facing team, including hiring, training, quality monitoring, coaching, accountability, and performance management.

 - Enrollment & Pipeline Performance: Proven ownership of intake-to-enrollment performance, including pipeline management, follow-up execution, reducing drop-off, and achieving measurable enrollment outcomes.

 - Systems & Technology Ownership: Demonstrated success owning CRM and customer communication systems—ideally Zoho CRM, Zoho Bookings, RingCentral, or comparable platforms—including workflow configuration, automation, data quality, reporting, and team adoption.

 - Process Improvement: Strong process-improvement mindset with the ability to identify workflow breakdowns, design and implement practical solutions, and measure whether changes improve efficiency, quality, and conversion.

 - Data & Performance Management: Data-informed leader who can translate performance metrics into action, identify trends and breakdowns, establish accountability, and use insights to improve individual and team performance.

 - Family & Referral Partner Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate warmly and confidently with families and referring providers, personally navigate complex or escalated situations, and build trust without pressure.

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong ability to work across teams and influence without direct authority, partnering effectively with Site Directors, Operations, Business Development, and clinical leaders to align family demand, service capacity, and enrollment priorities.

 - Relevant Service Experience: Experience in ABA, behavioral health, healthcare, patient access, admissions, or another high-touch service environment preferred, with an understanding of the importance of responsiveness, accuracy, and empathy throughout the client journey.

jobs.description:

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. 

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 285 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways. 

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C https://www.assorthealth.com/blog/assort-health-raises-120-million-series-c-to-scale-largest-deployment-of-ai-agents-for-the-patient-journey at a $1.2 billion valuation. Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.

You'll partner closely with Account Executives to build pipeline and help healthcare organizations..

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at a fast-growing Series B company. You'll have real ownership over your territory and the opportunity to grow quickly as we scale.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and execute multi-channel outbound sequences across email, phone, and LinkedIn to generate qualified meetings for Account Executives

 - Research target accounts to craft personalized, relevant outreach that speaks to the operational pain points of healthcare call centers

 - Qualify inbound leads when they arise, and efficiently move prospects through the top of funnel

 - Collaborate with AEs and marketing to refine messaging, share field intelligence, and contribute to campaign strategy

 - Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline targets

 - Maintain clean, accurate activity and pipeline data in Salesforce




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 1 year in seat as an SDR or applicable experience (we want to hear your story!)

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Genuine curiosity about healthcare and enthusiasm for AI-driven transformation

 - Familiarity with sales tools such as Outreach, Apollo, Outreach, or similar sequencing platforms

BENEFITS & PERKS FOR ASSORTIES

 - 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.

 - 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

HOW WE WORK & WHAT WE VALUE

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result.
