jobs.title: Sr. Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager

Remote – US

About Backblaze

Backblaze (NASDAQ: BLZE) is the high-performance capacity storage layer for AI. Founded in 2007, we scaled the business on less than $3 million in outside funding until our 2021 IPO on the Nasdaq. Today we manage over five billion gigabytes of data for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including AI platforms, GPU clouds, businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

About the Role

As a best of breed storage platform, a robust partner ecosystem is how Backblaze reaches the AI market: GPU clouds, AI infrastructure vendors, data and AI platforms, and the events where that ecosystem gathers.

You will serve our Partnerships & Ecosystem team, and report to the VP of Marketing. Product Marketing, Campaign leads, Content and Creative, Demand Generation, Communications, and Analyst Relations all back you up as you provide the bridge between corporate GTM efforts and our partner orgs GTM efforts. You work at a senior level and carry the work yourself, with strong collaboration and teams to support your efforts.

The job is to give partner marketing the same structure, standards, and ambition as everything else Marketing does, and to make every partnership worth more to Backblaze, to the partner, and to the customers we share.

What You’ll Do

Set the plan and the operating rhythm

• Build and run a rolling six-month partner marketing plan with the Partner team with a focus on priority partnerships in the AI space

• Structure the work in manner that keeps the teams aligned and informed with shared calendars, clear intake paths, and a point of view on what Backblaze will and won’t do

• Fold partner marketing into Marketing’s broader planning so partner programs, launches, and campaigns move with brand, product marketing, and demand generation priorities

• Stay agile and responsive as opportunities evolve and shift around you

• Lead the reporting cadence on impact, in collaboration with the business intelligence team, at a level consumable from c-suite to team meetings

Translate our story for partners

• Take Product Marketing’s core positioning and materials and adapt them for each partner’s sellers, architects, and customers: joint value propositions, partner-facing narratives, and co-branded messaging that stay true to how Backblaze talks about itself.

• Equip priority partners’ teams to get Backblaze right, with kits, one-pagers, and sales plays built alongside Enablement and Partnerships

Build brand with the ecosystem

• Raise Backblaze’s profile with the most credible names in AI through joint narratives, co-presented content, webinars, and thought leadership that establish Backblaze as a storage leader for AI

• Coordinate announcements with Communications, including the disclosure requirements that come with being a public company

• Working with the events team, advocate for Backblaze’s presence at AI-first events and moments where we can show up with strategic partners

Bridge marketing and enablement

• Working with the content and creative team, build co-branded reference architectures, joint case studies and customer references, and informative announcements that help customers make decisions

• Work with DevRel and Sales Engineering around content and enablement with technical depth, they can provide the substance but you’ll need to provide structure and promotion

• Own how Backblaze appears on partner surfaces: integration and partner pages, directories, marketplace listings, co-branded assets, and Powered By Backblaze materials, and documentation. Keep them accurate, current, and consistent

• Support analyst submissions for partner-validated architectures alongside our Analyst Relations team

The Right Fit

Required

• 7–10 years in B2B technology marketing, including 4+ years in partner, alliance, or ecosystem marketing at an infrastructure, cloud, data, or AI company.

• A record of launching and running co-marketing with partners larger than your own company, and of earning priority from a partner’s marketing team

• Proven skill at translating core product positioning into partner-specific narratives, and the writing ability to draft them yourself. Bring samples

• Technical fluency to work with Sales Engineers and partner architects: cloud and object storage, S3-compatible APIs, and how AI and data pipelines use storage (training data, checkpoints, inference)

• Experience planning and executing a presence at major industry conferences, ideally in the AI ecosystem

• Comfort reading pipeline and campaign data in Salesforce and dashboards that others build, and turning it into decisions

• The discipline to work solo: set priorities, hold them, and use AI tools to multiply your output without lowering the bar

Strongly Preferred

• Partner marketing experience at an AI cloud, AI infrastructure vendor, or data platform.

• Experience with partner-hosted conferences and co-presented programming at GTC scale.

• Public company experience, including work within disclosure requirements for partner announcements.

• Experience standing up partner marketing in a function that did not have a home.

• A background producing technical proof: reference architectures, benchmark-backed content, and customer references.

Logistics

• Location: Remote – US

• Travel: ~25%, concentrated around major AI events and partner meetings

• Reports to: VP, Marketing

• Partners with: Partnerships & Ecosystem, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Channel Marketing, Content and Creative, Demand Generation, Communications, Analyst Relations

Backblaze Perks

• Healthcare for family, including dental and vision

• Competitive compensation and 401K

• RSU grants for full-time employees

• ESPP program

• Flexible vacation policy

• Maternity & paternity leave

• MacBook Pro to use for work plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation

• Childcare bonus (human children only)

• Fertility treatment and support

• Learning & development program

• Commuter benefits

• Culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

Pay Transparency

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

jobs.title: Consultor de Vendas - Ouro Preto/MG
Senior / Staff Sim-to-Real Engineer (Tendon-based Robotic Hands)
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for an experienced and autonomous Senior/Staff Sim-to-Real Engineer to bridge the gap between simulation and physical hardware for our advanced tendon-driven robotic hands.

Simulating tendon-driven mechanisms is notoriously difficult due to complex routing, friction, elasticity, and non-linear transmission dynamics. In this role, you will be responsible for creating elegant, highly accurate abstractions of these complex mechanisms for our simulators, and proving they work through rigorous empirical testing and system identification.

You will play a critical role in our control pipeline, ensuring that Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies trained in simulation successfully transfer to physical hardware. As a senior member of the team, you will have the autonomy to define our system identification roadmap, establish testing protocols, and drive the sim-to-real engineering culture.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Tendon Mechanism Abstraction: Develop and implement simple, computationally efficient, and highly accurate physical abstractions for complex tendon-driven mechanisms in simulation.

• System Identification & Validation: Design and execute empirical testing protocols to identify system parameters and prove that your simulation abstractions accurately reflect physical reality.

• Actuator Characterization: Perform rigorous system ID and control tuning on low friction robotic actuators to ensure high-fidelity torque and effort mapping.

• Rigid Multi-Body Calibration: Drive the kinematic calibration, inertial parameter identification, and effort production verification across our multi-body hand systems.

• Sim-to-Real Pipeline Ownership: Collaborate closely with the RL and Controls teams to ensure the dynamics engine and domain randomization strategies perfectly support zero-shot or few-shot transfer of control policies onto physical hardware.

• Technical Leadership: Operate autonomously to identify bottlenecks in the sim-to-real pipeline, propose solutions, and lead the technical execution from concept to deployed hardware.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

• Experience Level: 5+ years of industry or development experience post graduation in robotics, controls, or physical simulation, operating at a Senior or Staff level.

• Sim-to-Real Expertise: Proven track record of successfully transferring RL-based control policies from simulation to physical hardware. (Experience in locomotion or whole-body control is highly valued and directly applicable).

• System ID & QDD Actuators: Deep, hands-on experience with control, system identification, and characterization of Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD) actuators.

• Dynamics & Calibration: Strong foundation in rigid multi-body dynamics, kinematic calibration, and inertial identification.

• Hardware Profiling: Proven experience verifying effort production, characterizing friction/backlash, and diagnosing hardware-software discrepancies in complex mechanisms.

• Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to take an open-ended problem (e.g., "our policies fail when the tendon stretches"), design an empirical test, update the simulation model, and resolve the reality gap independently.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Senior Engineer:

• BS, MS or PhD in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 5+ years of relevant industry experience in robotics, controls or physical simulation with a BS (or 3+ years with an MS, or 1-2 years with a PhD)

Staff Engineer:

• MS or PhD in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 10+ years of relevant industry experience in robotics, controls or physical simulation with a BS (or 8+ years with an MS, or 6+ years with a PhD).

Preferred Qualifications

• Specific experience modeling, calibrating, or controlling tendon-driven or cable-driven robotic systems.

• Familiarity with modern RL environments and physics simulators (e.g., MuJoCo, Isaac Sim/Gym, Drake, or Bullet).

• Experience with sim-to-real techniques such as Domain Randomization, System ID-based digital twins, or Actuator Net modeling.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

• Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times

• Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

• Hearing and speech to communicate

Join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists who are passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

The Role

As a Patient Care Navigator, you are the patient's point of contact between visits. You follow OB patients from their first visit through postpartum, making sure every test, scan, referral and visit happens on time. For GYN patients, you close the loop on results, referrals, procedures and positive pregnancy tests. You work on site alongside our midwives, OBs, medical assistants and front desk, and you are measured on whether patients make it to each next step.

Schedule: Full-time, fully on site.

Employment type: Full-time

What You'll Do

Patient Navigation & Care Coordination

• Reach out to each new OB patient within 2 business days of her first visit to introduce yourself and confirm next steps.

• Track every patient on your caseload through each stage of pregnancy and make sure each checkpoint is complete.

• Make sure tests, scans and referrals are scheduled, completed and returned to the provider.

• Send hospital records ahead of delivery, capture delivery, and book postpartum visits.

• Hand patients off to ongoing GYN care at graduation.

GYN Follow-Up & Patient Communication

• Follow up on abnormal results and referrals until the visit, procedure or report is complete.

• Send procedure prep instructions, confirm appointments and rebook no-shows.

• Read incoming portal messages, resolve administrative requests, and route clinical questions to a midwife, OB or RN using approved protocols.

• Reach out to patients who are lost to follow-up and clear that queue weekly.

Clinic Support

• Cover medical assistant or front desk duties during planned absences.

What You Won't Do

You do not give medical advice, assess symptoms, or share or interpret results. You recognize when something is clinical and route it to the right clinician, every time.

How Success Is Measured

• Journey checkpoints completed on time.

• Referrals and results closed.

• Lost-to-follow-up queue cleared weekly.

• Hospital records sent on time.

• Portal response time and routing accuracy.

Qualifications

Required

• 2 years experience as a medical assistant in an outpatient clinical setting, certification preferred.

• Ability to work fully on site.

• Strong organization and follow-through across a large patient caseload.

• Clear, warm communication with patients by phone, message and in person.

• Comfort working in an EMR and patient portal.

Preferred

• Current medical assistant certification (e.g., CCMA, CMA, RMA) (strongly preferred)—required in states that require certifications.

• OB/GYN or women's health experience.

• Experience in patient navigation, care coordination or referral management.

How We Work

Our values are Excellence, Candor, Humanity, Ownership, Evidence, and Service. In practice, that means we care about our patients and each other, have honest conversations with respect, make decisions based on evidence, and keep the patient at the center of everything we do.

Oula's Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer:

We're committed to an inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. You can be a great candidate even if you don't meet every qualification listed. If that's you, tell us about yourself in your cover letter. We especially encourage applicants from traditionally underrepresented communities, including women, people of color, LGBTQ people, veterans, and people with disabilities.

Oula Health participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Associate Formulations Scientist
jobs.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

Job Description

Eurofins PSS West is looking for an Associate Formulations Scientist to support preformulation and formulation development at a client site in San Diego, CA. Under guidance, the scientist prepares and characterizes prototype formulations for preclinical research.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Prepare prototype formulations (solutions, suspensions, etc.) for exploratory in-vitro and in-vivo studies. This includes oral, subcutaneous and/or intravenous (sterile) dosage forms for feasibility work, and routine solution and suspension formulations for preclinical studies.
• Measure key properties of active compounds and formulations, such as solubility, pH, isotonicity, color and gelling tendency.
• Assess the chemical and physical stability of prototype formulations.
• Evaluate how prototype formulations perform using in-vitro tests such as non-sink dissolution and precipitation.
• Run quantitative analysis using HPLC and supporting techniques (DSC, PXRD, spectroscopy).
• Write protocols for laboratory studies.
• Record experimental procedures and observations in an electronic laboratory notebook (ELN).
• Follow procedures consistently, and recognize and escalate issues as appropriate.

The Ideal Candidate would possess:

• Experience with drug formulation and preformulation techniques, and an understanding of drug candidate properties
• Experience preparing formulations and running feasibility studies, including small-scale operations with guidance
• Quantitative analytical HPLC experience
• Experience running routine lab work (HPLC, DSC, PXRD, spectroscopy, solubility determinations, dissolution testing, suspension processing) on time, productively and with consistent quality
• Ability to learn new techniques, handle multiple tasks at once, keep accurate records and comply with company policies
• Strong computer, scientific and organizational skills
• Excellent oral and written communication and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently and on a team, with self-motivation, adaptability and a positive attitude

Basic Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry or a related field, with 1–3 years of related experience, including at least 1 year in formulation development
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship
• Candidates within commuting distance of San Diego, CA are encouraged to apply

Position is full time, [schedule], with overtime as needed.

What we offer:

• Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays
• Career Development and continuing education opportunities
• Compensation Range: $52,000 - $56,000

Position is full-time, 8am - 5pm with occasional overtime required.

Eurofins Lancaster Laboratories Professional Scientific Services® (PSS) is a global, award-winning insourcing solution that places our people at our clients’ site dedicated to running and managing laboratory services while eliminating headcount, co-employment and project-management worries.

We infuse our 55-year track record of scientific and laboratory operations expertise, as well as HR and great place to work best practices, to recruit, hire, train and manage highly qualified scientists to perform laboratory services using our client’s quality systems and equipment.

With a network of 100 charter schools and growing, ACCEL Schools employs a diverse staff of passionate administrators and educators who value research-based practices and a desire to grow as professionals. The Regional Director of Academics serves as part of the school leadership teams, providing job-embedded and ongoing professional development for Directors of Academics, teachers, staff, and administration. He/she provides support to the principal and school staffs in data analysis and professional development decision-making. He/she provides professional development and guidance for Directors of Academics to improve their content knowledge and effective delivery of coaching. Overall, the job of the Regional Director of Academics is to build the capacity of the schools and its teachers to meet the learning needs of all students. The Regional Director of Academics' goal is to ensure that school staff acquires the understanding and skills to enhance instructional practices at the classroom level and raise the level of student academic achievement.

Essential Role:

• Participation and/or delivery in all required Director of Academics professional development. He/she must remain knowledgeable about current and past research in the specific content area and other pedagogies relevant to the coaching

• Identification of the school teaching and learning needs, barriers and weaknesses by analyzing student data, and organizing and implementing problem-solving actions.

• Monitor instructional effectiveness and student progress using tools and strategies gained through professional development.

• Work collaboratively with ACCEL Shared Services teams and the Regional Vice President to ensure alignment on goals and strategies for each school.

• Performance of additional tasks and responsibilities as assigned

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university

Reporting into Product, this role translates syndicated data, consumer insights, and internal performance metrics into actionable recommendations that inform product innovation, portfolio strategy, channel priorities, and business growth.

As a core contributor to the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) process, this role leads market and commercial evaluations of new product opportunities, develops data-driven business cases, and helps guide portfolio prioritization and investment decisions.

Working cross-functionally with Product, Innovation, Sales, Marketing, and Leadership, the Sr. Category Manager combines strategic thinking with hands-on analytics to build the insights, reporting tools, and data partnerships that support informed decision-making across the organization.

Responsibilities:

Category, Market & Consumer Insights

• Serve as the organization's senior authority on category dynamics, consumer behavior, channel shifts, emerging trends, and competitive activity.

• Develop and execute a consumer learning agenda in partnership with Marketing, Product, and Innovation, leveraging quantitative research, qualitative insights, behavioral data, and external research to identify unmet needs, validate product opportunities, and strengthen brand and category strategy.

• Monitor the broader health, wellness, nutrition, fitness, and human performance landscape and elevate the shifts and emerging opportunities that deserve leadership attention.

• Translate complex market and category data into clear strategic recommendations and present them to the executive team.

Product & Portfolio Strategy

• Supports whitespace identification across categories, products, formats, and sales channels.

• Own the framework for evaluating opportunities market and category attractiveness, size, momentum, competitive intensity, and strategic fit.

• Partner with Innovation to shape the portfolio roadmap, category, and consumer evidence a formal voice in product strategy and development decisions.

• Develop data-backed opportunity assessments that help leadership decide where Momentous should invest, innovate, or expand, and recommend where to deprioritize.

• Lead the development of the market and commercial rationale for new product opportunities, including consumer need, market sizing, competitive positioning, differentiation, channel opportunity, pricing assumptions, and expected growth potential.

• Partner with Finance, Innovation, Commercial, and Demand Planning to develop integrated product business cases, validate commercial and financial assumptions, and translate approved opportunities into initial demand forecasts.

• Serve as a core contributor to Momentous’ PLM opportunity evaluation and stage-gate process, ensuring product investment decisions are supported by rigorous market, consumer, and commercial evidence.

• Lead post-launch category and consumer performance analysis, evaluating actual market outcomes against original business-case assumptions and translating learnings into recommendations for product optimization, future innovation, and portfolio decisions.

Omnichannel Growth Insights

• Identify differences in consumer behavior, category performance, assortment, and competitive dynamics across channels, and recommend how channel priorities and investment should respond.

• Surface growth opportunities that can be activated across the omnichannel business and align commercial leaders around them.

• Equip Sales and commercial teams with insights and recommendations that strengthen channel and customer strategies.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to inform pricing, price-pack architecture, promotional strategy, assortment, and channel-specific product priorities through competitive benchmarking, consumer insights, and category economics.

Analytics & Business Intelligence

• Own category intelligence, syndicated consumption data analysis, and market-performance reporting, establishing a consistent view of category health, competitive performance, and emerging opportunities.

• Establish the KPI frameworks and reporting standards that give leadership visibility into category health, market opportunities, and emerging risks.

• Set repeatable analytical frameworks for evaluating category, product, and market opportunities, and ensure the team applies them consistently.

• Co-develop Promotion, Pricing strategy (price gaps vs. competition), New item prioritization to win across channels with sales and finance partners.

Qualifications:

Experience & Expertise

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred.

• 7+ years of experience in category management, consumer insights, market intelligence, analytics, or a related CPG function, with experience translating data into product, portfolio, and growth opportunities.

• Deep knowledge of syndicated market and consumption data, including SPINS, and the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

• Strong understanding of CPG category dynamics, consumer behavior, competitive landscapes, and omnichannel market trends.

• Experience identifying market whitespace, emerging consumer needs, and product or portfolio growth opportunities through data and insights.

• Experience analyzing performance across multiple channels and categories.

• Experience developing data-backed recommendations for cross-functional and senior leadership audiences.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to synthesize multiple data sources into clear insights, implications, and recommendations.

• Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect market signals to product, portfolio, and business opportunities.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Product, Innovation, Leadership, and external partners.

• Ability to think at both a long-term strategic level and a detailed, hands-on analytical level.

• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to make complex insights clear, relevant, and actionable.

• Comfortable working across multiple categories, channels, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to translate market opportunities into revenue assumptions, pricing considerations, margin implications, and directional investment cases.

• Ability to constructively challenge established assumptions and influence cross-functional decisions through evidence, sound judgment, and clear strategic recommendations.

BENEFITS

jobs.title: IP Paralegal
jobs.description:
Perplexity AI is looking for a highly organized and resourceful IP Paralegal to serve as the operational backbone of a fast-growing, full-stack intellectual property program, with a primary responsibility for patent and trademark prosecution and portfolio management, and additional support work across copyrights, trade secrets, and open source compliance.  This role reports to the Director of Intellectual Property and offers significant responsibility and direct exposure to novel questions at the intersection of artificial intelligence and IP law, as well as growth potential across other areas of an in-house practice group.

You will partner closely with outside counsel, engineering stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to run the workflows behind a growing patent and trademark portfolio, maintain copyright and trade secret practices, and support open source compliance review.  You will own day-to-day docketing and portfolio hygiene, manage outside counsel requests and billing against budget, and run intake and matter tracking so that nothing slips.  You will also run our patent rewards program end-to-end and be a go-to resource for IP diligence support and IP-adjacent needs, including commercial and litigation support as needed.  This role requires a genuine curiosity about using agentic AI systems to make the IP program run faster and more consistently, rather than treating AI tooling as an afterthought.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is detail-obsessed, comfortable moving across multiple IP disciplines in the same week, fluent with AI and legal-technology tooling, and energized by building repeatable systems from the ground up so that a lean team can run a large, technically complex portfolio.  If you are a curious person and your instinct when something breaks is to redesign the process, you will do well here.

Key Responsibilities

 - Manage end-to-end workflows across the patent and trademark portfolios, including docketing, deadline tracking, filing coordination, portfolio maintenance, and status reporting to internal stakeholders.

 - Support trade secret protection practices and open source compliance review, including tracking disclosure and license obligations and flagging issues for attorney review.

 - Administer copyright matters, including registration filings, recordation, and portfolio record keeping.

 - Own intake and triage for new invention disclosures, trademark clearance requests, and other IP matters.

 - Manage outside counsel relationships and billing, including matter budgets, accrual tracking, invoice review against outside counsel guidelines, rate negotiation support, and matter-management hygiene in billing systems.

 - Run the patent rewards program.

 - Prepare and file U.S. trademark applications and coordinate foreign filings through local counsel.

 - Run preliminary clearance searches for new products and features.

 - Coordinate trademark office action responses, review watch notices, and recommend enforcement actions.

 - Manage the domain name portfolio and the online brand protection and takedown programs.

 - Conduct IP portfolio analysis, including filing trend tracking, competitive landscape monitoring, and gap identification, to support portfolio strategy and prosecution priorities.

 - Provide support on IP-adjacent matters as needed, including commercial contract IP terms and litigation support (e.g., document gathering, chronologies, and coordination with outside counsel).

 - Maintain and improve internal file management systems, trackers, and dashboards, keeping matter data, deadlines, and portfolio status current and audit-ready.

 - Build and improve the systems behind the work, including intake workflows, filing playbooks, matter templates, and escalation paths, so that recurring problems are solved structurally rather than absorbed by heroics.

 - Use and help evolve agentic AI tools to support IP workflows such as docketing, disclosure intake, prior art gathering, and portfolio reporting, and bring ideas for where automation can meaningfully improve program efficiency.

Qualifications

Need to have:

 - A sense of humor and a team mindset

 - 10+ years of experience as an IP paralegal, with a mix of in-house and law firm experience

 - Demonstrated AI tool fluency and genuine curiosity about applying agentic AI systems to IP program operations

 - Hands-on experience supporting a mix of patent and trademark prosecution workflows, including docketing, filing coordination, and portfolio maintenance

 - Working knowledge of copyright administration and trade secret protection practices

 - Experience managing outside counsel relationships, including invoice review, budget tracking, and adherence to outside counsel guidelines

 - Experience managing a high volume of concurrent matters and deadlines with strong organizational skills and exacting attention to detail

 - Ability to multitask and effectively manage competing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to correspond directly with outside counsel, inventors, and internal stakeholders

 - Demonstrated discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential and privileged material

 - Genuine interest in IP diligence work and in stepping into IP-adjacent needs as they come up, including commercial and litigation support

Nice to have:

 - Paralegal certificate, associate's degree in paralegal studies, or bachelor's degree

 - Direct experience with open source license compliance review

 - Experience running or supporting an inventor recognition or patent rewards/incentive program

 - Experience supporting IP diligence for M&A, financing, or commercial transactions

 - Litigation support experience (e.g., discovery, document review, case file management)

 - Experience with IP portfolio analytics, competitive filing intelligence, or landscape mapping

 - Direct experience with docketing platforms, IP management software, and legal billing or matter management systems

 - Experience at a high-growth technology startup

 - Interest in artificial intelligence laws and regulations

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering, Fluid Systems
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Manufacturing Engineer, Fluid Systems, to help develop the systems behind our human-rated space stations. You'll use your engineering knowledge and creativity to design, build, and test novel solutions at the cutting edge of space technology.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

Responsibilities:

• Conceptualize, develop, and manufacture innovative tube-bending and welding cells to meet the demanding requirements of the Haven-1 program

• Lead first-build and test efforts, including design integration, assembly sequencing, mBOM development, work order creation, and specification authoring

• Create and maintain detailed manufacturing plans, assembly procedures, and work instructions to ensure consistent, accurate production of all tubing systems

• Identify and resolve manufacturing challenges through root-cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions

• Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to challenge assumptions, push boundaries, and drive efficient human-spaceflight production within aggressive timelines

• Collaborate closely with design engineers, integration engineers, production teams, and external vendors to execute builds expediently and efficiently

• Develop efficient, capability-driven tooling solutions that streamline production, increase system output, and reduce operational burden

• Partner with quality assurance teams to establish and maintain rigorous quality control processes

• Establish and maintain standard practices, troubleshooting guides, and standardized repair procedures; review and approve all related planning documents

• Support day-to-day production of bent tubes, orbital tube welding (OTW), and manually welded tubing, ensuring optimal efficiency and adherence to quality standards

• Evaluate and challenge existing production and design requirements for tubing assemblies, using data-driven insights to eliminate waste and optimize the manufacturing process

• Continuously streamline and improve production systems by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, reduce waste, and improve overall product quality

Minimum Qualifications:

• B.S. in mechanical, aerospace, manufacturing or electrical engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field

• 2 + years of manufacturing experience managing a product/product line across multiple work centers and/or departments, fluid, pressurized, propulsion, or environmental control hardware in design, manufacturing, or test

• 2-4+ years of experience for Manufacturing Engineer II

• 4-6+ years of experience for Senior Manufacturing Engineer

• Hands-on fabrication, assembly, and/or integration experience; CAD proficiency (NX preferred)

• Experience with CAD tools (e.g., Siemens NX) and the ability to review designs, generate manufacturing documentation, and design assembly or test tooling

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Hands-on experience building or testing hardware, in industry or through student teams such as Formula SAE, rocketry, CubeSat, or robotics

• Experience with aerospace, spacecraft, propulsion, or other safety-critical or high-reliability hardware

• Experience taking designs or processes from concept through build or test, and from R&D to production

• Familiarity with CAD tools, ideally Siemens NX, and PLM tools such as Teamcenter

• Exposure to thermal or structural analysis using Ansys, or similar tools

• Awareness of aerospace workmanship, design, and environmental test standards such as IPC, SMC-S-016, NASA-STD-5001, or MIL-STD-810

• Proficiency applying GD&T

• Strong problem-solving skills, including troubleshooting and structured root cause analysis

• Strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to work well in cross-functional teams

• Senior Level: experience mentoring engineers or technicians and managing multiple projects at once

Additional Requirements:

• Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones

Pay Ranges:

• Engineer/ Level I: $86,100.00 - $122,220.00

• Engineer/ Level II: $112,340.00 - $159,468.00

• Senior Engineer/ Level III: $137,760.00 - $195,552.00

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Facilities Electrical Technician
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

You will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing electrical systems and equipment in our industrial environment. This role requires a thorough understanding of industrial electrical systems (480v, to 120v), excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. This is a full-time, on-site position in Torrance, CA.

Responsibilities

• Install, maintain, and repair electrical systems, components, and equipment in industrial settings, including machinery, lighting, and power distribution systems

• Diagnose electrical issues using appropriate testing devices and interpret electrical schematics, diagrams, and blueprints

• Perform preventive maintenance on electrical systems to ensure efficient operation and prevent breakdowns

• Install and program PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers) and other control systems

• Troubleshoot and repair electrical equipment, including motors, transformers, and circuit breakers

• Ensure all electrical work complies with relevant codes, standards, and safety regulations.

• Collaborate with other maintenance personnel to resolve complex electrical and mechanical issues

• Maintain accurate records of work performed, including maintenance logs and service reports.

• Participate in training and development programs to stay updated on the latest technologies and industry best practices

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in facility electrician maintenance and coordination

• Experience with electrical, basic plumbing, and carpentry work

Nice to Have

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills

• Ability to work independently and collaborate in a team environment

• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs unassisted

• Exceptional communication skills and a customer-service-oriented approach

• Experience working in a fast-paced environment

• Proficiency with Microsoft Suite

Compensation and Benefits:

jobs.title: Senior Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASTION

Bastion provides the regulated infrastructure businesses need to hold, move, and issue stablecoins. Our platform combines custodial wallets, global payment orchestration, and stablecoin issuance. Customers can use each product independently or connect them into a single end-to-end flow.

We operate through our own regulated entities, with compliance and risk controls built directly into the platform. We can also support customers operating under their own licenses with the compliance and financial operations required to run their programs.


OVERVIEW

We’re hiring a Senior Director, Business Development to win and close strategic deals with large enterprises: Fortune 500 companies, global brands, and major platforms adopting stablecoin, payments, and treasury infrastructure. These deals are large, complex, and don’t fit a standard sales motion. You open the account, get to the executives who own the decision, navigate the buying committee, structure the commercial terms, and get it signed.

New enterprise buyers appear every quarter, from global brands exploring branded stablecoins to Fortune 500 teams rethinking cross-border payouts internally and for their end-consumers. You find them early and build executive relationships that last beyond a single deal.

You work with our CEO on executive relationships and strategic deals, with product, legal, and compliance on deal structure. This is inherrently a hands-on role with leadership opportunities. We will work with you on what the right long-term career path and ownership scope.

While we have a preference for this role to be based in New York City, we are open to the role being remote across the United States.


WORK TO BE DONE

Instead of a list of requirements, we want to give you a directional look into the first 30, 90, and 180 days on the job.

We are a startup, so the pace is fast and the specific work will change. People who thrive here are finding ways to contribute in their first week, and fully productive in their third month. You need to be okay with that.

If you think this is something you can handle, we will be excited to speak with you.


FIRST 30 DAYS: LEARN AND ORIGINATE FROM WEEK 1

 - Join live customer and prospect calls to learn where Bastion wins today

 - Support our CEO on live deals that will close in Q4

 - Build a target list of large enterprises, with a clear thesis for why each needs Bastion now

 - Activate your network and book first executive-level conversations with target accounts


BY 90 DAYS: OWN THE ENTERPRISE PIPELINE

 - Run complex enterprise deals end to end: map the buying committee and align finance, legal, compliance, product, and security stakeholders

 - Lead commercial structure, negotiation, and procurement for large programs

 - Test new enterprise segments and report what converts

 - Represent Bastion at events where new buyers show up

 - Outcomes
   
   - A measurable pipeline of originated enterprise opportunities
   
   - At least one Fortune 500-scale deal in late-stage negotiation


BY 180 DAYS: TURN NEW SEGMENTS INTO MOTIONS

 - Convert your strongest segment into a motion that scales

 - Write the enterprise playbook: target account logic, buying-committee map, messaging, use cases, early references

 - Shape product and commercial strategy with what you learn in market

 - Expand into the next geography or use case with the strongest demand

 - Outcomes
   
   - One segment handed off as a working sales motion
   
   - Large enterprise customers signed from originated opportunities


SOME CHALLENGES YOU MIGHT TACKLE

 - Long, multi-stakeholder cycles. Enterprise deals move through treasury, legal, compliance, procurement, and security review. You keep momentum across months and many stakeholders.

 - Prospects who haven’t started looking. Many future stablecoin buyers have no RFP. You build the thesis and find them first.

 - Blurry lanes. BD sits between sales and partnerships. You keep handoffs clean so customers see one Bastion.

 - Interesting versus valuable. You qualify hard and walk away from deals that don’t fit.

 - Custom structures. Large enterprises rarely accept standard pricing or terms. You structure deals that work for both sides.

 - A moving market. Regulation and competition shift fast, and a thesis that works in month one may not hold in month six.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, and placement. Bastion participates in E-Verify to authorize eligibility of employment in the United States.

jobs.title: Medical Receptionist/Phlebotomist
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a One Medical Medical Receptionist/Phlebotomist, internally known as Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist, at one of our offices, you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

• Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, bilingual applicants encouraged to apply

• A High School Diploma or equivalent

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)

• A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care

• A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

The range for this role is $19 to $21 per hour based on a standard full-time schedule. Total compensation packages may be based on factors unique to particular candidates, such as skill sets, depth of experience, and work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include benefits. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts generally taking place between 7am-7pm based in office in Miami, FL.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

Program Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
WestCoast Children’s Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. Working at WestCoast Children’s Clinic means being part of an organization that is client-centered, trauma-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity.

Position Details

Title: Outpatient Program Care Coordinator

Classification: Regular Full Time (1.0 FTE), Non-exempt (Hourly)

Location: Oakland, CA / Hybrid (availability to provide client services in-person and complete documentation remotely)

Regular Work Schedule: Full time, M-F

Compensation:

• $34.62 per hour (plus additional 10% Spanish language differential for qualified candidates)

The Program Care Coordinator connects clients who have completed their initial referral screening to an Outpatient Program care team. Utilizing a trauma-informed and strengths-based approach, this role ensures that clients and families have the space, resources, access, and advocacy needed to amplify their own voice and choice in pursuing the level of care they deserve.

The Program Care Coordinator facilitates initial scheduling, connecting clients to treatment teams, monitoring follow-up, and provides immediate case management to support waitlisted clients until team assignment. The position engages internal and external providers to champion team-based care practices across service phases. The ideal candidate brings flexibility, organization, initiative, creativity, and an inclusive approach, backed by deep knowledge of the unique challenges facing children and families, especially those involved in foster care.

Key Responsibilities:

• Track and manage youth referrals across electronic health records, spreadsheets, and Google Workspace.

• Provide short-term case management and care coordination for waitlisted youth, complete risk assessments and provide immediate crisis resources.

• Obtain clinical documentation (ROIs, past assessments) to inform care planning.

• Organize and facilitate program orientations for new referrals.

• Conduct proactive outreach to re-engage disengaged clients and connect them to care.

• Serve as a backup Child & Family Team (CFT) Meeting facilitator.

• Review CFT Care Plans to ensure state regulatory compliance.

• Complete compliant Medi-Cal documentation within 48 hours of service.

• Monitor client feedback to drive continuous program improvement.

• Cultivate and strengthen strategic community partnerships, and plan/execute monthly community gatherings for participants and staff.

• Uphold agency mission, ethical standards, and mandated reporting obligations while consistently participate in supervision, team meetings, and professional development.

Qualifications:

• Minimum educational requirements: Bachelor's degree with relevant experience. Candidates with an Associate of Arts Degree with long-term relevant experience may be considered.

• Experience facilitating events, team meetings and/or trainings.

• Ability to assess needs, strengths & provide crisis intervention and de-escalation,

• Passionate about working with young adults who have experienced complex trauma.

• Strong organizational, written & communication skills.

• Values working on a team, cultural humility, compassion, inclusivity, self-reflection, ongoing personal growth, self-care and social justice.

Competencies:

• Demonstrated experience working with transitional age youth (TAY) and families who may be involved in the child welfare system.

• Ability to work with clients who have complex traumatic histories and other attachment difficulties.

• Cultural Humility - Knowledge of issues of race, class and ethnicity.

• Efficiency and Time Management - Ability to be well-organized and complete timely documentation.

• Collaboration and Team Functioning - Ablility to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Why work here?

-Be part of a compassionate, driven team that is social justice-focused: We have Staff Affinity Groups such as Staff of Color, LGBTQ+, Equity and Inclusion, Health and Wellness, and more!

-Make a difference for the Bay Area’s most vulnerable populations: We serve hundreds of vulnerable kids and their families each year to create positive changes in their lives!

-Access a growth-oriented learning community: As a Joint Commission Accredited agency, we are dedicated to providing the highest standard of care, and offer extensive clinical trainings and seminars led by field experts.

Benefits:

• Employer-paid Medical Benefits for Employees 100% employer-paid dental and vision Dependent medical, dental and vision (50% employer-paid)

• Medical and Dependent Care FSA and commuter plans

• 100% employer-paid life insurance long-term disability insurance

• Voluntary accident, term life and hospital indemnity insurance

• 403(b) and ROTH retirement plan options, employer contribution targeted at 7.5% after first year of employment

• Quarterly (5-10%) and annual incentive compensation (10%)

• Three weeks PTO during the first year of employment, 4+ weeks PTO with additional years of service

• 12 paid holidays plus one paid floating holiday per year

• 4 paid self-care days per year

• Wellness stipend ($100.00 per month)

• Professional development stipend and CEUs for trainings

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Join us and make a difference in the lives of vulnerable children and families in the Bay Area.

WCC is passionate about leading and encouraging open conversations around race, gender, power, and privilege and how these impact community mental health. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diminishing the influence of privilege and discrimination in our field and our workplace, whether due to differences concerning age, citizenship, color, disability, marital or parental status, race, religion, gender, or sexual orientation.

jobs.description:
Axogen is committed to building and maintaining a strong and gratifying company culture that fosters professional growth. Our hands-on and personal approach makes transitioning to a new job a seamless and enjoyable process. Most benefits are effective on day one!

Axogen is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Why you’ll love working at Axogen:

• Friendly, open, and fun team culture that values unique perspectives

• Company-wide dedication to profoundly impacting patients’ lives

• Comprehensive, high-quality benefits package effective on date of hire

• Educational assistance available for all employees

• Matching 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid holidays, including floating holidays, to be used at your discretion

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Referral incentive program

Axogen Mission and Business Purpose

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life by making restoration of peripheral nerve function an expected standard of care. We aim to lead the markets we serve by always requiring the solutions we offer patients and caregivers provide an improved benefit-to-risk profile as compared to existing standards of care. To ensure we deliver improved benefit-to-risk solutions, we will guide and expect the market and design requirement specifications underlying our engineering, business development, and clinical research activities, objectively target advancements in standards of care.

Join Our Talent Community

At Axogen, we're always looking to connect with top-performing sales professionals who are passionate about improving patient outcomes. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a pipeline of talented Operating Room (OR) sales professionals for future Area Sales Manager opportunities throughout Massachusetts and Connecticut.

If you have a proven track record in medical device sales, thrive in the operating room environment, and are motivated by bringing innovative technologies to surgeons and patients, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

As an Area Sales Manager, you will manage and grow a defined territory by promoting, selling, and supporting Axogen's portfolio of nerve repair products. Working from your home office and in the field, you will partner with surgeons, operating room personnel, and healthcare stakeholders to drive adoption of innovative nerve repair solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

• Achieving and exceeding territory sales and market share objectives

• Identifying, developing, and growing new and existing customer accounts

• Building strong relationships with surgeons, clinical staff, and key decision-makers

• Supporting surgical cases and providing product expertise in the operating room

jobs.title: Key Account Leader, Mid Cities West
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the Team: Public safety is where drone technology faces the highest stakes. Agencies across the country are standing up Drone as First Responder (DFR) programs that put an aircraft over an emergency within seconds of a call. As drone programs move from the age of tools to the age of infrastructure, we are expanding our public safety sales team to meet that demand.

About the role: As a Key Account Leader, Mid-City at Skydio, you will own a territory of mid-sized public safety agencies with 41 to 100 sworn personnel. This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying role: you find the opportunities, run the deals, and close them. Your number is yours, and so is the territory plan behind it.

You will be the person an agency trusts with one of the most visible programs it will stand up this decade. That means understanding how the agency actually works, who has to say yes, and what it will take to get there, then running a process that gets the program funded, approved, and deployed. You will report to the Key Account Director, Mid-City, and work alongside Sales Engineering, Business Development, Channel, Marketing, Strategic Relationships, Government Relations, and Mission Success.

Most agencies in this segment need a council or commission to approve a program, so winning the chief is often only half the deal. You will help your champion build the case that gets through a public vote, and you will learn to read a council agenda as closely as a pipeline report.

We sell autonomous flying robots and the artificial intelligence that powers them. Every seller here uses AI tools as a normal part of running a territory: researching agencies, preparing for meetings, responding to RFPs, and analyzing pipeline. We expect you to as well.

This is a highly competitive market, and much of the work happens alongside our channel. You will sell against incumbent platforms and well-funded challengers, and win on the merits.

Location: Remote, Western U.S.

How we work

These are the standards we hire to, and they describe how the best people on this team already work.

 - High integrity. Public safety is a tight-knit community. Chiefs and Sheriffs talk to each other, and a reputation for straight answers travels fast. We sell what the ecosystem is actually capable of, we are clear about where the product is today and where it's headed, and we win on our own merits. There's no compromise here.

 - Sales is a team sport. One team. No lone wolves. Deals are won by account leaders, sales engineering, business development, channel, marketing, strategic relationships, government relations, and mission success pulling in the same direction, and our partners are part of that team, not a channel to be managed around. The best people here care more about the collective number than their own slice of it.

 - Great conversationalists. This is the craft of the job: asking better questions than anyone else in the room, listening for what a chief or sheriff isn't saying, real curiosity about how an agency operates. Not polish, not a rehearsed pitch. Trust in this market is built one honest conversation at a time, and it is the thing competitors cannot copy.

 - Curious, and fluent with the tools. Everyone on this team uses AI as a normal part of their work: researching agencies, preparing for meetings, analyzing pipeline, drafting and then editing. That takes taste more than technical skill: knowing what a quality result looks like, describing a problem precisely enough to get it, and catching the tool when it is confidently wrong. The same muscle makes a great seller. Discovery is specifying the problem; qualification is checking the output. We hire people who are curious about how things work, whether that's an agency's budget, a council's politics, or the aircraft's autonomy, and who have spent the last two years embracing AI rather than waiting to be told to use it.

How you'll make an impact

Build pipeline

 - Own your territory plan: know the agencies in it, which are likely to move this year, and why

 - Generate your own pipeline through outbound, events, and partners rather than waiting on inbound demand

 - Get in early and shape the criteria the agency will use to make its decision

Win

 - Run full-cycle deals from first conversation to award: discovery, demonstration, proof of value, proposal, procurement, and approval

 - Qualify with MEDDPICC rigor, and walk away from deals that are not real

 - Build consensus across the people who have to say yes: the chief or sheriff, the city or county manager, finance, procurement, and the council or commission

 - Sell against incumbents and challengers: frame Skydio's unique differentiators, run displacement plays, and defend accounts under attack

 - Equip your champion to take a program through council or commission approval: the budget case, the community case, and the timing

Partner

 - Sell with and through channel partners, and structure deals that get customers to yes

 - Bring in Sales Engineering, Business Development, Government Relations, and Mission Success at the right moment, and keep them pointed at the same outcome

 - Hand off cleanly to Mission Success after award and stay close enough to the account to grow it

Run your territory

 - Forecast honestly and keep your pipeline clean enough that your Director can trust it

 - Use AI tools daily for agency research, call prep, RFP response, and pipeline analysis, and never let anything AI-drafted reach a customer unreviewed

 - Bring what you hear in the field back to the team: competitive intelligence, product gaps, and what is changing in how agencies buy

What makes you a good fit

Required

 - 3+ years carrying an individual quota in enterprise software, hardware, or SaaS sales, with attainment you can state year by year, including the year you missed and what you changed

 - Personal success running full-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals from first conversation to signed contract

 - A record of building your own pipeline, and a clear view of how much of your closed business you sourced

 - Disciplined qualification and a forecast your manager could trust

 - Fluency selling with and through channel partners

 - Daily, systematic use of AI tools in your own work, and at least one workflow, analysis, or tool you built or changed in the last two years that made you measurably better (we will ask you to show it, not describe it)

 - Presence with agency leadership and high personal integrity under quota pressure

 - Ability to travel at least 50% of the time, and based in Western U.S.

Preferred

 - Experience in public safety, specifically law enforcement, fire, or emergency management

 - Experience selling into SLED customers, including getting a program approved by a council or commission

 - You have built something with AI that other people use, whether a research tool, an analysis, or a workflow, and you can talk about what the first version got wrong

 - Curiosity that shows: you can explain how something outside sales works (an agency budget, an airspace waiver, the aircraft's autonomy) in plain language, and you learn fast

 - Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Salesforce, Clari, BGov, GovWin, Slack, and Google Workspace

 - UAV, robotics, or emerging technology background, and comfort in a fast-moving environment

What to expect from our process

We run a structured process and we tell you what it is. A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager. A deep dive on your selling record: attainment year by year, how you built pipeline, and the mechanics of deals you won and lost. A working session where you use your own AI tools on a realistic problem from this territory and walk us through your choices. A panel where you run a discovery conversation and walk us through how you would win a deal in this segment. A conversation about how you think. References with people who managed you and worked alongside you. Every interviewer scores independently against the same rubric before we compare notes.

On AI in the process: draft your resume yourself and refine it with AI if you like; we want your real experience, well expressed. Use whatever tools you want to prepare. Expect to use them in the working session. Leave them off during the conversational interviews so we can see how you think in real time. We use AI to draft job descriptions like this one and to take notes, and a human makes every hiring decision.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $140,000 + Commission*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.
