jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (Agentic Automation)
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

We're seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our team to help advance our Agentic Automation vision. You'll drive product direction across how coding agents build and operate automations on UiPath, how UiPath's own coding agents and Autopilots are extended, and how non-deterministic agents (conversational, autonomous, computer use) take on tasks inside complex business processes — including the emerging patterns the industry is still inventing: skills and tool surfaces for external coding agents like Claude Code, agent-to-agent handoffs, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, composing deterministic workflows with non-deterministic reasoning, evals and observability for agent behavior, and more.

This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You will not be running status meetings. You will be deep in the product: testing, prototyping with coding agents, talking to customers and FDEs, and turning what you learn into crisp direction for the engineers building it. Influence, not headcount, will be your default leverage.

Your north star will be builders shipping automations faster with agents reliably carrying real work in production: capable enough for the most ambitious processes, and dependable enough that enterprises trust them with non-deterministic tasks.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Own the multi-year vision for how agents (UiPath's and third-party) build and operate automations across the platform.

 - Extend UiPath to work with external coding agents: design the skills, tools, and APIs that let agents like Claude Code author, run, and debug automations against the platform.

 - Help evolve UiPath's own coding agents (AutoPilots): what they can build, how they reason about a process, and how they hand off to humans and to other agents.

 - Define how non-deterministic agents (conversational, autonomous, computer use) slot into complex business processes alongside deterministic workflows, with clear contracts for when each is used.

 - Partner with the largest and most demanding customers on production deployments. Go deep enough to know which specific step failed and what would fix it.

 - Use the platform as a builder. Stand up agents, wire them into real processes, use coding agents aggressively to prototype and ship reference implementations. If you need a working example to make a point, build one.

 - Translate the fast-moving agent landscape (tool/skill ecosystems, orchestration frameworks, evals, computer-use models) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.

 - Define the metrics that matter (e.g. task success rate, time-to-build automation, human interventions per run, agent reliability in production) and prioritize ruthlessly.

 - Represent UiPath's agentic automation story externally with customers, partners, and industry forums.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 8+ years in technical PM or eng roles with specific emphasis on automation, workflow/orchestration platforms, developer platforms, or applied agentic AI. Proven track record of shipping infrastructure that builders rely on.

 - Prior experience building business process orchestration, workflow engines, or agent platforms. You've designed the systems that coordinate work across steps, services, and actors.

 - Deep fluency in agentic AI: tool-calling, MCP, coding agents, agent design patterns, computer use, evals and observability. You can read an agent trace and immediately see what's wrong with it.

 - A clear view on how deterministic automation and non-deterministic agents should compose, and where each belongs in a real business process.

 - Builder posture, AI-native. You write code (or prompt agents to) to test ideas and ship prototypes. You treat coding agents as leverage. You do not simply write specs or decks and wait.

 - First-principles thinker, comfortable in ambiguity. Can produce a defensible direction in days, not quarters.

 - Sharp communicator: a position doc that inspires bold decisions, a technical explanation a skeptical architect trusts, a demo that closes the room.

 - Comfortable with regulated, on-prem, and hybrid environments.

Ideal Background

 - Built automation, orchestration, developer-platform, or agent products at a frontier lab, hyperscaler, RPA/automation vendor, or as an early PM at a startup in the space.

 - Has gone 0 → 1 and felt the weight of it. Startup or founding PM style experience strongly preferred.

 - Has opinions about where agentic automation is going in the next 24 months, with receipts

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. jobs.title: Maintenance Manager
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline’s US Operations depend on aircraft and systems that are safe, compliant, and ready to perform. As Maintenance Manager, you will own daily maintenance execution for local fleets and systems, turning inspections, repairs, and aircraft intake into reliable operational availability.

You will lead supervisors and technicians and while staying hands-on in the maintenance environment. You will make airworthiness decisions within approved maintenance procedures, escalate engineering or compliance questions through the appropriate channels, and build the shop-floor and operational discipline that supports dependable growth.

What You'll Do

• Lead daily maintenance execution and approved airworthiness determinations for local systems and fleet assets.

• Own workflow from asset receiving and conformity checks through inspection, repair, documentation, and return-to-service coordination.

• Set maintenance schedules, shift coverage, backlog priorities, and work-in-progress to meet operational readiness goals.

• Conduct maintenance planning to support continued airworthiness and fleet health programs.

• Coach technicians and supervisors to high performance levels through training, clear expectations, direct feedback, and performance accountability.

• Track and improve asset downtime, uptime, turnaround, first-time-fix quality, backlog closure, and technician productivity.

• Enforce maintenance SOPs, safety protocols, qualification practices, and audit-ready recordkeeping.

• Partner with engineering and compliance to root-cause recurring issues, resolve escalations, and improve maintenance processes.

• Monitor performance KPIs and ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance operations.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of hands-on maintenance, fleet management, service-operations, or technical leadership experience in automotive, autonomy, aviation, or a related field.

• Experience leading daily execution in a safety-sensitive or regulated maintenance environment.

• Demonstrated ability to manage inspections, repairs, maintenance backlogs, and return-to-service workflows.

• Ability to earn and maintain Zipline Repairman certification for authorized safety-sensitive maintenance functions.

• Sound judgment applying approved procedures, identifying nonconformances, and escalating engineering or compliance questions.

• A record of improving system availability, turnaround, quality, or technician productivity through disciplined operating practices.

• Ability to work onsite in *metro* and flex with shift operations as site needs change.

What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $110,000 -$130,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Constellation Schools is seeking highly qualified Instructional Paraprofessional in Cleveland, Ohio for the 2026-2027 School Year.

• Work with student(s) and teacher(s) on academic requirements and grade appropriate work.

• Able and willing to accept assignments relative to student safety which may include restraining a student.

jobs.title: Care Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABBY CARE: POWERING THE FUTURE OF CARE AT HOME FOR ALL OF AMERICA.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.




THE OPPORTUNITY:

Abby Care is at an exciting inflection point -  since 2022 we have grown to support family caregivers in 8 markets nationally, and we're thrilled to launch Abby Care in the greater Phoenix market, and as a result, build our founding team. Critical to our success is hiring for a founding Care Partnerships Manager to help us grow our presence and deliver on our mission - helping families find Abby Care.

As our Care Partnerships Manager, you'll own key relationships from case management leaders and supervisors at our health plan partner, to individual case managers. Your role is to make referring to Abby Care the simple and obvious choice, ensuring a case manager never has to chase us for an update. Initially, you'll also support provider relationships ensuring they are educated on Abby Care and updated on our mutual patients.

A true builder, you’re energized by being part of a founding team, you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves - building playbooks and optimizing processes is in your DNA. Highly consultative, you find energy in building and fostering relationships; honesty and follow through are your calling card. You sweat the details, are highly organized, and understand the complexities of the home care landscape. If you’re excited to be part of a small but mighty team that is on a mission to change family caregiving from a fundamentally human centered and tech enabled capacity, we’d love to hear from you!

This is a Full-Time hybrid opportunity based in the Phoenix area, with regular travel to build relationships across the market.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Refine Our Playbook: We have an idea of what works but need you to help pressure test those assumptions and rebuild what could be done differently.

 - Build & Own Relationships: Serve as the primary liaison for our health plan partner's case management team, acting as the trusted main point of contact for their leaders, supervisors, and individual case managers.

 - Start With Leaders: Map the case management organization, find a champion on each team, and plan how and when we reach their teams. We show up, build the materials and answer questions.

 - Promote through Education: Teach who fits our program, how to refer in minutes, and what happens next. Run team sessions and a launch roadshow of in-person events. Lead with listening, never with a pitch.

 - Keep Case Managers in the Loop: Acknowledge every referral the same business day, send updates on every family, and get the care plan to the payor case manager when it is done. Be proactive so case managers don’t have to ask for an update.

 - Own Authorizations: Request, track, and chase authorizations from submission through approval and renewal. Removing barriers is key.

 - Support Providers: Early in the launch, help support PCP office relationships: records, status updates, and stalled requests.

 - Track Everything: Log every interaction, referral, and authorization in our CRM, and use it to see where a relationship needs attention. You develop the plan and reprioritize as you see fit.


WHAT YOU’LL HAVE:

 - 5+ years of relationship, care coordination, provider or payor relations, or business development experience, ideally with a health plan, a case management team, or home- and community-based care.

 - A feel for how case managers think and what they need to place a family with confidence. Familiarity with the Arizona Medicaid landscape is a big plus.

 - A consultative edge. You'll become the go-to person case managers call first, not just another vendor in their inbox.

 - Great written and verbal communication. You're comfortable being the face of Abby Care to people more senior than you.

 - Organized to a fault. You love a tracker and hate dropping a ball.

 - A founding mindset: you have built a relationship, a program, or a process from zero, and you liked it.




OUR VALUES

 1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

 2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

 3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

 4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

 5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.



Equal Opportunity Employer

Abby Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, contact talent@abbycare.org.



Abby Care considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment and conducts background checks consistent with applicable law, including the California, Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Philadelphia, and New York City Fair Chance laws. We are an E-Verify participating company.



Automated Decision Tools

Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact talent@abbycare.org.

jobs.title: Senior Welder - B Shift
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

SENIOR WELDER

Based out of Rocket Lab Headquarters in Long Beach, California the Senior Welder will weld and fabricate various fluid systems and sub-assembly components for the Rutherford and Archimedes Rocket engines.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Follow procedures to set up and operate our welding systems.

• Weld assemblies according to work orders, blueprints and verbal instructions.

• Follow blueprints and meet product specifications within tight tolerances.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A SENIOR WELDER:

• 8+ years of experience in welding with a focus on advanced techniques.

• Experience in industries such as Aerospace, Automotive, Shipbuilding, or Construction.

• Familiarity with industry standards and codes (e.g., ASME, ANSI, ISO, D17.1).

• Proficient in various welding techniques, including manual GTAW(TIG), OTW (Orbital Tube Welding), Laser Welding, Lathe Welding.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and welding symbols.

• Experience welding on .011 - .250.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Experience with welding on different materials such as Inconel, Monel, Stainless 300-400 series.

• Experience working with 3D printed parts and exotic alloys.

• Experience in metal fabrication and assembly.

• Experience with Deburring and using pencil grinders.

• Capable of doing welding fit ups.

• Capable of supporting the grinding department.

CERTIFICATIONS

• Certified Welder.

• Certifications in specialized welding processes (TIG / Brazing process).

• Certification for specific materials (e.g., Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Titanium, and Inconel).

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willing to work Monday - Thursday (3:30pm - 1:45am)

• Ability to travel and communicate outside of work hours

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed

• Repetitive assembly operations, grasping, standing, lifting, bending, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position.

• Must be able to move repetitively, bend or twist, and use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools or controls.

• Must be able to walk or stand for extended periods – 8 hours min

• Must be able to lift up to 25lbs. unassisted.

#RL1

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

Hourly Pay Range (CA Only)

$35—$50 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Resident Onboarding
jobs.description:
At Second Nature, our people are our greatest differentiator. To build an industry-changing business, we don’t just need talent; we need an environment where high standards, continuous improvement, and customer obsession are the default.

Excellence is not a destination — it is how we show up every day. In twenty years time, we want every single employee to look back to their time at Second Nature and say: This is where I did my very best work. Where I grew the most. Where I pushed myself beyond what was comfortable. ✨





💟 ABOUT US

Everything else in life has gotten convenient. You can get a ride, buy anything, or answer any question in a few taps. Renting hasn't caught up. Setting up utilities, buying renters insurance, changing air filters, scheduling pest control: all still a chore.



Second Nature built the world's first Resident Experience Platform to fix that, making resident onboarding, resident services, and ancillary revenue effortless for property managers. Join 200+ people turning that friction into wins for residents, property managers, and investors, creating the ultimate Triple Win! 🔥🔥🔥



📝 ABOUT THE ROLE
RESIDENT ONBOARDING IS WHERE EVERY RESIDENT RELATIONSHIP WITH SECOND NATURE BEGINS, AND THE ONRAMP TO OUR MARKET-LEADING RESIDENT BENEFITS PACKAGE. FEW PARTS OF THE COMPANY HAVE A MORE DIRECT EFFECT ON REVENUE.



This role owns Resident Onboarding Lift, the onboarding product we built jointly with AppFolio and deliver exclusively to AppFolio property managers. Our partnership with AppFolio is one of the most important relationships at Second Nature, and converting partnership bookings into enrolled, revenue-generating clients is one of our top company priorities. You will own the product side of that work.


Our AppFolio joint product is the whole job here, not one segment of it. You will come to know their platform, their roadmap, and their property managers as well as you know our own, and you will spend as much time with mutual AppFolio-Second Nature customers as you do with our engineering team. You will drive our joint roadmap in partnership with your peers at Appfolio, as well as Appfolio and Second Nature senior leadership.


This is an individual contributor role with real ownership. You will not have direct reports. Your influence comes from the quality of your thinking, the trust you build with engineering, go-to-market and the Appfolio team, and your willingness to be the most credible advocate for Resident Onboarding in every room, including the ones where you are the only product person present.




THINGS YOU'LL OWN

 - The outcome. Own the Resident Onboarding Lift roadmap and the numbers it moves: AppFolio door enablement, enrollment rate, and resident adoption. You set the targets, you report progress to leadership, and you own the result.

 - AppFolio fluency. Become the person at Second Nature who best understands how resident onboarding actually works inside AppFolio: lease templates, signing order, counter-signing, how their property managers really run a move-in. Contribute to the joint roadmap with AppFolio's product team so that what we build fits the way their customers operate. You will also own, drive, and execute weekly AppFolio joint partner calls and deliver on timebound commitments.

 - Execution. Write requirements that are clear, complete, and fast to build against. Align engineering, marketing, and support so launches land with customers instead of just shipping.

 - The craft. You won't manage anyone, but you will set the standard. Model the discovery-through-iteration practices the rest of the product org learns from.



Key Outcomes for the first 12 Months

 - Own and execute the product roadmap: Develop and maintain a prioritized Resident Onboarding Lift roadmap aligned with Second Nature’s strategic goals, customer needs, and business objectives, with clear milestones and measurable product outcomes.

 - Influence AppFolio’s product strategy: Build a strong working partnership with AppFolio’s product and leadership teams to align roadmaps, influence platform capabilities, and drive decisions that improve the joint product experience.

 - Deliver high-quality product execution: Translate customer insights and business priorities into clear requirements, technical tradeoffs, and actionable product plans, enabling engineering to deliver predictable and efficient solutions.

 - Drive continuous product improvement: Establish a disciplined discovery, experimentation, and iteration process using customer feedback, product analytics, and performance insights to identify friction, validate opportunities, and improve Resident Onboarding Lift over time.

 - Deliver measurable product & partnership impact: Establish and execute a joint roadmap with AppFolio that improves onboarding performance, addresses customer pain points, and delivers measurable gains in activation, enrollment, and resident experience.





WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years in product management, including time owning a product line or platform end to end. You can speak to business results, not just to features shipped.

 - A record of turning strategy into a sequenced roadmap and winning the investment to build it.

 - Experience building products that depend on a partner's platform, where your roadmap and theirs have to fit together.

 - Demonstrated experience influencing a major partner’s strategy and roadmaps.

 - Influence that works in both directions: internally with leadership, externally with partners and customers. You have the confidence to stand your ground in debates with senior executives, and the savvy to know when to push and when to hold your punches.

 - Technical fluency deep enough to earn engineering's trust and make real architecture tradeoffs.

 - Curiosity and passion for your market and product. You wake up in the morning wondering how the products your team has launched are doing, and obsessively drive to "why" things are (or aren't) working.

 - Bonus: Direct experience with AppFolio, as a user, a builder, or an integration partner. Proptech or SaaS experience. Complex B2B2C products.

Not everyone meets 100% of the qualifications. If you believe you can own this product and scale it aggressively, apply.




OUR CORE VALUES

🏴‍☠️ Pirate Ship; not a cruise ship. Bias towards action.

💪 Massive Growth takes massive growth. We embrace challenges to increase our impact.

🥧 Grow the Pie. We focus on results so our customers & their customers win. Triple Win!

💜 Purple Heart. We put the team before ourselves.

🤝 Extreme Ownership. See something? Say something; right the ship to get us on course.

🙌 Be a moment maker. We aim to shatter the status quo.





REMOTE WORK

This is a remote-first, work-from-home position. To be successful in a remote role at Second Nature, you must:

 - Be available during your scheduled working hours and give your full attention to your Second Nature work. Note: Second Nature generally works East Coast hours, with some flexibility.

 - Have a quiet, professional, distraction-free environment in which to work

 - Have access to your own reliable high-speed internet connection

 - Attend our bi-annual in-person company meetings (Second Nature reimburses business travel per company guidelines)
   


WHY SECOND NATURE?

🩺 Health First: Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life Insurance; 401K Plan

📍 Location: Work Remotely from anywhere in the US

📆 Flexibility: Open PTO and sick days

🤩 Culture: Diverse, inclusive, supportive, and growth-focused

🚀 Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team building a new category and making a real difference

💻 The Product: Award-winning, customer-loved platform that truly delivers on our mission

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Workforce Operations
jobs.description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions. If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

Role Purpose

You will shape how venue teams prepare and work together to deliver workforce operations for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games. Reporting to the Head of Workforce Operations, you will connect workforce service levels, training and readiness with venue operating plans. The role combines planning with operational delivery at a standalone venue or Sports Park, including test events and Games-time deployment. You will help functional teams resolve issues together, maintain service continuity and prepare paid staff and volunteers for their assignments, bringing co-creation, integrity and practical judgment to evolving operational needs.

Key Responsibilities

·       Manage workforce Food and Beverage and Accommodation service levels, aligning operational needs with venue operating plans.

·       Lead workforce venue strategy, planning and operational delivery for a standalone venue or Sports Park, supporting test events.

·       Manage workforce training for volunteers and paid staff, coordinating onboarding, uniforms, accreditation and role assignment readiness milestones.

·       Partner with Event Venue Management, Transport, Food and Beverage, Uniforms and Volunteer Management to coordinate workforce requirements.

·       Oversee Games-time coverage and shift fulfillment, resolving venue escalations with Functional Area leads and central workforce planning.

Required Competencies

·       7+ years experience in workforce operations, operations, event operations or live event management, supporting planning and operational delivery.

·       Ability to align workforce service levels with venue operating plans and coordinate requirements across interdependent operational functions.

·       Ability to manage volunteer and paid-staff training, linking preparation to onboarding, uniforms, accreditation and role assignment milestones.

·       Ability to resolve workforce service escalations with Functional Area leads and central planning teams while maintaining operational continuity.

·       Capacity to lead on-the-ground workforce operations, manage shift coverage and translate readiness priorities into coordinated venue delivery.

Valued Experience

·       Olympic Experience supporting workforce preparation or event operations.

·       Experience coordinating Food and Beverage and Accommodation services.

·       Experience supporting operational planning and delivery of test events.

·       Experience coordinating workforce readiness across several operational teams.

·       Experience resolving venue workforce issues during live event delivery.

What We Offer

·       Contribute to workforce operations that support the Olympic and Paralympic Games in Los Angeles.

·       Work alongside teammates across venue services, operational planning and workforce delivery functions.

·       Develop transferable experience connecting workforce preparation, test events and operational delivery.

·       Take pride in shared outcomes that help paid staff and volunteers contribute effectively.

What This Role Means for the Games

Prepared workforce teams help venues maintain coverage and service continuity throughout the Games. Your work connects the practical needs of paid staff and volunteers with operational plans, helping teammates deliver their assignments and resolve issues together across the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

·       Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office.

jobs.title: Head of Security & IT
jobs.description:
THE 4 BIGGEST BLOCKCHAIN STRENGTHS ARE ALSO ITS WEAKNESS

 - Permissionless nature leads to fragmentation of meaning

 - Decentralization leads to too many standards https://xkcd.com/927/

 - Immutability leads to exponential data + query infrastructure complexity

 - Neutrality means that no one is accountable for interpretations

Blockchain data is public. It is not usable at institutional scale. Despite being open, blockchain data is fragmented, hard to interpret, and painful to maintain. Even a simple question like “Who are the largest Ethereum token holders over time?” can require running nodes, ingesting full chain history, decoding contracts, cleaning edge cases, and writing complex SQL.




BLOCKCHAINS ARE OPTIMIZED FOR WRITES, NOT READS. 

They are built for consensus and execution, not searchability, standardization, or financial interpretation. Blockchains are computers, not databases https://x.com/Tim_Roughgarden/status/1512847113599729668. Every protocol defines its own schema. The same economic action can be encoded in dozens of different ways. The result:

 - Fragmented standards

 - Exponential complexity

 - No accountability for interpretation

 - Events without economic meaning

Finance cannot operate on that, it needs an effective system of record.




ALLIUM IS BUILDING THE SYSTEM OF RECORD FOR ONCHAIN FINANCE

Allium ingests, verifies, and standardizes data across 140+ blockchains and 30+ petabytes of history. We close four structural gaps that prevent blockchains from becoming systems of record:

 - Semantic Gap: Translating raw events into financial concepts like payments, trades, deposits, and staking income

 - Standardization Gap: Mapping thousands of protocols into a single canonical cross chain schema

 - Infrastructure Gap: Read optimized, globally distributed data at web scale

 - Accountability Gap: Auditable methodology, SLAs, and SOC 1 and 2 compliance

The result is a neutral, canonical data layer institutions can build on with confidence.




FINANCE IS MOVING ONCHAIN

Stablecoins, tokenized assets, trading, staking, and lending are growing rapidly. Institutions need a trusted source of truth for onchain financial activity, just as they rely on Bloomberg or DTCC in traditional markets. Raw blockchains cannot serve that role.

As AI agents begin transacting autonomously https://x.com/AlliumLabs/status/2019810793324482901?s=20, the requirement becomes even stricter. Agents cannot reason over raw event logs. They need structured data, attribution, condition checks, and auditability. 

Allium is the read layer that makes onchain finance usable for humans and machines.




WHO WE SERVE

Allium powers three core personas with the same canonical data foundation:

1. Finance, Accounting, and Risk Teams They need reliable, audit grade answers. They rely on Allium for financial reporting, reconciliation, compliance, risk monitoring, and defensible metrics that can stand up to auditors and regulators.

2. Engineers and Product Teams They need low latency, production ready infrastructure. They use Allium to power wallets, trading systems, payment rails, staking infrastructure, and real time applications that cannot break.

3. Strategy, Research, and Executive Teams They need clarity and insight. They use Allium to understand ecosystem economics, market structure, user behavior, competitive dynamics, and where capital is flowing onchain.

And of course...agents 🦞. Our customers and users include Visa, Stripe, G-SIB Banks, Big 4 Accounting firms, BCG, Coinbase, Phantom, Uniswap and cited by the Federal Reserve. 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a hands-on security leader to own Allium's security program and employee IT environment. You'll set priorities, implement controls, and partner with Engineering and business teams to protect the systems and data our company depends on.

AI is changing how software is built and how attackers operate https://www.wiz.io/blog/anatomy-of-ai-driven-cloud-attacks. We want someone who can help Allium use agents and automation safely while building effective defenses against credential theft, compromised dependencies, and fast-moving attacks. You'll combine technical execution with ownership of a growing function, working directly on problems while shaping the team, tools, and specialist support we need.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the security roadmap. Assess our environment, prioritize material risks, and turn priorities into implemented controls with clear owners. Give leadership a concise view of progress, unresolved exposure, and decisions that require their judgment.

 - Set the security approach for AI agents. Establish practical standards for agent identities, tool permissions, credential handling, execution isolation, data access, and logging. Partner with Engineering to evaluate coding assistants, model gateways, and integrations, and test for prompt injection, tool misuse, and unintended actions.

 - Own employee IT and workforce security. Own the coverage and effectiveness of controls across employee devices, identities, cloud environments, and critical SaaS applications. Track exceptions, assign remediation owners, and build reliable onboarding and offboarding processes. Define how routine IT support is delivered through internal resources or providers.

 - Strengthen cloud and software security. Reduce standing privilege and strengthen separation between employee devices, development environments, and production. Establish practical standards for credential storage and privileged access. Partner with Engineering on secure development, CI/CD, and software supply-chain controls.

 - Lead detection, response, and recovery. Build a coordinated program across cloud, identity, development, employee systems, and agent activity. Define responsibilities for internal teams and providers, maintain escalation paths, and test containment, credential-revocation, and recovery procedures with system owners.

 - Build a fast, evidence-based vulnerability response. Maintain visibility into internet-facing services, including developer tools and management interfaces. Track relevant threats and active exploitation, determine whether we are exposed, and coordinate patching, isolation, credential revocation, or other mitigations. Prioritize based on evidence and business impact.

 - Support enterprise trust. Coordinate audits, customer security reviews, vendor assessments, and technical evidence. Work with Legal and commercial teams so security commitments reflect actual controls and have clear owners.

 - Build the function. Select and manage security and IT tools and providers, automate recurring work, and help hire and develop the team as needs grow. Use AI to improve the team's work with appropriate data safeguards and validation.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Typically 6+ years of relevant security engineering, infrastructure security, or corporate security experience, with evidence of independently owning meaningful security improvements.

 - Recent hands-on experience implementing controls in cloud-based environments. You can investigate a technical issue yourself and work effectively with the engineers who own production systems.

 - Depth across several relevant areas, including identity, cloud or application security, detection and response, endpoint security, or software supply-chain security. You know when specialist support is needed.

 - Experience building or improving a security program at a growing technology company, including making tradeoffs with limited time and resources.

 - Practical judgment about AI-enabled tools: where they can help, how their access should be controlled, and how to validate their behavior and output.

 - Clear communication with engineers, business leaders, customers, and providers. You can explain a risk, recommend a proportionate response, and follow through.


EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE HELPFUL

 - Enterprise SaaS, data infrastructure, fintech, or another business serving customers with rigorous security requirements.

 - Securing AI agents, developer tooling, CI/CD, or systems that use non-human identities and third-party integrations.

 - SOC 2, customer assurance, vendor security reviews, or managing external security and IT providers.


DON'T TAKE OUR WORD FOR IT, WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS SAY ABOUT US (HTTPS://WWW.ALLIUM.SO/BLOG#LOVE) https://www.allium.so/blog#love

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/2f62de56-0dd0-4792-90f8-069c5cb51068/585a3023-4036-4ec0-af76-ed3198f80890/image.png]




WHAT SOME COOL PEOPLE HAVE TO SAY ABOUT US:

 - The Information's Top 50 Startups (https://www.allium.so/post/allium-named-to-the-informations-50-most-promising-startups-of-2025) 

 - Mario Gabriele from The Generalist's Future 50 Startup List: https://www.allium.so/post/allium-named-awardee-of-the-generalists-inaugural-future-50-startups

 - Tomasz Tungus from Theory Ventures: https://tomtunguz.com/allium/

 - Bucky Moore from Kleiner Perkins: https://www.kleinerperkins.com/perspectives/allium-series-a/




OK, NOW FOR SOME TOUGH LOVE. HERE ARE THE VALUES WE STRIVE FOR AT ALLIUM:

 - Obsessiveness - The best people at Allium cannot put a problem down once they pick it up. We care more about the work than is strictly rational. Institutions trust us because our data is right. Right means caring about the small things. The decoded contract that ships with one wrong field. The label that is 99% accurate but wrong on the address that matters. The query that runs in 4 seconds when it should run in 400 milliseconds. Most companies tolerate these. We do not.
   
   Obsessiveness shows up as depth of care. It is not measured in hours worked or visible effort. You should feel something physical when work ships half-right. That instinct is what we hire for.

 - Pro Athlete Mindset - Consistency. Day in and day out, in pursuit of excellence. A win yesterday does not guarantee (or even imply!) a win tomorrow. I hope anyone who supports a failing sports team will feel the pain (cough Man United fans) of inconsistency

 - Figure It Out & Extreme Ownership - Every day is unexplored territory. There are new engineering frameworks, new legal docs, new compliance, new sales, new regulations, and new operational procedures every single day. If you don’t know it, learn it. If you can’t learn it, find someone or a product that does it. If you can’t find someone, find someone who can find someone. It is never a lack of resources, but lack of resourcefulness.

 - High Agency - (One of) the highest commonalities between all successful people is their responsiveness. Most successful billionaire CEOs still reply to emails within minutes (within working hours). And when you reply, respond fast with effective solutions - and even better, resolutions. If you’re looking for a superpower, you can’t go wrong with responsiveness. Well of course this doesn't make sense when you're an engineer coding in flow, but in general high agency of problem solving gets one very far in life

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Public Relations & Communications
jobs.description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.



We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.



By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.



Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.



The Role

This role turns Neara’s technology, customer and societal impact, and proprietary perspective into stories that make Neara matter to customers, policymakers, partners, investors, prospective talent, and everyone who depends on critical infrastructure. You will own US communications soup-to-nuts, personally brainstorming and riffing on the angle, writing the story, sharpening the thesis, pitching reporters, prepping the spokesperson, and landing the story.



Please note this is emphatically not an agency management role. We are seeking a formidable, hands-on operator who loves creating storytelling momentum from end to end. There may be select circumstances where you use agencies or freelancers to broaden your reach but you will own the ideas, output, and relationships that drive impact in this role.



About You

 - You do not wait for cookie-cutter “news” or announcements to fall into your lap. You proactively and creatively build momentum to drive a consistent storytelling drumbeat, seeking and developing stories on your own and via cross-functional partnerships.

 - You understand the difference between visibility and authority and what it takes to build strong spokesperson profiles vs. generic thought leadership.

 - You are equally comfortable ripping apart and rewiring a weak argument, personally pitching reporters and advising senior spokespeople.

 - You’re motivated by emerging technology categories and know how to establish relevance.

 - You wouldn’t dream of “spraying and praying” and you have a proven approach for building trusted relationships with journalists and ensuring spokespeople are genuinely helpful resources rather than reciting thinly veiled pitches.

 - You have a high degree of intellectual curiosity and are energized by building fluency in emerging technology categories and deeply technical and regulated, sensitive topics.

 - You work with urgency, even amid ambiguity and have a track record of building momentum without perfect conditions.



What You Will Do

 - Create a differentiated pipeline of media campaigns, drawing on a combination of internal and external data and developments, customer outcomes, and major industry inflection points.

 - Develop and lead a distinctive US communications strategy that builds Neara’s authority across all relevant stakeholders, establishing Neara as a leading voice in the strategic conversations we care about by clearly identifying and executing opportunities to connect our work to relevant industry shifts, news, and debates.

 - Build and maintain meaningful relationships with journalists and industry voices across the conversations we care about.

 - Cultivate a strong and diverse US spokesperson bench, positioning and coaching spokespeople as compelling, credible, and genuinely useful sources, helping stress-test their POVs, prepare them for interviews, speaking opportunities, etc.

 - Personally brainstorm, write, and pitch stories, contributed op-eds, reactive newsjacking commentary, and other external communications.

 - Build a process to support rapid-response newsjacking that allows time-poor people to contribute useful, differentiated commentary in time-sensitive contexts.

 - Build strong internal cross-functional partnerships to translate your own observations and proprietary insight into timely, externally resonant stories.

 - Curate and distribute news pipeline in which people across the organization should be expected to be conversant.

 - Apply rigorous editorial and reputational judgment, including rejecting content proposed internally that does not qualify as news and claims that require further substantiation.

 - Create clear impact metrics tied to narrative penetration, quality of coverage and strategic influence and relevance.



Who You Are

 - Experience in communications, public relations, or journalism with substantive ownership of media strategy and execution for a high-growth technology, AI, infrastructure or company with similarly complex subject matter.

 - You love to be hands-on personally developing stories, pitching reporters and have been successful securing high-quality coverage in competitive media environments.

 - You are an exceptional writer and editor who can make complex ideas clear and urgent without overstating them.

 - You have strong news judgment and are comfortable challenging senior stakeholders.

 - You have strong commercial instincts and can connect your work to elevating market positioning and pipeline relevance.

 - Extra credit:
   
   - Existing relationships across technology and AI and critical infrastructure media are a strong advantage but most importantly you must clearly show you know how to build them.
   
   - Experience in AI-heavy, critical infrastructure and highly regulated / politically sensitive adjacent subject matter is a plus.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Research Scientist Intern
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. If you’re a software engineer or researcher who’s curious and passionate about Level 4 autonomous driving, we'd like to meet you.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

jobs.title: Head of Data & ML
jobs.description:
ABOUT POSH

We are all social creatures, but the dominant “social” companies today have evolved into digital loneliness machines, driving isolation, anxiety, and mental health challenges around the world.

Human connection is lost. Posh is a beacon guiding us back.

Posh enables anyone to build an IRL community based on shared interests, while connecting consumers with the communities of people just like them. Founded by event organizers who were frustrated with the growing loneliness epidemic and the tools available to build their own event brand, we’ve built the ultimate platform for launching, monetizing, and finding IRL communities of people just like you. In just 6 years, Posh has grown to a team of 70, expanded to 10M+ users, secured $70m in venture funding, and facilitated over $400M in transactions.





ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Head of Data and ML, you will own the entire data function. You’ll be accountable for the technical excellence and vision of the team that builds event discovery for 1M MAUs, the experimentation and measurement that guide product investment, and the data platform the whole company relies on to make decisions.

This is a rare opportunity to lead a unified data organization, providing clear direction and impact across the business. You’ll lead a talented multi-disciplinary team of 8 data scientists, machine learning engineers, and analytics/data engineers. Your job is to keep the team’s bar and vision sharp as Posh scales: choosing the right problems, making sound decisions, and shipping work that moves the product forward.

Your day-to-day will involve:

 - Balancing team leadership with hands-on technical work as a true player-coach

 - Translating a product-oriented vision into a technical roadmap the team believes in

 - Working hands-on in analysis reviews, experiment critiques, model evaluations, and building prototypes yourself when it moves things forward

 - Mentoring senior ICs into leaders and helping mid-level ICs level up

 - Setting a culture of rigor, urgency, and craft across every discipline on the team

This role is in-person 5 days a week at our SoHo, NYC headquarters. Relocation bonuses are available for out-of-state candidates.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Be the technical translation layer: Turn the product vision into focused data and ML bets, and give the team the context to make good calls on their own. When product brings you an idea, you sharpen or debate it, say what’s possible, what it will cost, and what we’ll learn. When something isn’t possible yet, you can explain why and lay out the path to get there. Own the data narrative at All Hands, leadership reviews, and board updates.

 - Build Posh’s discovery and search systems: Advise the team as they build our ranking, recommendation, classification, and search algorithms, from problem framing and baselines to offline evaluation and online testing. Define the metrics that prove discovery is getting better every quarter.

 - Make experimentation a source of truth: Raise the rigor of experiment design, metric selection, and analysis. Bring causal inference to the questions A/B tests can’t answer cleanly, so product and engineering investment follows real evidence. Improve our understanding of ecosystem tradeoffs and marketplace dynamics.

 - Scale the data and ML foundation: improve our data infrastructure, with a focus on AI/ML readiness - from our warehouse to feature pipelines, observability, and evaluation tooling. Make sure every model and AI feature we ship is built on data we trust. Make build-vs-buy calls along the way.

 - Make Posh AI-native with data: rethink how data work gets done now that agents can write SQL and run analyses. Lead data and and cross-functional partners to build the semantic layer and AI-native tools on top of it (text-to-SQL, MCP, agentic analytics), so anyone at Posh can get a trustworthy answer on their own. Measure data adoption and close the gaps.

 - Raise the bar at every level: Set what great looks like across DS, ML, and DE. Give senior ICs room to lead, give mid-level ICs a clear path to their next level, and have hard conversations quickly and with care.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You believe in the importance of real-world human connection and are passionate about our mission to help the world connect more meaningfully in real life.

 - You have 10+ years in data, including 3+ years managing DS, ML, and/or DE teams at a high-growth consumer or marketplace company.

 - You’re a former Staff-level IC who still works like one: senior ICs respect your technical judgment because you can add signal in model review, experiment readouts, and architecture discussions.

 - You’re deep in either causal inference or recommendation/ranking systems, and credible in the other.

 - You’re bullish on AI-native data development. You’ve already changed how you and your team works because of it, and you have a clear view of where data roles, tooling, and team shape are heading.

 - You’ve turned ambiguous product goals into technical roadmaps that shaped critical decisions.

 - You’d rather multiply a strong team than build a large one.


IDEALLY:

 - You have built a semantic layer or AI evaluation frameworks in production.

 - You have entrepreneurial spirit and been part of a 0-1 founding team or a founder yourself.

 - You have worked closely with a founder or CEO who is deeply involved in product, taste, and pace.

About Us:

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Brand Designer to shape how Flexport shows up in the world, from our website and campaigns to the keynote in front of a thousand people. You’ll work directly with our CEO and marketing team to bring our brand, vision, and narrative to life. Your work will be the foundation for the rest of the organization to launch, sell, and grow our business.

What you’ll do

• Turn creative direction into market-ready assets for campaigns, events, and product launches, and hold the quality bar when deadlines get tight.

• Evolve our brand guidelines, templates, and component libraries so teams across Flexport can move quickly while adhering to our brand standards.

• Design brand-forward web experiences with our developers and digital marketers, including pages built in our content management system (CMS), Sanity.

• Build executive presentations, sales decks, and keynote visuals that propel our narrative forward.

• Design and animate short brand videos, product explainers, social motion, and event visuals that help bring our storytelling to life.

• Create custom illustrations, icons, and data visualizations that make complicated logistics ideas clear and simple.

• Deploy artificial intelligence (AI) tools for ideation, image generation, and production. You’ll help us scale using AI and determine the best tools for the best medium.

• Brief and manage outside designers, agencies, and freelancers so their work arrives on time and looks like Flexport.

What you’ll bring

• 5 to 7 years in brand design, visual communication, or a similar creative role, ideally at a fast-moving tech or business-to-business (B2B) company.

• A portfolio with range across identity, campaigns, web, presentations, and motion, showing strong typography, layout, and hierarchy, along with the thinking behind your choices.

• Deep skill in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, comfort in Keynote and Google Slides, and hands-on time with Canva and Claude Design.

• Motion skills in After Effects or a similar tool such as Rive, Lottie, or Jitter, plus the ability to storyboard and direct short video.

• A daily habit of using AI in your creative process, and opinions about where it helps and where it falls short.

• Experience evolving brand guidelines and building templates for people who aren’t designers.

• The project management and communication skills to juggle several workstreams and stakeholders, and the confidence to present your work to executives.

• Experience managing creative vendors or freelancers.

• Working knowledge of HyperText Markup Language (HTML) or a CMS such as Sanity.

jobs.title: Wound Care Nurse LVN – Regional Liaison
jobs.description:
Wound Care LVN – Regional Travel

Skilled Wound Care | Sacramento, CA + Extensive Regional Travel | Full-Time | $75,000 - $90,000 + Quarterly Bonus

Take your wound care passion on the road.

Skilled Wound Care is hiring a Wound Care Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN/LPN) to join our growing team as a Regional Clinical Liaison. We’re a fast-growing mobile surgical wound care physician group, bringing specialized wound care to skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and long-term care communities in new markets across the U.S.

If you’re a wound care nurse who loves meeting new people and wants a job that isn’t tied to one building, this role is for you. You’ll be the link between our wound care physicians and the facilities we serve, helping patients with chronic wounds get specialist care and supporting the nursing teams who care for them every day.

About the Travel

Travel is at the heart of this role. You’ll spend most of your week on the road, not behind a desk.

• Daily regional travel: You’ll drive to multiple skilled nursing facilities across your assigned territory each day.

• Out-of-state travel: You’ll travel as needed to help launch Skilled Wound Care in brand-new markets.

• Overnight stays: Some trips may require overnight stays, especially during new market launches.

If you love variety, exploring new places, and the freedom of working in the field, you’ll feel right at home.

Why You’ll Love This Role

• No two days are the same. You’ll visit different facilities, meet new teams, and see new places every week.

• Help build something new. You’ll be part of the team that brings Skilled Wound Care to new cities and states.

• Share what you know. You’ll support facility staff with wound care education, documentation best practices, and prevention strategies.

• Make a visible difference. You’ll help track healing progress and see the impact as patients get the care they need.

• Build new skills. You’ll learn business development, account management, and healthcare operations, plus get an education stipend toward wound care certifications like WCC.

What You’ll Do

• Partner with assigned SWC wound care physicians to grow full, productive practices in your region

• Travel daily to skilled nursing facilities throughout your territory

• Support wound care education and in-services for SNF nursing staff

• Help collect and report patient healing outcomes and visit data

• Build relationships with skilled nursing facility leadership to open new accounts and grow existing ones

• Coordinate scheduling and logistics for physician visits and procedures

• Support new market launches, including out-of-state travel as needed

• Represent the Skilled Wound Care brand and mission in every facility

• Assist with recruiting top-tier providers

• Meet and exceed growth targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

What You Bring

• Active LVN/LPN license (required)

• Experience in long-term care and wound care (required)

• Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation (required)

• Willingness to travel extensively, including daily regional driving and out-of-state trips with occasional overnight stays (required)

• Proficiency with EMR systems

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Outgoing, organized, and comfortable working independently on the road

• Healthcare sales or account management experience preferred

• Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Management or Business Administration preferred

• Full COVID-19 vaccination required

• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs

Benefits

• $75,000- 90,000 base salary plus quarterly bonus

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Generous 401(k) plan

• Paid time off and holidays

• Life insurance

• Education stipend

About Skilled Wound Care

Skilled Wound Care is proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified for the 4th year in a row. 95% of our employees say it’s a great place to work, 39% higher than the average U.S. company. We were also named to Fortune’s Top 50 Best Small and Medium Workplaces in Health Care.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

NEUTRON

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven execution history with the Electron program. If you’re interested in joining a high performing team, pushing the boundaries with a clean sheet development of re-usable liquid launch vehicle, this is your opportunity!

SENIOR CNC MACHINIST - D SHIFT

Based out of Rocket Lab Headquarters in Long Beach, California the Senior CNC Machinist will maintain, set up and operate the CNC machines to build flight-ready hardware that meet Rocket Lab specification at the needed rate.

• Work with CNC lathe and mill machines

• Read and translate drawings/CAD models

• Provide feedback to improve work instructions

• Work with CNC programmer to maintain tolerances

• Work to reduce any non-conformances found by quality or engineering.

• Provide improvement ideas on batch sizes, setups, tool selection etc.

• Track calibration and maintenance of all equipment and tooling in the area.

• Experience in an Aerospace Manufacturing Environment

• 5-axis CNC operation and setup

• Competent navigating DMG Mori Machines: DMU 50,85,125, NLX 2500-4000

• Experience using Siemens, Fanuc and Celos Controls

• Experience using bar feeders

• Manual Programming

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: Senior Tech Lead Manager
jobs.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting.

 


ROLE DESCRIPTION

We’re seeking a Tech Lead Manager with strong technical leadership, attention to detail, and a passion for scalable system design. In this role, you’ll lead the engineering on one of our product pods. You will be a player-coach. You will be responsible for architecting, scoping, and building systems and features end-to-end, as well as leveraging and developing a team of talented engineers to make a reliable, delightful and valuable product for our customers, to get patients their care as quickly, carefully, and efficiently as possible.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead technical decisions and contribute through coding, technical design, and code review.

 - Coach engineers, give clear feedback, and help hire and grow the team.

 - Collaborate with product and design leads to define new product features.

 - Interact with customers through calls and on-sites to get feedback and represent Tennr.

 - Collaborate with product, sales, and customer success teams to incorporate feedback from customers into the product.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in full-stack or back-end software engineering.

 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and lead junior, mid-level and senior engineers.

 - Proven track record of building and maintaining scalable web applications, in-depth knowledge of distributed systems and service-oriented system design.

 - Clear communication, comfort with ambiguity and hard work, and an interest in improving the healthcare system.

 - Excellent time-management and prioritization skills.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - 3+ years of engineering management experience

 - Professional experience building products on top of LLMs or agent harnesses

 - Professional experience building on top of speech models

 - Professional experience building real-time A/V web systems

 - Professional experience integrating with telephony infrastructure
